chapters.title: Chapter 401: Full Level Golden Swan Skill
paragraphs: Ding Ling felt a slight surprise in his heart.
He did not expect Yang Guo to appear at this moment.
"I wonder how far the World of Divine Condor has progressed."
Based on a few pieces of information:
Yang Guo was observing.
Guo Jing had fought with Zhao Zhijing previously.
Qiu Chuji and Ma Yu were already old.
Calculating like this.
Yang Guo has most likely already become a disciple under Little Dragon Girl of the Ancient Tomb Sect on Zhongnan Mountain!
"Little Dragon Girl."
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows slightly.
This is indeed the most fresh and refined legendary beauty of the Divine Condor World, just not sure exactly what she looks like.
As Ding Ling just arrived in this Divine Eagle World, he was quite curious about this.
But he didn’t have the mindset to explore it.
For him, he’s seen too many beauties. Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, without exception, were stunning beauties with peerless looks.
Even Qu Feiyan, once she grows up and matures, will surely be a lovely, pretty beauty no less than Xiao Qiao.
As for beauties.
Ding Ling had no intention of necessarily meeting them.
He preferred to let things take their natural course.
However, having come to Zhongnan Mountain, Ding Ling thought of the fragment of the Nine Yin Scripture.
If he could obtain this fragment.
The fortune for himself would be not to be underestimated either.
"After I finish watching the martial arts of the Quanzhen Sect, I’ll go find the fragment of the Nine Yin Scripture."
The Nine Yin Scripture fragment is in the secret chamber inside the ancient tomb.
If I go through the ancient tomb.
It would naturally be easier to search.
But Ding Ling was unfamiliar with Little Dragon Girl and her peers, so it wouldn’t be good to disturb them abruptly.
Thus, the only option is to choose that pool.
But Zhongnan Mountain covers a very vast area, and among the vast mountains, finding a pool is quite difficult.
Ding Ling set aside the various thoughts in his heart, left the mountain gate of the Quanzhen Sect, descended Zhongnan Mountain, and let the Ferghana Horse forage on its own nearby.
He then took out a pile of copied Secret Manuals from the Storage Pouch.
Preparing to start watching.
The first Secret Manual.
Was the Quanzhen Swordsmanship.
After looking it over, he placed it aside.
The second was the "Tong Gui Swordsmanship."
He read through it rapidly.
Quickly finished skimming it.
He slightly closed his eyes.
In Ding Ling’s library, a book immediately coalesced.
In an instant.
[Tong Gui Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
All at once, the essence, esoteric truth, principles, and marvels of the swordsmanship flowed throughout his organs and meridians, becoming an instinct.
Making Ding Ling’s mastery of this skill reach the Great Perfection realm in the span of a breath.
"Another superior swordsmanship technique."
Ding Ling recalled scenes from his battle with Qiu Chuji.
It seemed Qiu Chuji had used this Tong Gui Swordsmanship at the time.
And he had cultivated the Tong Gui Swordsmanship to the realm of Transformation.
Unfortunately. His inner strength was insufficient, and his physical quality far inferior to Ding Ling’s.
He also didn’t have the Breathing Technique to support him.
And was easily crushed and killed by Ding Ling.
Clang, clang, clang!

Ding Ling used his finger as a sword, and saw Sword Qi burst erratically from his fingertip, the practices were ruthless, completely disregarding his own safety, with a stance of perishing together and fighting for life.
"The swordsmanship is good. But it’s not suitable for me."
Ding Ling wouldn’t be foolish enough to perish together with someone else.
He has the Divine Skill Automatic Full Level cheats, as long as he holds steady, he is sure to soar!
"But it’s still very good for enhancing foundation and increasing physical quality."
Ding Ling could sense his own strength, speed, and vitality had increased significantly.
This feeling gave him great pleasure.
He continued flipping through the Secret Manuals.
The next was "One Qi Transforms the Three Pristine Ones."
Soon read through.
A book immediately coalesced in the library.
In the blink of an eye.
[One Qi Transforms the Three Pristine Ones Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
This is clearly also a peerless swordsmanship.
Ding Ling opened his eyes, a gleam of light shot out, he used his finger again as a sword to perform it.

In the void, Sword Qi seemed to condense and very quickly split into three; as Ding Ling continuously pierced out, in the void, a full eighteen swords were thrust out, each sword splitting into three shadows, making the sword shadows in the void densely packed, seemingly ready to rain down at any time.
Ding Ling nodded secretly, it was a very good superior swordsmanship.
In terms of attack power and speed, it could be considered top-notch.
Unfortunately.
In the Quanzhen Sect, it seemed that no one could cultivate this swordsmanship to instantly thrust eighteen swords, each sword splitting into three shadows!
Having cultivated to this level.
It would be truly fearful to ghosts and gods.

Ding Ling’s physical qualities were extremely high, able to withstand the backlash after rapidly executing this swordsmanship, so he was unharmed, but other martial arts experts might not be the same.
After all, they don’t have Breathing Technique to assist in body refining.
"Continue."
Ding Ling’s spirit lightly stirred.
The Quanzhen Sect’s techniques were indeed extraordinary.

It truly lives up to its name as a renowned top-tier sect of the current world. Unfortunately, after Wang Chongyang, the disciples of the Quanzhen Sect became more useless with each generation, or else, it absolutely wouldn’t have declined to the point of having almost no presence in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World!
"This is a Lightweight Skill."
Ding Ling flipped through a Secret Manual.
Soon.
[Golden Swan Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
This is definitely a high-tier superior Lightweight Skill!
Ding Ling took a deep breath.

Using a special Vigorous Qi to activate the Golden Swan Skill, with a slight movement, he remarkably rose three zhang high, walked several dozen steps in the air, meandered and turned several times before elegantly landing.
"What a Lightweight Skill!"
Before Ding Ling could say anything, a voice suddenly came from one side.
Ding Ling followed the sound and saw a tall, handsome young man quickly running towards his position.
As he got closer.
It became clear to see his face, it seemed that this person looked about seventeen or eighteen, with a slender and handsome face, full of vigor, truly a fine-looking gentleman.
He was now full of excitement and joy.
From a distance, he was shouting loudly:
"Hero, great man! Please don’t leave."
Ding Ling was surprised and turned his head.
He had just come to this world and didn’t know anyone outside the Quanzhen Sect.
This person seemed to know him?
Could he be a player?
But thinking that players couldn’t arrive in the World of Divine Condor so soon, a thought suddenly struck him, thinking of someone.
He calmly and unhurriedly put the Secret Manuals he had read back into the Storage Pouch.
Some that he hadn’t finished reading, he temporarily held them in his arms.
He didn’t expect the Golden Swan Skill to be so amazing.
No.
To be accurate.
His integrated Vigorous Qi had grown stronger again, once activated by this Qi, even ordinary martial arts could strike effortlessly with great power!
Not to mention this first-class superior Lightweight Skill, once activated by this Qi, would certainly surpass other martial arts experts’ practice and use by far.
It’s easy to understand.
The same Kung Fu, in different people’s hands, will definitely exert different power.
Da, da!
The young man quickly ran to Ding Ling’s front, showed a look of admiration and reverence towards Ding Ling, and then hurriedly offered his respects.
Ding Ling had some ideas in his mind but pretended to raise an eyebrow and asked:
"Who are you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 402: Yang Guo
paragraphs: "I am Yang Guo, a disciple of the Ancient Tomb Sect."
Indeed, it is Yang Guo.
Ding Ling sized Yang Guo up with a couple of glances.
This young man has certainly grown into a fine figure, genuinely dignified and upright!
His person possesses a phoenix demeanor and dragon grace, his spirit is elegant and outstanding, truly a rare beauty among men.
No wonder Little East Evil, Guo Xiang, would be captivated for life at first sight; he leaves a deep impression on those who gaze upon him.
"What brings you to me?"
Ding Ling inquired.
"I wish to invite you to visit the Ancient Tomb Sect as my guest."
Yang Guo, fearing Ding Ling might misunderstand, solemnly explained:

"You might not be aware, but I harbor a deep grudge against the Quanzhen Sect’s Lul Qingdu, Hao Datong, and others. You avenged me, cleansing the shame. I cannot find words to express my gratitude, so I would like to first invite you to the Ancient Tomb Sect for a meal before discussing other matters."
He pleaded:
"I hope you won’t decline or refuse."
His eyes blazed as he gazed at Ding Ling:
"I hold nothing back, speaking sincerely from the heart, with absolutely no falsehoods or deception. I earnestly invite you to the Ancient Tomb Sect so I can properly host you..."
He seemed afraid Ding Ling would disagree.
He poured out an unending river of words, referencing text and citations, speaking on and on.
Ding Ling glanced sideways, musing:
"Yang Guo indeed has a glib tongue, clever and witty, able to speak at length without pausing. If I continue to refuse, he might talk until nightfall."
Yang Guo clearly was not someone to give up easily.
Ding Ling did not agree.
He persistently continued to plead, earnestly and eagerly gazing at Ding Ling.
His intense gaze seemed as if to melt Ding Ling.
Causing Ding Ling to get goosebumps, he coughed dryly:
"Alright. Say no more. I’ll go!"
Thinking of the Nine Yin Scripture Fragment accessible through the tomb’s secret chamber, it seemed more convenient and time-saving.
Ding Ling formed the idea of exploring the Ancient Tomb Sect.
Finding a pond alone amidst these vast mountains proved challenging.
Not to mention the time, effort, and mental drain.
Given his tense relations with the Quanzhen Sect now,

there would certainly be many Daoists watching him from the shadows. Ding Ling intended to search the pond and explore the tomb’s secret chamber, a discreet task, yet if watched from afar by Quanzhen Sect Daoists he remained unaware, how could it be called a secret?
Moreover,
he had come to terms with Ma Yu and others. At this point, returning to Quanzhen Sect was inadvisable, to prevent further disputes.
The Secret Manual Ma Yu had provided was genuine.
If it were false.
Ding Ling would naturally have reason to revisit Quanzhen Sect, but since it was real, he had already promised, and it didn’t suit him to renege now.
Had Ma Yu been wicked and harbored murderous intent, Ding Ling would surely act preemptively.
Naturally, he wouldn’t abide by any Jianghu code or promises.
Yet the issue was Ma Yu had always been extremely respectful, vigilant, and cautious.
Ding Ling wouldn’t kill without reason.
This was secondary.
The main issue was Ding Ling thought the task time-consuming and exhausting.
Now, since he intended to go to the tomb. He might as well resolve the matter.
With this thought, Ding Ling joined Yang Guo in heading towards the Ancient Tomb Sect.
Along the way.
Yang Guo chatted avidly, full of enthusiasm, clearly enjoying the discussion.
Ding Ling occasionally chimed in, finding his interaction with Yang Guo quite pleasant.
Midway.
Ding Ling spotted a Daoist observing him from a distance.
If not for his profound skill and exceptional vision, he might not have noticed the Daoist concealed amongst the thorns.
The Daoist apparently realized he had been spotted by Ding Ling, panicking and yelling, fled frantically, disappearing in the blink of an eye.
Ding Ling furrowed his brow in thought.
Scanning the surroundings.
In the distance, faint figures could be seen in all directions.
He shouted:
"Get lost!"
Ang!
Roar!

The Lion’s Roar displayed its power, startling countless birds in the mountains to flutter into the sky. Some Quanzhen Sect disciples watching Ding Ling’s movements from hiding were also petrified, turning pale and retreating back to their sect.
Ding Ling observed this without much thought.
He simply disliked being stared at by these Quanzhen Sect disciples.
But even if now no one watched him.
Searching for the pond without detection.
Ding Ling had no desire to search.
Taking the shortcut instead of a winding path.
How idle could one be?
How foolish?
With this in mind, Ding Ling further resolved to confess this matter to Yang Guo upon entering the tomb, treating access to the secret chamber as compensation.
After all, even if not mentioned.
Following the plot, Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl would eventually learn the Nine Yin Scripture Fragment.
The main point is that many people in this world know the Nine Yin Scripture, and this fragment is not some secret tradition, there’s no need to hide it.
Honestly speaking,
Yang Guo would cooperate better with him.
"What kind of Kung Fu is this?"
Yang Guo witnessed Ding Ling’s shout echoing through the skies, his proximity nearly shattered his eardrums, and he was stunned.
This was because Ding Ling’s soundwave aimed at the Quanzhen Sect disciples.
Had it been directed straight at him.
Wouldn’t he be deafened in an instant, becoming completely deaf?
Just imagining it.
Yang Guo couldn’t help but feel even more reverent.
"Lion’s Roar."
"Shaolin Temple’s Buddhist Lion’s Roar?!"
Yang Guo gaped in awe.
"Seems your knowledge is not shallow either."
Ding Ling was surprised:
"You mentioned you spent these past years living in the tomb, right?"
"But I spent over a decade mingling in the mundane world."
Yang Guo laughed:

"Moreover, I also lived on Peach Blossom Island. During that time, I listened daily to Uncle Guo and Lady Guo discussing various martial arts in the land, and happened to hear about this Lion’s Roar Divine Skill Secret Technique. I hadn’t expected the technique to be so powerful, truly stunning."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"Would you like to learn it?"
"What?"
Yang Guo was shaken, eyes wide looking at Ding Ling:
"You want to teach me, hero?"
"What martial arts do you know?"
Ding Ling did not answer but asked instead.
Yang Guo candidly responded:
"I was once taught Toad Skill by my foster father, later joined the Quanzhen Sect, memorized some Profound Skill Heart Method Mantras, but didn’t learn any martial arts..."
He concluded:
"The martial arts I’m most proficient in now must be those of the Ancient Tomb Sect."
Upon finishing, he looked at Ding Ling:
"What did the hero intend?"

"If you don’t mind, you could exchange your Toad Skill for my Lion’s Roar and Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique. I’ve heard you praising my hammer technique all along the way, claiming that it’s what men truly ought to learn among martial arts skills. Now I give you the opportunity. Can you seize it?"
Ding Ling did not particularly care about exchanging skills.
After all, these skills were not exclusively his to know.
Li Yuanba had penned the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique for Zuo Lengchan; it’s hard to say he hadn’t shared it with Li Shimin and others either.
Since many people would know it.

After all, these skills were not exclusively his to know.
Li Yuanba had penned the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique for Zuo Lengchan; it’s hard to say he hadn’t shared it with Li Shimin and others either.
Since many people would know it.

chapters.title: Chapter 403: Full Level Toad Skill
paragraphs: Ding Ling naturally wouldn’t hide anything.
He was quite eager to exchange for the Unparalleled True Skill, Toad Skill.
"This..."

Yang Guo hesitated a bit; without Aunt’s permission, he wouldn’t easily teach Ancient Tomb Sect’s martial arts. Moreover, the Toad Skill belonged to his adoptive father. Would it be inappropriate to teach it rashly?
"He is your adoptive father. This means the Toad Skill can be considered your family heritage. Whether you want to teach it or not, it’s all within your discretion."
Ding Ling reminded him.
Yang Guo suddenly realized and decisively said:
"I agree to the exchange!"
He hesitated:
"Would exchanging two skills for one be inappropriate? Let’s do one skill for one skill."
He didn’t want to take advantage of his benefactor.
Thinking of what Ding Ling had done for him, he blushed, feeling embarrassed:
"Logically speaking, hero, you avenged me, and I should give the Toad Skill to you for free, but... but..."
But he truly admired, envied, and was astonished by the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique, a skill for true men!
The scenes where Ding Ling wielded the Drumming Golden Hammer, sweeping across the Quanzhen Sect, were almost etched into Yang Guo’s mind.
He thought he might never forget them!
This made him extremely envious and eager to learn the hammer technique.
Now there’s a chance to learn.
He was overjoyed, excited, his blood began to boil!
Ding Ling, who was full level in acting and Observing People Skill, naturally noticed Yang Guo’s thoughts and immediately said:
"No problem. If you encounter any superior true skill techniques in the future, you can repay me with another skill."
Looking through the entire "Divine Condor" book.
It can be seen that Yang Guo is arrogant and unruly, cunning, chivalrous, and has a considerable view of the overall situation.
Such a person, his personality may have flaws, but overall, he is better than many in the world and worth trusting, investing in.
Of course, at Ding Ling’s level, he doesn’t need to invest in anyone.
He just felt that Yang Guo had good luck, and if by chance he obtained some Divine Skill Secret Manual, Yang Guo was unlikely to go back on today’s agreement.
Yang Guo, unaware of his arduous life, often turning crises into opportunities, heard Ding Ling’s words and doubted he would obtain any superior techniques.
But after Ding Ling repeated it several times.
He no longer refused.
Started the skill exchange with Ding Ling.
He led Ding Ling to a deserted place and began explaining the Toad Skill.
As Ding Ling emphasized, he only needed to recite the Mantra Technique and demonstrate the moves, without needing Yang Guo’s explanation.
Therefore.
Yang Guo demonstrated quickly.
Mere moments.
He recited and demonstrated everything.
He looked at Ding Ling.

Only to see Ding Ling slightly closing his eyes, moments later, tides of Primordial Qi in the heavens and earth converged towards Ding Ling’s location, visibly, Ding Ling’s aura becoming more profound, inscrutable.
Yang Guo was astounded, unable to believe what he saw.
Especially after Ding Ling got up and demonstrated a set of techniques, Yang Guo was utterly shocked.
"Hero, you, you..."
He was so overwhelmed that he stuttered, unable to complete a sentence.
He was articulate, but this was his reaction.
It showed just how tumultuous his mind was!
"What an amazing Toad Skill."
Ding Ling praised.
Just now.
The bookshelf in the library condensed related books of the "Toad Skill."
Then, instantly.
[Toad Skill Inner Power Heart Technique Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
Ding Ling’s Inner Power Value increased.
That was just the beginning.
Almost simultaneously.
[Toad Skill External Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
This Toad Skill was evidently a superior martial art considered first-class and top-tier, rare for both inner and external skill simultaneous cultivation.
Inner skill cultivates inner power.
External skill cultivates moves.

This move looked peculiar requires assuming a toad-like crouching position on the ground. When fully charged, it can shoot out like a cannonball, its palms striking ferociously, swiftly, with extreme dominance!
Clearly.
Yang Guo inherited from West Poison Ouyang Feng; this set of Toad Skill didn’t cut any corners and was remarkable.
But looking at Yang Guo now, it was apparent he was undertrained in Toad Skill, only superficially mastering its inner and external skills.
"Hero."
Yang Guo straightened his strained head and asked in shock:
"Have you learned Toad Skill before?"
"No."
"So you just learned it now?!"
"Correct."
"Hiss."
Yang Guo gasped in disbelief, gritted his teeth:

"Hero, your talent is truly remarkable, your comprehension extraordinary. I always thought my talent was good, but in front of you, hero, I’m completely overshadowed, like a firefly to the bright moon, utterly unbeatable and minuscule. Ashamed, truly ashamed!"
Ding Ling smiled faintly, noncommittal.
He couldn’t explain having cheats.
He didn’t intend to explain, just attributed it to his extraordinary talent. After all, he had grown used to the admiration.
With Yang Guo’s compliments.
He now felt as calm as water, with no ripple at all.
Habit formed from hearing it a lot.
He was truly numb.
Initially, he would blush, feel shy.
Then he thought of himself as unworthy, undeserving.
Later, he charged down the road of thick skin!
Now.
His thickness of face wasn’t as impervious as castle walls but was beyond what it used to be.
Yang Guo’s praise felt like a gentle breeze, not stirring any feeling, he sighed internally, thinking:
"Looks like my thick-skinned skill has reached the Transformation Realm! In a few more years, perhaps I truly would consider myself an unparalleled genius!"
However, it didn’t affect his lifelong pursuit, instead, it benefited him. As he aspired for Immortal Dao, having a thick skin helps in learning and apprenticeship!
"Hero. To what extent have you mastered Toad Skill?"
After praising Ding Ling fiercely, Yang Guo saw Ding Ling expressionless, embodying the look of ’I’m tired of hearing this,’ his eye twitched, realizing:
This hero likely grew up in an environment filled with praise, flattery, admiration. My commendations seemed ordinary, leaving him numb, was natural.
Thinking thus.
Yang Guo admired, was envious, and felt awe toward Ding Ling.
Being powerful was fine.
The talent being overwhelming was absurd!
Little wonder at such a young age, with a mere hammer, he could overthrow the Quanzhen Sect.
With such extraordinary talent, Yang Guo couldn’t compare!
Reflecting on it.
Yang Guo felt somewhat dispirited, saddened, the discrepancy was so vast, he felt like a nobody.
This feeling... wasn’t pleasant.
Ding Ling saw it, didn’t offer much comfort. Would he comfort others every occurrence of this nature?
He was disinclined to comfort, merely said casually:
"Perfect mastery, innate in instinct."
"Hiss."
Yang Guo gasped again, seeing Ding Ling expressionless, automatically silent, awkwardly laughed:
"Hero, you are indeed extraordinary. How did you cultivate it?"
"Just watching you demonstrate. Then I mastered it."
"Just like that?"
Yang Guo was dumbfounded.
"Just like that."
Ding Ling nodded affirmatively.
Yang Guo felt Ding Ling was playing him, but recalling the scenes just witnessed.

chapters.title: Chapter 404: Ancient Tomb Sect
paragraphs: Yang Guo couldn’t help but take a deep breath, nodding in agreement:
"The hero is truly unrivaled and unpredictable to the extreme. In my view, if the world’s people have ten units of talent, the hero would monopolize nine of them."
The gap is indeed heaven-defying.
Yang Guo could hardly believe that such a person exists in this world!
Too frightening!

He had practiced the Toad Skill for some years now, but because its posture was truly ugly and unrefined, and he had to practice the Ancient Tomb Sect’s martial arts day and night, the Toad Skill had been neglected for a long time.
But even though neglected, he would still practice it occasionally.
Calculating the time he spent learning, it also amounts to years.
Comparing to Ding Ling.
The feeling of disparity arises instantly.
Yang Guo originally felt proud and believed he had extraordinary talent, but at this moment, he was quite affected, thinking to himself:
"The hero is so outstanding, with such high talent, yet without excessive arrogance and pride. I should learn from him."
As he thought this way, his whole demeanor became much more composed at that moment.
People are like this; when they have the power of an exemplary figure, they unconsciously undergo some extremely subtle and peculiar transformations!
Ding Ling seemed to be aware of this and didn’t waste words, directly teaching Yang Guo the techniques of the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique and Lion’s Roar.
Although Yang Guo had an uncommon aptitude, surpassing ordinary people.

Yet facing these two extremely difficult techniques, he was also overwhelmed, listening to Ding Ling’s explanation for quite a while, still unable to grasp the technique, and thinking about the time Ding Ling spent practicing the Toad Skill, Yang Guo was quite discouraged.
However, considering the Ancient Tomb Sect’s martial arts, he himself had practiced them for several years and still hadn’t reached the state of mastery.
He understood that this was normal.
The Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique and Lion’s Roar were such profound and wondrous martial arts, how could they be learned in a short period?
After realizing this.
He didn’t rush, and said at the moment:
"Hero, I see it’s getting late. Why not return to the Ancient Tomb Sect with me first?"
Ding Ling agreed.
On the way, Ding Ling mentioned the issue of addressing each other, suggesting that they should simply call each other’s names.
At first, Yang Guo was a bit embarrassed, feeling it somewhat disrespectful.
Later, Ding Ling insisted.
Yang Guo also became more relaxed.
Not long after.
They arrived at the entrance of a tomb.
"This is the Ancient Tomb Sect’s location."
Yang Guo pointed to a portal at the tomb in front:
"Entering this portal leads to our Ancient Tomb Sect."
Yang Guo began to introduce the Ancient Tomb Sect.
He focused on the characteristics of the Ancient Tomb Sect.
Ding Ling memorized this in his heart, thinking:

"What Yang Guo said is indeed very consistent with some scenes from the TV series. The internal structure of the Ancient Tomb Sect is extremely complex and exquisite. If ordinary people do not know the method and enter, getting lost is a minor issue; triggering some mechanisms and being trapped and captured could be problematic. Although I am proficient in array techniques, I initially need Yang Guo to lead the way."
Ding Ling followed Yang Guo into the interior of the Ancient Tomb Sect.
The first thing in view was a deep, narrow passageway.
The passage seemed endless, at a glance, as if no end could be seen.

Ding Ling couldn’t help but praise: Wang Chongyang built this Living Dead Tomb to resist the Jin Soldiers, indeed remarkable; I wonder how much effort Wang Chongyang put in back then to create today’s extensive tomb.
Tap, tap!
The roads within the tomb were winding.
Yang Guo led Ding Ling through twists and turns, arriving at a hidden chamber, roughly fifty square meters in size, connected to several other hidden chambers.
The air was thick with the smell of smoke.
The right side of the hidden chamber had some bowls, utensils, and cooking implements.
Under the faint candlelight, Ding Ling saw the walls on one side were completely blackened.
Evidently, Yang Guo cooked here often.
"Hero, Ding Ling..."
Yang Guo almost blurted out the word hero again, but realized and called the name, seeing Ding Ling looking over, scratched his head, chuckled sheepishly, and said:
"Our Ancient Tomb Sect is like this, a bit simple and shabby, don’t mind it."
"No."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"If martial artists can’t endure some hardship, what martial arts are they learning?"
"Ding Ling, you’re not much older than me, having such high understanding. No wonder you’ve cultivated such astonishing martial arts."
Yang Guo admired and said that, pointing to the left, and continued:

"The left side is where my aunt and I live, the right side used to be Granny Sun’s place. Ding Ling, if you don’t mind, you can stay on the right for now, and after discussing with my aunt, you can live with us there. There’s a Cold Jade Bed there that’s very effective. I think you’ll like it."
As Yang Guo was speaking.
Unexpectedly, at this moment, from the corridor on the left came a sound with a few clear notes:
"Guo’Er. Have you returned?"
"Aunt.
Yang Guo said with excitement:
"Come quickly, I’ll introduce a hero to you."
"What hero?"
The voice was faintly distant, like celestial music drifting in the air, yet it had a hint of worldly coldness; hearing this unexpectedly, even someone like Ding Ling couldn’t help but shiver!
As he followed the sound and looked in its direction, he thought to himself:
"Such ethereal, cold, yet immortal-like voice, truly the first time I’ve heard it, so extraordinary. Ancient Tomb Sect, Aunt... it must be the Little Dragon Girl."
Thinking of the Little Dragon Girl.
Ding Ling couldn’t help but brighten his eyes slightly.
This was the goddess in the hearts of many netizens!

Back when Ding Ling was an ordinary person, he also viewed Little Dragon Girl as a goddess; however, time has passed, and he has experienced too much, his mindset has undergone a radical transformation.
The person remains the same.
But his attitude has completely changed.
No longer would he have the reverent mindset that truly views women as goddesses.
Tap, tap!
A series of extremely slight footsteps sounded.
Clearly, the newcomer had exceptional lightweight skill, undoubtedly unmatched.
In the dim candlelight.
Ding Ling’s gaze was piercing as he quickly discerned the newcomer’s appearance.
Unexpectedly, the newcomer appeared to be around sixteen to seventeen years old, seemingly much younger than Yang Guo, with a face as bright as light, incredibly beautiful!
She seemed as ethereal as the Gushe Fairy!
Her divine elegance, ice-like skin, and jade-like bones were not enough to describe even part of her beauty.
Indeed, like a female immortal descended to the mortal world, her beauty was enough to make ordinary women lose their color.
"This..."
Ding Ling was moved.
This was a top-tier beauty whose looks were not inferior to Diao Chan!
Diao Chan was charming and spirited;
This young girl’s aura from head to toe was one of cold, unearthly beauty, untouched by the mortal world.
This kind of temperament was truly rare. Ding Ling, upon first glance, was almost unable to take his eyes off.
Fortunately, his character was extraordinary, distinct from the past.

chapters.title: Chapter 405: Innate Skill Full Level
paragraphs: Ding Ling regained his senses in the blink of an eye.
He mused to himself:
"No wonder Yin Zhiping fell for Little Dragon Girl at first sight. Even I almost couldn’t resist, let alone other men."
Ding Ling prided himself on having encountered many beautiful women.
He had even been served and attended to by peerless beauties like Diao Chan and Da and Xiao Qiao, developing a strong resistance to unparalleled beauty!

Yet, even so, upon first seeing Little Dragon Girl, Ding Ling couldn’t help but be dazzled, feeling a breathtaking sensation in his heart. He thought to himself that ordinary women truly paled in comparison to this woman.
"Auntie, this is the hero."
Yang Guo ran over, pulling Little Dragon Girl along. He pointed at Ding Ling, his face animated with excitement as he said:
"Auntie, you didn’t see, let me tell you..."
Yang Guo began to recount, in great detail, the grand deeds Ding Ling accomplished at the Quanzhen Sect.
He spoke of how Ding Ling, with a Drumming Golden Hammer, overturned the Celestial Spirit North Dipper Array, causing countless Daoist priests to become souls under his hammer.
Little Dragon Girl couldn’t help but be subtly moved, her ever-cold eyes seemed involuntarily to glance at the Drumming Golden Hammer in Ding Ling’s hand.
When he mentioned Ding Ling using a single hammer strike to kill Qiu Chuji.
Little Dragon Girl’s almond eyes widened.
Upon describing the swift kills of Hao Datong and Sunx Bu’er.
Little Dragon Girl’s gaze towards Ding Ling grew more nuanced.
"...Ding Ling truly did what I’ve long wanted to do but dared not!"
Yang Guo’s voice was intense, his emotions evidently reaching a fever pitch:
"He killed Hao Datong, avenging Granny Sunx. Auntie, we must treat him well and thank him."
Upon the mention of avenging Granny Sunx.
Little Dragon Girl sighed softly, almost imperceptibly. However, she quickly returned to her expressionless and cool demeanor:
"You did well. But Ding Ling is not a member of our Ancient Tomb Sect, and he cannot stay long. This is the rule of our school, and I cannot change it."
Little Dragon Girl spent her days with Yang Guo.
Proximity breeds influence.
Over the years.
Evidently, she has been greatly influenced!

The whole person, though still exuding an extreme coolness, when she spoke, she had a vitality, letting people know the person in front of them was someone of the Mortal World, not some unattainable Immortal Fairy from above.
"I understand."
Yang Guo smiled and said:
"It’s impossible for Ding Ling to stay long in our Ancient Tomb Sect. We..."
Before he finished speaking.
He heard a rumbling sound.
Yang Guo followed the sound and identified the source, only to see Little Dragon Girl seemingly oblivious, while he himself felt awkward, blushed, and ashamed:
"At that time, I only thought of inviting this hero Ding Ling to our Ancient Tomb Sect, but I forgot to buy food. Auntie, you and Ding Ling wait here. I’ll go buy it now."
Yang Guo acted with Thunderous Wind.
Without waiting for Little Dragon Girl to say two sentences.
He rushed out again in a hurry.
Ding Ling originally wanted to lend the storage pouch to Yang Guo temporarily, but seeing him already using his Lightweight Body Technique, disappearing in a flash, he could only drop the idea.
For a time.
In the vast Ancient Tomb Sect.
Only Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl were left.
After ’big eyes staring at small eyes’ for a moment.

Little Dragon Girl seemed a bit embarrassed, or to put it precisely, she was at a loss, not knowing how to entertain the guest, she just blinked her cool shimmering eyes a few times at Ding Ling, said ’you, you’, but couldn’t find the words, and seemed to give up as if self-abandoning, saying:
"Do as you please."
After speaking, she turned and flew away.
In no time, she vanished without a trace.

Ding Ling quickly stepped forward, pursuing, only to find the tunnel ahead winding endlessly, not knowing how deep it went nor how many paths there were, with no sign of Little Dragon Girl to be found anywhere.
"This Little Dragon Girl doesn’t seem that difficult to approach either."
Ding Ling mused:
"If it were a few years ago, perhaps Little Dragon Girl was the most difficult to approach, because back then, her only companion was Granny Sunx, alongside endless darkness, solitude, and coldness.
Anyone in such an environment for a long time would become reclusive and indifferent.
Yet these years with Yang Guo around, it seems she’s become more humane, more aware of some worldly principles.
However, Yang Guo himself is not that old, and he doesn’t know much about worldly principles.
Compared to Little Dragon Girl, perhaps he just understands a tiny bit more.
With two such innocents together.
Even if they share worldly principles with each other, how much can they truly understand?"
Ding Ling was relieved.
He did not blame Little Dragon Girl for not greeting him.
After all, everyone knew Little Dragon Girl was such a person.
So much that she doesn’t even know she needs to pay when buying a bun after coming down the mountain! One can imagine how barren her world is.
Yang Guo hadn’t mentioned this matter to her, likely not even guessing his aunt would be troubled over a mere penny upon descending the mountain!
"Better continue practicing martial arts."
Under the faint candlelight, Ding Ling took out one secret manual after another.
And continued to peruse them.
After flipping through one volume.
Soon.
[Frost-Breaking Palm Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
This too was a high-tier palm technique.
Ding Ling flipped his wrist and struck forward, whereupon palm shadows filled the void like a sudden snowstorm, with endless might!
This palm technique belonged to the Ice Attribute.
Although Ding Ling’s Pure Yang True Qi couldn’t perfectly unleash its power, he could still activate about seventy to eighty percent of its effect using the Breathing Technique.
The Breathing Technique in this regard was indiscriminate.
Whether Yin Attribute or Yang Attribute cultivation techniques, the Breathing Technique could activate them, achieving over sixty to seventy percent of its effect!
In this respect, it surpassed Inner Power manifold.
Of course, the advantages of Inner Power are not something the Breathing Technique can compare with.
Ding Ling continued to flip through the secret manuals.
The next one turned out to be "Innate Skill"!
"Innate Skill."
Ding Ling paused slightly.
This was indeed the top supreme skill practiced by Wang Chongyang.
Rumor has it, once practiced, it generates Innate True Qi, though he didn’t know the truth of it.
Ding Ling examined it carefully.
He soon finished reading.
As a book solidified in the library.
[Innate Skill Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
Whoosh!
Swirling Primordial Qi surged in.
Drowning Ding Ling.
After a period of time.
Ding Ling quietly sensed and comprehended.
He found that this Innate Skill was indeed different from the Toad Skill Inner Power Heart Method, the qi generated was indeed endless and highly resilient True Qi.
This True Qi.
Even Pure Yang True Water couldn’t draw or refine it, leaving it to roam through his meridians and dantian.
Ding Ling’s Innate Skill had already reached Full Level.
His control power over Innate True Qi had reached the Transformation Realm.
He operated the Innate Skill.
Converging this mass of Innate True Qi in his dantian, placing it next to the Pure Yang True Water.
Though this Innate True Qi was discordant with the six drops of Pure Yang True Water.
Yet they were distinctly separated.
No significant conflict occurred between them.
Ding Ling observed this, his brows slightly furrowed, thinking:
"This Innate True Qi and Pure Yang True Water are both quite gentle in nature, so they don’t conflict much. But if I learn something volatile like the Sunflower Manual in the future.
It is utterly impossible to perfectly integrate these various qis.
It will be troublesome.
Thusly,
In choosing the next Inner Power Heart Method, if it’s a top Heart Technique,
I must be cautious in my selection."
Ding Ling had a vague feeling.
If he chooses the correct cultivation technique.
All these True Qi and True Water will be used by him, and when unleashed together, that must be the moment when his Divine Skill reaches Great Success.

chapters.title: Chapter 406: Culinary Competition
paragraphs: And now.
Pure Yang True Water and Innate True Qi do not interfere with each other, but Ding Ling cannot simultaneously operate both true powers, so he can only use one type of True Qi at a time.
This does not greatly affect Ding Ling.
Because he knows that top divine skills like the Innate Skill are rare in this world.
As long as he collects enough Inner Power Heart Methods.
The quantity of True Water will continue to increase, and his progress can still be rapid.
After reading the Innate Skill.
Ding Ling continued to browse other secret manuals.
These secret manuals also contained several superior Sword Techniques and Palm Techniques.
Ultimately, they increased Ding Ling’s four-dimensional attributes as follows:
[Strength +0.6]
[Agility +0.8]
[Constitution +0.6]
The increase in agility was somewhat greater.
Because these Sword Techniques and Palm Techniques significantly boost attack speed.
Ding Ling glanced at the character panel:
[Root Bone 2 (ordinary people count as 1 point), Wisdom 3, Strength 41.3, Agility 41.7, Constitution 41.3, Defense 40, Charm 11.7.]
Strength, agility, and other attributes have increased quite a bit.
As of now.
Operating the Breathing Technique to activate martial arts, paired with over four thousand pounds of strength, high agility, and high endurance.
To say Ding Ling is a destructive force on the battlefield is not an exaggeration.
However, Ding Ling remains quite calm about it.
After all, he has experienced too much carnage and has long been accustomed to sweeping through everything on the battlefield.
"I wonder if my current martial arts cultivation, combined with the Breathing Technique and other skills, can effortlessly crush Huang Laoxie and Guo Jing."
Ding Ling is unsure in his heart.
But he feels that surpassing Guo Jing should not be difficult.
"Once my strength cultivation reaches the pinnacle of this world and there’s no further progress, and after completing the glory task of the Path of the War God, I’ll leave this world."
Ding Ling thinks like this.
He continues to browse some Inner Power Heart Methods and Sword and Palm Techniques.
Since most of them are second-rate and third-rate Inner Powers and Palm Techniques.
They did not bring Ding Ling any increase in attribute points.
They only deepened his foundation considerably.
Ding Ling can clearly perceive that after reading the dozens of second-rate and third-rate secret manuals, his control over the fused Vigorous Qi has improved greatly.
Previously, due to over-cultivating a Medical Saint Breathing Technique and the enhancement of his physical quality, the power of the fused Vigorous Qi surged.
He was almost unable to control it at one point.
But with the improvement of his foundation now.
Ding Ling has become much more adept at controlling this Vigorous Qi.
Hoo!
Ding Ling took a long breath and, with a wave of his hand, stored all the secret manuals into his storage pouch.
This time’s gain from the Quanzhen Sect allowed him to advance further.
It became much clearer to him how to navigate the path in this world.
He only needs to continuously collect secret manuals.

"Once Yang Guo returns, we’ll go find that secret chamber. I remember it should be the place where the coffins are placed. And as far as this ancient tomb goes, there seems to be only that one place where coffins are kept."
Ding Ling thinks like this.
He then begins to slowly adjust his breathing.
Carrying the Drumming Golden Hammer proved inconvenient, so he put it into his storage pouch.
With the inclusion of this hammer, the interior of the storage pouch instantly felt ’cramped.’
Ding Ling ponders secretly:
"Once I have enough Achievement Medals, I must buy a larger storage pouch!"
So it is necessary to earn more Achievement Medals.
That way, he won’t be unable to afford any treasures he comes across in the future.
As for how much time has passed, who knows.
Tap, tap!
Accompanied by the sound of hurried footsteps.
The person hasn’t arrived yet.
But Yang Guo’s voice comes first:
"Ding Ling, Gugu..."
Ding Ling looks in the direction of the voice and sees that it is indeed Yang Guo who has returned carrying several bags.
He has a bundle of firewood under his arm, clearly well-prepared this time.
He walks into the room, glances around, first greets Ding Ling, and then asks:
"Where is my Gugu?"
"She left after you did."
Ding Ling replies calmly.
Yang Guo smiles somewhat awkwardly:
"My Gugu is very kind and gentle, but she rarely interacts or communicates with outsiders, so she doesn’t know much about the ways of the world. Ding Ling, I hope you can bear with her."
"It’s no hardship at all."
Ding Ling smiles slightly:
"Alright, go cook then."
"Alright."
Yang Guo rubs his hands together and laughs:

"My cooking skills are pretty impressive. My Gugu usually only eats honey and the food I cook. She says it’s delicious! I guarantee Ding Ling, you’ll definitely find your appetite stimulated and eat several bowls of rice!"
"Really?"
Ding Ling smiles without commenting.
"Of course. Just watch."

At seventeen years of age, Yang Guo is lively, energetic, and hospitable, viewing Ding Ling as an idol. Being watched with ’anticipation’ by his idol naturally filled him with enthusiasm, and with all his energy brought to bear, he performed the actions of chopping and deep-frying with the ease of flowing water.
Ding Ling nods approval silently.
Yang Guo, after all, has suffered since childhood; a poor child is early-minded, and in terms of cooking, Yang Guo’s skill level is clearly maxed out.
However, Ding Ling could not really commend his culinary arts.
After watching for a while.
Ding Ling no longer humored Yang Guo.
After Yang Guo prepared a small dish, he enthusiastically pulled out a pair of chopsticks and offered it for Ding Ling to taste.
Ding Ling tried it.
Hmm.
It does surpass ordinary home-cooked dishes by quite a bit.
No wonder the Little Dragon Girl, who stays in ancient tombs for long periods, never tires of Yang Guo’s cooking.
"How is it?"
Yang Guo raised an eyebrow proudly and said:
"I already said, if nowhere else, my cooking is very skilled."
Ding Ling smiles without speaking.
"Ding Ling. Although you surpass me by a lot in martial arts, when it comes to cooking skills, you may not necessarily beat me."
Yang Guo, after all, is a young man with a competitive spirit, full of pride, and can’t help saying :
"My culinary skills have been highly praised by Gugu!"
"Oh?"
Ding Ling slightly raises his eyebrows:
"If I defeat you in cooking, what will you do?"
"Whatever you want."
Yang Guo says without hesitation:

"It makes sense that I’m not as good as you in martial arts. But if I’m also not as good in cooking, that would be too unbelievable. You don’t look much older than me. How can I possibly be inferior to you in everything?"
"You said it."
Ding Ling stands up and directly walks to the cooking area, saying:
"When I defeat you, you can’t back out."
"One word from Yang Guo is as good as a bond!"
"Haha."
Ding Ling laughs heartily three times:
"If that’s the case, then watch me."
Whoosh!

With a wave of his hand, Ding Ling generates a surge of Qi, launching the vegetable knife from the chopping board; he catches it with one hand. He waves his hand again, and under the surge of Qi, grabs a green pepper from mid-air.
Ding Ling then swings the knife, crack!
As the knife flashes dazzlingly fast, a quick sequence of chopping sounds is heard.
Ding Ling then begins to heat the oil...
In just a few moments.
A dish of stir-fried green pepper with meat is cooked.
Ding Ling places it in a bowl.
"You can taste it now."

chapters.title: Chapter 407: Little Dragon Girl
paragraphs: Yang Guo watched, utterly dumbfounded, his heart in turmoil and unable to calm down for quite some time.
This clean and crisp cooking, as if dreamlike and illusionary — the chopping, the tossing, the stir-frying skills!
Occasionally utilizing martial arts, nourishing the dishes with unending inner strength, making them increasingly aromatic!
This series of actions truly opened Yang Guo’s eyes.
Can cooking be done in this way?!
At this moment, hearing Ding Ling’s words, Yang Guo came back to his senses, awkwardly coughing.
He picked up the chopsticks and tasted a piece of green pepper.
After this tasting.
Yang Guo’s eyes immediately lit up, and his heart felt as if it was floating on clouds, utterly intoxicated and ecstatic!
"This feeling..."
Yang Guo found it hard to describe in words.
After a while.
He took a deep breath and almost knelt before Ding Ling:
"Ding Ling, I’ve eaten your food today. How am I supposed to live after this!"
"Isn’t that a bit exaggerated?"
Ding Ling glanced over.
His culinary skills are a combination of the real world, the Three Kingdoms World, and The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World — a fusion of three worlds’ culinary skills!
He could be considered the Kitchen God of Great Success!
Though he seldom cooked, whenever he did, even slightly testing his skills, it amazed people like Qu Feiyan.
However.
The dish just cooked for Yang Guo.
Was made with only thirty percent of his power. Even with that, it was enough to leave Yang Guo in such awe, how would it be if he went all out?
Ding Ling thought so.
Yang Guo, eyes wide, said:
"Ding Ling, I’m not exaggerating at all, your dishes are truly too delicious. Even Immortals would savor them. I almost bit my tongue."
It truly is exceptional.
Too exceptional."
He sighed:
"I submit, I submit! I’m indeed impressed by you, Ding Ling. Your martial arts prowess is already outstanding. It’s unheard of to have culinary skills this strong as well.
I admire you wholeheartedly."
He paused, slightly hopeful, looking at Ding Ling:
"I believe if my aunt tasted your dishes, she would certainly be captivated by you!
I wonder if you could prepare two dishes for my aunt. Not many, just two would do."
He said:
"I mentioned before, if I lost, you could do whatever you wanted. This I cannot take back..."
He babbled on without end.
Ding Ling interrupted him and said:
"Alright. Go get your aunt for dinner."
Ding Ling decided to show off.
Because his goal was to learn the Ancient Tomb Sect martial arts, it would be challenging if he didn’t gain the approval of Little Dragon Girl.
If truly unable to learn.
Ding Ling could only give up.
After all, he’s just making a few small dishes, and he needs to eat as well.
Thinking this way.
Ding Ling began to stir his inner strength to speed up cooking.
With inner strength assisting, the Medicine King Breathing Technique and the Medical Saint Breathing Technique occasionally expedited with vigorous qi, possessing extraordinary nourishing effects.
All kinds of techniques unfolded.
Ding Ling cooked swiftly.
Not long after.
Two dishes were cooked.
He then conveniently used breathing technique qi and inner strength to expedite the rice cooking.
In a flash of time, it was done.
When Yang Guo arrived with Little Dragon Girl, they were greeted by the ’invigorating’ scent of food and rice.
Little Dragon Girl naturally smelled it too, and her stomach unexpectedly rumbled again.
Yet she remained calm, as though not the one who was hungry. But from her slightly embarrassed expression, it was apparent she was somewhat sheepish.
Yang Guo, seeing this, quickly pulled Little Dragon Girl over to Ding Ling, reaching the ’kitchen.’
Yang Guo, seeing Ding Ling had already finished cooking, couldn’t help but click his tongue in astonishment:
"That’s so fast!"
He pointed at the dishes, looking at Little Dragon Girl:
"Aunt, here is Ding Ling’s cooking. I’m telling you, after eating it, you will definitely be entranced, unable to extricate yourself."
Little Dragon Girl remained skeptical.
But the food was indeed so aromatic, it tempted even her.
This was rare.

Knowing that her Ancient Tomb Sect Technique ’Twelve Few, Twelve More’ encompassed the whole text — fewer thoughts, fewer emotions, fewer joys, fewer likes, etc., made her quite indifferent in demeanor, normally hard to captivate her interest and attention.
Yet these mere dishes.
Almost broke her Yu Girl Skill Technique! Stirring a deep-seated craving within her.
This perplexed and amazed her greatly.
But indeed she was hungry.
Urged by Yang Guo, she sat down.
"Ding Ling, join us.
Yang Guo also stepped forward and pulled Ding Ling to sit down.
The three of them sat together to eat.
Ding Ling felt it was alright.
Yang Guo started eating, unable to stop:
"Oh my heavens!"
He ate while mumbling:
"Too delicious! Even better than before with stir-fried green peppers! Aunt, try it, try it, it’s truly too delicious. I feel my life until now was wasted."
For the first time realizing food could be this good!"
Little Dragon Girl was indeed hungry and started eating too.
Unlike Yang Guo’s ’no restraint’ ’no image’ fast scooping actions, she was dignified and elegant, like a lady, a fairy.
She ate slowly and gracefully.
However.
After just one bite of food.
Little Dragon Girl’s calm face showed a hint of shock.
"How is it?"
Yang Guo swallowed a large mouthful of food, seeing Little Dragon Girl’s expression, couldn’t help but laugh heartily:

"I told you long ago. Ding Ling’s martial arts prowess is one thing, but his culinary skills are even more commendable than martial arts. It’s impossible not to admire. Aunt, if you find it delicious, eat more."
Yang Guo touched his round belly:
"So quickly full. But it feels I haven’t had enough."
He ate too fast.
Just like that, he cleared a bowl of rice!
Obviously, the food was explosively delicious, making him unwittingly act like this.
Little Dragon Girl also ate, unconsciously nodding repeatedly, evidently delighted, thoroughly enjoying herself.
After finishing one bowl of rice.
Uncharacteristically, she had another.
This was unprecedented.
Yang Guo felt increasingly proud, laughing as if he was the one who cooked:
"Not in vain is he my benefactor. Truly remarkable. With your level of culinary skills, I bet even emperors would roll off their thrones just to taste your culinary masterpiece, Ding Ling!"
Ding Ling merely smiled, not saying anything.
After finishing two bowls of rice, Little Dragon Girl, feeling full, found her eyes increasingly bright, and her gaze at Ding Ling had turned subtly.
Within them, there was awe, admiration, approval, wonder, confusion, puzzlement, and bewilderment... complexity to the extreme.
Her awe and admiration need no further mention.
Confusion about how Ding Ling, so young, could master martial arts to the Transformation Realm, not to mention possessing such incredibly advanced culinary skills.
Though she isolated herself in the ancient tomb for years, unaware of the outside world’s chef standards.

chapters.title: Chapter 408: Muscle and Bone Strengthening - Full Level
paragraphs: But Yang Guo knew.
Yang Guo’s expression was clear, as if telling her, outside chefs facing Ding Ling are like nothing!
Since it is so.
How could Ding Ling, at such a young age, possess such extraordinary skills?
Baffled by having eaten such delicious food, what should she do in the future? Can she still eat the dishes made by her own Guo’er?!
She was deeply skeptical!
She was open and forthright, with nothing she couldn’t express, so her thoughts and feelings were all visible on her face, in her eyes.
Yang Guo looked on, feeling extremely embarrassed:
"Auntie, I will work hard on my cooking skills in the future, striving to make them tastier."
Speaking of this.
He himself seemed to lack confidence, sighing in despair:

"I feel that even if I put in another hundred years of effort on cooking, I still wouldn’t reach the divine level of skill like Ding Ling, the Kitchen God. After eating your food, eating the food made at home later.
It would definitely be like swallowing bran and chaff, hard to swallow!"
"If you want to learn, I can teach you."
Ding Ling smiled slightly.
"Really?"
Yang Guo instinctively felt joy.
Little Dragon Girl’s eyes also lit up; obviously, after eating Ding Ling’s cooking, she too remembered it deeply, hard to forget in this lifetime.
"Of course."
Ding Ling, having eaten his fill, put down his chopsticks and said:
"In my life, I have studied astronomy, geography, music, chess, calligraphy, painting, cooking, and more."
Hearing this.
Yang Guo was dumbfounded.
Little Dragon Girl was also involuntarily moved again.
"But I personally like Martial Arts the most."
Ding Ling said:
"I am intent on gathering all martial arts for my own use. So, if you are willing, you can exchange the Ancient Tomb Sect’s martial arts with me for some martial arts or skills you can use."
Yang Guo was startled, instinctively looking at Little Dragon Girl.
Little Dragon Girl was also stunned, her eyes slightly vacant, but no one knew what she was thinking at this moment.
"There are only two of you left in the Ancient Tomb Sect."
Ding Ling said:

"Naturally, the Ancient Tomb Sect listens to you. Whether you exchange martial arts or skills, it is up to you. Besides, even if I learn the Ancient Tomb Sect’s martial arts, I won’t go around talking about it."
"This..."
Yang Guo glanced at Little Dragon Girl, feeling a headache, and said:

"Logically speaking, Ding Ling, you want to learn the Ancient Tomb Sect’s martial arts, even for repayment, we should offer the Secret Manual without a second thought. But this matter concerns the ancestor’s teachings, and we can’t make a decision lightly; it requires some consideration."
Little Dragon Girl instinctively nodded.
"No rush."
Ding Ling smiled and said:
"Once you’ve thought it through, we’ll talk again. Now that we’ve just eaten our fill, why don’t you take me around this Ancient Tomb a bit?"
’No problem.’
Yang Guo quickly agreed.
He felt a bit ashamed.
Originally wanting to repay Ding Ling somewhat, in exchange for true skills or in cooking, he seemed to have gained a great advantage.
Thinking of this.
Yang Guo couldn’t feel at ease, how can you repay someone like this?
But at the moment, he couldn’t think of a concrete way to repay, so he decided to agree and comply with Ding Ling in everything for now.
Especially in terms of Ding Ling wanting to exchange for the Ancient Tomb Sect’s martial arts.
Yang Guo secretly noted it down, deciding to find some free time to discuss it privately with his aunt.
Once it’s properly discussed.
What martial arts can’t be passed on?

Ding Ling is such a remarkable hero, the Ancient Tomb Sect’s martial arts are nimble but lack in strength, even if learned, Ding Ling might find few places to use them; in exchanging like this, what harm could it be?
Clip-clop!
Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl led Ding Ling deeper and deeper into the Ancient Tomb.
This ancient tomb is deep and winding.
Ding Ling followed Little Dragon Girl and her companion, nearly getting dizzy.
He secretly marveled: Wang Chongyang must have had an incredible memory, because normally, people with bad memories would easily get lost here.
And Little Dragon Girl, Yang Guo’s talent, comprehension, and nature could be said to definitely be among the top in the world.
Their memory naturally is extremely strong as well.
Though Ding Ling could cheat in some ways, he couldn’t surpass the two in this aspect.
But naturally, he wouldn’t expose his shortcomings, just subtly guiding the two of them towards the hidden chamber where the coffins were placed during the conversation.
After some time.
They reached a hidden chamber.
Upon looking around.
There were indeed several coffins here, and Ding Ling once again verbally guided Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl to open several of the empty coffins.
Ding Ling stepped forward, examining carefully.
Just as expected.
He saw sixteen large characters inscribed on the inside of one of the coffin lids:
"Yu Girl’s Heart Scripture, superior to Quanzhen, Chongyang in life, never inferior to others!"
Sixteen characters.
Written in thick ink, with vigorous brush strokes, the characters were quite large, even with weak candlelight, they were clearly visible when the coffin lid was opened.
Little Dragon Girl and Yang Guo naturally also saw it and were involuntarily amazed, turning their heads:
"Huh. There really is something odd here."
Yang Guo was puzzled:
"Ding Ling, how did you know there was something unusual about the coffin here?"
"I understand Feng Shui. I saw it."
Ding Ling said with an air of importance.
Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl believed without a doubt!

After all, along the way, they talked to Ding Ling and discovered that Ding Ling was indeed knowledgeable about astronomy, geography, music, chess, calligraphy, and painting, excelling in everything without exception; it was just incredible!
The two were impressed.
At this moment, hearing Ding Ling say this, they naturally believed him wholeheartedly.
"Is this writing by Wang Chongyang?"
Little Dragon Girl was curious.
After eating the meal Ding Ling cooked and chatting with Ding Ling on the road, she naturally no longer avoided Ding Ling and stopped speaking to him.
"It should be."
Yang Guo smiled and said:

"That old Daoist is boasting. Since our Yu Girl’s Heart Scripture can surpass Quanzhen’s Martial Arts, Ancestor Granny must be much more powerful than him. How could he dare say he’s never been weaker than others in his life? Besides."
Yang Guo glanced at Ding Ling:
"Wang Chongyang didn’t meet Ding Ling. If he had, he would certainly have been completely silenced, with nothing more to say."
Little Dragon Girl nodded in agreement.

Ding Ling’s talent and versatility were indeed outstanding. Little Dragon Girl admitted to being much inferior to Ding Ling, so she naturally didn’t think the Quanzhen Sect’s old Daoist could be stronger than Ding Ling.
"Huh. There are more words here."
Little Dragon Girl saw many small characters carved next to the sixteen large characters and picked up a candlestick to take a closer look. Upon seeing it, she couldn’t help but exclaim in surprise:
"It says a lot here. Wang Chongyang says that although Ancestor Granny’s Yu Girl’s Heart Scripture can entirely break Quanzhen Sect’s Martial Arts,
he also left a Martial Arts Technique,
which can also counter our Yu Girl’s Heart Scripture.
"How is that possible?"
Yang Guo didn’t believe it.
"But he said that this Martial Arts Technique is left in another stone room in our Ancient Tomb; we’ll know by taking a look."

Little Dragon Girl glanced at Ding Ling and saw that Ding Ling remained expressionless, just watching. She thought for a moment and then took the initiative to leap into the coffin and began to explore. After a while, she indeed found a mechanism. Her hand covered the mechanism, trying to turn it left once, then lifted it up.
Ka-cha-cha!
A crisp sound.
The stone slab at the bottom of the coffin surprisingly rose in response.
"There is indeed a secret chamber."
Little Dragon Girl was surprised and couldn’t help but glance at Ding Ling, thinking:

"Ding Ling could see at a glance that there was something unusual here, and he determined the anomaly was in the coffin. Now it seems he was completely right, not in the slightest bit wrong. This person is truly amazing. I’ve grown up this much and still didn’t see a hint of anomaly here."
Thinking this way.
Little Dragon Girl jumped out of the coffin.
After the foul air dissipated.
She followed Ding Ling again, jumping into the coffin, stepping on stone steps, walking through a passage, turning a corner, and then entering a stone room.
Looking around, they couldn’t understand.
Only Ding Ling reminded them.
Then they saw lines of dense characters and symbols on the roof of the room.
On the far right, four big words were boldly written:
Nine Yin Scripture!
"It’s indeed the Nine Yin Scripture."
Ding Ling smiled slightly.
Compared to searching outside.
Searching in this Ancient Tomb was indeed much easier.
Ding Ling no longer hesitated.
But began to examine it carefully.
The first thing he looked at was the "Bone Strengthening Chapter"!
This was a top-tier cultivation technique.
After reading it once.
Ding Ling slightly closed his eyes.
After absorbing a book into the library.
In an instant.
[Muscle and Bone Strengthening Chapter Full Level]
[Root +1]
[Physique +2]
[Defense +2]
Once cultivated to full level.
Crackle!
A series of bone-cracking sounds burst out from Ding Ling’s whole body.
Like bones growing, stretching, forging.
Ding Ling only felt intense pain throughout his body, but as a special Vigorous Qi flowed from his limbs into his bones, he felt an indescribable pleasurable sensation.
This feeling.
It’s like a person who has never exercised suddenly works out for several hours and feels sore all over.
The difference is.
After the soreness, Ding Ling felt a satisfying and joyful sensation that penetrated deeply into his heart.
It was like a chrysalis transforming into a butterfly after enduring hardships, finally undergoing a metamorphosis!

Upon seeing it, she couldn’t help but exclaim in surprise:
"It says a lot here.
Wang Chongyang says that although Ancestor Granny’s Yu Girl’s Heart Scripture can entirely break Quanzhen Sect’s Martial Arts,
he also left a Martial Arts Technique,
which can also counter our Yu Girl’s Heart Scripture.
"How is that possible?"
Yang Guo didn’t believe it.
"But he said that this Martial Arts Technique is left in another stone room in our Ancient Tomb; we’ll know by taking a look."
Little Dragon Girl glanced at Ding Ling and saw that Ding Ling remained expressionless, just watching.
She thought for a moment and then took the initiative to leap into the coffin and began to explore.
After a while, she indeed found a mechanism.
Her hand covered the mechanism, trying to turn it left once, then lifted it up.
Ka-cha-cha!
A crisp sound.
The stone slab at the bottom of the coffin surprisingly rose in response.
"There is indeed a secret chamber."
Little Dragon Girl was surprised and couldn’t help but glance at Ding Ling, thinking:
"Ding Ling could see at a glance that there was something unusual here, and he determined the anomaly was in the coffin.
Now it seems he was completely right, not in the slightest bit wrong.
This person is truly amazing.
I’ve grown up this much and still didn’t see a hint of anomaly here."
Thinking this way.
Little Dragon Girl jumped out of the coffin.
After the foul air dissipated.
She followed Ding Ling again, jumping into the coffin, stepping on stone steps, walking through a passage, turning a corner, and then entering a stone room.
Looking around, they couldn’t understand.
Only Ding Ling reminded them.
Then they saw lines of dense characters and symbols on the roof of the room.
On the far right, four big words were boldly written:
Nine Yin Scripture!
"It’s indeed the Nine Yin Scripture."
Ding Ling smiled slightly.
Compared to searching outside.
Searching in this Ancient Tomb was indeed much easier.
Ding Ling no longer hesitated.
But began to examine it carefully.
The first thing he looked at was the "Bone Strengthening Chapter"!
This was a top-tier cultivation technique.
After reading it once.
Ding Ling slightly closed his eyes.
After absorbing a book into the library.
In an instant.
[Muscle and Bone Strengthening Chapter Full Level]
[Root +1]
[Physique +2]
[Defense +2]
Once cultivated to full level.
Crackle!
A series of bone-cracking sounds burst out from Ding Ling’s whole body.
Like bones growing, stretching, forging.
Ding Ling only felt intense pain throughout his body, but as a special Vigorous Qi flowed from his limbs into his bones, he felt an indescribable pleasurable sensation.
This feeling.
It’s like a person who has never exercised suddenly works out for several hours and feels sore all over.
The difference is.
After the soreness, Ding Ling felt a satisfying and joyful sensation that penetrated deeply into his heart.
It was like a chrysalis transforming into a butterfly after enduring hardships, finally undergoing a metamorphosis!

chapters.title: Chapter 409: The Dragon Girl’s Utmost Admiration
paragraphs: "This feeling is truly remarkable."
Ding Ling reflected carefully.

He was well aware that this directly increased two points in physique and defense, causing his physical attributes to soar! Ding Ling could clearly perceive that his body was becoming increasingly astonishing!
This was the reason why Ding Ling could fully withstand the transformation of his muscles and bones.
If his physical attributes weren’t high enough.
He wouldn’t be able to endure this sudden and violent transformation.
The transformation duration was too short!
Moreover, there were no nourishing herbs to supplement Ding Ling’s nutrition or warm and nourish his meridians and bones, resulting in a strong pull, sharp pain, and soreness.
If he had consumed the previously exchanged "True Pill," it would only result in a slight feeling of soreness.
It would feel more like soaking in a hot spring, extremely comfortable.
Comparing the two. The difference is glaringly obvious.
Though, unlike the True Pill.
Once the Muscle and Bone Strengthening Chapter reaches full level.
Besides the significant initial improvement.
Continuing to cultivate.
Will still slowly enhance bones and improve meridians.
"It’s a great cultivation technique."
Ding Ling secretly admired:
"Getting this cultivation technique in this world makes the trip worthwhile."
Ding Ling’s weakest point was his bones.
After the enhancement of bones this time.
Ding Ling could clearly feel that if he continued to cultivate other martial arts, even without cheats, he would certainly be far stronger than ordinary people!
He could already be considered a little prodigy in the eyes of ordinary people.
And because the Muscle and Bone Strengthening Chapter is at full level.
It can operate automatically.
Ding Ling just needs to remember to run this Muscle and Bone Strengthening Chapter constantly, keep up the nutrients, and it wouldn’t be surprising if his bones improve again over time.
He felt a surge in his heart and decided to ensure this Muscle and Bone Strengthening Chapter runs through his meridians and bones constantly in the coming period.
Yang Guo noticed the commotion on Ding Ling’s side, and amidst his side glances, couldn’t help but feel shaken.
He had just started looking.
Without thoroughly understanding what these cultivation techniques meant.
Ding Ling had already succeeded in cultivating them?!
Is the disparity between people this vast?

Little Dragon Girl also couldn’t help but glance to the side; on the way, she had heard Yang Guo boasting about Ding Ling instantly mastering the Toad Skill—at that time, she considered Yang Guo was exaggerating, for how could there exist such a remarkable person in the world?
Even if Ding Ling was known as the All-Purpose King.
It’s unlikely that just listening once and viewing once, he could successfully cultivate an extremely profound martial art, let alone reach the level of mastery.
This is too absurd!
But watching the current situation.

Little Dragon Girl couldn’t help but be dazed, with tumultuous thoughts, becoming partially convinced of Yang Guo’s words, though remaining slightly doubtful that Ding Ling might have mastered the martial arts inscribed at the top of the stone wall earlier on.
With thoughts in her mind, she felt embarrassed to ask; seeing through it, Yang Guo voiced Little Dragon Girl’s confusion.
Ding Ling thought, "If I had learned it, why would I come to the Ancient Tomb Sect?"
But he replied:
"This is also my first time encountering such a marvelous technique. It truly is exceptional."
Yang Guo, upon hearing, praised him profusely, expressing his admiration.
Little Dragon Girl’s eyes, clear and chilling like ice crystals, were filled with shock, confusion, and disbelief.
[Achievement Medal Acquired: You have earned Little Dragon Girl’s high admiration.]

[Note: In Little Dragon Girl’s world, during her childhood, she had only her master, senior sister, Granny Sun and a few others. As she grew up, her senior sister left, Granny Sun passed away, leaving only Yang Guo.
Her world is as clean and chilly as a pool of autumn water. In her perception, her Ancestor Granny Lin Chaoying was the strongest, most talented woman in the world.
Yet Lin Chaoying practiced martial arts for a lifetime, with the cultivation of some supreme skills taking seven or eight years, over ten years!
And you managed to learn the Muscle and Bone Strengthening Chapter from the Nine Yin Scripture in mere moments, leaving her deeply shaken.
Her worldview and outlook on life have a tendency to collapse at any time because of this.
At this moment, she holds you in high admiration! Like beholding a peerless, rarely seen genius against all odds!]
Upon hearing the notification sound.
Ding Ling was slightly moved, glancing at Little Dragon Girl.
At the same time, Little Dragon Girl also looked at Ding Ling due to being overly shocked and confused.
Their eyes met.
Ding Ling smiled slightly.
Little Dragon Girl’s flawless face akin to white jade was tinged with a blush, whether due to shyness, embarrassment, or simply deeply touched?
Ding Ling didn’t bother much; after a polite smile, he once again focused his attention on the Nine Yin Scripture.
After a few breaths.
[Healing Chapter Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +50]
[Physique +1]
As the Healing Chapter reached full level instantly.
Ding Ling felt a stream of special Vigorous Qi circulating throughout his limbs and bones.
And simultaneously.
Streams of Primordial Qi surged in abundance.
Strengthening Ding Ling’s inner power value by another 50 points.
This inner power, refined by Pure Yang True Water, merged into the True Water completely.
Despite this.
Ding Ling found that merely operating this technique slightly.
Would generate a peculiar Vigorous Qi throughout his limbs and bones, which has incredibly effective healing and curative properties.
"No wonder it’s the Healing Chapter of the Nine Yin Scripture. Truly impressive. This is indeed an exceptional technique."
Not a first-class exceptional technique.
Cannot bring inner power value to Ding Ling.
Yet this Healing Chapter can, showcasing its uniqueness.
Most importantly, it also added one point to physique. Typically, Chapters merely add around 0.1, 0.2 or so; this directly added a full point.
Evidencing that this Healing Chapter must indeed, like the Muscle and Bone Strengthening Chapter, encompass the essence contained within the Nine Yin Scripture!
"It’s excellent."
Ding Ling felt very satisfied.
Continuing to read further.
Within moments.
[Great Demon-Subduing Fist Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.1]
[Physique +0.1]
This is a high-tier fist technique.

Ding Ling slightly clenched his fist and punched forward, seeing a vigorous energy spreading out, forming a fist, shooting forth. Boom! With a punch falling, it even created a fist seal one inch deep on the secret room’s wall side.
And Ding Ling had not exerted his full strength.
Only exerting a fraction of strength.
Achieving such effect with mere fraction showcases the strength, dominance, and absolute power of the Great Demon-Subduing Fist.
Ding Ling secretly nodded.
This fist technique is extremely strong, perfectly fitting for him.
Yang Guo watched with wide eyes, unable to hold back his comment:
"Ding Ling, did you just master the Great Demon-Subduing Fist?"
Though he can’t comprehend these cultivation techniques in a short time, he can grasp some general concepts.
And among the Nine Yin Scripture’s martial arts, it seems only the Great Demon-Subduing Fist possesses such power.
"Indeed."
"Learned just by reading it once."
Yang Guo clicked his tongue:
"It’s truly explosive!"
Little Dragon Girl, observing nearby, couldn’t help but nod slightly, her eyes coldly stunning, increasingly bewildered and shaken while gazing at Ding Ling!
