chapters.title: Chapter 410: Soul Transfer Technique at Full Level! Cold Jade Bed
paragraphs: Ding Ling continued reading.
A few blinks later.
He had already speed-read through a Cultivation Technique.
The next moment.
[Snake and Raccoon Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.3]
[Constitution +0.1]
This is a first-class high-tier Lightweight Body Technique.
Once unleashed.
One can move with the agility of a snake, like a raccoon flipping over with extreme nimbleness!
The intricacy of the Body Technique, rarely comparable with any Lightweight Skill.

Ding Ling darted around swiftly in the secret chamber, his movement speed ghostly fast, causing Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl to be unable to catch a sight of him, leading to them exchanging glances in shock.
"Mastered another one. This, this..."
Yang Guo felt a strong visual déjà vu of starting to learn together, then watching Ding Ling soar through the skies, while he could only stand vigilant and anxious.
This is so powerless and helpless!
He then deeply felt his own incompetence!
The only consolation for Yang Guo was perhaps that his Aunt hadn’t mastered any Cultivation Technique either and was just staring blankly like him.
Two people staring blankly is better than one staring blankly! That would be too awkward, too embarrassing.
After Ding Ling landed.
He continued to read.
Speed-read through.
[Soul Transfer Technique Full Level]
[Wisdom +0.5]
Huh?!
Ding Ling’s mind cleared, and he intuitively felt that his horizon seemed to widen, and many forgotten knowledge points seemed to recall at this moment!
This Soul Transfer Technique increases wisdom!
Ding Ling was astonished.
Give him more of such Cultivation Technique!
Wouldn’t his wisdom just keep surging upwards?!
Sadly.
For now, it remains a thought.
Ding Ling continued to read.
Perhaps it was due to the wisdom increase.
Although he was speed-reading ten lines at a glance, remembering was too easy compared to before, not to mention he didn’t need to remember, so he found reading these Techniques more and more handy.
Two blinks later.
[White Python Whip Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
Another first-class high-tier Technique.
And it’s a Whip Technique.

Ding Ling didn’t have a whip, yet he could still use his arm to perform the Technique, and when he swung his arm, snap-crackle-pop! It seemed as though shadows appeared in the void, emitting sounds like they could crack it open.
"Excellent."
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
Next Chapter.
[Heart Shattering Palm Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
Once unleashed, the palm technique seizes soul and shatters heart, seeming to smash a person’s heart to pieces, smack!
He slapped the wall, leaving a palm print over an inch deep.
This Palm Technique is not inferior to the Great Demon-Subduing Fist.
Incredibly vicious and sinister.
One strike seeks a person’s life!
Continue.
[Nine Yin Divine Claw Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
Form hand into claw.
One claw reaching out, sharp qi overflowing, easily tearing several slits in the wall.
Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl were watching in astonishment, each stunned to numb limbs, bodies stiff, faces full of disbelief.
Ding Ling continued to read.
In no time, he mastered Acupressure Chapter, Closing Chapter, etc., all reaching full level.
The Nine Yin Scripture Fragment here was learned.
Ding Ling spent only a moment.
It can only be said.
With Divine Skill Automatic Full Level cheats, whatever you learn is quick, and it can swiftly become ingrained in the bone, transform into mastery!
In terms of proficiency because the Divine Skill all transformed into mastery, so only a short practice is needed to quickly max it out.
"All right."
After Ding Ling finished learning, he said:
"Did you remember it all?"
"No."
Yang Guo said blankly, puzzled:
"The Kung Fu here is so difficult to learn and remember. We couldn’t fully understand it even after reading through it. How could we possibly remember it?"
Little Dragon Girl nodded in agreement, clearly feeling the same.
After Yang Guo finished speaking, he seemed to realize something, looking at Ding Ling in awe and admiration:
"Amazing. Today I finally witnessed what is called a true genius. Previously, when Ding Ling you showed a glimpse of Toad Skill, it shocked me greatly.
Now we are learning the Nine Yin Scripture at the same time.
With comparison.
The feeling is even more obvious and intense. In front of you, I truly feel like I am nothing!"
For the first time in his life, Yang Guo had a strong feeling that his talent was so inadequate.
Without comparison, there is no harm.
With the Toad Skill previously, he could find excuses like not practicing for a long time and being rusty.
But now they are simultaneously practicing the Nine Yin Scripture.
Even though they couldn’t fully understand it, Ding Ling had already learned it!
This sense of disparity is fatal!
And because of going through this experience.
Both Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl.
Their respect for Ding Ling skyrocketed!
After a while.
Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl only managed to memorize parts of the Heart Method Mantra.
The two didn’t understand many parts.
Little Dragon Girl was somewhat embarrassed.
Yang Guo couldn’t help but begin to ask Ding Ling for guidance.
Ding Ling didn’t hold back, often easily pointing out issues directly with his high-level insights.
Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl often showed expressions of sudden realization, saying ’Ah, I see’.
After a few hours like this.
It was time to sleep.
Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl were embarrassed to ask Ding Ling for more teaching, so they decided to return to sleep.
On the way.
Yang Guo quietly discussed the matter of the Cold Jade Bed with Little Dragon Girl.
Little Dragon Girl also felt a bit sorry for Ding Ling and agreed to Yang Guo’s request.
Ding Ling was quite curious about the Cold Jade Bed. He didn’t refuse and, under their guidance, went straight to the secret chamber where the Cold Jade Bed was placed.
Then, as Yang Guo indicated, Ding Ling stepped forward and sat on it, feeling invigorated and chilled to the bone.
But his physical prowess was high, and he quickly adapted to the coldness.
Under the stimulation of the Cold Jade Bed.

All of Ding Ling’s Full-Level Pure Yang True Skill, Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic, Tai Chi Scripture, Innate Skill, Nine Yin Scripture’s Bone Strengthening Chapter, Healing Chapter, began to operate autonomously!
Though there was substantial Vigorous Qi in his Dantian and meridians.
The key focus was on two types of Qi.
One was the Pure Yang True Skill’s Pure Yang True Water;
One was the Innate Skill’s Innate True Qi.

Other energies like those generated by the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic were just minor strands, which autonomously operated along with the Full-Level Technique, continuously nurturing the meridians, enhancing the toughness of the bones, and so on.
It could be anticipated.
With diligent practice here for a year or half.
Ding Ling’s Bone Strengthening Chapter would undoubtedly further increase his foundational strength by 1 point.
Other energies generated by the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic and Tai Chi Scripture might also undergo some remarkable transformations!
At that time, Ding Ling’s Dantian might integrate various divine skills, possibly leading to earth-shattering changes.
"The Cold Jade Bed is really a treasure."
Ding Ling admired it quietly.
The nature of the Cold Jade Bed is extremely yin and cold, sitting on it clears the heart fire and leads to courageous advancement.
Such a rare treasure.
This is unique in the World of Divine Condor.
Ding Ling had no intention of monopolizing or taking it away.
His Storage Pouch had limited space and couldn’t accommodate the massive Cold Jade Bed.
Perhaps he could take a small piece, but wouldn’t that waste its full potential?
Only the complete Cold Jade Bed can truly unleash its extraordinary effects.
Ding Ling, skilled in creation and carving, naturally noticed the internal structure of this Cold Jade Bed, its sides engraved with various mystical array patterns.
Without a doubt.
Lin Chaoying must have been an expert in Array Dao, and paired with the Cold Jade Bed, these engraved array maps might achieve a year’s practice equivalent to another’s ten years!

As for the explanation of Little Dragon Girl and Yang Guo: "The Cold Jade Bed’s extreme cold is hard to endure, the resistance through practice, over time, becomes second nature, and even in dreams, one can autonomously practice. Thus, constant practice results in a year equivalent to ten years for others."
Their explanation is easily accepted.
However, Ding Ling saw more details beyond that.
This was also his reason for not taking a small piece.
If taking it, take the entire thing, but his Storage Pouch was still too small.
Ding Ling did not dwell further.
He decided to teach Yang Guo entry-level Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique and Lion’s Roar and leave.
During this period.
If Yang Guo can persuade Little Dragon Girl to let him learn the Martial Arts of the Ancient Tomb Sect.

In terms of proficiency because the Divine Skill all transformed into mastery, so only a short practice is needed to quickly max it out.
"All right."
After Ding Ling finished learning, he said:
"Did you remember it all?"
"No."
Yang Guo said blankly, puzzled:
"The Kung Fu here is so difficult to learn and remember.
We couldn’t fully understand it even after reading through it.
How could we possibly remember it?"
Little Dragon Girl nodded in agreement, clearly feeling the same.
After Yang Guo finished speaking, he seemed to realize something, looking at Ding Ling in awe and admiration:
"Amazing.
Today I finally witnessed what is called a true genius.
Previously, when Ding Ling you showed a glimpse of Toad Skill, it shocked me greatly.
Now we are learning the Nine Yin Scripture at the same time.
With comparison.
The feeling is even more obvious and intense.
In front of you, I truly feel like I am nothing!"
For the first time in his life, Yang Guo had a strong feeling that his talent was so inadequate.
Without comparison, there is no harm.
With the Toad Skill previously, he could find excuses like not practicing for a long time and being rusty.
But now they are simultaneously practicing the Nine Yin Scripture.
Even though they couldn’t fully understand it, Ding Ling had already learned it!
This sense of disparity is fatal!
And because of going through this experience.
Both Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl.
Their respect for Ding Ling skyrocketed!
After a while.
Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl only managed to memorize parts of the Heart Method Mantra.
The two didn’t understand many parts.
Little Dragon Girl was somewhat embarrassed.
Yang Guo couldn’t help but begin to ask Ding Ling for guidance.
Ding Ling didn’t hold back, often easily pointing out issues directly with his high-level insights.
Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl often showed expressions of sudden realization, saying ’Ah, I see’.
After a few hours like this.
It was time to sleep.
Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl were embarrassed to ask Ding Ling for more teaching, so they decided to return to sleep.
On the way.
Yang Guo quietly discussed the matter of the Cold Jade Bed with Little Dragon Girl.
Little Dragon Girl also felt a bit sorry for Ding Ling and agreed to Yang Guo’s request.
Ding Ling was quite curious about the Cold Jade Bed.
He didn’t refuse and, under their guidance, went straight to the secret chamber where the Cold Jade Bed was placed.
Then, as Yang Guo indicated, Ding Ling stepped forward and sat on it, feeling invigorated and chilled to the bone.
But his physical prowess was high, and he quickly adapted to the coldness.
Under the stimulation of the Cold Jade Bed.

All of Ding Ling’s Full-Level Pure Yang True Skill, Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic, Tai Chi Scripture, Innate Skill, Nine Yin Scripture’s Bone Strengthening Chapter, Healing Chapter, began to operate autonomously!
Though there was substantial Vigorous Qi in his Dantian and meridians.
The key focus was on two types of Qi.
One was the Pure Yang True Skill’s Pure Yang True Water;
One was the Innate Skill’s Innate True Qi.

Other energies like those generated by the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic were just minor strands, which autonomously operated along with the Full-Level Technique, continuously nurturing the meridians, enhancing the toughness of the bones, and so on.
It could be anticipated.
With diligent practice here for a year or half.
Ding Ling’s Bone Strengthening Chapter would undoubtedly further increase his foundational strength by 1 point.
Other energies generated by the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic and Tai Chi Scripture might also undergo some remarkable transformations!
At that time, Ding Ling’s Dantian might integrate various divine skills, possibly leading to earth-shattering changes.
"The Cold Jade Bed is really a treasure."
Ding Ling admired it quietly.
The nature of the Cold Jade Bed is extremely yin and cold, sitting on it clears the heart fire and leads to courageous advancement.
Such a rare treasure.
This is unique in the World of Divine Condor.
Ding Ling had no intention of monopolizing or taking it away.
His Storage Pouch had limited space and couldn’t accommodate the massive Cold Jade Bed.
Perhaps he could take a small piece, but wouldn’t that waste its full potential?
Only the complete Cold Jade Bed can truly unleash its extraordinary effects.
Ding Ling, skilled in creation and carving, naturally noticed the internal structure of this Cold Jade Bed, its sides engraved with various mystical array patterns.
Without a doubt.
Lin Chaoying must have been an expert in Array Dao, and paired with the Cold Jade Bed, these engraved array maps might achieve a year’s practice equivalent to another’s ten years!

As for the explanation of Little Dragon Girl and Yang Guo: "The Cold Jade Bed’s extreme cold is hard to endure, the resistance through practice, over time, becomes second nature, and even in dreams, one can autonomously practice.
Thus, constant practice results in a year equivalent to ten years for others."
Their explanation is easily accepted.
However, Ding Ling saw more details beyond that.
This was also his reason for not taking a small piece.
If taking it, take the entire thing, but his Storage Pouch was still too small.
Ding Ling did not dwell further.
He decided to teach Yang Guo entry-level Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique and Lion’s Roar and leave.
During this period.
If Yang Guo can persuade Little Dragon Girl to let him learn the Martial Arts of the Ancient Tomb Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 411: Li Mochou
paragraphs: That would naturally be the best if there’s none.
Ding Ling had some expectations regarding this.
He knew Little Dragon Girl was extremely innocent and pure, indifferent to everything.
If Yang Guo wholeheartedly wanted to hand over the Martial Arts Secret Manual of the Ancient Tomb Sect to Ding Ling.
Little Dragon Girl probably wouldn’t be too resistant.
In the original, Yang Guo also taught the Yu Girl’s Heart Scripture to Lu Wushuang, and Little Dragon Girl didn’t say anything.
That night.
Ding Ling peacefully spent the night in meditation and cultivation.
The next dawn.

Ding Ling was about to get up to find Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl, planning to make Yang Guo memorize the essentials of the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique and Lion’s Roar today, and then let him comprehend it on his own.
He didn’t intend to stay here much longer.
Although the Cold Jade Bed was good.
Ding Ling, with the Divine Skill Automatic Full Level cheats, had ample opportunities to quickly improve himself.
He planned to set out today for the Shaolin Temple to seek out the Nine Yang Divine Skill.
As for the martial arts of the Ancient Tomb Sect.
Ding Ling could only say he would leave it to fate.
If he could obtain it, great, if not, it wouldn’t matter.
"The Nine Yang Divine Skill is kept in the Scripture Pavilion at Shaolin Temple. Even if players know the exact location, entering deep inside to obtain the True Scripture is probably not easy."
If only one player knew about it.
Keeping it secret.
And being vigilant and daring.
Might just succeed.
But the problem is numerous players know about this, and everyone wants the Nine Yang Divine Skill. Most likely, no one will end up getting it.
Ding Ling had seen through this.
That’s why after arriving at the Quanzhen Sect, he first learned the Bone Strengthening Chapter, then looked if he could get martial arts from the Ancient Tomb Sect.
If not.
Then he’d go seek the Nine Yang Divine Skill.
Thinking so.
Ding Ling just stepped out of the stone room’s door.
Whoosh Whoosh!
Two familiar figures swiftly dashed towards him from the front and back, their voices arriving before they did:
"Ding Ling, Li Mochou is here to kill. I and my aunt really can’t hold her off. We had no choice but to trouble you."
Upon closer look.
Indeed, it was Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl.
But at this moment, one of them was pale, the other’s face was blue, their bodies trembling, clearly heavily poisoned.
To have held out until now without collapsing speaks to their extraordinary Divine Skills and profound Inner Strength.
Ding Ling walked forward two steps, gesturing for Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl to enter the inner room first.
Yang Guo looked at Ding Ling with gratitude, embarrassment, and awkwardness, feeling utterly ashamed.
Little Dragon Girl also felt guilty and embarrassed.
After all, Yang Guo invited Ding Ling to the tomb to repay a favor, but the reality was they kept enjoying Ding Ling’s hospitality and guidance again and again.
Though they had also done some things in return, to them, these seemed insignificant. How could they repay the kindness that avenged Granny Sunx?
Not to mention other aspects of their friendship.
Being so clear-headed.
Even someone as indifferent and cold as Little Dragon Girl had her pale face inexplicably tinted with a blush, showing her extreme guilt.
Especially when they’ll have to rely on Ding Ling to confront their own senior sister later.
Little Dragon Girl’s Heart Lake was stirred with countless waves, prompting her to remind Ding Ling:
"Li Mochou is my senior sister, her most formidable skills are the Five Poison Divine Palm and Ice Soul Silver Needle, be careful of her poison."
As her voice fell.
Accompanied by a girlish laughter of "giggling".
Swish!
A beautiful silhouette suddenly appeared a short distance away in front of Ding Ling.
Ding Ling turned his head.
Looking carefully.
He saw a woman dressed as a Taoist, with brilliant eyes and white teeth, seeming jewel-like and flower-like, stunningly beautiful, indeed an outstanding beauty.
However.
At this moment, the beautiful woman’s expression was cold, her bright eyes full of Evil Qi, ruining the alluring beauty.
She wielded a duster, casually flinging it behind her, her bright eyes accidentally glanced at Ding Ling, then quickly looked at Little Dragon Girl, coldly laughing:
"My good junior sister, you certainly have good tastes. Not only did you raise a junior, but now you secretly have such a handsome, imposing young man!
What skill you possess."
"You, you’re talking nonsense."
Little Dragon Girl was furious:
"Ding Ling is a benefactor of the Ancient Tomb Sect, not what you think!"
"Giggle giggle."
The beauty laughed, her voice crisp like a sounding bell:
"Good junior sister, why so anxious? I haven’t even said much, are you feeling guilty proving it?"
Jealousy flashed across her face:
"Having Little Yang Guo is one thing, but now you secretly have such a noble-looking, profound young gentleman. What are you up to? Have you forgotten our sect’s rules!
Do your eyes still respect our master and ancestors!
You aren’t worthy of inheriting the Yu Girl’s Heart Scripture!
The Yu Girl’s Heart Scripture should be returned to me, Li Mochou!"
At the end of the speech.
The true motive finally revealed.
Little Dragon Girl calmed down and said:
"Senior sister, give up this thought. I promised my master, and I can’t pass the Yu Girl’s Heart Scripture to you."
"Giggle giggle."
Li Mochou laughed, bending back and forth, abruptly.
She flicked her sleeve.
Whoosh whoosh!
More than a dozen small, glowing blue lights flashed and vanished in the void, shooting towards Ding Ling’s vital points at lightning speed.
Clearly.
She intended to severely injure Ding Ling.

Meeting him for the first time and using such a vicious method, Ding Ling’s heart burned with hidden anger, and he swiftly drew the Heaven-Swaying Sword from his waist, deploying the Breaking Arrow Form of the Dugu Nine Swords like lightning.
In fact, it was faster than before!
Clang clang clang!
In the blink of an eye, more than a dozen tiny silver needles resembling horseflies were struck down!
These silver needles were swift as lightning, so tiny they were hard to discern with naked eyes.
A typical first-class Martial Arts expert faced with such a Hidden Weapon could only succumb to their fate.

Li Mochou used this method to dominate the Great River’s south and north, acquiring the Red-Training Fairy’s reputation, feared by all who heard. Even in the Ancient Tomb Sect, with full effort, neither Yang Guo nor Little Dragon Girl together could withstand her.
Unexpectedly.
Now her lightning-fast tactic was so easily countered by a young man.
Startled inside, her hand didn’t waver, flicking her sleeve as more than a dozen Ice Soul Silver Needles flew out.
This time she employed even stronger techniques, each needle not only heavily poisoned but infused with exceptionally strong Inner Strength, capable of easily piercing through rock.
"Let’s see how you evade this!"
Li Mochou shouted clearly, simultaneously wielding the duster and charging at Ding Ling, evidently afraid Ding Ling might dodge her attack, hence her duster could exert its effect.
But unexpectedly, Ding Ling wielded his sword seamlessly, like antelope’s horns, leaving no trace, as brilliant sword lights flashed through the void!
Accompanied by clanging sounds, visibly, her released Ice Soul Silver Needles were perfectly intercepted and blocked.
She was moved, changed color, realizing she encountered a master, unwilling to slack, she swung the duster directly towards Ding Ling’s head!

chapters.title: Chapter 412: Five Poison Secret Technique
paragraphs: He flicked the duster lightly.
Threads of white lines, as straight as steel needles, seemed to transform into a rain of steel spears in an instant, piercing towards Ding Ling.

Ding Ling raised his brow slightly; advancing instead of retreating, he continuously executed the Dugu Nine Swords, Sword God Skill, Seven-string Invisible Sword, and One Qi Transforms Three Pristine Sword Technique.
At times, the sword force was fierce, like a rushing sea;
At times, the sword flowers bloomed, turning into a scene of a setting sun, stabbing towards the opponent.
At times, one sword split into eighteen swords, each targeting three illusions!
At times, the sword tip trembled, emitting waves of sonic booms that pierced forward!
Several exquisite sword techniques unfolded, each one worthy of being called a top-tier sword art in the world. Moreover, all were at a mastery level.
Any one of them could break through a battle array formed by a group of first-class experts.
When several were executed together.
How could Li Mochou withstand it?
She only felt a blur before her eyes, a sharp pain in her eardrums, and upon looking again, a sword had already pierced into her chest!
It sank straight in, penetrating her body.
From the engagement to being impaled.
It all happened in an instant.
Li Mochou looked at Ding Ling in disbelief, her pretty face turning ashen white in an instant.
She felt an intense pain emanating from her chest.
There seemed to be an infinite suction force there, madly draining her strength.
In less than a breath, she felt weak all over, unable to hold the duster anymore, which fell to the ground with a thud, making a dull sound.
"Senior Sister..."
Little Dragon Girl was stunned.
"Master Li, this..."
Yang Guo was speechless.
He expected Ding Ling to easily defeat and kill Li Mochou soon.
But he hadn’t imagined it to be so effortless and swift.
How many exchanges had there been?
If not counting the first two times the Ice Soul Silver Needle was knocked off, it seemed it was over in less than a single exchange!
Too fast!
So fast that Yang Guo hadn’t even reacted, looking at the dying Li Mochou, his expression was dazed.
In his eyes, the Great Demon, the nearly invincible Li Mochou, just died like that?!
"You, you..."
Li Mochou looked at Ding Ling, her expression venomous, as if she wanted to devour him alive.
Ding Ling was not going to indulge her, directly withdrawing the sword.
Puff!
As the sword was pulled out, a column of blood spurted from Li Mochou’s wound.
She clutched her chest, but how could she stop the blood gushing out?

She staggered back two steps and collapsed to the ground, her expression somewhat twisted, as her beautiful face became increasingly vacant. At this moment, it seemed as if she was lost in past memories, muttering unconsciously:
"What is love in this world, that makes one vow life and death? The pair flies north and south, old wings facing cold and heat. Joy in reunion, suffering in separation..."
Before finishing the poem, she had already breathed her last.
Obviously, she was a lovestruck soul.
But she was heartbroken by someone.
Which is why she ended up like this.
However, Ding Ling, having reached this point, wouldn’t spare someone just because they were beautiful.
If you want to kill him, be prepared to be killed by him.
[Achievement Medal Obtained: Intimidating Li Mochou.]
[Note: Li Mochou roamed the world unchecked, striking fear in Jianghu. This time, she came prepared, yet unexpectedly died so easily at your hands.
To the end, she was bewildered, shocked, and resentful.
But at the moment of her impending death, she thought of her lover, taking her last breath with a sigh of resignation and relief.]
Hearing the notification sound.

Ding Ling glanced deeply at Li Mochou, and at the sight of something resembling a secret manual near her chest area, he stepped forward, flipped it up with his sword tip, and grabbed it for a closer look.
The surface of the manual had already been stained with blood.
But large, twisted characters like serpents could still be faintly seen:
"Five Poison Secret Technique"!
Li Mochou’s signature skill.
Ding Ling saw the blood soaking in quickly, fearing that the Five Poison Secret Technique might become incomplete, so he began to read it on the spot.
Not long after.
[Five Poison Secret Technique Inner Power Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +80]
A rush of primordial qi surged over, engulfing Ding Ling.
Ding Ling quickly activated several true skills, refining the qi in just a few breaths.
[Five Poison Secret Technique External Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Physique +0.4]
Instantly comprehending.
Ding Ling realized.
The external skills of the Five Poison Secret Technique included Five Poison Divine Palm, making poisons, identifying toxins, detoxification, and other secret techniques.
Those with low physique might easily get poisoned to death.
So, learning this divine palm urgently required enhancing one’s physique.
And Ding Ling’s physique had long surpassed ordinary people.
Now, after reaching full level, his physique increased significantly again.
Ding Ling could clearly feel his own resistance to poison had improved considerably.
The Five Poison Secret Technique’s inner power heart method possessed characteristics like poison resistance, etc. Though its primordial qi was absorbed by Pure Yang True Skill, Innate True Qi, etc.,
the remaining vigorous qi could still enhance Ding Ling’s poison resistance and detoxification traits under his breath control.
After reading the Five Poison Secret Technique, Ding Ling casually placed it into his storage pouch.
He glanced at Little Dragon Girl and Yang Guo.
At an unknown time.
Little Dragon Girl had walked to Li Mochou’s side, gazing at her with a complex expression on her face.
Yang Guo also walked over, looking at Ding Ling with respect, then turned to Little Dragon Girl and softly called out:
"Aunt."
Little Dragon Girl returned to her senses, sighing:
"Senior Sister is dead. It’s only right to place her body in the coffin now. Let’s go do it."
Seeing this, Ding Ling suggested taking his leave.
But Yang Guo replied:
"Ding Ling, please wait for half a day.

Yesterday, I already talked it over with Aunt. I planned to pass on the Ancient Tomb Sect’s Kung Fu to you this morning to repay your great kindness. I just didn’t expect Li Mochou to suddenly attack.
So, we must thank you, Ding Ling, for saving us from distress."
Upon saying this.
He solemnly expressed his gratitude again with a deep bow.
Little Dragon Girl, under Yang Guo’s indication, also gave Ding Ling a formal bow, albeit with a dazed expression.
Ding Ling waved his hand, said no more, and headed back to the secret chamber, leaping onto the Cold Jade Bed to continue practicing.
Since it was indeed possible to receive the Ancient Tomb Sect’s martial arts.
Ding Ling decided against leaving immediately.
But from this, one could see.
Little Dragon Girl and Yang Guo didn’t regard the inheritance of skills as extremely important.
Apparently, Li Mochou wasn’t given them because of Little Dragon Girl’s master and other reasons.
Tap, tap!
The sound of footsteps gradually faded away.
Needless to say.
Little Dragon Girl and Yang Guo must have gone to deal with Li Mochou’s corpse.
Whoosh, whoosh!
Ding Ling trained on the Cold Jade Bed for half a day.
Just feeling a slight improvement in his skills.
Then at that time.
Yang Guo slipped in, handing Ding Ling a map of the Ancient Tomb Sect, then said:

"The stone wall in the core area of this map is engraved with all the Martial Arts Masterpieces of our Ancient Tomb Sect. Some masterpieces, even I have not mastered fully. Ding Ling, you should go learn. It’s best to observe it on-site."
He paused, adding: "Even Master Li doesn’t know about this core area. It’s an extremely hidden place."

Obviously, she was a lovestruck soul.
But she was heartbroken by someone.
Which is why she ended up like this.
However, Ding Ling, having reached this point, wouldn’t spare someone just because they were beautiful.
If you want to kill him, be prepared to be killed by him.
[Achievement Medal Obtained: Intimidating Li Mochou.]
[Note: Li Mochou roamed the world unchecked, striking fear in Jianghu.
This time, she came prepared, yet unexpectedly died so easily at your hands.
To the end, she was bewildered, shocked, and resentful.
But at the moment of her impending death, she thought of her lover, taking her last breath with a sigh of resignation and relief.]
Hearing the notification sound.

Ding Ling glanced deeply at Li Mochou, and at the sight of something resembling a secret manual near her chest area, he stepped forward, flipped it up with his sword tip, and grabbed it for a closer look.
The surface of the manual had already been stained with blood.
But large, twisted characters like serpents could still be faintly seen:
"Five Poison Secret Technique"!
Li Mochou’s signature skill.
Ding Ling saw the blood soaking in quickly, fearing that the Five Poison Secret Technique might become incomplete, so he began to read it on the spot.
Not long after.
[Five Poison Secret Technique Inner Power Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +80]
A rush of primordial qi surged over, engulfing Ding Ling.
Ding Ling quickly activated several true skills, refining the qi in just a few breaths.
[Five Poison Secret Technique External Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Physique +0.4]
Instantly comprehending.
Ding Ling realized.
The external skills of the Five Poison Secret Technique included Five Poison Divine Palm, making poisons, identifying toxins, detoxification, and other secret techniques.
Those with low physique might easily get poisoned to death.
So, learning this divine palm urgently required enhancing one’s physique.
And Ding Ling’s physique had long surpassed ordinary people.
Now, after reaching full level, his physique increased significantly again.
Ding Ling could clearly feel his own resistance to poison had improved considerably.
The Five Poison Secret Technique’s inner power heart method possessed characteristics like poison resistance, etc.
Though its primordial qi was absorbed by Pure Yang True Skill, Innate True Qi, etc.,
the remaining vigorous qi could still enhance Ding Ling’s poison resistance and detoxification traits under his breath control.
After reading the Five Poison Secret Technique, Ding Ling casually placed it into his storage pouch.
He glanced at Little Dragon Girl and Yang Guo.
At an unknown time.
Little Dragon Girl had walked to Li Mochou’s side, gazing at her with a complex expression on her face.
Yang Guo also walked over, looking at Ding Ling with respect, then turned to Little Dragon Girl and softly called out:
"Aunt."
Little Dragon Girl returned to her senses, sighing:
"Senior Sister is dead.
It’s only right to place her body in the coffin now.
Let’s go do it."
Seeing this, Ding Ling suggested taking his leave.
But Yang Guo replied:
"Ding Ling, please wait for half a day.
Yesterday, I already talked it over with Aunt.
I planned to pass on the Ancient Tomb Sect’s Kung Fu to you this morning to repay your great kindness.
I just didn’t expect Li Mochou to suddenly attack.
So, we must thank you, Ding Ling, for saving us from distress."
Upon saying this.
He solemnly expressed his gratitude again with a deep bow.
Little Dragon Girl, under Yang Guo’s indication, also gave Ding Ling a formal bow, albeit with a dazed expression.
Ding Ling waved his hand, said no more, and headed back to the secret chamber, leaping onto the Cold Jade Bed to continue practicing.
Since it was indeed possible to receive the Ancient Tomb Sect’s martial arts.
Ding Ling decided against leaving immediately.
But from this, one could see.
Little Dragon Girl and Yang Guo didn’t regard the inheritance of skills as extremely important.
Apparently, Li Mochou wasn’t given them because of Little Dragon Girl’s master and other reasons.
Tap, tap!
The sound of footsteps gradually faded away.
Needless to say.
Little Dragon Girl and Yang Guo must have gone to deal with Li Mochou’s corpse.
Whoosh, whoosh!
Ding Ling trained on the Cold Jade Bed for half a day.
Just feeling a slight improvement in his skills.
Then at that time.
Yang Guo slipped in, handing Ding Ling a map of the Ancient Tomb Sect, then said:
"The stone wall in the core area of this map is engraved with all the Martial Arts Masterpieces of our Ancient Tomb Sect.
Some masterpieces, even I have not mastered fully.
Ding Ling, you should go learn.
It’s best to observe it on-site."
He paused, adding: "Even Master Li doesn’t know about this core area.
It’s an extremely hidden place."

chapters.title: Chapter 413: Bird-Catching Skill! Celestial and Earth Net Formation
paragraphs: Ding Ling took the map and glanced at Yang Guo:
"Do you have anything else?"
Yang Guo nodded:
"Aunt said Master Li has passed away. We need to prepare some incense and other items to pay respects to her. I plan to go down the mountain to buy them."
"Alright, go ahead."
Ding Ling looked at the map, though complicated, it wasn’t incomprehensible.
After all, his ’Following the Map’ skill had reached full level.
As long as he had a map, finding the precise location wasn’t too difficult.
Yang Guo left.
Ding Ling didn’t see Little Dragon Girl.
He didn’t specifically seek her out either.
Instead, he followed the map to find the secret chamber.
After winding his way through various secret doors for almost an hour, Ding Ling finally reached the core location.
He silently admired:
"Amazing. The path is full of mechanisms. Numerous secret doorways and passages. Many places seem like dead ends but once the precise mechanism is activated, a safe path reveals itself.
The mechanisms here are interconnected, seemingly endless. Wang Chongyang must be a mechanical master, or rather,
he knows a top-notch mechanical master!"
Upon arriving at the secret chamber, Ding Ling surveyed the surroundings.
Sure enough.
The place was etched with various Martial Arts Masterpieces.
Even the Sword Technique of the Quanzhen Sect was etched here.
However, Quanzhen Sect’s techniques lacked a Heart Method Mantra.
Whereas the Ancient Tomb Sect’s were etched with both techniques and heart method mantra.
"In this way, it won’t risk being lost."
Ding Ling nodded with approval.
In worlds like the Three Kingdoms, breathing techniques, and Martial Arts Masterpieces handed down orally, many have been lost.
The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World is better, with many Inner Power Heart Methods recorded in secret manuals.
However, here there are no secret manuals, only inscriptions on stone.
The longevity of stone inscriptions is far greater than secret manuals, lasting hundreds or even thousands of years, these inscriptions may still exist.
With this thought, Ding Ling couldn’t help but wonder:
"Does this mean that the Smiling, Proud Wanderer World also has these stone inscriptions in its ancient tombs?"
But recalling the numerous deadly and hidden doors along the way, Ding Ling concluded that without a map, no one could find this place.
Even with exceptional luck, it’s unlikely.
The probability of finding this place is like someone winning five million ten times consecutively—it’s absurd!
Not realistic.
"Time to start learning the Martial Arts Masterpieces of the Ancient Tomb Sect."
Ding Ling’s Heart Lake stirred slightly.
After all, these were the masterpieces capable of outshining all Quanzhen Sect’s martial arts.
Even Wang Chongyang was at a loss until he acquired the Nine Yin Scripture to find a way to counter them.
It shows that in Jianghu, the Ancient Tomb Sect’s masterpieces are undoubtedly top-notch!
Ding Ling first examined the lightweight skills.
He skimmed through quickly.
In the next instant.
[Bird-Catching Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.3]
[Constitution +0.1]
This was clearly a top-level lightweight body technique, not inferior to the Snake Stepping Weasel Rolling Method.
Ding Ling activated the lightweight skill, his form shifted, elegant and nimble to the extreme! He seemed like a leaf, floating lightly, weightless.

"Combine this lightweight technique with Golden Swan Skill, Flying Swallow Technique, Ten Thousand Miles Solo Lightness Skill, and Snake Stepping Weasel Rolling, with my special Vigorous Qi, I might effortlessly leap over dozens of miles."
"In this way, what’s the difference between me and an Earth Immortal?"
Ding Ling had experienced being an Earth Immortal in the Three Kingdoms.
He hadn’t expected to reach this level so quickly without relying on Celestial Might.
His lightweight traveling ability almost rivaled his power when utilizing Celestial Might!
What if he harnessed Celestial Might, wouldn’t he become unbelievably powerful?
Ding Ling didn’t ponder further, he continued reading.
A short while later.
[Celestial and Earth Net Formation Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
Though just an entry-level skill of the Ancient Tomb Sect, it was Lin Chaoying’s unique creation, and being an Ultimate Skill, it was naturally remarkable!
Once initiated.
The technique rapidly and seamlessly executed, easily controlling and catching birds in flight! Naturally, catching people would be even easier!
After mastering the Celestial and Earth Net Formation, Ding Ling felt deeply impressed.
He anticipated.
With his special Vigorous Qi.
Not just ninety-nine sparrows, even two or three hundred sparrows would struggle to escape his Celestial and Earth Net Formation!
"This technique is truly extraordinary, Lin Chaoying is indeed a genius, her intellect, perception, and aptitude must be astonishing, or else how could she have created such a technique.
I couldn’t."
Ding Ling felt embarrassed.
It’s fortunate he has the Divine Skill Automatic Full Level cheat, otherwise, he would be just an ordinary person and naturally unable to compare with such a genius.
But fortunately, he has self-awareness and won’t compare his weaknesses with others’ strengths.

He has the Divine Skill Automatic Full Level cheat, all he needs to do is use it; it’s unnecessary to ponder over creating martial arts, which would be time-consuming, exhausting, and likely pointless.
Unless one day he reaches the intelligence level of Lin Chaoying and others, then he might start creating martial arts.
Before that.
It’s best to advance step by step and rise steadily.
Before achieving immortality, Ding Ling won’t consider wasting time on creating martial arts.
Ding Ling continued to read.
Moments later.
[Yu Girl’s Heart Scripture Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
Whoosh!
Once more, a surge of Primordial Qi flowed from all directions, engulfing Ding Ling.
Ding Ling channeled his True Skill, swiftly absorbing and refining Qi.
Not long afterward.
A sixth drop of True Water split into one drop of True Water.
[True Power Value: 7 points]
True Power Value increased by one point.
Still 300 Inner Power Value gains one point.
It should have divided out a drop of True Water long ago.
But the Innate True Qi of the Innate Skill hadn’t merged into the True Water of the Pure Yang True Skill, so the 100 Inner Power Value didn’t count.
"Indeed a top-tier technique."
Ding Ling silently praised.
This technique is not a bit inferior to Pure Yang True Skill.
If Pure Yang True Skill hadn’t condensed True Water first, his Dantian might have been filled with Yu Girl’s Heart Scripture’s exclusive True Qi.
The Yu Girl’s Heart Scripture is truly outstanding.
Even though the 100 Inner Power Value was absorbed and refined by Pure Yang True Skill.
There was still a trace of special flexible Vigorous Qi moving through the Dantian and meridian paths.
Just like the special Vigorous Qi generated by the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic and Tai Chi Scripture, it worked similarly.
Ding Ling only needed to slightly channel this technique.
This strand of Vigorous Qi would rapidly manifest its power, if paired with the Ancient Tomb Sect’s masterpieces, Yu Girl’s Heart Scripture would surely demonstrate formidable power.
"Very good."
Ding Ling continued to read.
Next is Ice Soul Silver Needle, Jade Bee Needle, Jade Maiden Pure Heart Swordsmanship and so forth, all reaching full level.
Watch and they reach full level.
The full level of these techniques.
Also noticeably increased Ding Ling’s four-dimensional attribute values again.
[Strength +0.4]
[Agility +0.6]
[Constitution +0.4]

chapters.title: Chapter 414: The Dragon Girl Seriously Injured
paragraphs: Full Level in several types of Martial Arts.
Plus the various skills acquired earlier.
Ding Ling’s strength once again soared significantly.
Ding Ling glanced at the Character Panel:
[Bone Structure 3 (average person is 1 point), Intelligence 3.5, Strength 43.1, Agility 44, Constitution 46, Defense 42, Charm 11.7.]
Compared to the 40-point limit in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World.
Upon arriving in the Divine Eagle World.
The Four-dimensional Attributes are rising rapidly.
Looking at the situation.
Maybe it won’t be long before it reaches 50 points.
"I wonder if 50 points is the limit in this world?"
Ding Ling wasn’t very sure.
After all, the rumored Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill is extremely powerful, and the strength limit may exceed this value.
"When encountering Golden Wheel Dharma King, I must find a way to seize this art."
Coming to this world, learning Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill is a must.
This is the Outlandish Martial Arts that legends say require thousands or even tens of thousands of years to reach Great Perfection!
Ding Ling is really curious about how powerful this skill can be.

"Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill is divided into thirteen levels. The first level can be mastered in two years by a dim-witted person. The second level requires four years. The third level requires eight years.
And so forth. Training to the thirteenth level requires an unbelievably long time, making it seem not meant for ordinary people!"
"And Golden Wheel Dharma King reached the tenth level in decades. It is imaginable that his talent must have reached an unbelievable level!"
Thinking so, Ding Ling glanced around the secret room and decided to return.
The time spent returning was no shorter than going.
It also took about an hour.
Back and forth.
The time spent on the road alone was more than two hours!
Ding Ling’s eye twitched twice, shook his head, and walked directly to the secret room where the Cold Jade Bed was located, not seeing Little Dragon Girl or Yang Guo.
Ding Ling felt puzzled.
Thinking of how Yang Guo mentioned he wanted to pay tribute to Li Mochou, he then walked towards the secret room where the coffin was.
He’s going to leave the Ancient Tomb Sect.
He needs to inform the two of them, and also pass on the core secrets of Lion’s Roar and Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique to Yang Guo.
This was agreed upon when exchanging Martial Arts, and there’s no going back.
After all, Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl treated him well, and Ding Ling acknowledged their integrity.
Tap-tap!
Thanks to having a map, even with many twists and turns in this ancient tomb, Ding Ling smoothly found the secret room with the coffin and took a focused look.
Yet he saw no one.
Ding Ling called out twice, but no one responded.
"Strange, where did they go?"
Ding Ling thought to himself, considering how much time had passed since his departure and return, perhaps they went to cook, he then headed to the ’kitchen’ secret room.
However, the secret room was also empty.
"It’s already this time, they wouldn’t just leave without a word for no reason, something must have happened, I reckon?"
Ding Ling couldn’t comprehend.
After pondering for a while, he stopped worrying and took out paper and pen, starting to write down the secrets of Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique and Lion’s Roar.
Once finished.
He placed it to the side and pressed it down with a bowl.
"So, when Little Dragon Girl and Yang Guo return, they should notice it immediately."
Ding Ling couldn’t stay in the Ancient Tomb Sect for long, and besides, the Ancient Tomb Sect wouldn’t allow an outsider to stay long, even if Little Dragon Girl and Yang Guo wouldn’t mind too much.
But knowing the rules of the Ancient Tomb Sect, Ding Ling naturally chose to abide by them as much as possible.
He wouldn’t want to be an annoying and disliked person.
"It’s time to go."
Ding Ling took one last look at the ancient tomb, sighed, turned around, and walked boldly towards a corridor.
This is the way out of the ancient tomb.

Ding Ling employed Bird-Catching Skill, as light as a swallow, extremely agile! His entire body was light and floaty, seemingly walking on clouds, with a gentle push of the ground, his body shot like a cannonball, whistling out far away.
Truly an exceptional Lightweight Skill Mystic Technique.
Within mere moments.
Ding Ling walked out of the ancient tomb, stood at its entrance, and faintly heard the sound of bells coming from afar.
That was the Daoists of Quanzhen Sect ringing the bell, perhaps they were about to start training?
"Hmm?!"
Ding Ling was about to lift his leg forward when he inadvertently glanced and saw a delicate silhouette lying in the grass not far away.
The figure’s owner was dressed in white, her face pale as paper, stunningly beautiful, who else could it be but Little Dragon Girl?
Ding Ling was surprised.
He approached and called out, but received no response.
Then took a closer look.
Her chest subtly moved up and down, blood trickling from her lips, seemingly wounded.
"How did such a thing happen all of a sudden?"
Ding Ling surveyed the surroundings.
Yang Guo was nowhere to be seen.
Yet, shadows of people could faintly be seen in all directions.
Calculated with fingers.
hours had already passed.
Player login time should be soon.
It’s quite likely that many players would arrive in this Ancient Tomb Sect area to search for Little Dragon Girl and Yang Guo.
With this realization.
Ding Ling bent down and picked up Little Dragon Girl, ready to return to the ancient tomb.
Unexpectedly.
Just as he picked her up.
Little Dragon Girl let out a soft moan, her eyelids trembled, and abruptly opened her eyes.
Ding Ling heard the sound and instinctively lowered his head, and upon doing so, their gazes immediately met.
Little Dragon Girl was initially confused.
But soon.
She seemed to realize what was happening.
Her pretty face instantly blushed with two patches of peach-colored red.
She struggled, weakly saying:
"Ding, Ding Ling, please, put me down."
"Okay."
Ding Ling, in straightforward manner, actually put her down.
But Little Dragon Girl was weak in her legs and hands, unable to stand steadily, and immediately collapsed to the ground again.
This time.
She appeared to have touched the wound, grimacing with pain, her eyebrows furrowed into a tight knot.
"What has happened to you? We can talk about it later, but I need to remind you that soon more people will come to the surroundings of the ancient tomb. You can see for yourself."
Ding Ling signaled Little Dragon Girl to observe the commotion around.
Although suffering from severe injury, Little Dragon Girl’s eyesight was still intact, and after careful observation, she indeed noticed many flickering shadows around the ancient tomb.
She was bewildered, confused as to why there were never people around the ancient tomb before, yet recently various strange people kept appearing one after the other.
But given the current situation.
She couldn’t really stay lying on the ground here for several hours.
Thinking of this.
She glanced at Ding Ling.
Seeing Ding Ling calmly watching her.
Recalling the words he spoke a while ago, her pale white face once again turned ’red’ with peach-colored cheeks.
She opened her mouth, seemingly wanting to say something, but due to the constraints between a man and woman, was ultimately unable to utter anything.
Little Dragon Girl had lived in the ancient tomb for years.
Yet, she was well aware of the issues concerning the prevention between men and women.
Facing such a dilemma now, she was momentarily at a loss, unsure of what to do.
Ding Ling noticed this, raised his eyebrows slightly, and without further ado, bent down and picked her up once more.
This time Little Dragon Girl didn’t resist or struggle, nor did she say a single bad word, only stiffened straightly with her body feeling a bit prickly.
Her face blushed to the roots of her ears.
All her life.
This was the first time she was held by someone of the opposite sex like this.
Though she’d practiced Yu Girl’s Heart Scripture with Yang Guo for quite a while, normally both paid great attention to the prevention between men and women, ensuring no misconduct occurred.

Due to Ding Ling’s arrival, which resulted in Zhao Zhijing and Yin Zhiping being hammered to death, the incident where Little Dragon Girl and Yang Guo were spotted practicing Yu Girl’s Heart Scripture in the flowers naturally did not occur.

Ding Ling thought to himself, considering how much time had passed since his departure and return, perhaps they went to cook, he then headed to the ’kitchen’ secret room.
However, the secret room was also empty.
"It’s already this time, they wouldn’t just leave without a word for no reason, something must have happened, I reckon?"
Ding Ling couldn’t comprehend.
After pondering for a while, he stopped worrying and took out paper and pen, starting to write down the secrets of Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique and Lion’s Roar.
Once finished.
He placed it to the side and pressed it down with a bowl.
"So, when Little Dragon Girl and Yang Guo return, they should notice it immediately."
Ding Ling couldn’t stay in the Ancient Tomb Sect for long, and besides, the Ancient Tomb Sect wouldn’t allow an outsider to stay long, even if Little Dragon Girl and Yang Guo wouldn’t mind too much.
But knowing the rules of the Ancient Tomb Sect, Ding Ling naturally chose to abide by them as much as possible.
He wouldn’t want to be an annoying and disliked person.
"It’s time to go."
Ding Ling took one last look at the ancient tomb, sighed, turned around, and walked boldly towards a corridor.
This is the way out of the ancient tomb.
Ding Ling employed Bird-Catching Skill, as light as a swallow, extremely agile!
His entire body was light and floaty, seemingly walking on clouds, with a gentle push of the ground, his body shot like a cannonball, whistling out far away.
Truly an exceptional Lightweight Skill Mystic Technique.
Within mere moments.
Ding Ling walked out of the ancient tomb, stood at its entrance, and faintly heard the sound of bells coming from afar.
That was the Daoists of Quanzhen Sect ringing the bell, perhaps they were about to start training?
"Hmm?!"
Ding Ling was about to lift his leg forward when he inadvertently glanced and saw a delicate silhouette lying in the grass not far away.
The figure’s owner was dressed in white, her face pale as paper, stunningly beautiful, who else could it be but Little Dragon Girl?
Ding Ling was surprised.
He approached and called out, but received no response.
Then took a closer look.
Her chest subtly moved up and down, blood trickling from her lips, seemingly wounded.
"How did such a thing happen all of a sudden?"
Ding Ling surveyed the surroundings.
Yang Guo was nowhere to be seen.
Yet, shadows of people could faintly be seen in all directions.
Calculated with fingers.
hours had already passed.
Player login time should be soon.
It’s quite likely that many players would arrive in this Ancient Tomb Sect area to search for Little Dragon Girl and Yang Guo.
With this realization.
Ding Ling bent down and picked up Little Dragon Girl, ready to return to the ancient tomb.
Unexpectedly.
Just as he picked her up.
Little Dragon Girl let out a soft moan, her eyelids trembled, and abruptly opened her eyes.
Ding Ling heard the sound and instinctively lowered his head, and upon doing so, their gazes immediately met.
Little Dragon Girl was initially confused.
But soon.
She seemed to realize what was happening.
Her pretty face instantly blushed with two patches of peach-colored red.
She struggled, weakly saying:
"Ding, Ding Ling, please, put me down."
"Okay."
Ding Ling, in straightforward manner, actually put her down.
But Little Dragon Girl was weak in her legs and hands, unable to stand steadily, and immediately collapsed to the ground again.
This time.
She appeared to have touched the wound, grimacing with pain, her eyebrows furrowed into a tight knot.
"What has happened to you?
We can talk about it later, but I need to remind you that soon more people will come to the surroundings of the ancient tomb.
You can see for yourself."
Ding Ling signaled Little Dragon Girl to observe the commotion around.
Although suffering from severe injury, Little Dragon Girl’s eyesight was still intact, and after careful observation, she indeed noticed many flickering shadows around the ancient tomb.
She was bewildered, confused as to why there were never people around the ancient tomb before, yet recently various strange people kept appearing one after the other.
But given the current situation.
She couldn’t really stay lying on the ground here for several hours.
Thinking of this.
She glanced at Ding Ling.
Seeing Ding Ling calmly watching her.
Recalling the words he spoke a while ago, her pale white face once again turned ’red’ with peach-colored cheeks.
She opened her mouth, seemingly wanting to say something, but due to the constraints between a man and woman, was ultimately unable to utter anything.
Little Dragon Girl had lived in the ancient tomb for years.
Yet, she was well aware of the issues concerning the prevention between men and women.
Facing such a dilemma now, she was momentarily at a loss, unsure of what to do.
Ding Ling noticed this, raised his eyebrows slightly, and without further ado, bent down and picked her up once more.
This time Little Dragon Girl didn’t resist or struggle, nor did she say a single bad word, only stiffened straightly with her body feeling a bit prickly.
Her face blushed to the roots of her ears.
All her life.
This was the first time she was held by someone of the opposite sex like this.
Though she’d practiced Yu Girl’s Heart Scripture with Yang Guo for quite a while, normally both paid great attention to the prevention between men and women, ensuring no misconduct occurred.

Due to Ding Ling’s arrival, which resulted in Zhao Zhijing and Yin Zhiping being hammered to death, the incident where Little Dragon Girl and Yang Guo were spotted practicing Yu Girl’s Heart Scripture in the flowers naturally did not occur.

chapters.title: Chapter 415: The Reason
paragraphs: "You could say."
"Now, Little Dragon Girl is truly being embraced by a man for the first time."
"Naturally, her heart is in turmoil!"

"In an instant, her thoughts flew wildly, even the Twelve Minor Technique she practiced in her early years could not restrain itself, and the peaceful, undisturbed state of mind was once again broken."
She dared not look at Ding Ling, only tightly closing her apricot eyes, while her eyelids uncontrollably trembled slightly.
Ding Ling saw it but did not point it out.
He’s spent some time together with Little Dragon Girl, and being adept in the Observing People Skill and other techniques, he understands her personality fairly well.
This is a complete novice!
Compared to Little Dragon Girl, Ding Ling might be considered an old hand.
Yet, he wouldn’t do anything deliberately to tease Little Dragon Girl, because that’s not respectful.
They moved swiftly.
Until they reached the Cold Jade Bed within the Ancient Tomb Sect.
Ding Ling thought of Little Dragon Girl being severely injured, unsuitable to lie on the bone-chilling Cold Jade Bed, so he redirected her to Granny Sun’s previous stone chamber.
During the journey.
Little Dragon Girl was dazed, completely unaware of what was happening, allowing Ding Ling to lead her.
Seeing such a Little Dragon Girl, Ding Ling sighed, such an innocent, no wonder she was deceived into marriage by that old rascal Gongsun Zhi! Indeed too pure and naive.
Modest, indifferent to fame or gain, this one is humble, cautious, resembling her master.
Thinking of her master as Lin Chaoying’s maid, one can infer a thing or two.
Lin Chaoying being assertive and fierce, the maid accompanying Lin Chaoying harmoniously implies the maid is gentle, accommodating, cautious and dutiful enough.
Plus, Granny Sun, who usually accompanied Little Dragon Girl, probably didn’t dare to discipline her much due to her low status.
In such an environment.
Under the daily influence of the two closest people, Little Dragon Girl’s temperament would somewhat resemble Lin Chaoying’s maid, which is understandable.
Ding Ling felt at ease.
After he placed Little Dragon Girl on the bed, he said:
"I see you’ve been poisoned by the Ice Soul Silver Needle earlier. The venom has already entered your viscera, you should rest and heal to expel the poison, why did you run outside?"
Little Dragon Girl opened her eyes, glanced at Ding Ling, her face flushed, a mix of bashfulness, shame, and guilt, reaching the peak of emotional turmoil; she originally wanted to say a few words.

But as the twelve minor twelve major Technique she practiced from childhood broke, coupled with the venom entering her viscera and being severely wounded, under the emotional turmoil, she couldn’t help but have blood dribble from her mouth, feel dizzy, and uncontrollably faint once again.
"Little Dragon Girl, Little Dragon Girl."
Ding Ling called a couple of times, yet there was no response.
He found it quite tricky.
Leave it alone?
He couldn’t do it, after all, Little Dragon Girl and Yang Guo are extremely respectful to him and cared much for him, offering the Cold Jade Bed and the Ancient Tomb Sect’s supreme skill.
They genuinely treat him as a benefactor.
Under such conditions.
How could he possibly abandon such a severely injured person like Little Dragon Girl?
Especially when there might be players lurking outside.
Leaving Little Dragon Girl here.
In no time, there might appear several more Dragon Knights like Yin Zhiping.
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling decided to heal Little Dragon Girl.

He has practiced the Healing Chapter of the Nine Yin Scripture to the level of instinct, and with Medicine King Breathing Technique, Medical Saint Breathing Technique, Qingnang Scripture, Inner Scripture as support.
Ding Ling’s skill in the Medical Dao can be said to have reached the Transformation Realm.
Besides.
He recently also reached full level in Ice Soul Silver Needle, Five Poison Secret Technique.
It’s clear how to cure Little Dragon Girl.
But to cure the poison, some herbs must be refined.
The tomb is empty, lacking such herbs.
Thinking of this, Ding Ling lifted Little Dragon Girl and utilized the Healing Chapter of the Nine Yin Scripture to heal Little Dragon Girl and suppress the poison.
As long as the poison is temporarily suppressed.
Ding Ling has time to refine the herbs, the poison on Little Dragon Girl would be no problem.
His prowess is remarkable!
True Qi vast and mighty, in no time, suppressed all of Little Dragon Girl’s poison into her Dantian.
At this moment, Little Dragon Girl regained consciousness, seeing Ding Ling in close contact with her, almost leaning together, her heart warmed, blushing, she softly said:
"Ding, Ding Ling, thank you."
Her Inner Strength is profound.

As soon as she regained consciousness, she could clearly sense her body feeling lighter, more comfortable, slightly mobilizing the Yu Girl’s Heart Scripture, she sensed a cluster of compressed poison in her Dantian.
Someone could expel the poison from the viscera and then gather it as a cluster?!
In addition to her shock, Little Dragon Girl felt secretly grateful towards Ding Ling, her bright and open nature made her express her thoughts openly:
"If not for you, I’m afraid I would’ve died."
"We are friends, no need to be so distant."
Ding Ling smiled slightly and said:

"This Ice Soul Silver Needle poison is severely toxic. You’ve delayed for too long; to completely cure it, some herbs must be refined, combining with the power of Great Medicine and my special Vigorous Qi, it’s not difficult to fully heal you."
"But in the Ancient Tomb Sect, there are no herbs.
Little Dragon Girl was quite troubled:
"Unless when Guo’Er returns, I’ll let him look for some herbs."
"Then Yang Guo?"
Ding Ling asked.
"He was taken away by a crazy old man."

Little Dragon Girl’s voice remained ethereal and icy, but perhaps due to familiarity, Ding Ling noticed the pleasing sound more than the initial enchantment and emotion, even so, her voice was still melodious and extremely pleasant to hear, simply listening to her talk was a kind of enjoyment.
This was Ding Ling’s true feeling.
"Could you elaborate on this?"
"It’s quite simple."
Little Dragon Girl nodded and said:
"Guo’Er was supposed to go down the mountain to buy items needed for the senior sister’s memorial, but before he descended, he was caught by an old man. That old man insisted on taking him away.
Guo’Er, fearing I would wait long, suggested meeting me once to clarify things.
The old man agreed.
But not long after meeting Guo’Er.
The old man was quite domineering and wanted to spar with me.
Guo’Er tried to block him.
He knocked Guo’Er unconscious.
Then started a fight with me.
Though he appeared deranged, his skills had reached the Transformation Realm, I was no match for him, after several rounds, I could barely hold on and wanted to concede.
The old man wouldn’t allow it, striking several palms, severely injuring me, if not for Ding Ling’s timely arrival, I would’ve died at the gate of the Ancient Tomb Sect."
She shared this.
Her expression was wistful, eyes dazed, lost in thought:
"I’m not afraid of dying. Everyone dies eventually, early or late, it doesn’t make much difference to me.
I’m just afraid of dying like this.
Guo’Er might feel heartbroken, sad, couldn’t move on, also, I promised Granny Sun to care for him lifetime."
Reflecting upon this, I momentarily didn’t want to die immediately.
Luckily..."
She glanced at Ding Ling:
"Ding Ling, you saved me. Thank you."
She thanked him again.
Saying openly whatever is on her mind, this is Little Dragon Girl.
Ding Ling admired such people.
Because he couldn’t be so open.

chapters.title: Chapter 416: Troubled Thoughts
paragraphs: "Once is enough to thank."
Ding Ling smiled, changed the subject, and said:
"Since Yang Guo was caught by that person. Do you think you can wait for him to come back any time soon?"
"This..."
Little Dragon Girl’s expression froze, and she glanced at Ding Ling somewhat awkwardly:
"Could it be that I have to trouble you again, Ding Ling?"
"In addition to being poisoned, I see that several of your bones are broken. If you don’t fix them in time, it could leave aftereffects, which would be troublesome."
Ding Ling reminded.
Little Dragon Girl seemed to have thought of something, her face flushed, like the red glow of an evening:
"I’ll do the bone setting myself."
Upon hearing this, Ding Ling didn’t say more, and just replied:
"I’ll go down the mountain to buy some herbs for you. You should take care of your body."
Ding Ling got up and walked two steps, then said:
"Have you recently gained any common knowledge about aliens in your mind?"
"Yes."
Little Dragon Girl was startled, then nodded and said:
"Suddenly, I just knew some information about aliens, I don’t know why."
Ding Ling thought to himself, ’If you can know that, then it would be against the heavens,’ but said aloud:
"Since you know about the aliens, you should know their characteristics. Now that they are gathering outside, you should be more cautious here by yourself."
Upon hearing Ding Ling say this.
Little Dragon Girl nodded with a few traces of nervousness amidst her confusion.
Seeing this, Ding Ling no longer worried, activated the Bird-Catching Skill, and disappeared from the stone chamber like the wind.
Little Dragon Girl watched intently, couldn’t help but be moved, thinking:

"Ding Ling has indeed learned the Supreme Skill of our Ancient Tomb Sect. Moreover, this Bird-Catching Skill is perfectly refined, it seems to have been practiced to the Great Perfection Mastery Realm. This, this is truly too powerful."
Little Dragon Girl’s heart stirred.
Her admiration, astonishment, and acknowledgment of Ding Ling increased further.
She was severely injured.
Although the poison had been suppressed, several broken bones needed to be set, otherwise it was difficult to move.
She attempted to set the bones herself.
But no matter how she tried, she couldn’t do it and couldn’t help but feel frustrated, murmuring:
"What should I do now?"
As she pondered, she suddenly heard movements in various parts of the ancient tomb.
Her ears perked up.
Listening carefully.

"This is the Ancient Tomb Sect indeed. It really looks like a large tomb. Old Liu, you used to be a grave robber, quickly find a way to see which path leads to the core of the tomb chamber. Perhaps we can find the Nine Yin Scripture Fragment before others do!"
"I think it’s not wise to enter the ancient tomb. Encountering Yang Guo or Little Dragon Girl would be too troublesome."

"Those searching all over Zhongnan Mountain are even more troublesome. Haven’t you noticed? The Quanzhen Sect has been inexplicably tense recently, every one of them is incredibly vigilant towards anyone stepping into Zhongnan Mountain.
Even those daring to step onto Quanzhen Sect’s territory face reprimands and warnings. It’s really bizarre! Did Ding Ling get into a conflict with the Quanzhen Sect right after entering this world?
Otherwise, why would the Quanzhen Sect guard against us so carefully..."
Little Dragon Girl heard this.
She was startled.
She realized one thing, that Ding Ling is also most likely an alien.
Moreover, these people seem to know them well, and even know about the Nine Yin Scripture Fragment?
How clever is Little Dragon Girl?
A brief contemplation, and she knew Ding Ling surely had known long ago.
Yet, while leading her and Yang Guo to find this secret chamber, and teaching them to cultivate without reservations, she hadn’t much thought.
What she thinks now is:
"So many aliens are pouring into the ancient tomb, and in the Ancient Tomb Sect, there are only me and Guo’Er. Now Guo’Er was taken by that mad elder.
There’s only me left in the Ancient Tomb Sect.
How can I possibly fend off these overwhelming aliens?
Moreover, they seem to know about the second secret path of the Ancient Tomb Sect as well."
Little Dragon Girl thought of the map in the hidden chamber recording the Nine Yin Scripture.
The map clearly indicates that you can enter and exit the ancient tomb via the waterway.
Upon thinking of this.
Little Dragon Girl couldn’t help but feel sad.
She was previously overwhelmed when Ding Ling broke the twelve stages of her heart.
Now she hasn’t recovered yet.
Suddenly hearing this unexpected news, and clearly connected to the future where the Ancient Tomb Sect may never see peaceful days again.
How could she remain calm?
"Am I still suited to stay here?"
Little Dragon Girl had doubts in her heart.
If a large number of aliens invaded the ancient tomb, and they found that waterway.
Even if she died.
She feared she would still not rest peacefully.
Thinking of death.
She thought of the coffin placed in the stone chamber and couldn’t help but widen her almond-shaped eyes in anxiety:
"If these aliens desecrate the coffin of my master, I could die a hundred times and still not redeem my sin. I mustn’t let my master’s coffin be dishonored.
She forced herself to move to repel the aliens.
But how could she manage?
Using just a bit of strength, a wave of pain came from her body, and her vision went dark, almost fainting.
She sighed.
Gave up.
Just thinking:
"It seems I can’t set the bones, being unable to move, saying it like this, I can only bother Ding Ling."
Thinking like this.
Her face suddenly flushed like fire, frantically shaking her head:
"No way, no way. Men and women shouldn’t touch each other. I was held by Ding Ling before, if he sets my bones again, won’t my chastity be gone? Absolutely not."
But if Ding Ling doesn’t set her bones.
She can’t set them herself.
Sitting idly like this for a long time, leaving aftereffects, she fears it would be even more troublesome.
Thinking of this.
Little Dragon Girl was caught in a dilemma, feeling confused and mostly helpless.
Especially hearing the voices of aliens getting closer and closer, she couldn’t help but feel a sense of unease.
Immediately.
She picked up a Yaoqin beside her and began to play it hard.
This Yaoqin was brought from the stone chamber where the Cold Jade Bed was located last night.
After all, Ding Ling needed to sleep on the Cold Jade Bed, and she needed the Yaoqin to control the Jade Bees.
Once the Yaoqin played.
Sure enough, the Jade Bees she raised came swiftly, responding to her command, swarming to sting those aliens.
In no time.
The ancient tomb echoed with cries and wails.
Little Dragon Girl didn’t intend to harm these people’s lives, so she held back.
However, what she didn’t expect was.
Playing the qin exposed her own location.
Those players couldn’t die immediately, but they had an urge to explore the legendary Little Dragon Girl.
They each wanted to see her beauty.
Moreover, they also understood Little Dragon Girl is kind-hearted and honest, perhaps saying a few good words could have her detoxify them.
Thinking this way.
These grave robbers, led by their leader, came smoothly into Little Dragon Girl’s stone chamber and saw her pale as paper, lying weakly on the bed.
