Moreover, these people seem to know them well, and even know about the Nine Yin Scripture Fragment?
How clever is Little Dragon Girl?
A brief contemplation, and she knew Ding Ling surely had known long ago.
Yet, while leading her and Yang Guo to find this secret chamber, and teaching them to cultivate without reservations, she hadn’t much thought.
What she thinks now is:
"So many aliens are pouring into the ancient tomb, and in the Ancient Tomb Sect, there are only me and Guo’Er.
Now Guo’Er was taken by that mad elder.
There’s only me left in the Ancient Tomb Sect.
How can I possibly fend off these overwhelming aliens?
Moreover, they seem to know about the second secret path of the Ancient Tomb Sect as well."
Little Dragon Girl thought of the map in the hidden chamber recording the Nine Yin Scripture.
The map clearly indicates that you can enter and exit the ancient tomb via the waterway.
Upon thinking of this.
Little Dragon Girl couldn’t help but feel sad.
She was previously overwhelmed when Ding Ling broke the twelve stages of her heart.
Now she hasn’t recovered yet.
Suddenly hearing this unexpected news, and clearly connected to the future where the Ancient Tomb Sect may never see peaceful days again.
How could she remain calm?
"Am I still suited to stay here?"
Little Dragon Girl had doubts in her heart.
If a large number of aliens invaded the ancient tomb, and they found that waterway.
Even if she died.
She feared she would still not rest peacefully.
Thinking of death.
She thought of the coffin placed in the stone chamber and couldn’t help but widen her almond-shaped eyes in anxiety:
"If these aliens desecrate the coffin of my master, I could die a hundred times and still not redeem my sin.
I mustn’t let my master’s coffin be dishonored.
She forced herself to move to repel the aliens.
But how could she manage?
Using just a bit of strength, a wave of pain came from her body, and her vision went dark, almost fainting.
She sighed.
Gave up.
Just thinking:
"It seems I can’t set the bones, being unable to move, saying it like this, I can only bother Ding Ling."
Thinking like this.
Her face suddenly flushed like fire, frantically shaking her head:
"No way, no way.
Men and women shouldn’t touch each other.
I was held by Ding Ling before, if he sets my bones again, won’t my chastity be gone?
Absolutely not."
But if Ding Ling doesn’t set her bones.
She can’t set them herself.
Sitting idly like this for a long time, leaving aftereffects, she fears it would be even more troublesome.
Thinking of this.
Little Dragon Girl was caught in a dilemma, feeling confused and mostly helpless.
Especially hearing the voices of aliens getting closer and closer, she couldn’t help but feel a sense of unease.
Immediately.
She picked up a Yaoqin beside her and began to play it hard.
This Yaoqin was brought from the stone chamber where the Cold Jade Bed was located last night.
After all, Ding Ling needed to sleep on the Cold Jade Bed, and she needed the Yaoqin to control the Jade Bees.
Once the Yaoqin played.
Sure enough, the Jade Bees she raised came swiftly, responding to her command, swarming to sting those aliens.
In no time.
The ancient tomb echoed with cries and wails.
Little Dragon Girl didn’t intend to harm these people’s lives, so she held back.
However, what she didn’t expect was.
Playing the qin exposed her own location.
Those players couldn’t die immediately, but they had an urge to explore the legendary Little Dragon Girl.
They each wanted to see her beauty.
Moreover, they also understood Little Dragon Girl is kind-hearted and honest, perhaps saying a few good words could have her detoxify them.
Thinking this way.
These grave robbers, led by their leader, came smoothly into Little Dragon Girl’s stone chamber and saw her pale as paper, lying weakly on the bed.

chapters.title: Chapter 417: Bone Setting
paragraphs: "Are you Little Dragon Girl?!"
The players were dumbfounded and astonished, as if seeing a celestial being.

Little Dragon Girl was severely injured. She had just barely managed to play the zither to drive off the alien, almost exhausting her strength. Looking increasingly frail and ethereal, like a snow lotus covered with frost, truly breathtakingly beautiful, invoking pity in those who saw her.
When had the players ever seen such a beauty?!
Each of them felt dry-mouthed, restless with anticipation.
Especially after discovering that Little Dragon Girl seemed paralyzed by her injuries, they exchanged glances, each whispering to the others:

"I used to despise Dragon Knight Yin Zhiping, but now, seeing Little Dragon Girl’s appearance, I understand him. What normal man, after seeing such an exquisite beauty, can remain calm? He’d have to be Liuxia Hui, a saint!"
"What should we do? Should we..."
Among the seven or eight players, all male, quite a few developed evil thoughts at that moment.
Of course, there were also some who didn’t want to go along with it, thinking it was extremely inappropriate.
They were scorned by some players:
"This is the game world, what are you afraid of?! There’s no legal responsibility here!"
Despite her serious injuries, Little Dragon Girl’s foundation remained strong.
Her hearing and vision were excellent.
The players, though speaking softly, were heard clearly and understood perfectly by her.
Though she could not comprehend much of what the players were saying.
She could understand their expressions, and she was filled with shame, anger, and anxiety. Taking a deep breath, she began to play the Yaoqin again.
With the pleasant tinkling of the zither, Jade Bees buzzed in like lightning.
Under Little Dragon Girl’s direction.
They swarmed toward the seven or eight players.
This time, Little Dragon Girl did not hold back.
She was extremely agitated, enraged to the utmost.
Several players were stung until they were barely alive.
One player, weaker in constitution, died on the spot.
Little Dragon Girl was startled, it was her first time killing someone, leaving her heart and spirit in disarray, uncertain about how to proceed.
But quickly.
The dead alien unexpectedly revived on the spot, lively and vigorous, without a hint of injury.
Little Dragon Girl was shocked, about to say something.
That player laughed heartily three times and lunged toward her.
Little Dragon Girl had exhausted her energy earlier and was now unable to resist, rolling forcefully to the side as the player missed his pounce.
Curled up in the corner, a sense of helplessness washed over her, thinking if she lost her purity here, death would be preferable.
Just as she was thinking this.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
Suddenly the sound of something whizzing through the air was heard.
They were stones.
Each stone like a bolt of lightning, or a flying sword, rushed with a swish and hit one player squarely on the head, causing it to shatter on the spot.
The other players met the same fate, dying quickly.
Some players revived quickly.
But the result was the same.
Killed a few times over.
And no more players appeared.
Ding Ling’s figure appeared at the entrance of the stone chamber, it was he who acted just now.
Seeing Ding Ling, the heart that had risen to Little Dragon Girl’s throat suddenly relaxed.
She didn’t know why, at that moment she wanted to cry.
Growing up, it was the first time she was seriously injured, the first time she was held by someone, the first time she killed, the first time she was almost harmed...
So many firsts, overwhelming her in less than a day.
How could someone as innocent as her endure it?
Seeing Ding Ling, as she relaxed her heart and spirit, the nerves tensed by anxiety also eased, causing her body to sway and fall forward uncontrollably once again.
With bird-catching skill operating at all times, Ding Ling moved like the wind, arriving in front of Little Dragon Girl and caught her in his arms.
Having been held by Ding Ling once.
Being held by him again.
Little Dragon Girl, though a bit shy, didn’t resist like the first time.
"Do you still resist my setting your bones again this time?"
Ding Ling asked.

Little Dragon Girl initially wanted to shake her head to refuse, but thinking of those players who revived, reflecting on what she just experienced, she was horrified. The head she intended to shake couldn’t move, only remaining silent, but her ears turned a bright red as if dyed.
Seeing this, Ding Ling didn’t say more, just thinking:
"This is too cliché, too common. Why did the hero rescuing the beauty scenario have to befall me."
He genuinely hadn’t expected to save Little Dragon Girl so timely and fittingly.
Gazing at the Yaoqin, the ground littered with Jade Bee corpses, he pondered for a bit.
Without overthinking it.
And he directly led Little Dragon Girl to the stone chamber where the Cold Jade Bed was.
This stone chamber could no longer be stayed in.
Who knew whether those players would log in again.
Though speaking of it.
If a player falls to level 0, it seems terrible consequences like stupidity, and impairment will occur.
Having logged out earlier, he used hacker technology to investigate ’Duanmu Qing’.
Duanmu Qing died way too many times.

Being severely injured and killed by Ding Ling in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, he sustained severe aftermath, becoming an idiot devoid of any memory or intellect, wandering aimlessly, not even knowing he was hungry.
The incident sparked an uproar in society.
After careful investigation and analysis, many players discovered his case wasn’t an isolate!
Upon summary.
They inevitably realized the devastating consequences of falling to level 0.
Thus.
No player would endure the dreadful consequence of being killed to level 0 unless absolutely necessary.
Ding Ling also knew this point.
With palpitations.
Convinced he mustn’t die!
The severe repercussions of dying a lot, if it would turn you into an idiot, you’d rather die instantly!
The severe consequences of dying repetitively.
Even dying once likely has aftereffects, though not apparent usually, undetectable.
Tap tap!
Carrying Little Dragon Girl, Ding Ling arrived at the secret chamber where the Cold Jade Bed was located.
He placed her on the bed directly.
Sure enough.
Little Dragon Girl shivered from the cold.
Embarrassed, ashamed, she dared not gaze directly at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling operated the Pure Yang True Skill, placing his hand on Little Dragon Girl’s back, guiding a stream of Pure Yang Inner Power into her meridians, dispelling the cold entering her organs.
She immediately felt warm and comfortable.
Seizing the moment, Ding Ling said:
"Lie still. I’m going to set your bones."
Little Dragon Girl’s body stiffened, her cool eyes veiled by mist, yet she didn’t resist...
After about a quarter of an hour.
Ding Ling finished setting the bones.
Little Dragon Girl’s gaze towards Ding Ling changed, a cloudy emotion brewed unfathomably in her eyes.
She wasn’t sure what it was caused by.
But she knew.
Her purity had been given to Ding Ling, it was likely she would follow Ding Ling for life. Thinking of this, she gazed directly at Ding Ling and asked:
"Ding, Ding Ling, do you like me?"
Ding Ling was stunned.
"Don’t you like me?!"
Little Dragon Girl’s body trembled, her complexion darkening, her chilly eyes slightly reddened. She turned her back, unwilling to see Ding Ling anymore.
Ding Ling felt overwhelmed, not overthinking, he answered truthfully:
"You’re so gentle, kind, and beautiful. Any normal man would like you, I’m no exception."
"Really?"
Little Dragon Girl was overjoyed, she turned around suddenly, gazing intently at Ding Ling, her ethereal and cool voice still persisted, but now it had an earthly vitality:
"Would you be willing to marry me as your wife?"

chapters.title: Chapter 418 418: Jade Seal
paragraphs: Puff!
Ding Ling almost spat out a mouthful of old blood.
He realized something was amiss, coughed twice, wiped the corner of his mouth, and smiled awkwardly:
"Isn't this too fast?!"
Although he's not a Saint, nor is he Liuxia Hui.
But Little Dragon Girl, with her cool and pure demeanor, resembling a Fairy, he couldn't stoop to do what Yin Zhiping did.
It's okay to like someone openly.
If he were to seize the moment to do something vile, Ding Ling would despise himself.
He truly treated himself just as a 'doctor' just now!
Doctors set bones for patients.
Isn't that very normal?
After setting the bone, Little Dragon Girl said she wanted to marry him, which would catch anyone off guard.
It's not that he's unwilling, it's really too sudden. Ding Ling wasn't mentally prepared.
How could she know.
Little Dragon Girl experienced ups and downs numerous times this day, far surpassing her past decades.
In the past, though her life wasn't smooth, she hadn't suffered any injury, living a plain, uneventful life.
Though later Yang Guo came along.
He merely added some liveliness, some human touch to her life.
She was still who she was, without much transformation.
Until Ding Ling arrived, her mindset frequently stirred.
Especially within less than a day's time experience, the depth of the impact surpassed countless instances from her decades past.
This is easily understood.
Many people never forget their first crush, and some vividly recall the first exciting thing they've ever done.
Little Dragon Girl experienced too many first-time excitements this day, her Heart Technique had long been broken, the waves within Heart Lake were tumultuous, and restless.
Hearing Ding Ling say it's too fast.
Little Dragon Girl was slightly taken aback, realizing their acquaintance only amounted to a day or two.
So brief.
Yet wanting to make a life-long commitment with Ding Ling, to become a union.
Indeed, it is a bit rushed.
Ding Ling's astonishment is quite normal.
Realizing this.
Little Dragon Girl said:
"You've already held me. And you..."
She didn't continue but simply blushed:
"This can't be faked. In this life, who else can I marry besides you? Unless you don't like me and don't want to marry me!
As she spoke, she couldn't help but think of the Ancient Tomb Sect's rule, recalling her master's words 'men are mostly unfaithful'!
Her heart couldn't help but ache, feeling somewhat lost and baffled.
Ding Ling was at a loss for words, but as Little Dragon Girl, this kind of world-class beauty, said she wanted to marry him, he had no reason to oppose.
After all, Little Dragon Girl's martial arts talent is also extraordinary.
According to the original scenario.
The Kung Fu like Left-Right Mutual Struggle, many can't learn it, Little Dragon Girl learns it effortlessly.
Other kung fu like Nine Yin Scripture, she learned with little time invested despite no one teaching her, whether she reached the Mastery and Flawless Realm is unknown.
But her disposition is absolutely top-notch.
When Ding Ling was setting her bone, he felt it distinctly, her disposition was shockingly superb.
Beautiful, gentle, pure, with extremely high talent.
Why would Ding Ling resist?
Unless he wasn't a man!
As naturally as it comes.
Ding Ling came together with Little Dragon Girl.
The hero saving the beauty is cliché.
Yet often the most heartfelt.
Little Dragon Girl felt although she knew Ding Ling briefly, the entire development seemed divinely destined, she saw this as fate sent by heaven.
She brought Ding Ling to meet her master, after speaking sincerely, they paid respects to her master together.
Considered as having met the elders.
Afterward.
Little Dragon Girl spoke of her previous troubles.
Ding Ling smiled slightly, directly picking up the Drumming Golden Hammer to smash a giant rock weighing thousands outside the ancient tomb!
Carrying the giant rock to the secret chamber where Nine Yin Scripture is engraved.
Directly blocking passage with the rock.
In such a manner.
Players must overcome the rock to enter.
To be safe.
Ding Ling even made the passage collapse.
This way.
The chance to enter the ancient tomb through this passage is nearly zero.
"Let's go."
Ding Ling brought Little Dragon Girl to the place where the Cold Jade Bed is stored, such treasures left in the ancient tomb is a real pity.
Ding Ling inquired if Little Dragon Girl had a way.
Little Dragon Girl replied:
"Master said to move this Cold Jade Bed, unless the Ancestor Granny's exclusive jade seal is used. That might work."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling casually asked, unexpectedly Little Dragon Girl had a method, thus he let her bring the jade seal.
Little Dragon Girl now indeed follows her husband.
No matter what Ding Ling says, she complies sincerely!
She embodies the ancient female virtues completely.
Though Ding Ling enjoyed service from beauties like Diao Chan and Da and Xiao Qiao in Three Kingdoms World.
Yet suddenly Little Dragon Girl, with her cold, ethereal beauty not resembling earthly beings, treated him like this, initially makes him feel 'flattered'!
After all, what Little Dragon Girl does does not quite match her appearance.
And Ding Ling, being a modern person, hasn't lived as a Prince for about a year, naturally feels 'awkward', suddenly taken care of clumsily by Little Dragon Girl, becomes emotional.
But since he confirmed this.
Little Dragon Girl, despite her extraordinary talent, cool nature, indeed bears her master's caution, duty, gentleness, acceptance, even excessively humble and self-deprecating demeanor.
Like in the original work.
Huang Rong just slightly 'provokes', Little Dragon Girl overthinks, leaves heartbroken.
This shows her inner fragility.

Ding Ling thinks: 'Since Little Dragon Girl decided to follow me, treating me sincerely, naturally I have no reason to let her down. I need to work harder to cultivate, so in the future, we will achieve immortality together with Diao Chan and Little Dragon Girl.'
Ding Ling is confident that progressing this way.
When he touches the Immortal Dao in the future.
Immortality is just a matter of time.
Tap tap tap!
Little Dragon Girl brought Lin Chaoying's exclusive jade seal.
Ding Ling's carving skill is full level, Dao of Array is also quite excellent.
Carefully observing and researching, he realized this jade seal holds the key to activating the Cold Jade Bed's array.
Just embed the seal in the array's core, it can carry away the Cold Jade Bed's core section.
Within the core lies the essence of Cold Jade Bed and the array.
Ding Ling acted according to his thoughts.
Sure enough.
The Cold Jade Bed indeed cracked under sound.
Revealing a piece of Cold Jade gleaming with treasure light!

Huang Rong just slightly 'provokes', Little Dragon Girl overthinks, leaves heartbroken.
This shows her inner fragility.
Ding Ling thinks: 'Since Little Dragon Girl decided to follow me, treating me sincerely, naturally I have no reason to let her down.
I need to work harder to cultivate, so in the future, we will achieve immortality together with Diao Chan and Little Dragon Girl.'
Ding Ling is confident that progressing this way.
When he touches the Immortal Dao in the future.
Immortality is just a matter of time.
Tap tap tap!
Little Dragon Girl brought Lin Chaoying's exclusive jade seal.
Ding Ling's carving skill is full level, Dao of Array is also quite excellent.
Carefully observing and researching, he realized this jade seal holds the key to activating the Cold Jade Bed's array.
Just embed the seal in the array's core, it can carry away the Cold Jade Bed's core section.
Within the core lies the essence of Cold Jade Bed and the array.
Ding Ling acted according to his thoughts.
Sure enough.
The Cold Jade Bed indeed cracked under sound.
Revealing a piece of Cold Jade gleaming with treasure light!

chapters.title: Chapter 419: Leaving the Mountain
paragraphs: Ding Ling glanced sideways, moved, and exerted true power to lift the Cold Jade, finding it incredibly heavy. Upon contact, it was bone-chilling, and its texture seemed indestructible, extremely hard!
Ding Ling could not crush it even with force.
Of course, Ding Ling dared not use full strength; otherwise, if such a precious jade were destroyed, it would indeed be a sin!
He observed carefully.
Sure enough, he saw various patterns inscribed on the jade. Holding it in hand, he felt Primordial Qi from all directions swarming in, then condensing into frost and adhering to the Cold Jade.
Ding Ling glanced at the remaining part of the Cold Jade Bed.
As expected.
It’s all ice blocks.
He couldn’t help but think:

"Thus, the key core of this Cold Jade Bed lies in this peerless Cold Jade. With it, and coupled with the inscribed array, it automatically converges and absorbs Primordial Qi from all directions, condensing into ice!"
Ding Ling was relieved.
But couldn’t help feeling secretly amazed.
This kind of Cold Jade is indeed extraordinary.
Just a little processing, and it can automatically absorb Primordial Qi for its use.
This is absolutely a rare treasure.
It’s just that the people in this world don’t know how to use it and can only squander it for cultivating Inner Power.
Ding Ling noted that this Cold Jade was rectangular, half a meter long, and less than half a meter wide and high, then placed it into the Storage Pouch.
Indeed.
It easily fit into the Storage Pouch.
After placing the Drumming Golden Hammer inside as well, the Storage Pouch was almost full. Next, only small items could be added.
Seeing this, Ding Ling felt it necessary to get another Storage Pouch.
Otherwise, some things would indeed be inconvenient to carry.
The Little Dragon Girl, having seen the Storage Pouch before, still couldn’t help feeling amazed, thinking it was an Immortal Treasure.
Ding Ling didn’t hide it from her, and after letting her play with the Storage Pouch for a while, he said:
"Now that we have the Cold Jade Bed with us, with the exclusive jade seal and this peerless Cold Jade, we can set up a Cold Jade Bed anytime, so there’s no need to stay here."
The Little Dragon Girl’s expression darkened, her cold eyes filled with tension, anxiety, and unease.
She had lived in the ancient tomb for decades, and now she was suddenly asked to leave.
Although she had mentally prepared herself a while ago, suddenly facing such a dilemma still made her anxiety palpable.
Ding Ling saw through it and said:
"The Alien is all-pervasive and can resurrect. If you stay here, you’ll surely encounter their incessant harassment. You’re all alone..."
"No."
The Little Dragon Girl suddenly interrupted Ding Ling, looking at him firmly:
"I still have you, and Guo’Er."
"Yes, yes, yes."
Ding Ling was stunned for a moment, then nodded with a smile:
"You still have us. But Yang Guo is missing, and I can’t stay in the Ancient Tomb for long either."
"Do you really want to leave the Ancient Tomb?"
"When I smashed the corridor, you should’ve known."
The Little Dragon Girl fell silent.
She struggled internally for a long time.
Ultimately, she chose to follow Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was her husband.
When married, she naturally followed him wherever he went.
Thinking of this, her restless, anxious heart calmed down.
Ding Ling understood and immediately took her hand, leading her outside the Ancient Tomb.
Upon reaching outside.
A long cry rang out.
Neigh!
Two Ferghana Horses responded, having followed Ding Ling through several worlds, quite spirited. Usually, Ding Ling imposed no restraints on them, and they wouldn’t stray.
Always around the Ancient Tomb, finding food on their own, saving Ding Ling a lot of thought.
At this moment, accompanied by the sound of hooves.
The two Ferghana Horses soon appeared in sight and quickly galloped to Ding Ling and the Little Dragon Girl.
Ding Ling indicated for the Little Dragon Girl to mount a horse.
As for the entrance of the Ancient Tomb.
Ding Ling once again smashed several thousand-pound boulders, hoisting them up to block the entrance.
The combined weight of these boulders even surpassed the Dragon-Breaking Stone.
Now, not to mention second- or third-rate experts, even first-rate experts would be at a loss.
Not everyone possesses such terrifying strength as Ding Ling.
By activating Fusion Qi and true power.
The force Ding Ling could exert far surpassed the power of Four-dimensional Attributes.
Ding Ling estimated that in terms of force, he should easily crush other masters in this world.
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling leaped onto the horse’s back.
The Little Dragon Girl had never ridden a horse, but her Bird-Catching Skill had reached the Mastery level, enabling her to sleep soundly on a rope; mere horseback riding was easy for her.

Ding Ling gave her a few pointers, imparting some key techniques, and her riding skills visibly improved. In a short time, her skill level reached Great Success, likely to achieve Mastery in no more than half a day.
Ding Ling marveled secretly, thinking:

"The Little Dragon Girl’s talent is outstanding. Unexpectedly, her comprehension is also exceedingly extraordinary. If she cultivates well with guidance from a master, her future will surely be bright."
Ding Ling felt a slight thrill, recalling the extremely talented Li Yuanba. In Inner Power and other areas, the Little Dragon Girl was not inferior to Li Yuanba, possibly even stronger.
It was evident she would become Ding Ling’s proud assistant in the future.
Clip-clop!
The two of them galloped along the road.
Facing difficult mountainous paths, they dismounted and led the horses.
Along the way, they encountered many players.
Upon seeing Ding Ling and the Little Dragon Girl, they couldn’t help but cry out in surprise.

"Oh my! Not long ago, someone said the Little Dragon Girl of the Ancient Tomb Sect was whisked away by Ding Ling. I didn’t believe it. Seeing how loving Ding Ling and the Little Dragon Girl are now, how could it be fake?!"
"Ah! That guy Ding Ling! He took my Goddess too! I originally wanted to apprentice at the Ancient Tomb Sect. Now that the Little Dragon Girl has left, what’s the point?!"

"Yes, indeed. Ding Ling has an endless streak of romances. From the Three Kingdoms, The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, to Divine Eagle World, without a pause. At least, he should leave us some room to breathe. Don’t take away all the peerless beauties!"
The players spoke openly.
Ding Ling, hearing it, understood immediately that the news about him and the Little Dragon Girl had undoubtedly been spread by some players he had killed before.
However, Ding Ling paid it no mind. Of the seven or eight players, two or three were obviously new players. After being killed multiple times, one likely dropped to level zero.
If this wasn’t enough to deter the player community, Ding Ling didn’t mind killing them one by one.
In his eyes, these players were like paper, incapable of withstanding a blow.
The Little Dragon Girl also heard it. Although she didn’t understand some parts, she knew they were jealous of Ding Ling, looking back with a touch of strange emotion.
She fixed her gaze on Ding Ling.
Ding Ling asked what was wrong.
She, puzzled, said:
"Ding Ling, you are so perfect and excellent. I married you. They should be the ones jealous of me, right? Why does it seem different now?"
"Because they’re men."
Ding Ling smiled:
"And most men regard you as a Goddess. Of course, no doubt, many women see you as a Goddess too."
"What do you mean?"
The Little Dragon Girl was confused.

Ding Ling explained a few more things. The Little Dragon Girl understood, but seemed indifferent. Clearly, in her mind, she never saw herself as a Goddess, yet always regarded Ding Ling as the perfect man.
To marry Ding Ling.
For her, it was a fate given by the heavens.

chapters.title: Chapter 420: Shaolin
paragraphs: Little Dragon Girl regarded Ding Ling as the core focus.
She saw herself as ephemeral as the breeze and grass.
Ding Ling understood this well as he observed. It was Little Dragon Girl’s nature at play. Though she was exceptional, her inherent humility and lack of confidence were quite evident.
Clearly, she had been deeply influenced by her master.
Although she typically did not show this lack of confidence.
Once deeply in love, she would become anxious and uncertain. A few words from others would stir her heart, leaving her restless and uneasy.
Knowing her disposition, Ding Ling specifically advised her never to believe what outsiders say. That they should focus on being together well in the future.
Of course, Little Dragon Girl readily agreed.
On the way down the mountain halfway.
They encountered some Daoists from the Quanzhen Sect.
The Daoists behaved as if they had encountered a fierce tiger, their faces turning pale, retreating in haste.
This startled some of the players trailing behind, who couldn’t help but start to discuss:

"It seems our previous guess was correct. Ding Ling did indeed cause a ruckus at the Quanzhen Sect, but no news leaked out. It shows that these Quanzhen Sect Daoists either did it for face or simply because they’re afraid of Ding Ling, so they hid all the unpleasant incidents."

"But now, the Quanzhen Sect overall looks extremely disciplined; there’s not a single lax person, nor anyone too arrogant or domineering. Could it be that people like Zhao Zhijing were killed by Ding Ling?"
Players came to Zhongnan Mountain, naturally for the fragments of the Nine Yin Scripture, to become disciples of the Quanzhen Sect and the Ancient Tomb Sect.
Now the Ancient Tomb Sect has dissolved.
The Daoists of the Quanzhen Sect all looked solemn and tense, refusing any outside guests.
The Nine Yin Scripture Fragment also seemed hard to find.
This left players feeling a sense of ’numbness’ and ’paralysis’ powerlessness.
Ding Ling, however, did not meddle or overthink it.
After coming down the mountain.
Ding Ling went to a small town nearby, asking if anyone had seen Yang Guo.
Clearly,

Yang Guo often came to the town for shopping. His handsome elegance made him well-known, and Ding Ling, seeing this, particularly asked a few people, telling them that if Yang Guo wanted to find his aunt, he could wait in Xiangyang.
To encourage them to be enthusiastic in this task, Ding Ling gave away some silver.
The silver was naturally exchanged from the gold in his Storage Pouch.
Three hundred taels of gold.
Sufficient for Ding Ling’s early expenses.
"Will Guo’er be able to find us this way?"

Little Dragon Girl walked beside Ding Ling. After setting her bones properly, Ding Ling specially brewed a medicinal soup for her. His skill was extraordinary, so cooking didn’t take long, and neither did brewing the medicinal soup.
After taking the medicine.
Little Dragon Girl looked much healthier.

Now she just needed a few more doses of the medicinal soup, and she would likely succeed in detoxifying herself. On the way, Ding Ling also took the opportunity to guide Little Dragon Girl in practicing the Healing Chapter of the Nine Yin Scripture. She was gifted and talented, now having reached an entry level, and could heal herself.
With both approaches at work,
Little Dragon Girl recovered well, appearing even more like a celestial with her cold elegance, attracting countless gazes along the way.
Yet she was oblivious, her eyes only on Ding Ling. Her almond-shaped eyes only followed Ding Ling as he walked; wherever Ding Ling went, her gaze followed.
Ding Ling was feeling complex emotions. At this, hearing her question, he replied:
"We will definitely meet him again in the future. There’s no need to doubt that."
Little Dragon Girl nodded and said:
"I promised Granny Sun to take care of him for a lifetime. He is also my apprentice; I can’t simply ignore him."
Ding Ling smiled, showing his understanding.
Little Dragon Girl was true to her word.
Yang Guo was also a good person, and Ding Ling admired both of them, hoping they would have a favorable outcome.
Now that Little Dragon Girl was with him,
naturally, he would do his best to guide her in training superior martial arts, aiming for her to reach the Innate Realm early on, so few in this world could harm her.

However, Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl indeed only had a master-disciple relationship at present. They had only been together for just over two years, mostly spent with one teaching martial arts and the other, besides learning martial arts, helping with cooking.
Nothing inappropriate occurred between them.
So, no so many future complications would arise.

Ding Ling understood this clearly in his heart, yet he wouldn’t be overly bothered. Noble-minded people feel serene, while petty people feel jittery. Ding Ling did not consider himself noble, but he certainly wasn’t petty either.
On this day.
Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl rode to an inn near Mount Songh.
While having a meal here, Ding Ling overheard some players engaging in fervent discussions nearby.
Listening carefully for a moment.
Ding Ling understood.
Indeed, it turned out just as he had guessed.
So many people knew about the Nine Yang Divine Skill that ultimately no one obtained it.
Instead, the monks of the Shaolin Temple discovered the Nine Yang Divine Skill hidden in the crevice of the Lengjia Scripture ahead of them!
This was good news.
Now everyone had no chance.

The monks of the Shaolin Temple hid this Divine Skill very well. Players couldn’t even access the regular scriptures on the ground floor of the Scripture Pavilion, let alone reach the top floor housing the Seventy-Two Skills and see the Nine Yang Divine Skill.
Regarding this.

Many players were filled with righteous indignation, feeling that everyone was unscrupulous! Selfish and only caring for themselves, each harbored the idea of ’if I can’t have it, then neither should anyone else’!
Now that Ding Ling had arrived, numerous players recognized him, feeling even more hopeless and preparing to seek alternative paths.
Now Ding Ling’s name had already resonated far and wide among the players.
Though many natives felt the players’ rumors were misleading and spiraled out of control, many also remembered Ding Ling’s name.
Made a note of the name Ding Ling.
While online, Ding Ling had frequently utilized hacking techniques to investigate, naturally uncovering much insider information.
But he couldn’t stop the players from spreading the word.
Who made him the number one player among them?
From Zhongnan Mountain, arriving at Mount Songh.
His route had long been noticed by those with intentions, and many knew his goal was surely the Nine Yang Divine Skill, with everyone speculating whether he would actually obtain it.
Some even set up gambling pools on forums everywhere, wagering whether Ding Ling would acquire the Nine Yang Divine Skill or not.
Ultimately, half supported and half opposed.
Those supporting Ding Ling felt he was too extraordinary, invincible, everything going smoothly, naturally leaving little room for failure.
Those opposing felt that Shaolin Temple was a great sect, housing innumerable experts. How could Ding Ling, a single person, withstand their offensive?
Nonetheless.
These people also knew of Ding Ling’s accomplishments at Shaolin Temple and with the Mount Songh Sect in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World.
But ultimately Ding Ling had never swept through Shaolin Temple.
In no world had he done so.
Thus this time.
They equally thought it impossible for Ding Ling to sweep through.
Of course, those in support felt Ding Ling sweeping through wasn’t a problem.
The forum, therefore, erupted into a fierce debate, truly like public opinions vying for dominance!

Of course, those in support felt Ding Ling sweeping through wasn’t a problem.

chapters.title: Chapter 421: Framing
paragraphs: "Ding Ling, eat."
Little Dragon Girl actively served Ding Ling, adding dishes and rice, showing great kindness.
Her demeanor was enough to make many players who viewed her as a goddess feel heart-wrenching pain, pounding their chests in regret and loudly lamenting the loss of their ’beloved’.
In response.
Ding Ling was left speechless but could only let those players feel envy and hatred.
From Zhongnan Mountain to Mount Song.
The journey was long and arduous.
Along the way.

Ding Ling was instructing Little Dragon Girl on cultivating the ’External Refining Breathing Technique’, also known as the Sword God Breathing Technique, which was a top-tier technique that was hard to master.
But for ordinary people, it would be difficult, while for Little Dragon Girl, it only took her a day to master it.
Next was to adhere to the prescribed routine and continue cultivating and learning.
With Ding Ling being an expert who had mastered the Breathing Technique, guiding her cultivation clearly and decisively.
It naturally allowed her cultivation to progress smoothly, never encountering any obstacles.
Until now.

Little Dragon Girl’s Breathing Technique vigor fused with the Inner Power of the Yu Girl’s Heart Scripture, once released, the power increased fivefold, tenfold. It can be said, having reached this stage, her self-defense ability improved manifold.
Moreover.
Ding Ling taught her a lot of common knowledge along the way.

She is extremely intelligent, quickly learning whatever she is taught, naturally understanding many common knowledge and information, no longer being as clueless as before, such as not knowing that a bun needs to be paid for.
Furthermore, she even took the initiative to buy some books on common knowledge to read.
Upon reading.
She understood how to be a virtuous wife!
Throughout the journey. She progressed from initial awkwardness, ignorance, clumsiness, to becoming competent and efficient.
It’s unknown what books she bought with Ding Ling’s silver, or what hardships she quietly endured, Ding Ling didn’t ask much.
He only observed her, kept it in mind, and thought:
"Little Dragon Girl seriously lacks a sense of security, she needs to be properly settled in the future."
Ding Ling cannot take people with him upon ascension.
Therefore, upon the next ascension.
Little Dragon Girl can only be left in this world, pondering on how to settle her is a problem.
She cannot stay with the Ancient Tomb Sect anymore.
Ding Ling considers placing her in some remote, ancient areas like Tian Mountain with sparse human presence.
She is a super homebody!
Even if alone, she can still play with the Jade Bees.
Therefore.
Ding Ling specially let her bring some Jade Beehive.
Thus, wherever she goes, she can raise bees.
Not having to worry about boredom.
Of course.
Thinking of this now is premature, Ding Ling is just letting his thoughts wander, preplanning for the future, thinking a bit far ahead.
After finishing their meal.
The two of them booked a room to rest at the inn’s second floor.
Ding Ling slept in the bed.
Little Dragon Girl slept on the rope.
Initially, Ding Ling disagreed, but Little Dragon Girl insisted, so he let her be.
She has slept on the rope for many years, her sleeping posture remains elegant, her reclining figure turns into a beautiful landscape painting.
Ding Ling couldn’t help but marvel at how such a pure and ethereal lady could exist in the mortal world.
"What’s wrong?"
Little Dragon Girl noticed Ding Ling not sleeping, merely staring at her, her heart sweetened involuntarily, a smile appearing on her lips, she said:
"Can’t sleep?"
"No."
"Then why are you looking at me with such an expression?"
Little Dragon Girl unexpectedly showed a bit of girlish innocence.
Which was rare.
Ding Ling was again stunned.
Little Dragon Girl couldn’t help but feel even more shy, but the joy in her heart she couldn’t conceal, overflowing to her face and eyes:
"If you wish to look, feel free to do so every day in the future. But now it’s time to sleep. I remember you have things to do tomorrow, don’t get delayed due to lack of rest."
"Okay."
Ding Ling smiled faintly, exchanged a few casual words with Little Dragon Girl, then lay down.
Thus, after an hour or two passed.
Suddenly, loud knocking sounded from outside the door.
Someone was knocking.
Knocking very loudly, urgently, the incessant knocking felt as if the door would be whipped apart by the other party.
Ding Ling awoke from a daze.
Little Dragon Girl also flipped off the rope.
In the dark.
Her pair of water-like eyes emitted a cold glow.
Ding Ling lit the oil lamp.
Stepped forward and opened the door, only to see a group of monks standing at the entrance.
Each had a hostile expression, and the leading old monk pressed his palms together, recited ’Amitabha Buddha’, his eyes like daggers aimed at Ding Ling, loudly said:
"Are you Ding Ling?"
"Yes."
Ding Ling was puzzled, thinking, ’I haven’t yet asked Shaolin Temple for the Nine Yang Divine Skill, how come they found me first.’
He then said:
"May I know why the venerable monks came looking, so aggressively knocking on the door at night?"
His expression was serene as water, standing with hands behind his back, with an imposing demeanor of a Grandmaster.
The old monk observed, startled, immediately raised his vigilance, waved his hand, and the monks behind him instantly raised clubs, angrily pointing at Ding Ling.
The old monk took the opportunity to take out a book from his bosom, said:
"Donor Ding, do you know someone set fire to Shaolin Temple tonight, seizing the Nine Yang Divine Skill, Lion’s Roar, Dharma Swordsmanship, and many other Shaolin ultimate skills?"
"What does that have to do with me?"

Ding Ling was also astonished, bewildered, thinking ’Isn’t it said players are suppressed by Shaolin Temple, unable to find a way to acquire Nine Yang Divine Skill? How come the skill was stolen today right after I arrived? Could this coincidence be more obvious?!’
"How is it unrelated to you?"
The old monk was furious, his face looked extremely unpleasant:
"You just arrived here today, and our Shaolin Temple immediately caught fire, where in this world is there such a coincidence?"
Ding Ling frowned:
"Master, don’t use fallacious reasoning, falsely accuse others!"
"I am not framing you."
The old monk laughed in anger, the laugh shook the clothes in the room, illustrating the depth of his inner power.
His laughter abruptly stopped, with righteous indignation, he stared at Ding Ling, said:

"Someone reported that the leader who set fire to Shaolin Temple was you, Ding Ling! Moreover, I tracked the suspect to this inn, and then saw the Burning Wood Saber Technique Secret Manual dropped at your door!
As of now.
With both human and material evidence, do you dare to deny it?!"
"I don’t understand what you are saying."
Ding Ling snorted, with deep eyes he looked at the old monk and his party:
"I didn’t go and set fire to Shaolin Temple, nor did I take the Nine Yang Divine Skill Secret Manual. If you trust me, leave my sight at once. If not, then I can’t do anything."
"Do you really think we are easily deceived like three-year-old children?"
The old monk shouted:

"Donor Ding, if you cooperate today, follow us to Shaolin Temple and return all secret manuals, we might consider sparing you this once, merely letting you retreat to Shaolin Temple to meditate, ending the rest of your life.
If you are unaware of your position.
No choice but to fight."

chapters.title: Chapter 422: Flame Saber! Deduction
paragraphs: "Haha..."
Ding Ling laughed loudly, not expecting to encounter such trivial matters at this time. However, he was not someone who feared trouble, and immediately said:
"If you want to engage in a duel with me, you must be prepared to be killed. I do not strike lightly; when I do, blood will surely be shed."
"Truly arrogant."
The old monk, enraged:
"Donor Ding, you set fire to Shaolin, stole the Secret Manual, stubbornly unyielding, extremely murderous, and now dare to speak such arrogant words. Truly, you are clueless."
"I don’t want to waste words with you."
Ding Ling’s face darkened, he waved his hand, and a surge of Vigorous Qi flew out, snap! Instantly capturing the Heaven-Swaying Sword placed at the bedside.
Clang!
Ding Ling drew the sword, pointed it at the group of monks, and coldly said:
"Anyone who doesn’t want to die, get lost immediately!"
Upon saying the last word ’get lost.’
Shezhan Spring Thunder!
Roar!
Sound waves surged forward like dragon’s roar or tiger’s howl!
The sonic wave shocked many monks, their eardrums pierced, some fell to the ground, groaning in agony.
The old monk was even more enraged upon seeing this:
"Even Buddha has three points of fire. Donor Ding is this reckless, so don’t blame us for being rude."
The old monk gestured and launched an attack first:
"Let me show you the Shaolin Temple’s Prajna Divine Palm!"
He struck out with his palm.
The powerful Palm Power condensed into a forest of steles; one palm struck out, followed by another quickly. In no time, the air was filled with dense palm shadows.
These palm shadows’ Qi interweaved into a net, yet overwhelmingly powerful to the extreme, seemingly like a mountain pressing down from above, capable of crushing and shattering everything.
The Little Dragon Girl saw this, frowned, and instinctively tightened her grip on the Golden Bell Rope, ready to act.
But Ding Ling was already one step ahead; he thrust out a sword.
Dugu Nine Swords’ Breaking Palm Form!
A flash of dazzling sword light disappeared in an instant.
Suddenly.
Puff!
It pierced through the sky full of palm shadows, penetrated the old monk’s palm, and in an instant, shredded his arms.
Then Ding Ling stepped forward, in the old monk’s terrified, horrified, and incredulous expression, he swung the sword across, puff!
Directly slicing the old monk’s neck.
In the next moment.
The old monk only felt the world spinning, dizzy and blurred vision. He struggled to open his eyes, seeing a blood-red scene covered in rain.
Once Ding Ling made a move?
There was no reason to hold back.
With the Heaven-Swaying Sword, he stormed into the monk group, dashing left and right, with no enemy able to resist. In just a few moments, corpses littered the ground.
The old monk, with extremely strong vitality, witnessed this scene before dying, his soul swayed unsteadily, feeling the utmost regret and remorse.
’Such a fierce villain, just like the legends of those Aliens. How dare I provoke him?! Truly blinded by anger, foolish beyond measure.’
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Shake the Shaolin Temple Bodhi Hall Abbot.]

[Notes: The Bodhi Hall Abbot’s cultivation has reached the First-class Transformation Realm, Half-Step Innate Realm! Yet faced with you, he was defeated instantly. He came with full confidence, but left bewildered, regretful unto death.
He could not believe this result until death. But with the facts before him, he had to accept, and for this, he felt regret, sorrow, and sadness.
If he could choose again, he would certainly never try to challenge you, let alone attempt to subdue you!]
Upon hearing the prompt.
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows slightly, glanced at the scene, walked to the old monk’s remnants, and used the sword tip to pick up the Secret Manual.
Grabbed it.
Carefully inspected.
Sure enough, it was the "Burning Wood Saber Technique!"
He casually flipped through it.
Scanning hundreds of lines quickly, he finished reading.
[Burning Wood Saber Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.2]
This is an absolutely High Tier Saber Technique Secret Manual.
Ding Ling executed Technique, using his palm as a saber, slashed forward, seeing fiery waves rolling in the void, spontaneously condensing into a Flame Saber!
Though this Flame Saber seemed frail.
Yet under the drive of special Qi, it could become overwhelmingly fierce! Extremely sturdy!
"This saber technique is truly marvelous!"
Ding Ling was moved.
This saber technique that can unleash heat waves and flames, how is it different from Jiu Mozhi’s Flame Saber’s ultimate skill?
Especially when driven by his special fusion qi, it truly becomes a Flame Saber. When swung horizontally, who can withstand it?
"It’s just a bit taxing on the constitution."
Ding Ling looked at his palm, though undamaged, he clearly felt a burning sensation.
It’s thanks to his impressive constitution and defense that he can withstand the Burning Wood Saber fueled by fusion qi.
For others, a single palm strike might lead to a ruined hand.
Using a weapon for the Burning Wood Saber technique seems more appropriate going forward.
At Ding Ling’s level.
He can perfectly execute the Burning Wood Saber technique with a sword, without needing to prepare a saber. His Giant Que Sword is extremely broad, using it as a saber poses no problem.
"Ding Ling, are you alright?"
The voice of the Little Dragon Girl reached out.
Ding Ling broke his thoughts, glanced at Little Dragon Girl, noticed her anxious expression, and replied:
"I’m fine. How could anything happen to me?"
"That’s good to hear..."
Little Dragon Girl let out a sigh of relief, then hesitantly said:
"But... I heard Shaolin Temple is a big sect. We killed so many monks, if they conduct a siege on us, wouldn’t it be hard to escape?"
Little Dragon Girl had been with Ding Ling for some time now, no longer the clueless novice she once was; her understanding of certain common knowledge had grown clearer.
"Why worry?"
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, stopped resting, went inside to pack up, then stepped outside saying:
"We’ll deal with soldiers with generals, and flood with earth."
"Alright.
Without overthinking, Little Dragon Girl stood firmly beside Ding Ling and said:
"I’ll accompany you."
Just in the recent battle.
She hadn’t even had the chance to act before it ended.
Ding Ling’s combat prowess once again opened her eyes wide.
On his journey, she had witnessed Ding Ling take action numerous times, and each time it reshaped her understanding.
This time, she realized Ding Ling might be strong to an incredible extent; otherwise, how else could he instantly kill a master of exceptional skill?
Indeed.
In her eyes, the head of Bodhi Hall was considered an unbeatable master and powerful figure.
Ding Ling instantly killed such a formidable superior in her mind.
How strong must one be to achieve that?
"Tap tap!"
Both of them stepped through blood, descended the stairs, and encountered the terrified innkeeper and others hiding on one side.
He just glanced at the innkeeper and the rest.
They immediately fell to their knees, continuously kowtowing, pleading, ’Hero, please don’t kill me, Hero, please don’t kill me.’
Ding Ling was taken aback, did he really resemble a villain?
The Little Dragon Girl seemed to perceive his thoughts and said:
"You are a good person. The ones you killed are the bad guys."
Little Dragon Girl had always shown her support for Ding Ling through her actions.
Constantly standing by Ding Ling.
Ding Ling chuckled at her, took her hand, and walked out of the inn!
Just as they exited, turning left.
Ding Ling saw a wash of crimson red lighting up this part of the territory.
Looking towards the direction of the light.

Indeed, Ding Ling saw a raging conflagration ascending the Mount Songh region, the fire burned intensely and greatly; it engulfed the forest, illuminating the Eight Directions Territory as brightly as daylight.
Ding Ling glanced sideways and pondered:
"Who are these people creating such a huge affair? Not only do they commit the act, but they also implicate and frame it on me!"
Information related to Ding Ling was released beforehand, notifying the Shaolin Temple folks of this ’villain’ Ding Ling.
Ding Ling arrived at Mount Songh.

Immediately, a fire broke out, theft occurred, diverting attention, then a player was sent to Ding Ling’s inn to throw the Burning Wood Saber Technique Secret Manual in front of Ding Ling’s door, before logging off and disappearing.
Ding Ling deduced.
This is approximately the conclusion.
As for the specific details within.
Ding Ling was unaware.
However, these people’s precise planning suggests that they might be a group with high IQ.
Regarding such people.
Ding Ling has never harbored contempt.
"But since you’ve provoked me, there’s no way I’d let you go unnoticed."
Ding Ling thought:
"Later I’ll log off, use hacking and other techniques to investigate, I don’t believe I can’t find traces online. As long as I find a hint, you’re dead!"

Ding Ling was taken aback, did he really resemble a villain?
The Little Dragon Girl seemed to perceive his thoughts and said:
"You are a good person.
The ones you killed are the bad guys."
Little Dragon Girl had always shown her support for Ding Ling through her actions.
Constantly standing by Ding Ling.
Ding Ling chuckled at her, took her hand, and walked out of the inn!
Just as they exited, turning left.
Ding Ling saw a wash of crimson red lighting up this part of the territory.
Looking towards the direction of the light.

Indeed, Ding Ling saw a raging conflagration ascending the Mount Songh region, the fire burned intensely and greatly; it engulfed the forest, illuminating the Eight Directions Territory as brightly as daylight.
Ding Ling glanced sideways and pondered:
"Who are these people creating such a huge affair?
Not only do they commit the act, but they also implicate and frame it on me!"
Information related to Ding Ling was released beforehand, notifying the Shaolin Temple folks of this ’villain’ Ding Ling.
Ding Ling arrived at Mount Songh.

Immediately, a fire broke out, theft occurred, diverting attention, then a player was sent to Ding Ling’s inn to throw the Burning Wood Saber Technique Secret Manual in front of Ding Ling’s door, before logging off and disappearing.
Ding Ling deduced.
This is approximately the conclusion.
As for the specific details within.
Ding Ling was unaware.
However, these people’s precise planning suggests that they might be a group with high IQ.
Regarding such people.
Ding Ling has never harbored contempt.
"But since you’ve provoked me, there’s no way I’d let you go unnoticed."
Ding Ling thought:
"Later I’ll log off, use hacking and other techniques to investigate, I don’t believe I can’t find traces online.
As long as I find a hint, you’re dead!"

chapters.title: Chapter 423: Annihilation of the Entire Clan
paragraphs: Ding Ling knew that this was a group crime, and therefore, they would definitely divide the spoils and make contact.
It’s impossible for them to disappear into thin air.
If that’s the case.
Then there must be some clues.
He had encountered such a situation once in the Three Kingdoms World.
But that time, the player group was even more arrogant and reckless!
This time, however, they were much more discreet. After framing him, they simply vanished.
From start to finish, Ding Ling did not know who they were, why they wanted to frame him, or what exact methods they used.
"Let’s go."
Since the Nine Yang Divine Skill was stolen.
Ding Ling saw no reason to visit Shaolin Temple anymore.
Moreover, with the great fire that consumed the Shaolin Temple.
How many secret manuals could possibly be preserved?
This was still a question.
A thousand-year-old temple destroyed overnight by a fire, whoever did this was ruthless!
The planning must have been meticulous and thorough to the utmost degree, otherwise, it would have been impossible to catch the entire Shaolin Temple off guard with lightning speed!
"Where to?"
Little Dragon Girl obeyed, and instinctively asked, but before Ding Ling could reply, she immediately added:
"I’ll go fetch the horse."
Evidently.
In her view, wherever Ding Ling went, she would follow, there was no need to ask too much.
Seeing this, Ding Ling did not respond, but once Little Dragon Girl brought the Ferghana Horse, he prepared to leap onto the horse and leave the Mount Songh area.
But as he was about to leave.
Someone wouldn’t let him go.
Swish, swish, swish!
A group of monks armed with sticks, led by someone, rushed out rapidly from a small path, blocking Ding Ling.
The leading few old monks wore kindly expressions, but at this moment, they were like Furious Vajras, glaring at Ding Ling, rebuking angrily:
"Are you Ding Ling?"
"What do you intend to do?"
Ding Ling did not mount the horse, instead drew the Giant Que Sword, planted it on the ground, and with a calm demeanor, looked towards the monks:
"Do you want to kill me? Or punish me?"
"Good, good, good!"
The leading old monk, seeing that Ding Ling had killed people, stolen scriptures, and burned Shaolin Temple, yet remained unfazed, couldn’t help but shout ’good’ three times, extremely infuriated:
"I, the Abbot Wuhai of Shaolin Temple. I want to ask Donor Ding a question, was it you who killed Wushan, the head of the Bodhi Hall?"
Clearly an inquiry.
Yet used a tone of certain outrage.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow:
"I killed him."
"Did you steal the scriptures? Did you start the fire?"
Still a statement of certainty.
"No."
"You’re still trying to argue!"
Abbot Wuhai was enraged, gritted his teeth, no longer showing a kind appearance, glaring fiercely, holding a single saber, said:
"Amitabha Buddha, your sins are boundless, and I shall send you to the Western Heaven to meet Buddha."
As soon as his voice fell.
With his command.
Monks from all directions immediately formed Arhat Arrays.
Surrounding and attacking towards Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl’s position.
Fearing the battle would affect Little Dragon Girl.
Ding Ling took the initiative to meet them.

He activated the Five Great Breathing Techniques and Pure Yang True Skill! In an instant, the special Fusion Qi infused all parts of his body, under the effect of the surging Vigorous Qi, the Bird-Catching Skill ran perfectly, and Ding Ling, like a flash of lightning, burst into the opponents’ battle array, boom!
He wielded the Giant Que Sword, the Burning Wood Saber Technique abruptly operated, the Flame Qi flowed and burst wantonly, actually condensing into an extremely refined Flame Saber in the void!
Swoosh!
He swung the Giant Que Sword forward, crackling!

The Flame Saber swept through, instantly setting a group of monks ahead on fire, and a special Qi erupted from the flames, with booming explosion sounds, they all fell to the ground, their chests no longer heaving, uncertain of life and death.
"Is this the Burning Wood Saber Technique of my Shaolin Temple?!"

Abbot Wuhai, with extraordinary eyesight, seemed to have a realization, yet was somewhat incredulous, only because in his impression, the Burning Wood Saber Technique was not supposed to have this kind of power.
He simply didn’t know.
Ding Ling’s special Fusion Qi was enough to enhance the technique’s power tenfold.
The ordinary Burning Wood Saber Technique had upgraded into the Flame Saber.
How could he possibly withstand it?
Crackling!
Once Ding Ling started the fight, he did not hold back.
Sometimes using the Flame Saber to clear the way, making monks grunt and unable to stand;
Sometimes the Sword God Skill manifested Sunset Diagrams and Flowers in Full Bloom, and where the diagrams fell, severed limbs and heads flew.

Sometimes, with a single thrust, he unleashed the Dugu Nine Swords, the moves were fierce and swift, antelope’s horns, Heavenly Horse Soaring in the Sky, leaving no way to discern where the sword came from!
The monks couldn’t withstand Ding Ling for a single round.
Indeed, they were wounded or killed at a touch!
Where Ding Ling passed, it was like the sea parting.
In just a moment, he pierced through the monks’ battle formation, then he charged back again.
Like this three or four times.
Until Abbot Wuhai also fell into a pool of blood.
Only then did Ding Ling stop.
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: Intimidated Shaolin Temple’s Abbot]

[Annotation: Abbot Wuhai, Innate Realm, Martial Power unrivaled in the world! He came well-prepared this time, thinking he could easily handle you. Yet he never expected your capability to be terrifyingly immense!
He wasn’t even your match for a single round.
With one move, you easily pinned him to the ground.
At his last moments, he was bewildered, shocked, and unbelieving.
If given the chance to do it over, he would surely lead the monks of Shaolin Temple far away from you!
Only because this mistake, he thoroughly forfeited the living strength of Shaolin Temple.
He felt remorse, self-blame, frustration. Yet it was to no avail.
He died with unwillingness, regret, resentment, helplessness, and powerlessness!]
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: Intimidated Dharma Hall’s Head.]
[Obtained Achievement Medal: Intimidated Prajna Hall’s Head]
Ding Ling heard a series of dense notification sounds.
Surprised,
He actually harvested two E-level medals.
Why didn’t he feel anything?

At this moment, he suddenly realized that his Breathing Technique’s Vigorous Qi integration with Inner Power had reached such a deep and explosive state, that it could easily crush this group of ordinary Innate experts.
So easily that it was no different from killing ordinary second-rate experts.
Ding Ling glanced around.
Some players were observing secretly.
Previously, Ding Ling had no particular feelings towards players, neither good nor bad, after all, he was a player himself, his former classmates, colleagues, etc., could all be players.
Players’ qualities vary, there are good and bad people, this is a fact.
But having been calculated by players not long ago, Ding Ling felt very displeased, and couldn’t help but shout:
"Get lost!"
Rumble!

With the power of a Lion’s Roar, one shout, all the onlookers, without exception, felt as though struck by thunder, with their minds buzzing as if a heavy hammer was pounding fiercely, only feeling a splitting headache, and for a moment, uncountable numbers were holding their heads, wailing and collapsed on the ground.
But with this one shout.

It immediately scared off the curious, those attempting to scavenge, as well as spies arranged by Ding Ling’s enemies, they were all shouted back three zhang and dared not casually stare at Ding Ling anymore.
One by one, they were shocked, some new players who had not seen Ding Ling lose his temper, at this moment, inexplicably had some admiration, respect, and fear for Ding Ling.
Yet more felt fervor.
"If only one day I could be as strong as Ding Ling."
After wiping out all the monks.
Finding that these monks all had bulging chests, seemingly carrying a lot of things.
Using his sword to check.
Indeed.
Either Great Medicine, Pills.
Or scriptures, secret manuals.
"When the fire was raging at Shaolin Temple, seeing the fire roaring and difficult to extinguish, these monks decided to bring all their possessions down the mountain."

chapters.title: Chapter 424: Buddha Qi
paragraphs: It’s all worked out in my favor now.
Ding Ling thought for a moment, and then he understood everything.
But what exactly is the truth.
Perhaps it was beyond Ding Ling’s expectations.
In this regard,

he didn’t dwell on it too much. In his subconscious mind, he believed that strength was everything, and with strength, one could easily suppress everyone. Therefore, he had always been on the Path of the War God, rapidly enhancing his own strength, disdaining to play with schemes and intrigue.
Most importantly, he was not good at it.
Although his wisdom was somewhat higher than that of ordinary people, compared to monsters like Zhuge Liang, he was far behind.
He might even be no match for Little Dragon Girl, Diao Chan, and Qu Feiyan.
Because Diao Chan and the others had extremely strong memories!
And Ding Ling?
He was far from being able to remember things instantly.
And those with high wisdom often have strong memories, which is the setting for the Wisdom Attribute.
Ding Ling was clear about this.
He did not expect to enhance his wisdom rapidly; he just wanted his strength to improve quickly.
In the Three Kingdoms World, one could gallop ahead, suppressing countless petty villains around the Great Wei Kingdom single-handedly, slaughtering the Xianbei Royal Court alone!
This is the embodiment of absolute strength.
Any schemes or ploys would collapse like dirt in the face of absolute strength, helpless and vulnerable.
It was because he suddenly realized this.
Ding Ling looked at the large fire on Mount Songh in confusion:

"If strength can truly crush everything, with Innate Experts being sharp-eared and far-sighted, possessing supreme strength, how could players make any moves right under their noses? Perhaps as soon as they act, they would be discovered and killed in one strike!"
No matter how players resurrect.
If someone blocked their resurrection point.
Even if they died multiple times, they would become idiots!
They likely wouldn’t dare go online and offline frequently.
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling understood there was definitely something fishy about it.
But since the information he controlled was limited, he could not accurately infer the beginning and process.
But the result was obvious.
He was framed, and the player ran away with the benefits.
By tracing the tracks from the results, it was not difficult.
After all, Ding Ling knew hacking and other skills.
"I’d better take care of these things and then find a quiet, secluded place to handle other matters."

Ding Ling picked up the Secret Manuals, Great Medicine, Buddhist Scriptures, and other things in the arms of the Abbot and others, and put them into the Storage Pouch. After the Storage Pouch was full, he put them in another bag.
He filled up two large bags.
Ding Ling tied the bags to one side of the Ferghana Horse and then rode away.
Many players watched with envy.
But they knew they didn’t have the ability to compete with Ding Ling for the treasure Secret Manual, so they could only watch helplessly as Ding Ling rode further away.
Under the moonlit night.
Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl rode for more than a dozen miles.
They stopped in a forest.
Made a fire.
And sat down there.
Ding Ling began to take out the collected Secret Manuals to study them carefully.
Flipping through them casually.
Reading ten lines at once, he quickly finished the first book.
[Flower-Picking Grasp Mastery]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
This is a High Tier grappling manual.
It is one of the Seventy-Two Shaolin Temple Skills, extremely formidable.
Especially when Ding Ling’s special Fusion Qi was used, it caused ripples in the void once performed, capable of easily capturing the target as if picking flowers.
Little Dragon Girl’s cold eyes were fixed on Ding Ling practicing martial arts, her alabaster face engraved with admiration.
In her eyes.
Ding Ling is an All-Powerful King!
She admired and adored Ding Ling more and more.
Watching Ding Ling learn the Seventy-Two Shaolin Temple Skills so quickly at this moment, she was both shocked and delighted.
To her.

The stronger Ding Ling was, the higher her sense of security; she hoped Ding Ling could be safe all his life, never getting hurt. As Ding Ling grew stronger, the possibility of injury decreased, increasing her joy and sense of security accordingly.
This shows.
Little Dragon Girl truly saw herself in the role of Ding Ling’s wife.
Ding Ling, seeing this, was increasingly determined not to let down such a pure, courteous, gentle, and kind-hearted girl as Little Dragon Girl.
He took a deep breath.
Continued to browse the Secret Manuals.
The second book was also quickly completed.
[Dragon Claw Grappling Hand Mastery]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.2]
This is a top-level grappling manual higher than the Flower-Picking Grasp.
With thirty-six styles in total.
When executed, it is like a true dragon turning over, and a flood dragon overturning the sea, each move full of divine might.
The third book.
[Breaking Taboo Saber Technique Mastery]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
Instantly entering Mastery.
Ding Ling unconsciously radiated a fierce Sword Intent charging forward!

With his eyes flashing with sharpness, he used his hand as a knife, slashing into the void. Instantly, the void was filled with dazzling saber lights. Even the dim night could not hide the sharpness, ferocity, and dominance of this saber technique.
This is an exclusive saber technique for slaughter!
There are seven or eight books among the Seventy-Two Ultimate Skills.
The rest were mostly second-rate, third-rate cultivation techniques.
These techniques numbered in the dozens.
After Ding Ling finished, it merely added some foundation, making his Vigorous Qi’s transformation more smooth and desirable, not becoming more difficult.
In addition.
There were hundreds of various Buddhist Scriptures.
After Ding Ling read each one.
[Wisdom +0.7]
The Sea of Consciousness became increasingly clear, seemingly expanding slightly.
Ding Ling could distinctly sense an increase in his memory.
Memories previously forgotten in the corners resurfaced substantially at this moment.
Not only that.
His analytical ability and various other abilities improved.
"This is wisdom."
Ding Ling felt very pleased.
Unfortunately.
These Buddhist Scriptures combined the unknown years of Shaolin Temple’s collection, containing countless sages’ wisdom, adding 0.7 to Wisdom for Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was quite satisfied with this.
After all, growing in Wisdom was favorable for him.
Especially since these Buddhist Scriptures didn’t just enhance Wisdom.
They also introduced a ’Buddha Qi’ to Ding Ling’s viscera and meridians.
This Buddha Qi was harmonious and vast, capable of smoothing over all Evil Qi and washing away all darkness.
Ding Ling could clearly feel that some Evil Qi and negative emotions hidden deep within his body were completely cleansed by this Buddha Qi.
"Such strong Buddha Qi."
Ding Ling was silently amazed.
"It’s much better than the Qingnang Scripture!"
Although the Qingnang Scripture also had the effect of cleansing and suppressing Evil Qi.
In terms of efficiency, it couldn’t compare to this Buddha Qi!

"No wonder the Sweeping Monk in Celestial Dragon Eight Books urged Xiaoo Yuanshan and Murong Bo to read more Scriptures; there was a reason. A person who cultivates too many ultimate skills and kills excessively would easily let Fire Qi flourish and get invaded by evil influences and Evil Qi.
With one misstep, they might fall into an abyss of no return!"
And if one specialized all these Buddhist Scriptures to Full Level.
The Dantian and meridians naturally and smoothly produce a pure, vast Buddha Qi.
Buddha Qi passing through.
All Evil Qi and evil influences will collapse like mud.

"I walk the Path of the War God, experiencing endless battles and massacres along the way, already invaded by Evil Qi. Initially, the Qingnang Scripture and others suppressed it, preventing it from erupting, allowing me to maintain a normal mind constantly.
But if it continues.
I fear that one day even the Qingnang Scripture will be unable to suppress this Evil Qi.
At that time.
I might end up doing acts of extreme cruelty and lose myself completely!"
