Ding Ling, seeing this, was increasingly determined not to let down such a pure, courteous, gentle, and kind-hearted girl as Little Dragon Girl.
He took a deep breath.
Continued to browse the Secret Manuals.
The second book was also quickly completed.
[Dragon Claw Grappling Hand Mastery]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.2]
This is a top-level grappling manual higher than the Flower-Picking Grasp.
With thirty-six styles in total.
When executed, it is like a true dragon turning over, and a flood dragon overturning the sea, each move full of divine might.
The third book.
[Breaking Taboo Saber Technique Mastery]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
Instantly entering Mastery.
Ding Ling unconsciously radiated a fierce Sword Intent charging forward!
With his eyes flashing with sharpness, he used his hand as a knife, slashing into the void.
Instantly, the void was filled with dazzling saber lights.
Even the dim night could not hide the sharpness, ferocity, and dominance of this saber technique.
This is an exclusive saber technique for slaughter!
There are seven or eight books among the Seventy-Two Ultimate Skills.
The rest were mostly second-rate, third-rate cultivation techniques.
These techniques numbered in the dozens.
After Ding Ling finished, it merely added some foundation, making his Vigorous Qi’s transformation more smooth and desirable, not becoming more difficult.
In addition.
There were hundreds of various Buddhist Scriptures.
After Ding Ling read each one.
[Wisdom +0.7]
The Sea of Consciousness became increasingly clear, seemingly expanding slightly.
Ding Ling could distinctly sense an increase in his memory.
Memories previously forgotten in the corners resurfaced substantially at this moment.
Not only that.
His analytical ability and various other abilities improved.
"This is wisdom."
Ding Ling felt very pleased.
Unfortunately.
These Buddhist Scriptures combined the unknown years of Shaolin Temple’s collection, containing countless sages’ wisdom, adding 0.7 to Wisdom for Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was quite satisfied with this.
After all, growing in Wisdom was favorable for him.
Especially since these Buddhist Scriptures didn’t just enhance Wisdom.
They also introduced a ’Buddha Qi’ to Ding Ling’s viscera and meridians.
This Buddha Qi was harmonious and vast, capable of smoothing over all Evil Qi and washing away all darkness.
Ding Ling could clearly feel that some Evil Qi and negative emotions hidden deep within his body were completely cleansed by this Buddha Qi.
"Such strong Buddha Qi."
Ding Ling was silently amazed.
"It’s much better than the Qingnang Scripture!"
Although the Qingnang Scripture also had the effect of cleansing and suppressing Evil Qi.
In terms of efficiency, it couldn’t compare to this Buddha Qi!
"No wonder the Sweeping Monk in Celestial Dragon Eight Books urged Xiaoo Yuanshan and Murong Bo to read more Scriptures; there was a reason.
A person who cultivates too many ultimate skills and kills excessively would easily let Fire Qi flourish and get invaded by evil influences and Evil Qi.
With one misstep, they might fall into an abyss of no return!"
And if one specialized all these Buddhist Scriptures to Full Level.
The Dantian and meridians naturally and smoothly produce a pure, vast Buddha Qi.
Buddha Qi passing through.
All Evil Qi and evil influences will collapse like mud.
"I walk the Path of the War God, experiencing endless battles and massacres along the way, already invaded by Evil Qi.
Initially, the Qingnang Scripture and others suppressed it, preventing it from erupting, allowing me to maintain a normal mind constantly.
But if it continues.
I fear that one day even the Qingnang Scripture will be unable to suppress this Evil Qi.
At that time.
I might end up doing acts of extreme cruelty and lose myself completely!"

chapters.title: Chapter 425: Three Kingdoms Ke Bineng
paragraphs: The emergence of Buddha Qi.
Perfectly solved this drawback.
Ding Ling thought to himself:
"It seems that in the future, when walking through other worlds, I also need to look at some more scriptures."
In the Three Kingdoms World, Ding Ling had also read some Dao Scriptures and Buddhist Scriptures, but they didn’t have this effect.
This shows.
The efficacy of Buddhist Scriptures in each world is different.
Just like the Great Medicine in each world, although the years are the same, the Medicinal Qi contained within is quite different.
It’s also like the rules of the Heavenly Dao in each world are different.
The Three Kingdoms have Celestial Might.
The Smiling, Proud Wanderer does not.
Does the Divine Eagle have it?
That’s a question mark.
After reading through all the books and Secret Manuals, Ding Ling.
Began to chew the Great Medicine.
Most of these Great Medicines are over two hundred years old.
Clearly, the Shaolin Temple is very wealthy.
Just these Great Medicines are worth more than ten thousand gold.
And they are the kind without a market.

After all, in the Martial World, many people need to consume Great Medicine for martial arts training, so many Great Medicines are in high demand, and having silver doesn’t necessarily mean you can buy them.
Ding Ling was able to obtain so many at once.
Can only be attributed to luck.
It’s clear those players who set the fire didn’t expect Ding Ling to quickly and decisively wipe out a group of monks and then reap such rewards. If they knew, they certainly wouldn’t settle quietly.
Ding Ling, however, was eager for these guys to come and rob him.
This way he could find out who was secretly attacking him.
Crunch, crunch!
Ding Ling is a straightforward person, and he immediately began to eat.
After finishing a two-hundred-year-old Great Medicine.
He activated the Five Great Breathing Techniques, rapidly refining it.
Almost in the blink of an eye.
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
[Defense +0.1]
It had the same effect as a three to four hundred year Great Medicine in the Lower Realm.
It should be noted that in the Lower Realm, Ding Ling had consumed a lot of Great Medicines.
A three-hundred-year Great Medicine almost had no effect later on.
But now, in this world, a two-hundred-year Great Medicine can simultaneously increase the four-dimensional attributes by 0.1.
This shows that the Primordial Qi and Spiritual Mechanism of this world must greatly surpass that of the Lower Realm.
"Very good."
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
He continued to gobble.
All of his Five Great Breathing Techniques were at full level, activating them all at once, the refining efficiency was exceedingly high.
Almost as soon as he finished eating the Great Medicine, he had already refined it.
This kind of astounding efficiency could leave anyone dumbfounded.
Naturally, ordinary first-class martial arts experts either use medicinal baths, decoct the medicine into a soup, or process into pills and swallow them to use the power of Great Medicine.
Even then, they cannot perfectly absorb the power of Great Medicine for their own use.
Not to mention the time, energy, and effort it consumes, the effect is far inferior to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling directly chews and eats it without any processing, yet perfectly absorbs and refines the power of the Great Medicine.
In this frantic eating.
After consuming hundreds of Great Medicines of various years.
Ding Ling’s four-dimensional attributes increased:
[Strength +5.1]
[Agility +5.1]
[Constitution +5.1]
[Defense +5.1]
Increasing by 5.1 points.
Plus the previous 0.1 point. A total increase of 5.2.
This is a terrifying value.
To know that Ding Ling’s full-level Kung Fu only increases by 0.2 or 0.1, or 0.3, things like that.
And now this is direct 5.2 points.
How many high tier martial arts? Secret Manuals?
Ding Ling was quite satisfied.
He clenched his fists, and a surge of overwhelming power coursed through his fists, as if it could transform into a giant dragon at any moment and strike.
Ding Ling glanced at the Character Panel:
[Bone Structure 3 (ordinary person is 1 point), Intelligence 4.2, Strength 49.1, Agility 49.7, Constitution 51.8, Defense 47.2, Charm 11.7.]
This is Ding Ling’s current strength status.
Strength approaching five thousand pounds.
Any punch thrown could presumably shatter mountains and rocks effortlessly.
Constitution exceeded 50 points.
Ding Ling could clearly perceive that his endurance, vitality, resistance, etc., have increased vastly. It can be said that now he could battle for five days and nights with no problem.
Defense was also approaching 50 points.
His skin was becoming increasingly tough.
Comparable to four or five layers of leather armor stacked together.
With such high defense.
Ordinary arrows would hardly cause him any harm.
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
High defense, high agility, high attack, high vitality, high endurance... Simply the All-Powerful King!
A full 360 degrees without any blind spots!
"Ding Ling, are you sure you’re okay?"
Little Dragon Girl looked at Ding Ling with a face of disbelief.
She was completely dumbfounded.
When had she ever seen someone consuming Great Medicine like that, as if their life didn’t matter.
Aren’t you afraid of over-supplementing and bursting your body?
Little Dragon Girl looked at Ding Ling with some worry.
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
’I now feel invincible, the best I’ve ever felt!’
"How is it that you..."
Little Dragon Girl was puzzled.
Ding Ling then explained a thing or two to her.
After hearing it, Little Dragon Girl not only felt relieved but also extremely shocked:
"Can you cultivate like this?!"
"What else then?"
Ding Ling said:
"So you have to work hard too."
Little Dragon Girl solemnly nodded:
"I will definitely strive hard to catch up with you, Ding Ling, as soon as possible, so as not to always drag you down."
"Don’t say you’re dragging me down."
Ding Ling said:
"Throughout the journey, you have been there helping me and supporting me at every step. Where is there any dragging down? Don’t belittle yourself! I believe you will become a peerless expert!"
Ding Ling’s words were indeed honest.
All this time, Little Dragon Girl had been obedient to Ding Ling, taking the initiative to do everything, even buying some sewing stuff to make Ding Ling a set of clothes.
Ding Ling saw all this with his own eyes.
How could he not be touched?
Besides that.

After recovering from her injuries, Little Dragon Girl practiced a top-notch Breathing Technique, and her skills had far surpassed ordinary First-class Experts now. If she were to fight that mad old man again, Little Dragon Girl said she was confident of not losing.
This shows how quickly she has improved.
Her future is evidently bright.
"Mm!"
Little Dragon Girl’s eyes brightened a little, seemingly regaining some confidence.
Facing the perfect, all-powerful Ding Ling.
She was increasingly feeling inferior.
Afrayed that one day, Ding Ling would look down on her and leave her.
Now, hearing Ding Ling say this.
She felt much relieved.
But the anxiety in her heart had not diminished one bit.
She became more diligent in practicing Breathing Techniques and Inner Power.
After an hour, Ding Ling went offline.
Through the Achievement Medal, he exchanged the skills he gained in the game world back to the real world.
Ding Ling’s strength in the real world instantly equaled that in the game world.
His speed was extremely fast.
Running Lightweight Skills, he was as fast as lightning.

He moved in and out of the depths of the mountains as if walking on flat ground, racing outside in the middle of the night, found a safe place in a small town relatively far from where he lived, and connected to a network with his laptop.
Then, he began analyzing, scanning, and locking in through hacker techniques.
Specifically tracking terms like ’Nine Yang Divine Skill’, ’Ding Ling’, ’arson’, ’conspiracy’, etc.
His hacker skills were full level.
He later learned many related skills.
You could say.
Nowadays on the internet.
He is the king.
He dominated the network, searched for a short time, and locked in on a post.
This post discreetly inquired about the whereabouts of ’Xianbei General Kebineng and others’, ’to what depth Kebineng’s hatred towards Ding Ling had reached?’, and similar questions.
The questions weren’t that direct.
But Ding Ling understood at first glance.
Especially by searching for Kebineng, he knew Kebineng had arrived in the World of Divine Condor.
Ding Ling’s heart skipped a beat.
He began swiftly reviewing Kebineng’s recent activities.
This review made things clear.
Originally, Three Kingdoms Xianbei General Kebineng harbored extreme hatred for Ding Ling, as for why?
Ding Ling single-handedly killed his way through the Xianbei Royal Court, slaying and injuring countless Xianbei experts.
It was only natural for Kebineng to see him as a foe.
Kebineng was indeed quite capable.

After becoming a Super-Elite Fierce General, he stepped onto the Celestial Ladder and went to the World of The Deer and the Cauldron, met Zuo Ci, received guidance from Zuo Ci, perfected Inner Power Heart Method, and rapidly advanced his Martial Dao cultivation.
In The Deer and the Cauldron World.
Kebineng became a popular figure, made friends with many heroes and rogues.
Finally, when the Celestial Ladder descended to the mortal realm.
He once again stepped onto the Celestial Ladder, arriving in this Divine Eagle World.
Alongside him also arrived top experts from the World of The Deer and the Cauldron like Hai Dafu, Fat Monk, and Hong Antong.

chapters.title: Chapter 426: The Dragon Girl Dons Armor
paragraphs: As for Daoist Zuo Ci?
He has ascended as well.
Which world he went to, nobody knows in the online world.
Zuo Ci the Daoist is adept at Escape Armor Skill and Transformation Skill. If he doesn’t want to be found, who could possibly find him?
Ding Ling thought of Zuo Ci and felt quite troubled.
Why isn’t this Demon Dao dead yet?!
And he ascended as well.
This is truly troublesome.
That being said, Ding Ling wasn’t afraid of him.
His strength has progressed rapidly now, and killing Zuo Ci would surely be easier.
After all, Heavenly Dao is fair.
In other worlds, Ding Ling doesn’t have Celestial Might bestowed!
How could Zuo Ci have Celestial Might bestowed?!
Neither of them has Celestial Might bestowed, so fighting?
Ding Ling is confident he could beat Zuo Ci like a dog!
So he isn’t afraid of encountering Zuo Ci again, he merely thinks of the Demon Dao as a nuisance, and should he encounter him, he must deal with him promptly.
"Keep reading."
Ding Ling steadied his mind, suppressing all sorts of thoughts, and continued reading.
The tale goes that the Three Kingdoms Ke Bineng obtained a great bounty in The Deer and the Cauldron World.
Upon entering Divine Eagle World,
by chance or perhaps intentionally, he befriended a great general within the Mongolian Army, and with unparalleled martial power, impressed the general.
The general then recommended him to meet Kublai, the helm of the Mongolian Army.

Kublai held Ke Bineng in high regard, finding his military strategy and horsemanship to be top-notch, delighted beyond measure, and immediately appointed Ke Bineng as a Commander of a Thousand, pending deeds for promotion to Commander of Ten Thousand.
Ke Bineng was indeed remarkable.
Leading an army of a thousand, within just a few days, he consecutively defeated generals and captured flags, earning great merit, soon promoted to Commander of Ten Thousand.
It was at this moment,
players approached him.
The details of the discussion between the players and Ke Bineng are unknown, but people saw that after this, Ke Bineng became mysterious, often transporting things like Shizhi Water and Petroleum.
The smell of these substances was quite strong, to mask the scent.
Ke Bineng seemingly employed a special method taught by Zuo Ci.
This made substances like Petroleum and Shizhi Water become as odorless as clear water, which astounded many.
Seeing this.
Ding Ling pondered:
"It seems I underestimated these people. I’m surprised how these players with mediocre power could accomplish such feats, seemingly Ke Bineng directing from behind the scenes.
Nevertheless, Ke Bineng is quite extraordinary."
In history, Ke Bineng indeed achieved great fame.

Now, in this high combat power Three Kingdoms World, Ke Bineng cleverly dodges fatal disasters, ascends the Heaven-Ascending Ladder, sequentially gains great fortune, his strength and prowess drastically different.
"But what you shouldn’t have done above all, is wanting to kill me?"
After speedily reading through, Ding Ling was rather enraged.
Though still unclear about the exact process.
But from scant information.
One could guess.
It was the materials like Petroleum and Shizhi Water provided by Ke Bineng.
To know, the more watered it is.
The more the fire burns!.
If the Shaolin monks were unaware, continually using water to douse the fire, it would continually fuel the flames, escalating uncontrollably, understandable.
"The most critical part is that Ke Bineng obtained part of Zuo Ci’s true inheritance, able to mask the aura of substances like Petroleum, making it smell indistinctly like water.
This method of covert use.
The Shaolin monks practice martial arts, how could they know such obscure techniques?
Unanticipated, they were caught off guard, which is reasonable."
Ding Ling continued to search.
And finally pinpointed an ID named ’I am the Overlord’.
Through this ID.
Ding Ling followed the lead and found a hidden chat group of this person.
And learned of their loot location in the chat group.
At a Mongolian Army Camp north of Mount Songh Shaolin Temple.
Ke Bineng is stationed there.
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows:
"It seems indeed Ke Bineng is orchestrating behind all of this. But specifically, how did he accomplish it?"
Ding Ling was perplexed.
The monks were all massacred by him.
He couldn’t find anyone to ask.
And he guessed if he did ask.
These monks would surely be clueless.
Otherwise, they wouldn’t have accused him, the ’innocent suspect’, and ’hammered’ him!
"To prevent any prolonged dreams. I’ll set off for the Mongolian Army Camp tonight!"
Ding Ling returned.
Chose to go online.

Little Dragon Girl saw his return, and let out a long sigh of relief, her tense, delicate face relaxed considerably, she’s genuinely worried Ding Ling would disappear for good, seeing Ding Ling back now, her cool, clear eyes never left him, afraid if he disappears again, she’d never see him.
Ding Ling felt warmth in his heart upon seeing this, and said:
"I’m going to the Mongolian Army Camp.
"I’ll go with you."
"...Okay. But you must wear protective armor and such."
"I’ll follow your lead. Just don’t leave me."
After Ding Ling’s power boosted.
The merged might of Breathing Technique’s Vigorous Qi and True Qi became even stronger, even more explosive.
He held the Drumming Golden Hammer, feeling it as light as nothing.
Standing by, Little Dragon Girl watched with silent awe, such a massive hammer, Ding Ling wielded effortlessly, a testament to his strength.
Neigh!
The Ferghana Horse is an unparalleled horse, carrying Ding Ling northward.
Passing a city along the way.
Ding Ling charged directly into the City Lord’s Mansion, wielding the hammer, smashed a ferocious Mongolian general blocking the way, turning him into pulp!
Anyone daring to obstruct along the way, without exception, was either knocked flying or killed by the hammer.
No one could withstand a single move from Ding Ling.
Touch and you perish.
Impact and you’re harmed!
The City Lord was frightened to the core, prostrating to surrender!
Ding Ling didn’t kill him; he merely ordered him to prepare excellent armor, horses, bows, etc.
Moments later.
The City Lord nervously brought a Treasure Bow, a top-tier spear, several top-notch war horses, several sturdy and exquisite armors, and hundreds of arrow quivers.

Ding Ling, carrying the Drumming Golden Hammer, emptied a lot of space in his Storage Pouch, putting some arrow quivers inside the pouch. He wouldn’t stop until he could fit the Drumming Golden Hammer inside.
The rest of the arrow quivers were placed on the side of several war horses.
He and Little Dragon Girl donned good armor, helmets, and faceplates, also outfitting the two Ferghana Horses with heavy armor.
Then, they rode two high-grade war horses without armor, allowing the two Ferghana Horses to follow behind.
Ding Ling prepared to ride the Ferghana Horses for charging upon reaching the destination.
Along the way, Ding Ling taught Little Dragon Girl the use and practice method of the Howling Moon Spear Technique.
She has learned the Breathing Technique and understands various profound martial arts; learning some external skills becomes much easier now.
Even so,.
it’s hard to quickly master though.
Ding Ling taught Little Dragon Girl some entry-level spear techniques.
That wasn’t difficult for Little Dragon Girl, she soon wielded the spear with finesse, the special Vigorous Qi fused from Breathing Technique Qi and Inner Strength, with a thrust of the spear, Boom!
A casual spear thrust can pierce through a small tree on the side.
The strength is evident.

Little Dragon Girl was originally a First-class High Tier expert, through Ding Ling’s guidance and cultivating the Breathing Technique, she further rose to the First-class Peak Realm, the fused special Vigorous Qi allowed her to spar on par with some Innate Experts.
She donned armor, rode the war horse, and wielded a spear, truly heroic, not letting go of her honor as a woman.

sentences.text: As for Daoist Zuo Ci?
He has ascended as well.
Which world he went to, nobody knows in the online world.
Zuo Ci the Daoist is adept at Escape Armor Skill and Transformation Skill.
If he doesn’t want to be found, who could possibly find him?
Ding Ling thought of Zuo Ci and felt quite troubled.
Why isn’t this Demon Dao dead yet?!
And he ascended as well.
This is truly troublesome.
That being said, Ding Ling wasn’t afraid of him.
His strength has progressed rapidly now, and killing Zuo Ci would surely be easier.
After all, Heavenly Dao is fair.
In other worlds, Ding Ling doesn’t have Celestial Might bestowed!
How could Zuo Ci have Celestial Might bestowed?!
Neither of them has Celestial Might bestowed, so fighting?
Ding Ling is confident he could beat Zuo Ci like a dog!
So he isn’t afraid of encountering Zuo Ci again, he merely thinks of the Demon Dao as a nuisance, and should he encounter him, he must deal with him promptly.
"Keep reading."
Ding Ling steadied his mind, suppressing all sorts of thoughts, and continued reading.
The tale goes that the Three Kingdoms Ke Bineng obtained a great bounty in The Deer and the Cauldron World.
Upon entering Divine Eagle World,
by chance or perhaps intentionally, he befriended a great general within the Mongolian Army, and with unparalleled martial power, impressed the general.
The general then recommended him to meet Kublai, the helm of the Mongolian Army.

Kublai held Ke Bineng in high regard, finding his military strategy and horsemanship to be top-notch, delighted beyond measure, and immediately appointed Ke Bineng as a Commander of a Thousand, pending deeds for promotion to Commander of Ten Thousand.
Ke Bineng was indeed remarkable.
Leading an army of a thousand, within just a few days, he consecutively defeated generals and captured flags, earning great merit, soon promoted to Commander of Ten Thousand.
It was at this moment,
players approached him.
The details of the discussion between the players and Ke Bineng are unknown, but people saw that after this, Ke Bineng became mysterious, often transporting things like Shizhi Water and Petroleum.
The smell of these substances was quite strong, to mask the scent.
Ke Bineng seemingly employed a special method taught by Zuo Ci.
This made substances like Petroleum and Shizhi Water become as odorless as clear water, which astounded many.
Seeing this.
Ding Ling pondered:
"It seems I underestimated these people.
I’m surprised how these players with mediocre power could accomplish such feats, seemingly Ke Bineng directing from behind the scenes.
Nevertheless, Ke Bineng is quite extraordinary."
In history, Ke Bineng indeed achieved great fame.

Now, in this high combat power Three Kingdoms World, Ke Bineng cleverly dodges fatal disasters, ascends the Heaven-Ascending Ladder, sequentially gains great fortune, his strength and prowess drastically different.
"But what you shouldn’t have done above all, is wanting to kill me?"
After speedily reading through, Ding Ling was rather enraged.
Though still unclear about the exact process.
But from scant information.
One could guess.
It was the materials like Petroleum and Shizhi Water provided by Ke Bineng.
To know, the more watered it is.
The more the fire burns!.
If the Shaolin monks were unaware, continually using water to douse the fire, it would continually fuel the flames, escalating uncontrollably, understandable.
"The most critical part is that Ke Bineng obtained part of Zuo Ci’s true inheritance, able to mask the aura of substances like Petroleum, making it smell indistinctly like water.
This method of covert use.
The Shaolin monks practice martial arts, how could they know such obscure techniques?
Unanticipated, they were caught off guard, which is reasonable."
Ding Ling continued to search.
And finally pinpointed an ID named ’I am the Overlord’.
Through this ID.
Ding Ling followed the lead and found a hidden chat group of this person.
And learned of their loot location in the chat group.
At a Mongolian Army Camp north of Mount Songh Shaolin Temple.
Ke Bineng is stationed there.
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows:
"It seems indeed Ke Bineng is orchestrating behind all of this.
But specifically, how did he accomplish it?"
Ding Ling was perplexed.
The monks were all massacred by him.
He couldn’t find anyone to ask.
And he guessed if he did ask.
These monks would surely be clueless.
Otherwise, they wouldn’t have accused him, the ’innocent suspect’, and ’hammered’ him!
"To prevent any prolonged dreams.
I’ll set off for the Mongolian Army Camp tonight!"
Ding Ling returned.
Chose to go online.

Little Dragon Girl saw his return, and let out a long sigh of relief, her tense, delicate face relaxed considerably, she’s genuinely worried Ding Ling would disappear for good, seeing Ding Ling back now, her cool, clear eyes never left him, afraid if he disappears again, she’d never see him.
Ding Ling felt warmth in his heart upon seeing this, and said:
"I’m going to the Mongolian Army Camp.
"I’ll go with you."
"...Okay.
But you must wear protective armor and such."
"I’ll follow your lead.
Just don’t leave me."
After Ding Ling’s power boosted.
The merged might of Breathing Technique’s Vigorous Qi and True Qi became even stronger, even more explosive.
He held the Drumming Golden Hammer, feeling it as light as nothing.
Standing by, Little Dragon Girl watched with silent awe, such a massive hammer, Ding Ling wielded effortlessly, a testament to his strength.
Neigh!
The Ferghana Horse is an unparalleled horse, carrying Ding Ling northward.
Passing a city along the way.
Ding Ling charged directly into the City Lord’s Mansion, wielding the hammer, smashed a ferocious Mongolian general blocking the way, turning him into pulp!
Anyone daring to obstruct along the way, without exception, was either knocked flying or killed by the hammer.
No one could withstand a single move from Ding Ling.
Touch and you perish.
Impact and you’re harmed!
The City Lord was frightened to the core, prostrating to surrender!
Ding Ling didn’t kill him; he merely ordered him to prepare excellent armor, horses, bows, etc.
Moments later.
The City Lord nervously brought a Treasure Bow, a top-tier spear, several top-notch war horses, several sturdy and exquisite armors, and hundreds of arrow quivers.
Ding Ling, carrying the Drumming Golden Hammer, emptied a lot of space in his Storage Pouch, putting some arrow quivers inside the pouch.
He wouldn’t stop until he could fit the Drumming Golden Hammer inside.
The rest of the arrow quivers were placed on the side of several war horses.
He and Little Dragon Girl donned good armor, helmets, and faceplates, also outfitting the two Ferghana Horses with heavy armor.
Then, they rode two high-grade war horses without armor, allowing the two Ferghana Horses to follow behind.
Ding Ling prepared to ride the Ferghana Horses for charging upon reaching the destination.
Along the way, Ding Ling taught Little Dragon Girl the use and practice method of the Howling Moon Spear Technique.
She has learned the Breathing Technique and understands various profound martial arts; learning some external skills becomes much easier now.
Even so,.
it’s hard to quickly master though.
Ding Ling taught Little Dragon Girl some entry-level spear techniques.
That wasn’t difficult for Little Dragon Girl, she soon wielded the spear with finesse, the special Vigorous Qi fused from Breathing Technique Qi and Inner Strength, with a thrust of the spear, Boom!
A casual spear thrust can pierce through a small tree on the side.
The strength is evident.

Little Dragon Girl was originally a First-class High Tier expert, through Ding Ling’s guidance and cultivating the Breathing Technique, she further rose to the First-class Peak Realm, the fused special Vigorous Qi allowed her to spar on par with some Innate Experts.
She donned armor, rode the war horse, and wielded a spear, truly heroic, not letting go of her honor as a woman.

chapters.title: Chapter 427: Slaying the Enemy
paragraphs: The distinct elegance of Diao Chan was contrasted by the cool and ethereal aura unique to the Little Dragon Girl.
Clad in armor and holding a spear, she resembled a sunset tinged with red, inexplicably giving off a sense of desolation.
This feeling was strange.
Ding Ling guessed it was related to her spending much time in the ancient tomb, or perhaps it was due to her temperament.
Ding Ling didn’t ponder much on it, constantly guiding the Little Dragon Girl on key spear techniques along the way.
When they eventually reached the outskirts of the Mongolian Camp,
The spear techniques of the Little Dragon Girl had advanced significantly beyond the entry level.
It was competent enough for slaughter on the battlefield.
Seeing this, Ding Ling felt reassured, gave her a few words of advice, and then looked ahead.
Da-da-da!
A group of Mongolian Cavalry seemed to have spotted Ding Ling and his companion. Immediately, a junior officer shouted and led his team to approach.
Their speed was swift.

Not long after, they arrived in front of Ding Ling’s team. Ding Ling expected they would question him first, but seeing Ding Ling and the Little Dragon Girl’s appearance, they were momentarily stunned before bursting into laughter, then disregarded them and lunged toward the Little Dragon Girl.
The dozens of others simultaneously charged at Ding Ling with their spears.
It was evident.
They coveted the Little Dragon Girl, wanting to claim her for themselves or present her to their superior.

Ding Ling frowned, wielding the Drumming Golden Hammer, he swung it forcefully. A dull thudding was heard as five or six Mongolian soldiers were struck off their horses, with bones shattering and cries of agony following. The force was so immense that after being knocked off, they collided into several comrades.
Since a battle had started.
Ding Ling had no reason to hold back. He charged on horseback, quickly dispatching dozens of Mongolian soldiers with his hammer.
The junior officer was also knocked off his horse by the Little Dragon Girl.
But being soft-hearted and kind, she couldn’t bring herself to kill.
"To tread the battlefield, she must go through this..."
Ding Ling didn’t blame her; after all, it was her nature.
Instead, he chose to guide and console her.
He spoke some words.
The Little Dragon Girl, with her submissive nature, felt ashamed as she watched Ding Ling finish his enemies and still be there to guide her, then glanced at the junior officer.
Only to see him look at Ding Ling with terror, unwillingness, and fear, as if viewing a Great Demon King, with a deep-seated malevolence flashing in his eyes, caught by the Little Dragon Girl.
Seeing this man harboring such hatred towards Ding Ling.
The Little Dragon Girl sighed softly in her heart, gritted her teeth, closed her eyes, and thrust her spear forward.
Poof!
The officer was pierced through the chest, dying on the spot.
Poof!
As the spear was withdrawn, blood spurted out, splattering onto the Little Dragon Girl’s armor.
She shivered slightly, instinctively looked at Ding Ling.
"You did well."
Ding Ling nodded, encouraging:
"Just like that."
The Little Dragon Girl simply did not like killing, was not accustomed to killing.
But in this world, under the law of the jungle, ’If you don’t kill others, they might kill you tomorrow,’ how could one not kill?
Especially if one accidentally ascended to a world full of vicious, terrifying monsters eating people, how could one not kill ’men’ then?!
"Another team is coming. It seems we must force our way in this time."
Ding Ling put the Drumming Golden Hammer into his Storage Pouch, then took out a bow and arrows, drawing and shooting towards another team of soldiers in the distance.
Tornado Arrow Skill!
Double Extreme Arrow Skill!
Boing!

With the sound of the bowstring, three arrows, propelled by unique Vigorous Qi, transformed instantly into three small tornadoes tearing through the sky, piercing hundreds of meters of emptiness, and with loud roars, striking the leading officer of the cavalry, blowing his head apart with just one arrow!
The other two arrows simultaneously hit the chests and abdomens of two soldiers. Due to the immense, explosive power contained within the arrows, the blasts echoed through the night, boom boom!
The two soldiers were flung from their horses, colliding into several other soldiers behind them with a resounding thud.
Such might of one arrow!
Fierce beyond imagination!

All the Mongolian soldiers were terrified; the smarter ones turned their horses immediately and galloped away, continuously shouting in all directions. Ding Ling understood Mongolian and knew they were saying ’The person is formidable, quickly return to camp for reinforcements!’ ’Run quickly!’

Though the Little Dragon Girl didn’t understand, she saw Ding Ling’s expression changing once more; she truly hadn’t expected Ding Ling’s sword skills and hammer techniques to be astounding, but his archery was equally extraordinary.
But thinking about Ding Ling’s speed of mastering martial arts.
She smiled knowingly.
Her husband was an All-Purpose King, and she needed to grow accustomed sooner to that inconceivably mighty strength of his!
"Trying to run?"
Ding Ling urged his horse forward, continuously drawing and shooting, whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Arrows were shot out, each arrow trembling sharply, its shaft enveloped and driven forward by a small Xuan Wind tornado.
One arrow conjured a white airwave tunnel out of thin air.
Even under the moonlight, it was strikingly visible!
The Little Dragon Girl watched in shock, speechless.
And the opposing Mongolian soldiers, seeing this, were petrified with terror! Continually shouting ’Spread out!’ ’Quickly back to camp!’ ’Brothers ahead, stay away!’
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Bang bang bang!

Amidst the whistling arrows, each shot was unstoppable, tearing through all obstacles, under the influence of Ding Ling’s special Vigorous Qi, and his full-level Tornado Arrow Skill and Double Extreme Arrow Skill.
Mowing down in their path.
Easily annihilating this small cavalry squad.

Ding Ling looked toward the Mongolian Camp, seeing people constantly moving at the camp’s entrance, accompanied by intense drumbeats, occasionally hearing someone shouting something, but the distance was too great, even a supreme martial artist like Ding Ling couldn’t discern their words but could vaguely guess they were summoning the army to form a defensive or offensive formation.
Woo woo!
The sound of the horn being blown.
"What is it?"
The Little Dragon Girl glanced sideways.
"It’s the horn of battle."
Ding Ling remained calm, leaping off his horse, switching to ride the Ferghana Horse, and the Little Dragon Girl followed suit.
Ding Ling placed arrow quivers on one side of the horse’s belly, and the Little Dragon Girl did the same.
Although her Archery Skill wasn’t impressive,
She could pass arrows to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling knew that the Mongolian camp before him only belonged to Kebineng’s army of ten thousand. If it were Kublai’s hundreds of thousands, he wouldn’t dare recklessly charge in now.
Not out of fear for his life,
But concern of getting stuck.
Especially with the Little Dragon Girl following him, he couldn’t drag her into a battle against Kublai’s camp.
It was only Kebineng’s camp.
Just ten thousand.
Ding Ling was unyielding!
He was just bold!
He urged his horse forward within the blaring of the horns.
Ding Ling saw battalions emerging from the camp.
Leading them was an elderly man whose hair was streaked with white and commanded authority without anger.
His eyes were piercingly sharp; it seemed he spotted Ding Ling, and he loudly said:
"I am Mu Renqing! May I know your honored name, and why are you storming our camp and killing without reason?"
Mu Renqing.
Such a familiar name.
Ding Ling was momentarily stunned, but quickly recalled.
Wasn’t he the teacher of Yuan Chengzhi, Divine Fist Invincible Gui Xinshu, and others from "Green Blood Sword"?
Sect Leader of the Huashan Sect.
Known as the Divine Sword Immortal Ape!
Reputed to be the top figure in Green Blood Sword.
Why would he be here, colluding with players and Kebineng?
Ding Ling was puzzled.
But since they were enemies, Ding Ling naturally wouldn’t care how reputed, righteous he was before.

chapters.title: Chapter 428: Divine Sword Immortal Ape of the Green Blood Sword
paragraphs: As long as it’s an enemy, as long as someone wants to kill him, they should be prepared to be killed by him, Ding Ling thought so, his heart slightly calming, and immediately replied loudly:
"I am Ding Ling!"
"So you are Ding Ling!"
Mu Renqing’s face changed drastically, looking at Ding Ling with vigilance and scrutiny:
"Rumor has it you’ve killed countless people, bloodthirsty and merciless, you’re a Great Demon."
He glanced at the soldiers who were smashed to death by Ding Ling, many of whom had turned into a pile of flesh and blood! The degree of brutality was utterly appalling!
Unable to help twitching at the corner of his eyes, he resolutely said:
"Now it seems, the rumors are indeed true. You, this demon, appeared here for no reason, and started a massacre without a word, what do you intend to do?"
Just as Mu Renqing finished speaking.
Before Ding Ling could reply, someone burst out laughing, it was a brute with an ugly appearance but an extremely overpowering aura.
He wore sturdy armor and held a long spear, majestic and robust, his eyes like knives staring at Ding Ling, loudly saying:
"Mu Renqing, in my opinion, don’t bother talking nonsense with him. Just charge and kill. They only number two, how can they withstand our great numbers?! So many experts?!"
Mu Renqing frowned, seeming not to want to speak further with this burly man.
Someone couldn’t stand it, urged their horse forward, and loudly said:
"Hong Antong, what was discussed before? Why are you now acting rashly!"
This person stood nine feet tall, exuding an overbearing aura, sitting upright on his horse, and his eyes gleamed sharply, obviously a top expert.
Hong Antong looked at this person, saying:
"Yuchi Gong, I think you’re being overly cautious. This Ding Ling may have high martial arts, but how can he withstand the charge of thousands?!
After all, he’s flesh and blood.
He can get hurt, he can die!"
He was bold and extremely confident:
"Moreover, with us first-class experts assisting, attacking and killing, Ding Ling is nothing significant, no need for such caution. Killing him is as easy as flipping a hand!"
"Fool."
Yuchi Gong said with a stern face:
"Kebineng spoke of Ding Ling’s feats in the Three Kingdoms World, you know this. Why act contrary now?!"
Yuchi Gong was a fierce general from the Sui and Tang Era.
He habitually referred to Kebineng’s world as the Three Kingdoms World, never thinking to call it the Great Wei Kingdom World.
Many people did the same.
Relying on their habitual memories, not Kebineng’s phrasing.
Especially after players ventured in, word spread, and many started using the players’ terminology to define the world.
"I’ve met Zuo Ci from the Three Kingdoms World in my world, and he wasn’t all that powerful either! Yet Zuo Ci is rumored to be almost on par with Ding Ling!
Thus inferred.
Ding Ling might only be fierce in the Three Kingdoms World! In other worlds, he certainly can’t be too powerful."
"Are you an idiot?"
Yuchi Gong roared angrily:
"Didn’t you see the soldiers smashed into pulp by Ding Ling?"
"So what? Human strength has its limits, no matter his power, there will come a point when it’s exhausted."
Hong Antong looked displeased at Yuchi Gong, coldly saying:
"Insult me again, and beware, I’ll kill you!"
"If you’ve got the guts, then come!"
Yuchi Gong glared, not backing down!
Seeing his own side on the verge of infighting, while Ding Ling hadn’t even charged yet, about to devolve into chaos.
Someone rode their horse out, loudly saying:
"Stop arguing! Facing a great enemy, how can we be so lax and negligent! Please, everyone, listen to me, temporarily regroup, form a fist, then we have hope of killing this demon Ding Ling!"
"Kebineng."
Mu Renqing frowned, saying:
"You hadn’t accounted for this hurdle with Ding Ling in your previous plan, what compensation do you intend for my disciple afterward?"
"Let’s discuss after killing Ding Ling."
Kebineng was a rugged man with handsome features and deep-set eyes.
Tall and strong, clad in General Armor, exuding authority without anger.
He was about to say more.
Over there.
Ding Ling, with keen senses, saw the main characters appear, how could he hesitate?

At once, he bent his bow, nocked arrows, swoosh, swoosh, swoosh! Across the sound of the bowstring snapping, three arrows burst forth, like lightning cutting through the night sky! Aimed straight at Kebineng’s top, middle, and bottom vital points!
"Watch out!"
Yuchi Gong saw it, roaring angrily.
"Hmph!"
Kebineng had prepared for this from Ding Ling, seeing it, instantly tumbling off his saddle, sprinting into the camp swiftly like a fleeing rabbit, vanishing in the blink of an eye.
Though he escaped.
The three arrows flew behind, boom, boom, boom! In the sound of explosions, they targeted a person’s vital spot, killing him on the spot.
"Skinny Monk!"
Hong Antong was taken aback, only now realizing how terrifying Ding Ling was.
Such a long distance, likely not less than hundreds of feet! Yet he could still shoot and kill an expert from afar!
What incredible skill is this? Terrifying archery!
Hong Antong, initially slightly dismissive of Ding Ling, immediately collected all disdain, becoming serious and tense.
Once Ding Ling made a move.
There would be no holding back.
He had heard it loud and clear, these people were all in league.
All wanting to kill him.
Though he didn’t know why they gathered.
But since they want to kill him.
What more is there to say.
They all should just die!
Might as well eradicate them entirely.
Otherwise, he’d always have to guard against their schemes later on!
With this thought,
Ding Ling began to relentlessly bend his bow and nock arrows, swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!
Tornado Arrow Skill!
Double Extreme Arrow Skill!
With Fusion Qi, the power of these two skills amplified tenfold! The violent arrows wrapped in a whirlwind, trembling with a metallic clang, slicing through the sky, piercing the night!
Bang, bang, bang!
Amidst the continuous sound of bowstrings snapping.
Ding Ling’s arrow firing speed grew faster and faster.
Eventually.
Both his hands seemed to turn into phantoms.
Even the naked eye could hardly track them.
Only because of his high physical endurance and resilience, unimaginable to ordinary people, could he rapidly draw his bow without fear of backlash!
One person managed to produce the effect of an entire archer squad!
Amidst the piercing sounds of arrows soaring through the air, they rained down on Hong Antong and others.
In just a few breaths.
He shot no fewer than a hundred arrows!
On average, drawing and releasing the bowstring three to four times in a single breath, such extreme speed was unfathomable, even the Little Dragon Girl couldn’t believe her eyes!
That was her reaction.
Hong Antong, Mu Renqing, Yuchi Gong, and other experts were no exception, all dumbfounded, amazed, tongues tied, but immediately followed by shock, horror, and fear.
"Run!"
Yuchi Gong, having reached the entrance of the camp by then, seeing this, instantly rolled off his horse, hid under the horse’s belly, and spurred the steed to dash into the camp swiftly.
Others mimicked him, all hiding under the horses’ bellies.
Those slower in reaction were immediately covered and killed by the ’pouring’ rain of arrows.

sentences.text: As long as it’s an enemy, as long as someone wants to kill him, they should be prepared to be killed by him, Ding Ling thought so, his heart slightly calming, and immediately replied loudly:
"I am Ding Ling!"
"So you are Ding Ling!"
Mu Renqing’s face changed drastically, looking at Ding Ling with vigilance and scrutiny:
"Rumor has it you’ve killed countless people, bloodthirsty and merciless, you’re a Great Demon."
He glanced at the soldiers who were smashed to death by Ding Ling, many of whom had turned into a pile of flesh and blood!
The degree of brutality was utterly appalling!
Unable to help twitching at the corner of his eyes, he resolutely said:
"Now it seems, the rumors are indeed true.
You, this demon, appeared here for no reason, and started a massacre without a word, what do you intend to do?"
Just as Mu Renqing finished speaking.
Before Ding Ling could reply, someone burst out laughing, it was a brute with an ugly appearance but an extremely overpowering aura.
He wore sturdy armor and held a long spear, majestic and robust, his eyes like knives staring at Ding Ling, loudly saying:
"Mu Renqing, in my opinion, don’t bother talking nonsense with him.
Just charge and kill.
They only number two, how can they withstand our great numbers?!
So many experts?!"
Mu Renqing frowned, seeming not to want to speak further with this burly man.
Someone couldn’t stand it, urged their horse forward, and loudly said:
"Hong Antong, what was discussed before?
Why are you now acting rashly!"
This person stood nine feet tall, exuding an overbearing aura, sitting upright on his horse, and his eyes gleamed sharply, obviously a top expert.
Hong Antong looked at this person, saying:
"Yuchi Gong, I think you’re being overly cautious.
This Ding Ling may have high martial arts, but how can he withstand the charge of thousands?!
After all, he’s flesh and blood.
He can get hurt, he can die!"
He was bold and extremely confident:
"Moreover, with us first-class experts assisting, attacking and killing, Ding Ling is nothing significant, no need for such caution.
Killing him is as easy as flipping a hand!"
"Fool."
Yuchi Gong said with a stern face:
"Kebineng spoke of Ding Ling’s feats in the Three Kingdoms World, you know this.
Why act contrary now?!"
Yuchi Gong was a fierce general from the Sui and Tang Era.
He habitually referred to Kebineng’s world as the Three Kingdoms World, never thinking to call it the Great Wei Kingdom World.
Many people did the same.
Relying on their habitual memories, not Kebineng’s phrasing.
Especially after players ventured in, word spread, and many started using the players’ terminology to define the world.
"I’ve met Zuo Ci from the Three Kingdoms World in my world, and he wasn’t all that powerful either!
Yet Zuo Ci is rumored to be almost on par with Ding Ling!
Thus inferred.
Ding Ling might only be fierce in the Three Kingdoms World!
In other worlds, he certainly can’t be too powerful."
"Are you an idiot?"
Yuchi Gong roared angrily:
"Didn’t you see the soldiers smashed into pulp by Ding Ling?"
"So what?
Human strength has its limits, no matter his power, there will come a point when it’s exhausted."
Hong Antong looked displeased at Yuchi Gong, coldly saying:
"Insult me again, and beware, I’ll kill you!"
"If you’ve got the guts, then come!"
Yuchi Gong glared, not backing down!
Seeing his own side on the verge of infighting, while Ding Ling hadn’t even charged yet, about to devolve into chaos.
Someone rode their horse out, loudly saying:
"Stop arguing!
Facing a great enemy, how can we be so lax and negligent!
Please, everyone, listen to me, temporarily regroup, form a fist, then we have hope of killing this demon Ding Ling!"
"Kebineng."
Mu Renqing frowned, saying:
"You hadn’t accounted for this hurdle with Ding Ling in your previous plan, what compensation do you intend for my disciple afterward?"
"Let’s discuss after killing Ding Ling."
Kebineng was a rugged man with handsome features and deep-set eyes.
Tall and strong, clad in General Armor, exuding authority without anger.
He was about to say more.
Over there.
Ding Ling, with keen senses, saw the main characters appear, how could he hesitate?
At once, he bent his bow, nocked arrows, swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!
Across the sound of the bowstring snapping, three arrows burst forth, like lightning cutting through the night sky!
Aimed straight at Kebineng’s top, middle, and bottom vital points!
"Watch out!"
Yuchi Gong saw it, roaring angrily.
"Hmph!"
Kebineng had prepared for this from Ding Ling, seeing it, instantly tumbling off his saddle, sprinting into the camp swiftly like a fleeing rabbit, vanishing in the blink of an eye.
Though he escaped.
The three arrows flew behind, boom, boom, boom!
In the sound of explosions, they targeted a person’s vital spot, killing him on the spot.
"Skinny Monk!"
Hong Antong was taken aback, only now realizing how terrifying Ding Ling was.
Such a long distance, likely not less than hundreds of feet!
Yet he could still shoot and kill an expert from afar!
What incredible skill is this?
Terrifying archery!
Hong Antong, initially slightly dismissive of Ding Ling, immediately collected all disdain, becoming serious and tense.
Once Ding Ling made a move.
There would be no holding back.
He had heard it loud and clear, these people were all in league.
All wanting to kill him.
Though he didn’t know why they gathered.
But since they want to kill him.
What more is there to say.
They all should just die!
Might as well eradicate them entirely.
Otherwise, he’d always have to guard against their schemes later on!
With this thought,
Ding Ling began to relentlessly bend his bow and nock arrows, swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!
Tornado Arrow Skill!
Double Extreme Arrow Skill!
With Fusion Qi, the power of these two skills amplified tenfold!
The violent arrows wrapped in a whirlwind, trembling with a metallic clang, slicing through the sky, piercing the night!
Bang, bang, bang!
Amidst the continuous sound of bowstrings snapping.
Ding Ling’s arrow firing speed grew faster and faster.
Eventually.
Both his hands seemed to turn into phantoms.
Even the naked eye could hardly track them.
Only because of his high physical endurance and resilience, unimaginable to ordinary people, could he rapidly draw his bow without fear of backlash!
One person managed to produce the effect of an entire archer squad!
Amidst the piercing sounds of arrows soaring through the air, they rained down on Hong Antong and others.
In just a few breaths.
He shot no fewer than a hundred arrows!
On average, drawing and releasing the bowstring three to four times in a single breath, such extreme speed was unfathomable, even the Little Dragon Girl couldn’t believe her eyes!
That was her reaction.
Hong Antong, Mu Renqing, Yuchi Gong, and other experts were no exception, all dumbfounded, amazed, tongues tied, but immediately followed by shock, horror, and fear.
"Run!"
Yuchi Gong, having reached the entrance of the camp by then, seeing this, instantly rolled off his horse, hid under the horse’s belly, and spurred the steed to dash into the camp swiftly.
Others mimicked him, all hiding under the horses’ bellies.
Those slower in reaction were immediately covered and killed by the ’pouring’ rain of arrows.

chapters.title: Chapter 429: The Deer and the Cauldron - Hong Antong
paragraphs: "Ah!"
"No!"
The screams were incessant, echoing throughout the Celestial Extreme.
Clearly, it was just one person, yet they fired bolts of explosive and terrifying arrows, almost forming a rain of arrows!
Once covered by them, no one could survive!
It only took a moment.
At the camp gate, a multitude of people lay dead.
Each person’s face was unrecognizable, making it hard to tell who was who!
"These arrows actually explode!"
Hong Antong narrowly escaped into the camp, avoiding this calamity, witnessing the tragic state of the warriors at the gateway, he couldn’t help but feel lingering fear:
"Ding Ling’s prowess has truly reached such an extraordinary level, akin to a Land God?!"
He was incredulous:
"Can the might of one person be so terrifying?! Is he still human?"

"Otherwise, why do you think I gathered everyone’s strength, teamed up with the Aliens to steal the Nine Yang Divine Skill, and then smeared Ding Ling’s name, fully guiding the high monks of the Shaolin Temple into conflict with Ding Ling, in hopes of killing with a borrowed knife."
Kebineng glared at Hong Antong, frustrated with his incompetence:
"Sect Leader Hong, you, at least, are the leader of the Divine Dragon Sect, how can you be so unwise, so dismissive of an enemy highly regarded, even feared by me, Kebineng!"
"I thought it was all exaggerated rumors."
Hong Antong honestly said:
"After all, in my world, no matter how strong one person is, they can hardly resist a great army. Moreover, I’ve seen Zuo Ci, he didn’t appear strong enough to withstand a thousand armies!
Zuo Ci can’t resist an army!
Ding Ling, as strong as he is, can barely be slightly better than Zuo Ci.
How could he stand against the combined assault of a great army and our experts!
That’s what I thought. And I feel like what I said makes sense!"
"That’s utter nonsense!"
Yuchi Gong couldn’t refrain from rebuking again:
"Now the facts are right before your eyes and you still want to argue. The facts prove you are a fool! Cooperating with a person like you brings shame to me, Yuchi Gong!"
"Yuchi Gong!"
Hong Antong, unable to contain his anger, erupted immediately:

"Don’t take kindness for granted! Always humiliating me, Hong Antong, do you think I’m easy to talk with? Or do you think I’m easy to bully? Come, let’s have a life-and-death duel today to see if your Divine Whip is mightier than my spear!
"Enough. We’re standing here arguing at such a critical moment?"
Kebineng was even more enraged than Hong Antong, pointing outside the camp:
"Look, Ding Ling is still firing arrows. My warriors are continually being killed. You still have the mood to argue here, can’t you be rational? Consider the bigger picture?!"
Following Kebineng’s direction, everyone looked out.
Sure enough.
Ding Ling was getting closer to the camp.
But still outside the range of our archers.
Our side couldn’t reach Ding Ling.
Yet Ding Ling could freely slaughter our warriors.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
In the piercing sound of air being cut.
Mu Renqing, Hong Antong, Yuchi Gong and others clearly saw warriors getting shot down, collapsing to the ground.
They couldn’t help but gaze at each other.
Angry, fearful, hesitant, struggling, or in agony...
Indeed, it was a human emotion in various forms.
But it was undeniable.
Almost everyone present experienced an inexplicable sense of trepidation towards Ding Ling.
Even beings as excellent as the Divine Sword Immortal Ape, at this moment felt the same, and murmured:

"This Ding Ling has probably drawn his bow hundreds of times, each time releasing three arrows, drawing the bow for such a long time, his strength hasn’t diminished at all. His endurance and physical prowess must have reached an unimaginable level."
"Indeed."
Yuchi Gong agreed deeply:
"I also practice Cultivation Breathing Technique. Moreover, I know Ding Ling ascended from the Three Kingdoms World to the Upper Realm, clearly practicing Breathing Technique as well.
Yet just by practicing Breathing Technique, reaching Ding Ling’s level is a bit too outrageous. I really don’t know how he practiced."
"Besides, Ding Ling must have practiced an Unparalleled Inner Power Heart Method."
Kebineng pointed out:

"Otherwise, his arrows couldn’t possess such explosive power. All of us have practiced Breathing Technique and Inner Power Heart Method, naturally knowing that when Breathing Technique’s Vigorous Qi and Inner Strength are fused, it produces fivefold or tenfold explosive power.
This power is extremely strong and explosive, and difficult to control.
But seeing Ding Ling easily wielding it indicates his mastery of Fusion Qi is also an unimaginable level.
This opponent is incredibly dangerous!"
"Then what should we do?"
Hong Antong saw Ding Ling, in a flash, kill or injure hundreds more, he couldn’t help but feel his hair stand on end, his eyes widened as he said:
"Are we really going to just watch as Ding Ling slaughters all our warriors?! And do nothing?!"
"He doesn’t have that many arrows."
An elderly man, with a sallow face, no beard beneath his chin, looking about sixty or seventy years old, interjected suddenly:
"Moreover, I agree with Sect Leader Hong’s statement, human strength has its limits, let’s see how long he can keep shooting like this."
His voice was shrill and piercing.
Kebineng glanced at him and said:
"Hai Dafu, don’t underestimate Ding Ling. He’s far more terrifying than we imagined."
"No matter how fearsome, he’s still human."

Hai Dafu has also practiced Breathing Technique, making his physique much stronger than before, no longer hunched or coughing constantly, but instead standing upright, gazing with intimidating eyes towards Ding Ling’s direction, he declared firmly:

"Later, we will hide throughout the great army. When Ding Ling’s strength is exhausted, we’ll seize the opportunity to charge out and decapitate him in one fell swoop! To completely finish him, helping Kebineng to fulfill his lifelong ambition."
Kebineng’s lifelong ambition was to kill Ding Ling.
Everyone knew.
The players were present too, but their martial power was weak, their voices carried little weight, and no one cared about these weaklings like ants or sparrows.
They spoke occasionally, and aside from Kebineng giving some importance, others would completely ignore them or even regard them with disdain.
It angered the players, causing them to secretly curse and grumble.
They came this time expecting to share the spoils.

But after Kebineng got the Nine Yang Divine Skill, he never mentioned sharing the spoils, they planned to jointly meet Kebineng tonight to discuss the Nine Yang Divine Skill matter, yet unexpectedly Ding Ling attacked.
Kebineng immediately found an excuse, saying after jointly killing Ding Ling, they would share the Nine Yang Divine Skill.
This made the players furious, but they were helpless.
After all, they burned Shaolin and smeared Ding Ling’s reputation, occupying a crucial role.
But stealing the Nine Yang Divine Skill, stabilizing the Shaolin Temple abbot, secretly transporting Shizhi Water and petroleum to various places in Shaolin, was done by Kebineng and others.
They were unable to achieve this.
Especially Kebineng who learned Zuo Ci’s Technique, transforming Shizhi Water and other things to resemble clear water, this astonishing Technique left the players astonished and speechless.
