chapters.title: Chapter 430: Breaking Through the Formation
paragraphs: Thinking about it now.
Players also find it incredible, not knowing how Kebineng managed to do it.
It was Kebineng who stabilized the situation.
Resulting in the successful fire attack on Shaolin and the theft of the True Scriptures.
If there were only some players.
It would have been difficult to accomplish anything.
After all, their Martial Arts Cultivation is far inferior to the high monks of Shaolin Temple.

But now they succeeded, yet Kebineng seems to monopolize the results and not share with players, if it weren’t for Ding Ling’s sudden arrival, it’s hard to say that they wouldn’t have clashed with Kebineng.
And the outcome would likely be them getting killed.
Thinking of this.
The players, while feeling resentful, are increasingly determined to become stronger, otherwise they won’t earn the respect and recognition like Kebineng’s!
They mingled with Kebineng, ultimately using each other.

It’s just their strength is too weak, so when it comes to dividing the spoils, they are at Kebineng’s mercy without any choice. Most of them are new players, with some veteran players, but for Ascension to the Divine Eagle World, all their cultivation, skills, and learning transform into energy sacrificed to the ’Gate of Glory’!
Without sufficient strength, stepping onto the Heaven-Ascending Ladder requires paying the necessary price!
Thus, their current cultivation is no different from ordinary soldiers, facing the incredibly powerful Kebineng is no different than an ant.
Thinking about Kebineng’s attitude towards them and towards Ding Ling, two completely different attitudes.
While feeling depressed.
They realize the practicality of the forest law in this world.
Without strength, one can only be despised, pressed, and manipulated!
And like Ding Ling.
Just standing there makes Kebineng extremely nervous.
This is the gap.
Thinking of this.
The players can’t help but feel envy, jealousy, and hatred towards Ding Ling!

Envy and jealousy need no explanation. The hatred naturally comes from Ding Ling arriving too soon, if only he arrived a bit later, they might have ’intimidated’ successfully and obtained the Nine Yang Divine Skill and left.
But they also know the likelihood is low, since Kebineng is like a wolf, when he needs players, he welcomes with a smile and utmost respect.
When he doesn’t need anything, he immediately turns hostile.

Veteran players are fine, having experienced many things, but new players can’t bear it, thinking ’Nima, I, a player, stand at the pinnacle of the world as a predator, and can still be bullied by an NPC?!’
They are about to erupt, only stopped by the intimidation and threats from some veteran players.
But seeing how hard they are enduring, it’s obvious clashing with Kebineng is only a matter of time.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Ding Ling’s rain of arrows never stopped.
Tornado Arrow Skill!
Double Extreme Arrow Skill!
Under the activation of Fusion Qi, ten times power erupted, each arrow seeming like a grenade, exploding as soon as it lands, even if the other side is holding a giant shield, it’s useless.
Once hit by an arrow, most likely the person and the shield together are blasted away, followed by arrows directly piercing through, pinned to the ground!
Ding Ling’s face was expressionless, the speed of bending the bow and setting arrows so fast it appeared as afterimages.
In a brief moment.
At least a thousand people were killed.
Countless were injured or shot down.
Ding Ling reached to the side.
But found it empty.
Turns out the arrow quiver was completely used up.
Even the contents in the Storage Pouch were taken out by the Little Dragon Girl and placed to his right, as he reached to his right now, found it empty, naturally the arrow quiver was empty.
As expected.
He looked towards the Little Dragon Girl, she immediately handed the Storage Pouch back to Ding Ling, and said:
"The arrows prepared before are all used up."
"No problem."
Ding Ling put the Treasure Bow into the Storage Pouch, took out the Drumming Golden Hammer, held it in his hand, and said:
"Follow me closely later, remember, be clean and decisive, kill the enemy with one shot. Remember, if you don’t kill the enemy, the enemy will kill me. Do you want me to get hurt?"
Little Dragon Girl shook her head vigorously.
"I entrust my back to you. Be careful."
"Don’t worry."
Little Dragon Girl gripped the spear in her hand tightly and said solemnly:
"I will not let anyone harm you."
Ding Ling smiled faintly, thought for a moment, and added:
"Judging from the enemy camp’s situation, they will definitely shoot arrows at me. Wait until they finish a volley before you rush out, to avoid getting injured!"
He gave a few instructions, to which Little Dragon Girl nodded repeatedly.
Seeing this, Ding Ling immediately spurred his horse forward, heading straight for the entrance of the large camp.
"Ding Ling’s arrows are exhausted!"
Kebineng saw this clearly and could no longer hold back, roaring:
"Archers, step forward! Ready!"
Swish swish swish!

A batch of archers immediately stepped up, each drawing their bows and nocking their arrows, nervously watching Ding Ling. Previously, one group after another of archers had been unable to lift their heads because of Ding Ling.
Countless comrades, despite having the protection of the Great Saber Team and shield bearers, had met untimely deaths and fallen on the spot!
To the archers, Ding Ling was truly terrifying from the bottom of their hearts!
The more skilled a Divine Archer was, the more they understood how terrifying Ding Ling’s Arrow Skill was, and how powerful his strength!
Such an opponent was the one they feared the most, dreaded the most, and least wanted to face!
But the commander had given the order.
Military orders are like mountains.
They had no choice but to comply.
They could only forcibly suppress their fear and aim their arrows at Ding Ling’s vital points, hoping they could truly hit him.

Seeing this, Ding Ling activated the Five Great Breathing Techniques and Pure Yang True Skill. The Vigorous Qi of the Breathing Technique fused with the True Qi, a special Vigorous Qi circulated throughout his limbs and bones, eventually channeling into the Drumming Golden Hammer.
Buzz buzz!
The Drumming Golden Hammer became even lighter, almost weightless, and began to buzz as if it might explode at any moment.
Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique!
Ding Ling performed the Hammer Technique, his demeanor cold and noble, sharp and dominant, as if riding a phoenix descending into the mortal world as an overlord.
He charged forward swiftly.
With Kebineng’s shout of ’Fire!’...
Swoosh swoosh swoosh!
The dense arrows poured down like heavy rain, seemingly capable of crushing and overwhelming everything in an instant.
Ding Ling remained unmoved, using the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique.
Boom boom boom!
Countless phantom giant hammers appeared in the void, blocking all vital directions.
The arrows shot forth, but to no avail.
Easily blocked outside by the giant hammers!
Ding Ling seized the opportunity to accelerate and continuously dash forward.
He had only charged a short distance.
Noticing the Ferghana Horse fully armored and slowing down considerably, he leaped off the horse.
Using Bird-Catching Skill and Ten Thousand Miles Solo Lightness Skill, boom! In less than two breaths, he covered over a hundred meters in the blink of an eye.
At his current level of cultivation and strength.
With the special fusion Qi driving him.
He seemed to move as if by instant teleportation.
In less than two blinks, Ding Ling had reached the archers.
Then, as they stood there dumbfounded, he raised the Drumming Golden Hammer high and without hesitation smashed it down heavily.
Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique!
Boom boom boom!
Like thunder falling, more like lightning splitting the sky, one hammer stroke resulted in utter devastation. Several archers in front of him were instantly reduced to mush.

Boom boom boom! The hammer swept through, the second row of archers in its path, more than ten were instantly killed, a sweeping strike, rumbling! There was no escape, whether standing or preparing to ambush Ding Ling, all were sent flying by the hammer at this moment!
Some exploded mid-air as the hammer struck them, immense force entering their bodies, bones cracking and shattering on the spot!
Others were sent flying over ten meters, knocking over countless comrades on their way.
After Ding Ling broke into the archers, he was like a tiger among sheep, more like a waterfall descending from the heavens, truly unstoppable!
"Run!"
One archer, terrified beyond reason, heart and spirit shattered, turned and fled.
"Don’t run!"
Kebineng, overseeing from the rear, seeing this, pulled out a bow and shot the fleeing soldier, shouting angrily:
"Everyone charge! Today, either Ding Ling, this Great Demon, dies, or we do! If you don’t want to die, fight! He is only one person, we will surely win!"

sentences.text: Thinking about it now.
Players also find it incredible, not knowing how Kebineng managed to do it.
It was Kebineng who stabilized the situation.
Resulting in the successful fire attack on Shaolin and the theft of the True Scriptures.
If there were only some players.
It would have been difficult to accomplish anything.
After all, their Martial Arts Cultivation is far inferior to the high monks of Shaolin Temple.

But now they succeeded, yet Kebineng seems to monopolize the results and not share with players, if it weren’t for Ding Ling’s sudden arrival, it’s hard to say that they wouldn’t have clashed with Kebineng.
And the outcome would likely be them getting killed.
Thinking of this.
The players, while feeling resentful, are increasingly determined to become stronger, otherwise they won’t earn the respect and recognition like Kebineng’s!
They mingled with Kebineng, ultimately using each other.
It’s just their strength is too weak, so when it comes to dividing the spoils, they are at Kebineng’s mercy without any choice.

Most of them are new players, with some veteran players, but for Ascension to the Divine Eagle World, all their cultivation, skills, and learning transform into energy sacrificed to the ’Gate of Glory’!
Without sufficient strength, stepping onto the Heaven-Ascending Ladder requires paying the necessary price!
Thus, their current cultivation is no different from ordinary soldiers, facing the incredibly powerful Kebineng is no different than an ant.
Thinking about Kebineng’s attitude towards them and towards Ding Ling, two completely different attitudes.
While feeling depressed.
They realize the practicality of the forest law in this world.
Without strength, one can only be despised, pressed, and manipulated!
And like Ding Ling.
Just standing there makes Kebineng extremely nervous.
This is the gap.
Thinking of this.
The players can’t help but feel envy, jealousy, and hatred towards Ding Ling!
Envy and jealousy need no explanation.
The hatred naturally comes from Ding Ling arriving too soon, if only he arrived a bit later, they might have ’intimidated’ successfully and obtained the Nine Yang Divine Skill and left.
But they also know the likelihood is low, since Kebineng is like a wolf, when he needs players, he welcomes with a smile and utmost respect.
When he doesn’t need anything, he immediately turns hostile.

Veteran players are fine, having experienced many things, but new players can’t bear it, thinking ’Nima, I, a player, stand at the pinnacle of the world as a predator, and can still be bullied by an NPC?!’
They are about to erupt, only stopped by the intimidation and threats from some veteran players.
But seeing how hard they are enduring, it’s obvious clashing with Kebineng is only a matter of time.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Ding Ling’s rain of arrows never stopped.
Tornado Arrow Skill!
Double Extreme Arrow Skill!
Under the activation of Fusion Qi, ten times power erupted, each arrow seeming like a grenade, exploding as soon as it lands, even if the other side is holding a giant shield, it’s useless.
Once hit by an arrow, most likely the person and the shield together are blasted away, followed by arrows directly piercing through, pinned to the ground!
Ding Ling’s face was expressionless, the speed of bending the bow and setting arrows so fast it appeared as afterimages.
In a brief moment.
At least a thousand people were killed.
Countless were injured or shot down.
Ding Ling reached to the side.
But found it empty.
Turns out the arrow quiver was completely used up.
Even the contents in the Storage Pouch were taken out by the Little Dragon Girl and placed to his right, as he reached to his right now, found it empty, naturally the arrow quiver was empty.
As expected.
He looked towards the Little Dragon Girl, she immediately handed the Storage Pouch back to Ding Ling, and said:
"The arrows prepared before are all used up."
"No problem."
Ding Ling put the Treasure Bow into the Storage Pouch, took out the Drumming Golden Hammer, held it in his hand, and said:
"Follow me closely later, remember, be clean and decisive, kill the enemy with one shot.
Remember, if you don’t kill the enemy, the enemy will kill me.
Do you want me to get hurt?"
Little Dragon Girl shook her head vigorously.
"I entrust my back to you.
Be careful."
"Don’t worry."
Little Dragon Girl gripped the spear in her hand tightly and said solemnly:
"I will not let anyone harm you."
Ding Ling smiled faintly, thought for a moment, and added:
"Judging from the enemy camp’s situation, they will definitely shoot arrows at me.
Wait until they finish a volley before you rush out, to avoid getting injured!"
He gave a few instructions, to which Little Dragon Girl nodded repeatedly.
Seeing this, Ding Ling immediately spurred his horse forward, heading straight for the entrance of the large camp.
"Ding Ling’s arrows are exhausted!"
Kebineng saw this clearly and could no longer hold back, roaring:
"Archers, step forward!
Ready!"
Swish swish swish!
A batch of archers immediately stepped up, each drawing their bows and nocking their arrows, nervously watching Ding Ling.
Previously, one group after another of archers had been unable to lift their heads because of Ding Ling.
Countless comrades, despite having the protection of the Great Saber Team and shield bearers, had met untimely deaths and fallen on the spot!
To the archers, Ding Ling was truly terrifying from the bottom of their hearts!
The more skilled a Divine Archer was, the more they understood how terrifying Ding Ling’s Arrow Skill was, and how powerful his strength!
Such an opponent was the one they feared the most, dreaded the most, and least wanted to face!
But the commander had given the order.
Military orders are like mountains.
They had no choice but to comply.
They could only forcibly suppress their fear and aim their arrows at Ding Ling’s vital points, hoping they could truly hit him.
Seeing this, Ding Ling activated the Five Great Breathing Techniques and Pure Yang True Skill.
The Vigorous Qi of the Breathing Technique fused with the True Qi, a special Vigorous Qi circulated throughout his limbs and bones, eventually channeling into the Drumming Golden Hammer.
Buzz buzz!
The Drumming Golden Hammer became even lighter, almost weightless, and began to buzz as if it might explode at any moment.
Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique!
Ding Ling performed the Hammer Technique, his demeanor cold and noble, sharp and dominant, as if riding a phoenix descending into the mortal world as an overlord.
He charged forward swiftly.
With Kebineng’s shout of ’Fire!’...
Swoosh swoosh swoosh!
The dense arrows poured down like heavy rain, seemingly capable of crushing and overwhelming everything in an instant.
Ding Ling remained unmoved, using the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique.
Boom boom boom!
Countless phantom giant hammers appeared in the void, blocking all vital directions.
The arrows shot forth, but to no avail.
Easily blocked outside by the giant hammers!
Ding Ling seized the opportunity to accelerate and continuously dash forward.
He had only charged a short distance.
Noticing the Ferghana Horse fully armored and slowing down considerably, he leaped off the horse.
Using Bird-Catching Skill and Ten Thousand Miles Solo Lightness Skill, boom!
In less than two breaths, he covered over a hundred meters in the blink of an eye.
At his current level of cultivation and strength.
With the special fusion Qi driving him.
He seemed to move as if by instant teleportation.
In less than two blinks, Ding Ling had reached the archers.
Then, as they stood there dumbfounded, he raised the Drumming Golden Hammer high and without hesitation smashed it down heavily.
Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique!
Boom boom boom!
Like thunder falling, more like lightning splitting the sky, one hammer stroke resulted in utter devastation.
Several archers in front of him were instantly reduced to mush.
Boom boom boom!
The hammer swept through, the second row of archers in its path, more than ten were instantly killed, a sweeping strike, rumbling!
There was no escape, whether standing or preparing to ambush Ding Ling, all were sent flying by the hammer at this moment!
Some exploded mid-air as the hammer struck them, immense force entering their bodies, bones cracking and shattering on the spot!
Others were sent flying over ten meters, knocking over countless comrades on their way.
After Ding Ling broke into the archers, he was like a tiger among sheep, more like a waterfall descending from the heavens, truly unstoppable!
"Run!"
One archer, terrified beyond reason, heart and spirit shattered, turned and fled.
"Don’t run!"
Kebineng, overseeing from the rear, seeing this, pulled out a bow and shot the fleeing soldier, shouting angrily:
"Everyone charge!
Today, either Ding Ling, this Great Demon, dies, or we do!
If you don’t want to die, fight!
He is only one person, we will surely win!"

chapters.title: Chapter 431: Sui and Tang General Yuchi Gong Trembles in Fear
paragraphs: Kebineng’s voice, driven by Fusion Qi, thundered across the field, momentarily suppressing some of the wailing cries.
"Hahaha..."
Ding Ling charged back and forth, unstoppable in his killing spree, letting out a long howl at the sky followed by three bursts of laughter:
"Kebineng, you coward, only know how to kill your own! If you’re tough enough, come fight me!"
"Hmph!"
Kebineng did not respond, instead shouted, urging the Great Army forward:
"Anyone who dares disobey orders, I will report to the commander. He will punish you with the crime of exterminating nine generations of your family!"
Kebineng openly threatened.
Making some soldiers fearful of Ding Ling have no choice but to pick up their weapons, forcing themselves to charge forward despite their anxiety.
"Kill!"
"Kill!"
Clearly, Ding Ling was just one person.
Including Little Dragon Girl following closely behind to protect Ding Ling.
At most, they were two people.
Yet these soldiers felt powerless, helpless, and incompetent as if facing ten thousand ferocious wolves and beasts!
They couldn’t win!
This thought clearly crossed their minds!
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Especially seeing Ding Ling swinging a giant hammer, as he passed, blood and violence followed, anyone hit by the hammer became a puddle of flesh!
Some were lucky, only half of their body was hit, but it still resulted in their bodies collapsing, exploding, and instant death.
The soldiers were terrified, their hands and feet weak, wanting to flee.
But the constant drumming urged them onward!
They could only form ranks, either wielding large knives or holding spears, numbly stepping forward one by one.
"Whoosh whoosh!"
Ding Ling charged forward like the wind, with Little Dragon Girl closely protecting him, anyone daring to attack Ding Ling was swiftly pierced through by her, dying instantly.
After killing many.
Little Dragon Girl’s armor was stained red, her eyes transformed from bewildered and panicked to calm and fierce, the speed of her change exceeded everyone’s expectations.
Very clearly.
Little Dragon Girl has great potential, once adapted to the battlefield, she would be a formidable woman warrior.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Ding Ling continued charging forward, directly towards the central flag area where Kebineng was stationed.
He charged so fast.
Wielding the Drumming Golden Hammer, unleashing the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique, there was no one to match him, even some formidable generals faced his hammer and were killed in one strike.
Such a fierce man.
Let alone Kebineng.

Hai Dafu, Hong Antong, and others who previously doubted Ding Ling’s strength were now horrified, their hairs stood on end, utterly shocked and unable to believe how the world could have such an invincible, lawless man!
"This endurance, too strong."
Divine Sword Immortal Ape Mu Renqing was also stunned, unable to believe it:
"How could a mortal’s endurance last so long! And Ding Ling’s battle strength seems to grow stronger, not only not exhausted but even stronger?! What kind of monster is this?!"
"Too fierce."
Yuchi Gong’s whole body trembled, not knowing whether it was from fear, excitement, or shock:
"If I go forward, my destiny would probably be to be killed by one of his strikes! No wonder that freak Li Yuanba died at his hands. Apparently, this guy is more monstrous than Li Yuanba!"
Yuchi Gong’s expression changed repeatedly as he looked at Ding Ling.
Now he looked at Ding Ling as if looking at the demon god of the abyss, the fear and terror almost oozed from his eyes!
He had heard of Li Yuanba’s death in other worlds.
He also thought of avenging Li Yuanba.
After all, Li Yuanba was a close relative of his lord!
How could he sit by and watch such blood feud?
Thus, when he ascended to the Divine Eagle World, persuaded by the Alien to join Kebineng’s camp, pledging to kill Ding Ling for Divine Skill, he agreed.
He indeed lacked a Top Divine Skill, hearing of the power of the Nine Yang Divine Skill stirred him.
A copy of Nine Yin Scripture drew heroes worldwide into frenzied competition. The Nine Yang Divine Skill wasn’t inferior to the Nine Yin Scripture in any respect, even surpassing in some!
How could Yuchi Gong ignore it or give up?
Moreover, the plan involved killing Ding Ling, so he naturally agreed.
But now seeing the current situation, most likely that group of Shaolin monks were defeated or dead.
He had this thought, which was utterly normal.
Because Ding Ling was too fierce.
Like the Wuqu Star descending to earth, sweeping the frontier like a War God!
Pushing forward like a storm, unstoppable.
"This guy, this, this..."

Kebineng watched and couldn’t help but swallow dryly, for the first time the depths of his heart filled with regret and remorse, if he had known Ding Ling was this fierce, he should have fled with the Nine Yang Divine Skill rather than remaining to hold fort!
Too stupid!
But now, he was stuck with no escape, being targeted by Ding Ling, nowhere to run.
If he fled.
The Great Army would undoubtedly collapse, disintegrate, and utterly defeat!
Then.
Targeted by Ding Ling, with no one to deplete Ding Ling’s energy or battle power, he would most likely be caught and killed by Ding Ling.
He had just seen Ding Ling’s speed, too terrifying. Even on horseback, he couldn’t outrun Ding Ling.
This realization.
Kebineng upset, terrified, regretful, forced himself to stay calm and continuously direct the Great Army to charge at Ding Ling.
He still didn’t believe it.

He clearly remembered Zuo Ci telling him ’In our world, a Celestial Being can wield Celestial Might, Celestial Intent. But in other worlds, it’s not possible, thus it’s inferred Ding Ling must have fallen from the realm of Earth Immortal to a mortal level, he is not unbeatable.
In other worlds, he can certainly be killed!’
Zuo Ci spoke firmly.
Plus, he genuinely trusted Kebineng and imparted various Supreme Skills.
It was natural for Kebineng to believe him.
But facing Ding Ling now, Kebineng wished to curse at Zuo Ci ’Laozi must have gone mad, otherwise how could I believe your deceitful tricks!’
"Hoo!"
"Ha!"
"Kill!"
"Kill!"
Tens of thousands of the Great Army, squad after squad, neatly charged forward to die.
Ding Ling grew numb from the killing.

But it’s undeniable that with continuous intense battles! Constantly operating the Five Great Breathing Techniques and Pure Yang True Skill at full_speed, his Fusion Qi became increasingly smooth and flawless, making it more handy to control!
The proficiency of Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique had long maxed out.
Right now using it, truly unstoppable.
Ding Ling’s expression was indifferent, wielding the Drumming Golden Hammer, swinging it seemingly weightless, thus his swinging speed was exceptionally fast, Boom! Boom! Boom!
Left swinging, creating countless illusionary giant hammers, effortlessly killing large swathes.
Right swinging, again creating swathes of illusions, each illusion like a small mountain, crushing bones and flesh instantly!
Grinding people into pulp!
The Drumming Golden Hammer seemed like a world-ending millstone, thundering, destroying everything in a blood storm.
Because swinging the giant hammer was so light for Ding Ling, each time he seemed to swing once, but actually swung seven or eight times in a blink!
One strike down, in the breath of a moment, it struck seven or eight times.
Such countless illusionary giant hammers.
Who dares block?
Who can block?
By the end.
These soldiers watching, instinctively filled with fear, shouted and screamed.

chapters.title: Chapter 432: The Deer and the Cauldron - Hai Dafu
paragraphs: Clearly, it didn’t hit the opponent.
The opponent screamed in fear as a reflex.
This shows the immense pressure Ding Ling put on the opponent in this battle!
And also the intense fear of the soldiers!
It’s not an exaggeration to say they see Ding Ling as a god or a demon.
"Hahaha..."
Ding Ling swung his hammer, sending seven or eight soldiers flying, and laughed heartily as he looked at the retreating main army banner:
"Kebineng, you cowardly rat. Are you trying to run?"
As soon as he said this,
The hearts and spirits of the myriad troops wavered, showing signs of instability.
Kebineng, being who he is, immediately shouted loudly upon seeing this:
"I am irreconcilable with you, Ding Ling, you Great Demon. Even if I die on the battlefield today, I will absolutely not retreat! Soldiers, he is already finished. Charge!
Kill him!
Avenge our fallen comrades!"
Kebineng’s voice was passionate and grand, like great waves crashing on the shore, clearly reaching the ears of each soldier.
The previously shaken morale steadied quite a bit.

Many soldiers, who had lost brothers, charged at Ding Ling with red eyes, roaring in fury, not caring for their lives. Under the influence of these almost Death Warriors, the blood of many soldiers boiled, and they kicked up and roared as they charged forward.

Seeing this, Ding Ling stopped holding back, letting out a long howl. His Vigorous Qi and True Qi erupted, and his astonishing strength, agility, and other attributes came into play. His speed became faster, and his strength grew greater.
He was already immensely strong, and with high speed, high endurance, and Fusion Qi, his Overbearing Aura and Unrivaled prowess were displayed vividly.
As he let out another long howl, his Drumming Golden Hammer swung faster and faster, sweeping through like autumn winds scattering leaves, boom boom boom!
Wherever he passed, all enemies, whether mighty warriors or soldiers, were swept away!
In no time at all, it was unclear how many soldiers met their untimely deaths.
He advanced over a hundred meters.
With casualties numbering in the thousands.
Little Dragon Girl was covered in blood, as if pulled from a pool of blood.

Though Ding Ling was also stained with blood, he looked much better, radiant and full of spirit, becoming more crazed the more he fought. Later on, he unleashed his full potential, no one beneath his hammer remaining unscathed. Every time it came down, it smashed people to smithereens!
One by one, the top warriors charging forward were all killed miserably on the battlefield, without a whole body left.
Such tragedy.
Shocking the whole scene!
Even the Unrivaled mighty warriors shivered, unable to help trembling!
Kebineng’s heart pounded faster and faster!
Seeing Ding Ling getting closer and closer.
Kebineng dared not hesitate any longer.
Immediately signaling Hai Dafu and a few others, who were closest to him, to launch a surprise attack on Ding Ling.

Hai Dafu broke out in a cold sweat, wanting to refuse, but seeing the knife-like cold eyes of Kebineng, he knew that if he resisted, Kebineng might immediately order the soldiers to shoot him and his group.
Thinking about the handles Kebineng’s confidants held over him, if Kebineng saw him as an enemy, Kublai would not spare him either.
Moreover, he had already shown his cards and taken a stand against Ding Ling.
How could Ding Ling spare him?
Even if he escaped now, if he got targeted by the furious Kublai, he would likely meet a dead end.
Besides, Ding Ling was too monstrous and terrifying. Having made him an enemy, if he didn’t kill him now, in future encounters, he feared Ding Ling would surely hammer him to death!
Thinking this through.
Hai Dafu gritted his teeth, donned his leather armor, put on a helmet, and with a short knife in hand, blended into the soldiers as they charged towards Ding Ling.
He encouraged himself:

"Ding Ling has killed or injured about five or six thousand people now. So many people have been knocked down by him. Even if he were a god, he’s no longer at his peak. His strength must have diminished quite a bit. What he’s showing now is surely just a facade.
If I act decisively and go all out, maybe I can pierce through his facade of strength!
If I expose him, pointing out that his strength has indeed diminished.
Yuchi Gong, Hong Antong, and others would definitely not sit back and watch me die.
Kebineng would surely be overjoyed and then do his utmost to charge!"
With this thought.

Hai Dafu could only muster his spirits, his eyes fixed fiercely on Ding Ling. With a short knife in one hand and Bone-Softening Palm in the other, he launched a full-force attack. For a moment, one could see white gas swirling around his palm, as if poisonous snakes were wrapped around his hand.
"Dadada!"

As the soldiers charged, Hai Dafu reached Ding Ling’s side. Seeing Little Dragon Girl engaged in killing other soldiers, unable to break away, he decisively darted diagonally, stabbing his short knife towards Ding Ling’s waist and abdomen while slapping his Bone-Softening Palm towards Ding Ling’s back!
And at the same time.
In front and on both sides of Ding Ling were enemies everywhere.
Yet it seemed he did not notice this move from Hai Dafu.

Hai Dafu was overjoyed, laughing loudly in his heart, thinking ’Ding Ling, you are indeed at the end of your rope. Watch me, Hai Dafu, kill you! Your death will surely bring me, Hai Dafu, fame across the land!’

He hardened his heart, and the Bone-Softening Palm he launched with full force displayed more power. Before it even neared Ding Ling’s back, it made the void sizzle, as if it could dissolve the air itself!
Yet in the next instant.
Boom!

Ding Ling suddenly sidestepped, evading that godly peak strike. Then he swung his hammer down on Hai Dafu’s head, raining down countless phantom giant hammers. With no room to dodge, Hai Dafu’s eyes widened in fury. He let out a roar, putting all his strength into thrusting out his knife, seemingly wanting to perish together with Ding Ling.
But then with a loud crash, Peng!
The Drumming Golden Hammer knocked the short knife out of Hai Dafu’s hand. Following that, two pounding hammer blows came down, smashing Hai Dafu into pulp on the spot, dying a horrible death!
A First-class Expert, hidden within the Great Army, suddenly struck out and was instantly killed by Ding Ling!
Moreover, the death was swift and particularly gruesome.
Hong Antong, who had been preparing to launch a sneak attack, immediately retreated three feet, intending to withdraw.
But Ding Ling had noticed and wasn’t about to let these people escape.
He had long been aware of the few individuals of varying appearances but universally profound auras around Kebineng.
It was obvious.
These were the top experts Kebineng had gathered around him, whether willingly or unwillingly.
If they intended to kill him, Ding Ling.
How could Ding Ling let them off so easily?

He immediately let out a long howl, activated Golden Swan Skill, leaped three feet into the air without support, and stepping on nothingness, took several steps, reaching above Hong Antong. Then he heavily swung the Drumming Golden Hammer down.
Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique!
Diverse as it might be, all things share a common principle.
As long as one is strong enough and fast enough, a single Hammer Technique can conquer the world!

Ding Ling, whose physical prowess was currently outstanding and whose Fusion Qi grew increasingly terrifying, found using the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique as easy and natural as eating and drinking.

sentences.text: Clearly, it didn’t hit the opponent.
The opponent screamed in fear as a reflex.
This shows the immense pressure Ding Ling put on the opponent in this battle!
And also the intense fear of the soldiers!
It’s not an exaggeration to say they see Ding Ling as a god or a demon.
"Hahaha..."
Ding Ling swung his hammer, sending seven or eight soldiers flying, and laughed heartily as he looked at the retreating main army banner:
"Kebineng, you cowardly rat.
Are you trying to run?"
As soon as he said this,
The hearts and spirits of the myriad troops wavered, showing signs of instability.
Kebineng, being who he is, immediately shouted loudly upon seeing this:
"I am irreconcilable with you, Ding Ling, you Great Demon.
Even if I die on the battlefield today, I will absolutely not retreat!
Soldiers, he is already finished.
Charge!
Kill him!
Avenge our fallen comrades!"
Kebineng’s voice was passionate and grand, like great waves crashing on the shore, clearly reaching the ears of each soldier.
The previously shaken morale steadied quite a bit.
Many soldiers, who had lost brothers, charged at Ding Ling with red eyes, roaring in fury, not caring for their lives.
Under the influence of these almost Death Warriors, the blood of many soldiers boiled, and they kicked up and roared as they charged forward.
Seeing this, Ding Ling stopped holding back, letting out a long howl.
His Vigorous Qi and True Qi erupted, and his astonishing strength, agility, and other attributes came into play.
His speed became faster, and his strength grew greater.
He was already immensely strong, and with high speed, high endurance, and Fusion Qi, his Overbearing Aura and Unrivaled prowess were displayed vividly.
As he let out another long howl, his Drumming Golden Hammer swung faster and faster, sweeping through like autumn winds scattering leaves, boom boom boom!
Wherever he passed, all enemies, whether mighty warriors or soldiers, were swept away!
In no time at all, it was unclear how many soldiers met their untimely deaths.
He advanced over a hundred meters.
With casualties numbering in the thousands.
Little Dragon Girl was covered in blood, as if pulled from a pool of blood.
Though Ding Ling was also stained with blood, he looked much better, radiant and full of spirit, becoming more crazed the more he fought.
Later on, he unleashed his full potential, no one beneath his hammer remaining unscathed.
Every time it came down, it smashed people to smithereens!
One by one, the top warriors charging forward were all killed miserably on the battlefield, without a whole body left.
Such tragedy.
Shocking the whole scene!
Even the Unrivaled mighty warriors shivered, unable to help trembling!
Kebineng’s heart pounded faster and faster!
Seeing Ding Ling getting closer and closer.
Kebineng dared not hesitate any longer.
Immediately signaling Hai Dafu and a few others, who were closest to him, to launch a surprise attack on Ding Ling.

Hai Dafu broke out in a cold sweat, wanting to refuse, but seeing the knife-like cold eyes of Kebineng, he knew that if he resisted, Kebineng might immediately order the soldiers to shoot him and his group.
Thinking about the handles Kebineng’s confidants held over him, if Kebineng saw him as an enemy, Kublai would not spare him either.
Moreover, he had already shown his cards and taken a stand against Ding Ling.
How could Ding Ling spare him?
Even if he escaped now, if he got targeted by the furious Kublai, he would likely meet a dead end.
Besides, Ding Ling was too monstrous and terrifying.
Having made him an enemy, if he didn’t kill him now, in future encounters, he feared Ding Ling would surely hammer him to death!
Thinking this through.
Hai Dafu gritted his teeth, donned his leather armor, put on a helmet, and with a short knife in hand, blended into the soldiers as they charged towards Ding Ling.
He encouraged himself:
"Ding Ling has killed or injured about five or six thousand people now.
So many people have been knocked down by him.
Even if he were a god, he’s no longer at his peak.
His strength must have diminished quite a bit.
What he’s showing now is surely just a facade.
If I act decisively and go all out, maybe I can pierce through his facade of strength!
If I expose him, pointing out that his strength has indeed diminished.
Yuchi Gong, Hong Antong, and others would definitely not sit back and watch me die.
Kebineng would surely be overjoyed and then do his utmost to charge!"
With this thought.
Hai Dafu could only muster his spirits, his eyes fixed fiercely on Ding Ling.
With a short knife in one hand and Bone-Softening Palm in the other, he launched a full-force attack.
For a moment, one could see white gas swirling around his palm, as if poisonous snakes were wrapped around his hand.
"Dadada!"
As the soldiers charged, Hai Dafu reached Ding Ling’s side.

Seeing Little Dragon Girl engaged in killing other soldiers, unable to break away, he decisively darted diagonally, stabbing his short knife towards Ding Ling’s waist and abdomen while slapping his Bone-Softening Palm towards Ding Ling’s back!
And at the same time.
In front and on both sides of Ding Ling were enemies everywhere.
Yet it seemed he did not notice this move from Hai Dafu.
Hai Dafu was overjoyed, laughing loudly in his heart, thinking ’Ding Ling, you are indeed at the end of your rope.
Watch me, Hai Dafu, kill you!
Your death will surely bring me, Hai Dafu, fame across the land!’
He hardened his heart, and the Bone-Softening Palm he launched with full force displayed more power.
Before it even neared Ding Ling’s back, it made the void sizzle, as if it could dissolve the air itself!
Yet in the next instant.
Boom!
Ding Ling suddenly sidestepped, evading that godly peak strike.
Then he swung his hammer down on Hai Dafu’s head, raining down countless phantom giant hammers.
With no room to dodge, Hai Dafu’s eyes widened in fury.
He let out a roar, putting all his strength into thrusting out his knife, seemingly wanting to perish together with Ding Ling.
But then with a loud crash, Peng!
The Drumming Golden Hammer knocked the short knife out of Hai Dafu’s hand.
Following that, two pounding hammer blows came down, smashing Hai Dafu into pulp on the spot, dying a horrible death!
A First-class Expert, hidden within the Great Army, suddenly struck out and was instantly killed by Ding Ling!
Moreover, the death was swift and particularly gruesome.
Hong Antong, who had been preparing to launch a sneak attack, immediately retreated three feet, intending to withdraw.
But Ding Ling had noticed and wasn’t about to let these people escape.
He had long been aware of the few individuals of varying appearances but universally profound auras around Kebineng.
It was obvious.
These were the top experts Kebineng had gathered around him, whether willingly or unwillingly.
If they intended to kill him, Ding Ling.
How could Ding Ling let them off so easily?
He immediately let out a long howl, activated Golden Swan Skill, leaped three feet into the air without support, and stepping on nothingness, took several steps, reaching above Hong Antong.
Then he heavily swung the Drumming Golden Hammer down.
Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique!
Diverse as it might be, all things share a common principle.
As long as one is strong enough and fast enough, a single Hammer Technique can conquer the world!

Ding Ling, whose physical prowess was currently outstanding and whose Fusion Qi grew increasingly terrifying, found using the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique as easy and natural as eating and drinking.

chapters.title: Chapter 433: Mad Demon
paragraphs: Ding Ling swung his hammer down as if it could crush the Celestial Palace! Hong Antong saw it and couldn’t help but feel his liver and gall split apart, immediately shouting, ’Help me!’
The long spear in his hand shook continuously, stabbing towards Ding Ling’s vital spot like lightning.
It was obvious.
He shared Hai Dafu’s idea.
Couldn’t defeat Ding Ling, then perish together!
Besides, he didn’t believe Ding Ling could still be at his peak now, after all, Ding Ling was only human!
"Divine Dragon Eight Techniques!"
Hong Antong’s spear moved like a dragon, at times resembling a divine dragon spewing pearls, at times like a flood dragon overturning the sea, deploying with viciousness and ferocity to the extreme.
A burst of vigorous Qi pierced the void, making crackling sounds.
This was Hong Antong’s ultimate spear, combining all his lifelong learning, his Breathing Technique’s Qi, and Inner Power’s Inner Strength.
This spear was perfected to the finest detail; it was impossible to replicate such a spear again in the short term.
He pinned high hopes on this spear.
However.
Bang!

Ding Ling used his Golden Swan Skill to spin away, dodging this strike, then swung another heavy hammer down, this strike swift as thunder, like a surging wave sweeping over a small boat, giving a suffocating and oppressive feeling that it could capsize any moment.

Hong Antong barely managed a furious roar of instinct, again thrusting his spear, disregarding his life. This spear also was extremely miraculous, but Ding Ling no longer dodged, choosing instead to meet it head-on.

A loud bang was heard, the Drumming Golden Hammer clashed heavily with the opponent’s spear; the hammer, as heavy as Mount Tai, crushed it like a dirt mound, with a crunching sound, breaking the spear and not only that, the hammer’s force surged out, sending Hong Antong flying over three meters, knocking over the approaching Fat Monk.
Ding Ling seized the moment.
Striding forward.
He swung the Drumming Golden Hammer towards the soldiers charging from left and right.
With each swing a sure kill, crushing a vast number!
Like a true dragon crushing mortals, it was truly overwhelming and unstoppable.
In just a moment, Ding Ling caught up to Hong Antong, swinging his hammer down towards his head.
"Ding Ling!"
Someone shouted:
"You’ve fallen too deep into madness, stop creating more bloodshed."
It was Divine Sword Immortal Ape Mu Renqing rushing in, striking a palm towards Ding Ling’s back.

His palm gathered his entire Primordial Skill strength, fused with Breathing Technique’s Qi; when it was released, it felt like it could overturn the heavens, sink into the earth, its might unparalleled, fierce beyond measure!
This palm was the Primordial Palm, perfected into mastery, fused with Qi, exploding tremendously, shattering mountains: not difficult.
He leapt from the rear, aiming to severely wound Ding Ling with his palm.
Little Dragon Girl frowned like a sword, intending to throw her spear to aid Ding Ling without thinking.
But then, in a flash.
Ding Ling, having chewed many Great Medicines, raised his physique, agility nearly to 50 points, his reaction astonishing.
With just a sidestep in the air, one hand continued swinging the Drumming Golden Hammer at Hong Antong, the other hand formed a fist, blasting towards Mu Renqing’s palm.
Great Demon Subduing Fist!

The fist was bold, swift, grand, and majestic to the utmost, gathering Ding Ling’s explosive Qi, striking out with it; faintly, a Buddha Light appeared, like the Furious Vajra gazing down at mortals, forming a punch to strike the characters going against Buddha.
This was the Soul Transfer Technique, merging with Buddha Qi, producing the effect.
Enough to cause a momentary daze.
In just that moment, bang!
The Great Demon Subduing Fist and Primordial Palm collided and adhered to each other, followed by a booming sound, a split of palm and fist!

Ding Ling stood firm like a mountain, in contrast, Mu Renqing seemed struck by lightning, blasted to suspend several meters in the air, unable to contain himself from spitting forth several blood arrows.
Seeing his arms limp.
Clearly, the palm and fist clash cost him dearly, his arm was surely crushed by Ding Ling’s Great Demon Subduing Fist!
Bang!
He fell heavily to the ground, already severely wounded, adding injury to injury, couldn’t suppress a dry cough, spitting several mouthfuls of thick blood!
"So, so powerful..."
Mu Renqing clearly felt an extremely strong Qi from Ding Ling’s punch, blasting straight into his inner organs!
Tearing his organs apart.
He was already dying, couldn’t live long.
"Never expected that I, Mu Renqing, would die in this Otherworld! Had I known, why did I ascend?!"
His expression showed pain and regret, utterly unhidden:
"Just pity my pupil, with me gone, how will he navigate the mortal world with no shelter, having a hard time."
His eyes grew increasingly hazy, watching Ding Ling’s giant hammer sweeping the vicinity.
Seeing Hong Antong hammered flat on the ground, his body crushed beyond recognition couldn’t be identified.
Mu Renqing was terrified, suddenly experiencing a flash of lucidity before death, seeing it clearer.
Fat Monk, Yuchi Gong...
One expert after another, miserably falling under Ding Ling’s giant hammer.
No one was Ding Ling’s match.
He was terrifying, like a true dragon rampaging the world, more like a wild beast dominating the battlefield!
How could these mortals be opponents?!
The disparity was colossal!
Clearly, he reached the Half-Step Innate Realm.
But compared to Ding Ling, it was like a vast gulf!
Not a match at all!
Thinking of the absolute gap between a first-class peak expert and a most ordinary first-class expert.
Mu Renqing was relieved.
He believed Ding Ling was among the strongest in Innate Experts, beyond comprehension!
Terror spread lawlessly.
"Had I known he’d be this fierce. I wouldn’t have agreed to the Alien’s condition to come here..."
A flash of returning clarity before eternal silence.
He fell heavily onto the ground, eyelids growing heavier until extinguished, unmoving.
Meeting the same end as Hong Antong, Hai Dafu and others.
Before death, they felt indignation, regret, fear, terror to the extreme.
If they could choose again.
They would also avoid opposing Ding Ling, but sadly, there was no if in the world.
Boom!

After blasting Mu Renqing away with a punch and hammering Hong Antong to death, Ding Ling’s heart grew more excited, eyes reddening, laughing heartily, swinging his giant hammer, charging madly into the battle array.
Boom boom boom!
The giant hammer swung wildly! Crashed down!
Wherever he went.
Blood stained the ground!
Soldiers and generals fell dead on the ground.
Among them, leading the army’s charge, was Yuchi Gong.
He died too cheaply.
Facing Ding Ling head-on!

chapters.title: Chapter 434: Lethal Strike
paragraphs: Just one round.
Yuchi Gong was knocked off his horse by Ding Ling and sent flying!
It was as if a mountain had pushed him aside and then crushed an egg effortlessly.
Yuchi Gong didn’t have time to react before he was knocked off his horse and then smashed to death on the spot.
The last scene he saw before he died was Ding Ling, eyes red, laughing maniacally as he swung the giant hammer at him!
As the shadows of the hammer fell densely.
He knew nothing more.
But in that last moment before his death, he realized that he must have been hammered into mush!
He recognized that Drumming Golden Hammer.
Li Yuanba used to turn people into mush like this as well!
Who would have thought that as time passed,
he, Yuchi Gong, would also die under this Drumming Golden Hammer.
How laughable is this? How ironic is this?!
"If I hadn’t gone against Ding Ling, if I hadn’t sought revenge, perhaps one day I could have become as powerful as Ding Ling?"
Yuchi Gong believed in his talent.
Because since he learned the Breathing Technique, it had gone very smoothly for him, and later he ascended to learn Inner Power, also extremely smoothly, without any difficulties.
He was hundreds of times better than ordinary people.
With such talent, as long as he practiced diligently, given time, becoming a top expert was foreseeable, yet unexpectedly, he died here so cheaply.

"I hope Qin Qiong and the others can be rational, not to seek revenge for me, not to seek revenge for Li Yuanba! Otherwise, it’s too dangerous! Ding Ling is simply a human-shaped beast! Much scarier than Li Yuanba."
Facing Li Yuanba,
he was still able to retaliate.
Facing Ding Ling, he couldn’t even block a single hammer blow!
Terrifying.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Ding Ling charged all the way, targeting Kebineng under the central flag.
The likes of Fat Monk along the way were hammered to death, hammered flying, dying as worthlessly as Yuchi Gong.
Seeing this, some top experts from other worlds were frightened out of their wits, terrified out of their souls!
They no longer wanted to follow Kebineng’s orders and fled in all directions!
Unlike Hai Dafu, who was being blackmailed by Kebineng and had to obey him, they were free, gathered this time only to conspire for the Nine Yang Divine Skill and to kill Ding Ling.
Now Ding Ling was unkillable.
They also hadn’t obtained the Nine Yang Divine Skill.
But their immediate priority was to save their lives; they no longer cared for the coveted Nine Yang Divine Skill. Each ran like a rabbit pursued by the Death God, fleeing frantically.
In the face of life and death,
the Secret Manuals became trivial!
If there was even a glimmer of hope to defeat Ding Ling,
they wouldn’t have been so cowardly!
Indeed, Ding Ling was too terrifying.
One punch and Mu Renqing was dead, one hammer and Hong Antong was flattened! Yuchi Gong, a Super-Elite Fierce General, was hammered to death along with his horse!
And these were the top experts among them, dying so easily; if they faced Ding Ling’s Drumming Golden Hammer themselves?
Could they withstand half a move?
Just thinking about it sent shivers down their spines!
Dare they stay any longer?
Each wished they had two more legs to leave this slaughterhouse sooner!
Yes.
In their eyes,
this was a slaughterhouse. And Ding Ling was a butcher!
Single-handedly, with a female general, they had killed thousands of soldiers, and with divine energy, hammered down one expert after another!
Until now.
His energy not only hadn’t decreased,
but instead, he seemed to become more frenzied the more he killed.
The strength became more terrifying, and his speed increased.
Many of them, because they ran too slowly, were easily caught and hammered down, dying easily.
They were even more frightened, their souls almost leaving their bodies, screaming continuously.
Fortunately, Ding Ling’s main target was Kebineng; they were incidental, so Ding Ling did not pursue them but charged in a straight line, like splitting the sea, toward Kebineng.
"This guy..."
"Has been killing for so long, how does he still have so much strength!"
Kebineng was so scared that his legs cramped.
He overestimated his side’s forces,
completely underestimating Ding Ling’s endurance and combat strength!
"Is this guy possessed now? The more he kills, the crazier he gets?!"
Kebineng dared not face Ding Ling again.
Because Ding Ling had almost wiped out all the top experts on his side.
The Great Army of ten thousand suffered no less than nine thousand casualties.
The remaining thousand people were also scared, running in panic, regardless of Kebineng’s threats, intimidation, or scolding, to no avail.
Clearly, the morale had completely collapsed.
Ten thousand killed down to one thousand remaining.
It was then that it started the avalanche-like defeat.
The high quality of these ten thousand was evident.
But even so, in the end, they still lost.
Kebineng, shocked and fearful, knew he couldn’t answer to Kublai.
The ten thousand soldiers he brought were the absolute elite of the Mongolian Army!
These ten thousand elite came to threaten the Shaolin Temple, allowing him to steal the Nine Yang Divine Skill, and he used them to besiege Ding Ling.
Though he obtained the Nine Yang Divine Skill,
the plan to besiege Ding Ling was a complete failure!
Kebineng gritted his teeth, touched the Secret Manual in his arms, then turned without hesitation and ran madly.

He had the Nine Yang Divine Skill and other Secret Manuals, and had hidden many Great Medicines and treasures in some places; as long as he was given time to practice, in the future when the Nine Yang Divine Skill achieves Great Success, even if he can’t beat Ding Ling, he thought he would be more than sufficed to dominate a region!
Leaving a bright future behind?
To fight Ding Ling head-on?
No need.

Kebineng was fast, but Ding Ling was faster. Under the propulsion of Fusion Qi, his figure was like lightning, with the Drumming Golden Hammer before him. As he charged, countless blocking soldiers were knocked flying or killed.
In the end,
whenever anyone saw him running, they quickly rolled to the side, not daring to block Ding Ling’s charge forward.
"Hahaha..."
Ding Ling, with bloodshot eyes, laughed as he charged at Kebineng:
"Kebineng, you won’t escape!"
Kebineng galloped a kilometer on horseback, but seeing Ding Ling getting closer, decisively abandoned the horse and used the Lightweight Body Technique to flee up a mountain!
He ran quickly, like a gust of Xun Wind sweeping the ground.
But Ding Ling was even faster, closing the distance as if through instant teleportation, catching up to Kebineng in just a few breaths.
"Ding Ling, you can’t kill me!"
Seeing escape was hopeless, Kebineng collapsed and shouted desperately:
"I’m the Commander of Ten Thousand under Kublai! If you kill me, Kublai’s grand commander won’t let you off!"
He had suspected before.
If he ran away,
Ding Ling would definitely catch up to him easily.
But he had no idea that Ding Ling, after so many battles, could still maintain such strength, running like a thunderbolt, incomparably fast!
Against such speed,
Kebineng could only lament futilely!
But he couldn’t surrender either; while threatening, he pulled out a Hidden Weapon and fiercely launched it at Ding Ling.
It was the Heavy Rain Pear Blossom Needle!
The exclusive Hidden Weapon of the Three Kingdoms Assassin Organization.

Kebineng could make it too, clearly showing he had spent time in this Assassin Organization and even meticulously studied how to make this Heavy Rain Pear Blossom Needle; otherwise, it couldn’t have reappeared in this Divine Eagle World as such a Divine Weapon Hidden Weapon.
Yet Ding Ling’s armor and the defense of his skin, tough as four to five layers of leather armor?
These hidden weapons did not harm him one bit.
Instead, they only fueled Ding Ling’s rage further; eyes blood-red, he let out an angry roar, boom!
The Drumming Golden Hammer smashed down heavily.
"No!"
Kebineng swung his broadsword instinctively to block with all his might, but how could he withstand it?

Yuchi Gong believed in his talent.

He was hundreds of times better than ordinary people.
With such talent, as long as he practiced diligently, given time, becoming a top expert was foreseeable, yet unexpectedly, he died here so cheaply.
"I hope Qin Qiong and the others can be rational, not to seek revenge for me, not to seek revenge for Li Yuanba!
Otherwise, it’s too dangerous!
Ding Ling is simply a human-shaped beast!
Much scarier than Li Yuanba."
Facing Li Yuanba,
he was still able to retaliate.
Facing Ding Ling, he couldn’t even block a single hammer blow!
Terrifying.
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
Ding Ling charged all the way, targeting Kebineng under the central flag.
The likes of Fat Monk along the way were hammered to death, hammered flying, dying as worthlessly as Yuchi Gong.
Seeing this, some top experts from other worlds were frightened out of their wits, terrified out of their souls!
They no longer wanted to follow Kebineng’s orders and fled in all directions!
Unlike Hai Dafu, who was being blackmailed by Kebineng and had to obey him, they were free, gathered this time only to conspire for the Nine Yang Divine Skill and to kill Ding Ling.
Now Ding Ling was unkillable.
They also hadn’t obtained the Nine Yang Divine Skill.
But their immediate priority was to save their lives; they no longer cared for the coveted Nine Yang Divine Skill.
Each ran like a rabbit pursued by the Death God, fleeing frantically.
In the face of life and death,
the Secret Manuals became trivial!
If there was even a glimmer of hope to defeat Ding Ling,
they wouldn’t have been so cowardly!
Indeed, Ding Ling was too terrifying.
One punch and Mu Renqing was dead, one hammer and Hong Antong was flattened!
Yuchi Gong, a Super-Elite Fierce General, was hammered to death along with his horse!
And these were the top experts among them, dying so easily; if they faced Ding Ling’s Drumming Golden Hammer themselves?
Could they withstand half a move?
Just thinking about it sent shivers down their spines!
Dare they stay any longer?
Each wished they had two more legs to leave this slaughterhouse sooner!
Yes.
In their eyes,
this was a slaughterhouse.
And Ding Ling was a butcher!
Single-handedly, with a female general, they had killed thousands of soldiers, and with divine energy, hammered down one expert after another!
Until now.
His energy not only hadn’t decreased,
but instead, he seemed to become more frenzied the more he killed.
The strength became more terrifying, and his speed increased.
Many of them, because they ran too slowly, were easily caught and hammered down, dying easily.
They were even more frightened, their souls almost leaving their bodies, screaming continuously.
Fortunately, Ding Ling’s main target was Kebineng; they were incidental, so Ding Ling did not pursue them but charged in a straight line, like splitting the sea, toward Kebineng.
"This guy..."
"Has been killing for so long, how does he still have so much strength!"
Kebineng was so scared that his legs cramped.
He overestimated his side’s forces,
completely underestimating Ding Ling’s endurance and combat strength!
"Is this guy possessed now?
The more he kills, the crazier he gets?!"
Kebineng dared not face Ding Ling again.
Because Ding Ling had almost wiped out all the top experts on his side.
The Great Army of ten thousand suffered no less than nine thousand casualties.
The remaining thousand people were also scared, running in panic, regardless of Kebineng’s threats, intimidation, or scolding, to no avail.
Clearly, the morale had completely collapsed.
Ten thousand killed down to one thousand remaining.
It was then that it started the avalanche-like defeat.
The high quality of these ten thousand was evident.
But even so, in the end, they still lost.
Kebineng, shocked and fearful, knew he couldn’t answer to Kublai.
The ten thousand soldiers he brought were the absolute elite of the Mongolian Army!
These ten thousand elite came to threaten the Shaolin Temple, allowing him to steal the Nine Yang Divine Skill, and he used them to besiege Ding Ling.
Though he obtained the Nine Yang Divine Skill,
the plan to besiege Ding Ling was a complete failure!
Kebineng gritted his teeth, touched the Secret Manual in his arms, then turned without hesitation and ran madly.

He had the Nine Yang Divine Skill and other Secret Manuals, and had hidden many Great Medicines and treasures in some places; as long as he was given time to practice, in the future when the Nine Yang Divine Skill achieves Great Success, even if he can’t beat Ding Ling, he thought he would be more than sufficed to dominate a region!
Leaving a bright future behind?
To fight Ding Ling head-on?
No need.
Kebineng was fast, but Ding Ling was faster.
Under the propulsion of Fusion Qi, his figure was like lightning, with the Drumming Golden Hammer before him.
As he charged, countless blocking soldiers were knocked flying or killed.
In the end,
whenever anyone saw him running, they quickly rolled to the side, not daring to block Ding Ling’s charge forward.
"Hahaha..."
Ding Ling, with bloodshot eyes, laughed as he charged at Kebineng:
"Kebineng, you won’t escape!"
Kebineng galloped a kilometer on horseback, but seeing Ding Ling getting closer, decisively abandoned the horse and used the Lightweight Body Technique to flee up a mountain!
He ran quickly, like a gust of Xun Wind sweeping the ground.
But Ding Ling was even faster, closing the distance as if through instant teleportation, catching up to Kebineng in just a few breaths.
"Ding Ling, you can’t kill me!"
Seeing escape was hopeless, Kebineng collapsed and shouted desperately:
"I’m the Commander of Ten Thousand under Kublai!
If you kill me, Kublai’s grand commander won’t let you off!"
He had suspected before.
If he ran away,
Ding Ling would definitely catch up to him easily.
But he had no idea that Ding Ling, after so many battles, could still maintain such strength, running like a thunderbolt, incomparably fast!
Against such speed,
Kebineng could only lament futilely!
But he couldn’t surrender either; while threatening, he pulled out a Hidden Weapon and fiercely launched it at Ding Ling.
It was the Heavy Rain Pear Blossom Needle!
The exclusive Hidden Weapon of the Three Kingdoms Assassin Organization.

Kebineng could make it too, clearly showing he had spent time in this Assassin Organization and even meticulously studied how to make this Heavy Rain Pear Blossom Needle; otherwise, it couldn’t have reappeared in this Divine Eagle World as such a Divine Weapon Hidden Weapon.
Yet Ding Ling’s armor and the defense of his skin, tough as four to five layers of leather armor?
These hidden weapons did not harm him one bit.
Instead, they only fueled Ding Ling’s rage further; eyes blood-red, he let out an angry roar, boom!
The Drumming Golden Hammer smashed down heavily.
"No!"
Kebineng swung his broadsword instinctively to block with all his might, but how could he withstand it?

chapters.title: Chapter 435: The End
paragraphs: Bang!

A hammer as strong as a mountain descended like lightning, shattering the broadsword into three pieces with a crisp snap! In the terrified eyes of Kebineng, the speed of the Drumming Golden Hammer did not slow at all, with a rumbling roar!
Amidst the sound of thunder, it crashed down on his head.
After that, Kebineng knew nothing.
In the fleeting moment of his death.
He knew for sure he was hammered to death, possibly dying in a horrific, pitiful, and lamentable manner!
"If I had known today, why bother back then!"
"If I had quietly cultivated, and not been swayed by the Alien. Not letting hatred blind my mind, nor letting desire shatter my reason,
I would never have come here, nor would I have clashed with Ding Ling so intensely, ultimately leading to my death."
Kebineng was filled with the utmost regret.
He didn’t want to die!
He was the Xianbei War God, nurtured with full support by the Xianbei people!
How could he die so easily like this!
But there are no regrets in life; death is final, with no chance of return.
"I hope the other War Gods of the Xianbei people can be more rational."
Kebineng knew there were other War Gods of the Xianbei who had ascended to the Upper Realm, not just him.
"Ding Ling..."
"This guy is really too fierce. Zuo Ci, you old fox, you’ve ruined me!"
Kebineng’s consciousness gradually sank into the abyss, then completely disappeared.
Self-proclaimed as experienced, wise, brave, and clever as he was,
he died under Ding Ling’s Drumming Golden Hammer just like that.
Boom boom boom!
After killing Kebineng, Ding Ling didn’t stop swinging the Drumming Golden Hammer, smashing it down another dozen times, until Kebineng’s head was completely unrecognizable.
Not until a chilling voice, laden with nine parts worry and one part fear, reached him from afar:
"Ding Ling, Ding Ling..."
Ding Ling felt a cold splash of water over him and instantly came to his senses.
He looked at everything before him, shivering in shock, then quickly began to circulate the Qingnang Scripture and Buddha Qi techniques.
Swoosh swoosh!
Buddha Qi was extraordinary, and as it circulated with the Qingnang Scripture, it rapidly coursed through Ding Ling’s heart and meridians like lightning.
Visible to the naked eye.
Layers of blood-red evil qi were expelled.
In just a moment.
Ding Ling was restored to normal, his rationality returning.

He glanced at the direction of the voice, and saw that Little Dragon Girl, at some point, had dismounted, holding a long spear, her armor stained with blood, standing not far from him, watching him anxiously and worriedly.
He felt a warmth in his heart and quickly said:
"I’m fine. How about you? Are you hurt?"
"Are you really okay?"
Little Dragon Girl was very close to Ding Ling, taking just one step to reach his side. She looked closely at Ding Ling, putting his hand on her face, her cool eyes slightly reddened:
"You really scared me just now."
"I’m sorry."
Ding Ling also broke into a cold sweat.
He deeply understood what Hua Tuo had warned him before.
Hua Tuo had told him.

That his bone structure, and resistance to Evil Qi, was much less than that of Zhao Yun and others, and if he killed too much without caution, the Evil Qi entering his body could cause him to go berserk, leading to disaster.

So after teaching him the Qingnang Scripture, Hua Tuo had specifically advised him to always guard his heart during battle, to avoid being eroded by Evil Qi, which could lead to heart-fire rising and causing mental instability.
During the recent battle, however,
he forgot this principle, thinking that with the protection of Buddha Qi, he could act without scruple.
Now it seemed,
he had overestimated the efficacy of Buddha Qi,
and his own resistance to Evil Qi.
What he faced was Kublai’s elite, a group that spent every day in battle, their bodies steeped in Evil Qi, far surpassing ordinary soldiers!
Those Generals were the Ten Thousand Butchers, their overwhelming Evil Qi and Blood Qi far beyond common imagination.
Killing these people,
would definitely be followed by their residual Evil Qi overwhelming and eroding, if one does not tightly guard the heart, it’s normal for the Evil Qi to enter the body.
In the Three Kingdoms World,
the Evil Qi of the soldiers he killed was mostly far less than that of these elite warriors, plus he always kept his heart guarded, thus avoiding demonic influence.
But just now,
he nearly fell into demonic influence.
After being woken by Little Dragon Girl, he was alerted, pondering silently:

"It seems that when engaging in great battles like those with Mongolian Army elites, I must allocate a part of my heart and spirit, to constantly activate and circulate Buddha Qi and Qingnang Scripture."
In ordinary large-scale battles, this is unnecessary.
But the elite soldiers he just killed, each with such formidable Evil Qi, were not to be underestimated.
What keen eyesight Ding Ling had?
He naturally knew these people were the elite of the elite.
But since Yuchi Gong was hammered to death by him, how could mere elites withstand his Drumming Golden Hammer? To say they were made of paper was no exaggeration.
However, fortunately, it was over.
But still...
Ding Ling sighed softly.
Originally, he wanted to capture Kebineng alive, to find out how he was being plotted against. Although he knew some of the players’ strategies through hacking techniques,
he was still unclear about the specifics.
But he also knew.
He must have underestimated Kebineng and the players’ methods, having thought of them too simply.
From the series of strategic moves,
one could see Kebineng’s cunning.
Even a Beidou like the Shaolin Temple was destroyed by his calculations with a single fire.
Such a cunning old fox was best eliminated; otherwise, lurking behind every corner plotting against him, Ding Ling would find it hard to sleep in peace.
"Don’t say sorry to me."
Little Dragon Girl’s apricot eyes glimmered like autumn waters, staring fixedly at Ding Ling:
"As long as you’re alright."
With that said,
her elegant brows trembled, her body swayed, and she nearly fainted to the ground.
Ding Ling quickly caught her:
"Little Dragon Girl, you..."
"I’m okay."
Afraid of Ding Ling worrying about her, she quickly said:
"Just exhausted, the moment I relaxed, I realized my legs were already weak and couldn’t support myself."
"As long as you’re fine. Let me channel some True Qi to you, sit down."
"No need. You haven’t recovered yet."
"Sit down."
Ding Ling, without allowing her refusal, sat her down, circulating the Healing Chapter of the Nine Yin Scripture, channeling rolling ’Healing True Qi’ into Little Dragon Girl’s meridians.
Visible to the naked eye.
Little Dragon Girl’s complexion improved.
After a while.
Little Dragon Girl regained some strength, hurriedly saying:
"Ding Ling, Ding Ling, okay. I’m better now."

Seeing this, Ding Ling didn’t insist, collecting his energy and standing. His stamina, endurance, and capacity to endure were truly remarkable, not to mention fighting for half a day, even after days and nights of battle, was no problem.
Therefore, except for consuming some True Qi, the rest of him was no different from his peak state at the start.

chapters.title: Chapter 436: Nine Yang Divine Skill
paragraphs: The Drumming Golden Hammer in his hand still felt as light as a feather, as if it had no weight.
"What a pity for the Nine Yang Divine Skill..."
Ding Ling sighed deeply.
Those players are as sly as foxes.

After realizing Ding Ling’s ferocity was too difficult to resist, most had already logged off, and Ding Ling’s Drumming Golden Hammer seemed to have only crushed a group of new players hiding in the great army, attempting to ambush him.
The other old players proficient in stealth tactics appeared to have fled far away from him.
In reaction, Ding Ling could only come up with other strategies.
Meeting them again in the future, it wouldn’t be too late to slaughter them then.
These players who can log on and off anytime aren’t worth his concern.
This time, gathering Kebineng and others, he easily hammered them down.
For some players with low martial power, he could easily kill them with a pinch; there was no need to be overly concerned.
However, this group of players targeting him was irritating beyond measure.
Ding Ling could only strive to enhance his strength, and when strong enough, he would head to the real world to directly overturn these people’s families.
Currently, he hadn’t reached an invincible level.
If he acted recklessly,
it might provoke missiles and other super weapons to attack in a region-covering manner, which he couldn’t withstand.
Don’t doubt these people’s madness!
If their family’s safety were truly threatened,
they would surely stop at nothing, employing cover attacks, suppression, and attempts to kill Ding Ling.
Ding Ling didn’t want to gamble.
He needed a crushing, flawless victory!
"Until I have absolute strength, I need to remain steady. Stay guarded!"
Ding Ling’s goal was to lead Little Dragon Girl, Diao Chan, and others to eternal life.
To be invincible in the world.
He had a cheat that automatically maxed his Divine Skill level, allowing him to grow incredibly fast, and as long as he remained stable, the future would be his to dictate.
"Oh!"

After resting well, Little Dragon Girl unintentionally glanced and noticed a corner of a Secret Manual among Kebineng’s remains. She stepped forward, bent slightly, reached out her delicate hand, pinched the corner, and pulled it out forcefully.
Rustle!
A torn bag was pulled out.
Several Secret Manuals fell to the ground along with it.
Little Dragon Girl looked at the Secret Manual in her hand, with several extremely prominent big characters written on it:
Nine Yang Divine Skill
"Is this the Nine Yang Divine Skill?!"
Little Dragon Girl’s almond eyes widened slightly, hurriedly handing the Secret Manual to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was also taken aback.
Was this a silver lining?
Little Dragon Girl’s actions reminded him.
These people had recently come from Shaolin Temple to steal the scriptures; perhaps some among them might have some Secret Manuals hidden in their pockets.
Immediately, Ding Ling placed these Secret Manuals into his Storage Pouch, lifting the Drumming Golden Hammer, preparing to search further below.
This was war booty.
Not to be wasted.
Little Dragon Girl followed closely behind.
Helping Ding Ling to clean the battlefield.
She also killed many people.
Yet there was no abnormality; it was imaginable that she must be a top genius like Zhao Yun, extremely strong in resistance to Evil Qi!
A born Martial God! War God!
Such people can maintain rationality despite killing many; at most, they would have a thicker aura of Evil Qi, which couldn’t affect her in the slightest.
Ding Ling secretly envied.
But since Little Dragon Girl was on his side, it was a comfort.
He didn’t know if root bones were related to the erosion of Evil Qi.
If it were, he must work hard to enhance his root bones.

However, the effectiveness of Buddha Qi is also very strong; as long as Ding Ling continuously operates it, he didn’t need to worry about being eroded. He felt the need to increase Buddha Qi within his body, which would prevent any worries about Evil Qi erosion in future battles, no matter how many there were.
Walking all the way.
Ding Ling found most people crushed and shattered.
Don’t even mention Secret Manuals.
Many weapons were smashed into several pieces!

The discovery of Nine Yang Divine Skill was due to Ding Ling smashing straight down on Kebineng, not covering his entire body; otherwise, the probability of obtaining Nine Yang Divine Skill would have been low.
After a quick glance around, Ding Ling casually picked a few seemingly good Divine Weapons.
Like Yuchi Gong’s Divine Whip.
Hai Dafu’s dagger, among others.
These are top-quality Divine Blades that colliding with Ding Ling’s Drumming Golden Hammer remained unscathed, clearly top-tier Divine Weapons, naturally not to be missed by Ding Ling.
"Ding Ling."
Little Dragon Girl ’picked up’ two more Secret Manuals.
She handed them to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling took them and turned the pages.
"Primordial Skill"
"Primordial Palm"
Ding Ling looked at Little Dragon Girl.
Little Dragon Girl then spoke:
"They were found on the person named Mu Renqing."
Among this group of top experts, Mu Renqing seemed the only one with a completely preserved body.
Like Hong Antong, Hai Dafu, and others, without exception, all died horribly.
Don’t even mention Secret Manuals.
Finding a complete head would be difficult.
Ding Ling gave up.
Having obtained several Divine Weapons and some Secret Manuals was enough to leave.
Besides.
Little Dragon Girl’s first battlefield experience, although exceptionally adaptable, had also exhausted her strength, requiring a period of recuperation.
Ding Ling saw Little Dragon Girl’s unease.
She seemed to be enduring some discomfort.
Clearly.
The impact of this bloody battlefield on her was extremely strong.
Fortunately, along the way.
She had witnessed many similar scenes.
If she suddenly encountered such a hellish scenario, it was very likely that she would vomit directly.
Ding Ling understood.
Even a born Martial God would struggle when first witnessing such scenes, needing some time to recover.
Little Dragon Girl could hold on, helping him search for Secret Manuals and Divine Weapons, was already incredible and defying all expectations.
Ding Ling let out a long whistle.
Neigh!
The Ferghana Horse arrived upon hearing the sound.
Ding Ling jumped onto its back.
He rode away, on the way noticed Kebineng’s mount; it turned out to be another Ferghana Horse, so he switched mounts, intending to tame this horse, making it convenient for usage in other worlds.
Of course, the high-grade warhorses on this battlefield were indeed numerous.
To waste them like this would be a pity.
Ding Ling then used full-level Equestrian and Horse Selection skills to select over a dozen top warhorses, preparing to take them south to Xiangyang.
In Xiangyang was Guo Jing.
Guo Jing had the complete Nine Yin Scripture and Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms.
In Huang Rong’s hands was the Dog Beating Stick Technique.
Ding Ling wanted to see if he could learn these skills from them.
Learning them would be best.
If not, it didn’t matter.
Xiangyang, he would go sooner or later.
After all, outside Xiangyang City, there was the Divine Eagle and the tomb of Dugu Qiubai.
It’s just that there were too many players.
Ding Ling estimated that this tomb might have already been discovered and excavated by players.
Ding Ling hadn’t gone to investigate.

His residence was far in the mountains; each time he logged on and off, it was required to investigate certain matters, sprinting towards nearby towns and such to connect to the internet, utilizing hacker skills to investigate.
If there was no urgent matter needing clarification, he would simply log on and off to have a meal and trade power.
As his strength continued to rise,
his physique became increasingly remarkable!
Nowadays, even days without food were of no consequence in the real world of himself.
However, Ding Ling would still choose to log off to feast every day or every other day.
Clatter!
Ding Ling rode away.
Little Dragon Girl followed closely behind.
Arriving at a relatively secluded place.
Ding Ling stopped, intending to rest a bit here.
Little Dragon Girl busied herself with boiling water, grilling, and other tasks.
Having done these things many times before, she was quite proficient now.
Ding Ling observed, feeling a slight warmth on his face, then ceased further thoughts, taking out the Nine Yang Divine Skill to read.
The cover of this Nine Yang Divine Skill was brand new, clearly newly revised.
