it might provoke missiles and other super weapons to attack in a region-covering manner, which he couldn’t withstand.
Don’t doubt these people’s madness!
If their family’s safety were truly threatened,
they would surely stop at nothing, employing cover attacks, suppression, and attempts to kill Ding Ling.
Ding Ling didn’t want to gamble.
He needed a crushing, flawless victory!
"Until I have absolute strength, I need to remain steady.
Stay guarded!"
Ding Ling’s goal was to lead Little Dragon Girl, Diao Chan, and others to eternal life.
To be invincible in the world.
He had a cheat that automatically maxed his Divine Skill level, allowing him to grow incredibly fast, and as long as he remained stable, the future would be his to dictate.
"Oh!"
After resting well, Little Dragon Girl unintentionally glanced and noticed a corner of a Secret Manual among Kebineng’s remains.
She stepped forward, bent slightly, reached out her delicate hand, pinched the corner, and pulled it out forcefully.
Rustle!
A torn bag was pulled out.
Several Secret Manuals fell to the ground along with it.
Little Dragon Girl looked at the Secret Manual in her hand, with several extremely prominent big characters written on it:
Nine Yang Divine Skill
"Is this the Nine Yang Divine Skill?!"
Little Dragon Girl’s almond eyes widened slightly, hurriedly handing the Secret Manual to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was also taken aback.
Was this a silver lining?
Little Dragon Girl’s actions reminded him.
These people had recently come from Shaolin Temple to steal the scriptures; perhaps some among them might have some Secret Manuals hidden in their pockets.
Immediately, Ding Ling placed these Secret Manuals into his Storage Pouch, lifting the Drumming Golden Hammer, preparing to search further below.
This was war booty.
Not to be wasted.
Little Dragon Girl followed closely behind.
Helping Ding Ling to clean the battlefield.
She also killed many people.
Yet there was no abnormality; it was imaginable that she must be a top genius like Zhao Yun, extremely strong in resistance to Evil Qi!
A born Martial God!
War God!
Such people can maintain rationality despite killing many; at most, they would have a thicker aura of Evil Qi, which couldn’t affect her in the slightest.
Ding Ling secretly envied.
But since Little Dragon Girl was on his side, it was a comfort.
He didn’t know if root bones were related to the erosion of Evil Qi.
If it were, he must work hard to enhance his root bones.
However, the effectiveness of Buddha Qi is also very strong; as long as Ding Ling continuously operates it, he didn’t need to worry about being eroded.
He felt the need to increase Buddha Qi within his body, which would prevent any worries about Evil Qi erosion in future battles, no matter how many there were.
Walking all the way.
Ding Ling found most people crushed and shattered.
Don’t even mention Secret Manuals.
Many weapons were smashed into several pieces!

The discovery of Nine Yang Divine Skill was due to Ding Ling smashing straight down on Kebineng, not covering his entire body; otherwise, the probability of obtaining Nine Yang Divine Skill would have been low.
After a quick glance around, Ding Ling casually picked a few seemingly good Divine Weapons.
Like Yuchi Gong’s Divine Whip.
Hai Dafu’s dagger, among others.
These are top-quality Divine Blades that colliding with Ding Ling’s Drumming Golden Hammer remained unscathed, clearly top-tier Divine Weapons, naturally not to be missed by Ding Ling.
"Ding Ling."
Little Dragon Girl ’picked up’ two more Secret Manuals.
She handed them to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling took them and turned the pages.
"Primordial Skill"
"Primordial Palm"
Ding Ling looked at Little Dragon Girl.
Little Dragon Girl then spoke:
"They were found on the person named Mu Renqing."
Among this group of top experts, Mu Renqing seemed the only one with a completely preserved body.
Like Hong Antong, Hai Dafu, and others, without exception, all died horribly.
Don’t even mention Secret Manuals.
Finding a complete head would be difficult.
Ding Ling gave up.
Having obtained several Divine Weapons and some Secret Manuals was enough to leave.
Besides.
Little Dragon Girl’s first battlefield experience, although exceptionally adaptable, had also exhausted her strength, requiring a period of recuperation.
Ding Ling saw Little Dragon Girl’s unease.
She seemed to be enduring some discomfort.
Clearly.
The impact of this bloody battlefield on her was extremely strong.
Fortunately, along the way.
She had witnessed many similar scenes.
If she suddenly encountered such a hellish scenario, it was very likely that she would vomit directly.
Ding Ling understood.
Even a born Martial God would struggle when first witnessing such scenes, needing some time to recover.
Little Dragon Girl could hold on, helping him search for Secret Manuals and Divine Weapons, was already incredible and defying all expectations.
Ding Ling let out a long whistle.
Neigh!
The Ferghana Horse arrived upon hearing the sound.
Ding Ling jumped onto its back.
He rode away, on the way noticed Kebineng’s mount; it turned out to be another Ferghana Horse, so he switched mounts, intending to tame this horse, making it convenient for usage in other worlds.
Of course, the high-grade warhorses on this battlefield were indeed numerous.
To waste them like this would be a pity.
Ding Ling then used full-level Equestrian and Horse Selection skills to select over a dozen top warhorses, preparing to take them south to Xiangyang.
In Xiangyang was Guo Jing.
Guo Jing had the complete Nine Yin Scripture and Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms.
In Huang Rong’s hands was the Dog Beating Stick Technique.
Ding Ling wanted to see if he could learn these skills from them.
Learning them would be best.
If not, it didn’t matter.
Xiangyang, he would go sooner or later.
After all, outside Xiangyang City, there was the Divine Eagle and the tomb of Dugu Qiubai.
It’s just that there were too many players.
Ding Ling estimated that this tomb might have already been discovered and excavated by players.
Ding Ling hadn’t gone to investigate.

His residence was far in the mountains; each time he logged on and off, it was required to investigate certain matters, sprinting towards nearby towns and such to connect to the internet, utilizing hacker skills to investigate.
If there was no urgent matter needing clarification, he would simply log on and off to have a meal and trade power.
As his strength continued to rise,
his physique became increasingly remarkable!
Nowadays, even days without food were of no consequence in the real world of himself.
However, Ding Ling would still choose to log off to feast every day or every other day.
Clatter!
Ding Ling rode away.
Little Dragon Girl followed closely behind.
Arriving at a relatively secluded place.
Ding Ling stopped, intending to rest a bit here.
Little Dragon Girl busied herself with boiling water, grilling, and other tasks.
Having done these things many times before, she was quite proficient now.
Ding Ling observed, feeling a slight warmth on his face, then ceased further thoughts, taking out the Nine Yang Divine Skill to read.
The cover of this Nine Yang Divine Skill was brand new, clearly newly revised.

chapters.title: Chapter 437: Nine Yang True Water! Primordial Skill Full Level
paragraphs: The "Lengjia Scripture" was found among a pile of scriptures that Ding Ling had previously acquired and had already read.
It did not contain the martial arts content of the Nine Yang Divine Skill.
Evidently, after the monks of the Shaolin Temple learned all the secrets, they stripped this top divine skill from the Lengjia Scripture, compiled it into a volume, and revised it anew.
However, it later fell into Kebineng’s hands.
And now, it has fallen into Ding Ling’s hands.
Ding Ling looked at the Nine Yang Divine Skill, flipping through it while thinking to himself:
"I originally thought the Nine Yang Divine Skill had fallen into the hands of players. But now it seems, I overestimated them and underestimated Kebineng’s abilities.
But in retrospect, it makes sense.
Ancient wisdom is not much weaker than that of modern people.
Some ancient people with extremely high intelligence can even surpass most modern people in all aspects of wisdom. Modern people want to exploit these ancients.
Yet, they might not realize that they themselves could be exploited by the ancients.
Look at this plan to burn the Shaolin Temple, steal the true scripture, and conspire to kill me.
It must have been led by Kebineng.
The players only played a crucial role in it.
If not, how could the Nine Yang Divine Skill fall into Kebineng’s hands?
If the players led, then the Nine Yang Divine Skill would have inevitably ended up in their hands. Conversely, it’s the same."
After Ding Ling figured it out,
he also secretly warned himself.
As batches of experts ascend,
with players meddling in between, this Divine Eagle World is bound to become unrecognizable!
"I don’t even know their exact plans?"
Ding Ling had previously speculated about the players’ plans.
And the result?
Not to say completely wrong, but largely unrelated, or perhaps only slightly related.
As a result, Ding Ling gave it up.

He was more suited to sweeping over enemies, playing intrigue and deception was not his strength compared to these old foxes. As long as his strength was strong enough, he could crush through, why care about any plot or scheme!
Dare to come!
He dares to kill!
Whoosh, whoosh!
Ding Ling read through the Nine Yang Divine Skill quickly at ten lines at a glance.
[Nine Yang Divine Skill Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
Whoosh!
A surging wave of primordial qi rushed from all directions, overwhelming Ding Ling in an instant.
Ding Ling activated his true skill, rapidly absorbing and refining the primordial qi.
However, it was futile.
The primordial qi, once entering his body, automatically condensed into a scorching hot Nine Yang True Qi!
This Nine Yang True Qi was extremely overbearing and unrivaled!
The condensed True Qi was about to devour the seven drops of Pure Yang True Water with a thunderous roar!
The Pure Yang True Water, being extremely gentle, though it struggled,
stood no chance against the devouring Nine Yang True Qi.
In a moment, a drop of True Water was consumed by the Nine Yang True Qi.
The original Nine Yang True Qi instantaneously transformed into a drop of Nine Yang True Water!
After transforming into True Water,
it became even more ferocious and domineering to the utmost.
The remaining six drops of True Water were devoured by the Nine Yang True Water in no time.
The seven drops of Pure Yang True Water in the dantian were thus converted into seven drops of Nine Yang True Water.
Ding Ling slightly operated the Nine Yang Divine Skill and felt the speed of generating True Qi was incredibly fast!
The previous battle,
had consumed a lot of True Qi.
Recovering it would require considerable time.
But with the operation of the Nine Yang Divine Skill, the primordial qi from all directions poured in, fully restoring him to his original state in an instant.
Ding Ling was secretly amazed, exclaiming:
"Indeed, this is a top-tier marvelous skill! So powerful!"

"In the future, if engaged in combat, slightly operating the Nine Yang Divine Skill to automatically condense, absorb, and refine primordial qi, does it not mean that my combat power in terms of inner strength is explosively strong?!"
Ding Ling was moved.
Of course, he also knew that this was deeply related to his full level Nine Yang Divine Skill.
If an ordinary person practiced this Nine Yang Divine Skill, it would be impossible to reach Ding Ling’s level.

Moreover, due to Ding Ling’s prior accumulation and profound foundation, the conversion of seven drops of Pure Yang True Water into Nine Yang True Water enabled the Nine Yang True Water to leap over the thresholds of third-class, second-class, and first-class, directly stepping into the Innate Realm, paving a long path within the innate realm!
An Nine Yang Divine Skill at this level is naturally even more domineering, unrivaled, and terrifying!
"Excellent."
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
His inner power endurance was maximized, and his body’s durability was indisputable.
This combination of inner and outer strength,
coupled with the Breathing Technique to enhance the explosive effects by five or tenfold,
Ding Ling was full of confidence, now even if facing a great army of a hundred thousand, he has the ability to crush them all! Crush them to death!
Now,
he was not someone that could be easily resolved or killed by ordinary manpower.
"Whoosh whoosh!"
Ding Ling took a long breath and carefully observed the Nine Yang Divine Skill.
He discovered that not only was the speed of generating True Qi fast beyond comparison!
It almost seemed endless, inexhaustible!
Furthermore, it could automatically generate a protective True Qi layer.
This protective True Qi layer was very thin, adhered to Ding Ling’s skin, running uninterrupted with the operation of the Nine Yang Divine Skill at all times!
This protective layer constantly manifested without disappearing!
Ding Ling took out a short knife he obtained from Hai Dafu and pierced the protective layer; indeed, it was extremely resilient! Comparable to the defense of several layers of leather armor!

"Too strong. My own defense compares to four or five layers of leather armor, adding this protective True Qi layer of the Nine Yang Divine Skill, my skin surface now seems to stack nearly ten layers of leather armor!
So thick.
Who can break my defense?!"
Ding Ling’s sense of security soared!
With these ’thick armors’ protecting the body, he could roam the battlefield without wearing armor, and no one could stop him!
"Not just that.
Ding Ling slightly used some True Qi to strike this protective layer and found it could even automatically counterattack!
Ding Ling continuously experimented.
Ultimately finding out that any attack below the first-class peak level expert could automatically reflect damage!
"Is this the power of full-level Nine Yang Divine Skill?"
Ding Ling recalled that Zhang Wuji in Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber didn’t seem so strong, as Miejue was able to easily injure him despite his Nine Yang Divine Skill protection!
Miejue cannot possibly be an Innate Expert, right?
In that case, there’s only one possibility.
"Zhang Wuji’s Nine Yang Divine Skill wasn’t at full level!"
"Moreover, Zhang Wuji’s Nine Yang Divine Skill likely didn’t condense as much Nine Yang True Water as mine."
Whether a divine skill is strong or not.
Besides quality, it also relates to quantity.
The stronger the quality and the higher the quantity, the more remarkable this divine skill becomes.
"Not only that, it seems the Nine Yang Divine Skill also grants immunity to a hundred poisons, can automatically heal, and can counter cold-attributed inner power True Qi..."
Ding Ling intently comprehended, feeling very satisfied.
With this Nine Yang Divine Skill protecting him.
Roaming the world is within reach.
After finishing the Nine Yang Divine Skill, Ding Ling began to flip through the Primordial Skill.
A moment later, he was done.
[Primordial Skill Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +90]
[Strength +0.4]
[Agility +0.4]
[Constitution +0.4]
Whoosh whoosh!
Primordial qi swarmed in, entered the dantian, and was easily refined and absorbed by the Nine Yang Divine Skill for own use.
Not only that.
With the Primordial Skill at full level,
Ding Ling’s physical fitness in all aspects was also rapidly soaring!
Ding Ling was secretly amazed.
It turned out that the Primordial Skill was a divine skill cultivating both internally and externally.
It took a long time to not say, it also showed results slowly, but once successfully cultivated, its power would be immense, invincible, and absolutely destructive.
Moreover, physical fitness would far surpass that of ordinary people.
It can be said that this martial art is no less than some top inner power heart techniques.
Very remarkable.
It’s just that ordinary people definitely lack the patience to cultivate it.
Ding Ling continued to read the next one.
Soon.
[Primordial Palm Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]

chapters.title: Chapter 438: The Breath of Everyday Life
paragraphs: This palm technique is also extremely formidable. When combined with the Vigorous Qi of the Primordial Skill, they complement each other and double the power!

Now that Ding Ling has reached Full Level in Primordial Skill, although only a trace of Vigorous Qi remains in his body’s meridians, the Nine Yang Divine Skill can still unleash the unrivaled power of the Primordial Palm.
Ding Ling casually flipped his hand, unleashing a palm force of Primordial Ruyi, smack! It struck a large tree beside him, imprinting a one-inch deep mark on it.
And this was without Ding Ling using full force.
If he were to use full force, one palm would probably break the tree.
"Not bad."
Ding Ling was quite satisfied.
This Primordial Palm is also a High Tier palm technique.
With the Nine Yang Divine Skill powering it, it becomes indestructible, naturally beyond question.
Not just the Primordial Palm.

The Great Demon Subduing Fist, Nine Yin Divine Claw, Heart-Pushing Palm, Great Yin Yang Hand Seal, Tai Chi Fist, and other fist and palm techniques, when powered by the Nine Yang Divine Skill, are ferocious in power, far surpassing the previous use with Pure Yang True Skill.
Various moves were demonstrated.
With just two-tenths of force used, the void occasionally stirred with ripples.
Beside him, Little Dragon Girl watched with amazement and joy.
The stronger Ding Ling was, the happier she became, because if Ding Ling was strong, he wouldn’t get hurt. As long as Ding Ling was safe and sound, she felt at ease.
"Here."
Little Dragon Girl handed Ding Ling a cup of water.
Because the Storage Pouch can be used as long as there is Inner Power.
Little Dragon Girl can naturally use it too.
She used the water bottle from the Storage Pouch to scoop water.
After boiling the water, she took out the cup from the Storage Pouch and poured Ding Ling a drink, taking care of him meticulously.
As for barbecue?
There were quite a few horses killed on the battlefield, and they directly cut off several horse legs to bring along, so the two ate the grilled horse legs.
After eating and drinking to their fill.
With nothing to do, Ding Ling continued to teach Little Dragon Girl the Breathing Technique, guiding her to a stronger path.

As long as Little Dragon Girl mastered the Full Level of External Refining Breathing Technique, then practiced the Inner Refining Breathing Technique, integrating both, she could embark on the strongest path of body refining without any issues.
Because the potential of this Breathing Technique is endless.
It seems it can be used indefinitely.
Ding Ling naturally didn’t want Little Dragon Girl to miss out; if she were to learn, she should learn the best of External Refining Breathing Technique and Inner Refining Breathing Technique!
With Ding Ling’s high-level, insightful explanations.
Given time, Little Dragon Girl would surely reach the pinnacle path of the Martial God.
That day.
Little Dragon Girl and Ding Ling traveled south and arrived at an ancient and desolate mountain path.
It was deserted here.
But the two had been traveling for so long.
They had to rest here for a while.
Ding Ling, holding a bow and arrow, went hunting in the mountains.
Little Dragon Girl stayed behind, watching the warhorse, boiling water, lighting a campfire, and setting up some bowls and chopsticks, waiting for Ding Ling to return.
Throughout the journey.
The two have been cooperating like this.
Ding Ling’s bow is a Treasure Bow.
The arrows were collected from the battlefield, where Little Dragon Girl picked up dozens of quivers and stored them in the Storage Pouch.
With so many arrows.
Ding Ling had no need to go into town to buy them specially.
He used the bow and arrows for hunting.
Ding Ling, using the Nine Yang Divine Skill, performed the Tornado Arrow Skill and Double Extreme Arrow Skill, often easily shooting down high-flying geese and deer in the forest.
He has a huge appetite.
Lately, Little Dragon Girl’s practice of the Breathing Technique has also greatly increased her appetite.
Therefore, Ding Ling hunted and killed two wild boars and one deer before carrying them back.
Then Little Dragon Girl, by the stream, began skinning and other tasks.
She still had an ethereal, fairy-like appearance that avoided mundane occupations.

But now, she was engaged in worldly tasks full of smoke and fire. At this moment, with the rising sun, the slightly drunken rays of sunlight shone on her face and body, making her look more radiant and ethereal, like a fairy or saint.
Set against the backdrop of clear streams and green mountains behind her, she truly seemed like a figure who had walked out from a painting.
Just watching her was a kind of earthly enjoyment.
In his previous and current life, Ding Ling had never, apart from Diao Chan, seen someone as beautiful and lovely.
Even after seeing her many times, Ding Ling still felt he couldn’t get enough of looking at her.
Graceful and refined.
Like jade or flowers.
Incomparably beautiful.
These words were still inadequate to describe even a tenth of her beauty.
Perhaps only terms like ’Chang’e in the Moon’, which never grows old, could begin to capture a fraction of her allure.
"What are you looking at?"
Little Dragon Girl, sensing something, tilted her head, her almond eyes glancing at Ding Ling like autumn waters, and said:
"Watching me?"
"Yes. Watching you."
Ding Ling knew Little Dragon Girl’s nature. She wouldn’t lie, always spoke her mind, and had no hidden motives—what you see is what you get. This description fit her perfectly.
But her heart was also delicate and lacked a sense of security. This was perhaps deeply influenced by her master’s traits of ’humility’, ’caution’, ’modesty’, and ’gentle tolerance’.
Knowing her character, Ding Ling naturally knew how to interact with her.
He would never let her misunderstand or harbor any grievances.
Facing each other, the two were as honest as rock, leading to a harmonious, relaxed, and sweet way of interacting from the beginning.
Little Dragon Girl’s feelings for Ding Ling grew deeper with time, and she actively did many things.
She even did not mind holding hands or embracing him.
"Do you like watching me?"
Little Dragon Girl’s heart was filled with joy, her face beaming with a smile.
"Of course."
"If you like to watch, you can watch more."
Little Dragon Girl smiled with delight:
"I can show you every day."
"Hmm."
Ding Ling nodded with a smile.
After Little Dragon Girl cleaned the wild boar and deer thoroughly,
Ding Ling took over and began to prepare by taking out a cutting board, bamboo basket, and kitchen knife, starting to cook.
With over a dozen strong horses and storage pouches,
there was no need to worry about not having a place to store things.
Ding Ling naturally bought to his heart’s content.
These things were purchased earlier in a small town.
With money, there was no concern about not being able to buy things.
Ding Ling’s culinary skills were exceptional.
After Little Dragon Girl tasted it once, she couldn’t forget it, and every time she ate, she was full of praise.

he then started to heat the pot and fry oil.

Just as he finished preparing a dish,
clip clop clip clop!

Primordial Palm!
A surge of vigorous Qi instantly burst forth, and the swirling dust all reversed direction, showering the riders’ heads and faces with debris.
They reacted, their faces changing in color.
The leader, with a ferocious and malicious look, glared harshly at Ding Ling, but he seemed to be in a hurry and had no intent to confront Ding Ling, merely snorting and saying:
"We have no time to deal with you today. If there’s a next time, we’ll definitely settle the score with you!"
After speaking,
the group of riders immediately spurred their horses and left swiftly.
Ding Ling touched the hilt of the sword at his waist, thought for a moment, and decided against taking action.
There’s no need to spill blood during mealtime, or it might affect the meal later.
Moreover,
those people had already left.
If there was a next encounter, and they remained this aggressive, Ding Ling wouldn’t mind letting them taste some blood.
"This place is so remote, yet people still come by."
Ding Ling was also surprised but didn’t think much of it, instead continuing to cook.
His inner power was highly advanced, and his physical strength was exceptional, making his stir-frying speed dizzyingly fast!
Combined with his Kitchen God’s skills,
his cooking speed was incredibly quick.
Not long after,
a dozen or so dishes were ready.
Meanwhile,
he was also grilling meat on the side.

This time, it was roasted deer leg. Under his special skills, the sizzling of the deer leg accompanied by the dripping oil quickly released a tantalizing aroma that spread in all directions, making anyone who smelled it react noticeably.
Little Dragon Girl couldn’t help but feel her mouth water, watching Ding Ling expectantly, patting her stomach and softly saying:
"Ding Ling, I’m hungry."
Eating the dishes prepared by Ding Ling,
Little Dragon Girl felt that her own cooking was unpalatable.
She now felt very happy every day.
Being able to be with Ding Ling and eat such delicious food, nothing in life could be more delightful.
"You start eating."
Ding Ling said:
"I’m almost done."
"We’ll eat together later."
Little Dragon Girl set the tableware, sat beside, resting her chin on her knees, watching Ding Ling intently, her face full of appreciation and enchantment.
Obviously,
watching Ding Ling cook,
was also a kind of enjoyment for Little Dragon Girl.

Ding Ling said:
"It’s ready."
Little Dragon Girl immediately picked some food for Ding Ling:
"You eat more."
"You too."
After Ding Ling sat down, he also served some food to Little Dragon Girl.
Little Dragon Girl was overjoyed, eating happily.
As the two of them were engrossed in their meal, an unexpected voice suddenly rang out.
"Oh my, oh my, what a wonderful aroma, such a wonderful aroma. I’ve never smelled such a fragrant meat aroma in my whole life," said an old beggar.

Because the potential of this Breathing Technique is endless.
It seems it can be used indefinitely.

chapters.title: Chapter 439: Nine-fingered Divine Beggar Hong Qigong
paragraphs: The voice was a moment away in the distance.
The next second, it seemed to be right beside him.
Ding Ling looked toward the sound and saw an elderly man not far away on the ancient mountain path, his face glowing, his eyes fixed brightly on the roasted deer leg and dishes Ding Ling had made.
He kept shouting, ’So fragrant, so aromatic!’
He walked very quickly.
Close enough.
Seeing more clearly now.
He had a long square face, a short beard beneath his chin, large coarse hands and feet, and his clothes were covered in patches but very neat, without a speck of dirt.
He held a green jade-like staff in his hand and carried a large vermilion lacquered gourd on his back.
Full of righteous qi.
Clearly someone extraordinary.
Especially when Ding Ling noticed he only had nine fingers, his heart couldn’t help but skip a beat, and a name suddenly surfaced in his mind: ’Nine-fingered Divine Beggar Hong Qigong!’
’Could this be the Northern Beggar, one of the Five Extremes in the world?’
Ding Ling glanced at the old man casually and stopped looking.
This man was extraordinary in demeanor, had nine fingers, and held an extraordinary bamboo staff; if Ding Ling couldn’t guess who he was, then he wouldn’t be a true player.
"Young man."
The old man came up to Ding Ling, although he was speaking to Ding Ling, his eyes were glued to the deer leg and dishes, obviously captivated by the food in his eyes, his heart:
"Could you let this old beggar taste this delicious food?!"
After speaking, he finally looked at Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl, saying eagerly:
"Just a little bit."
"Ding Ling."
Being stared at by the old man, Little Dragon Girl blushed slightly, a bit embarrassed as she said:
"Why not give him some? We’ve made so much."
After suggesting that, feeling it might not be appropriate, she added: "I can eat a little less later."
She was inherently kind.
Always considerate of Ding Ling.
Naturally, Ding Ling couldn’t criticize her over a few dishes and besides, if it were Hong Qigong, he planned to use these dishes to tempt him.
Find a way for him to pass on his supreme skill.
Thinking this way, Ding Ling nodded, took out a short knife, cut a big piece of deer leg, picked up a plate of stir-fried pork, and gave the old man a pair of chopsticks, saying:
"Here."
"Generous!"
The old man was stunned for a moment, then gave Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl a thumbs-up:
"You both are truly kind to let an old beggar eat such delicious food."
Ding Ling smiled without speaking.
Little Dragon Girl also smiled and said nothing.
Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl continued to eat.
The old man mimicked them, sitting cross-legged on the grass; he began with some pork, and as he ate, he found it a refreshing taste with endless aftertaste.
Unable to resist quickly picking up food to eat.
The more he ate, the lingering fragrance intensified, mouth-watering!
Toward the end, he couldn’t stop his chopsticks, eating rapidly, almost swallowing his tongue.
"Delicious, delicious."
Finishing the pork, eating the deer leg with excitement, nearly moved to tears:
"Too good. This old beggar feels as if he’s wasted the first half of his life!"
He’s a gourmet.
Like a traveler, seeing the most beautiful scenery in the world, emotional tears welled up in his eyes.
Just as emotional now.
Purely unable to suppress his surging, excited emotions within.
"Why didn’t I meet you two young people earlier? If I had encountered you sooner, my life wouldn’t have been so empty."
He sighed, his eyes still fixed on Ding Ling’s other dishes.
Little Dragon Girl was taken aback.
Ding Ling, however, handed him another bowl of food and cut another big piece of deer leg.
"How could I accept this?!"
The old man blushed slightly, said so, but truly couldn’t resist in front of such fine food;
"Young man, then I won’t stand on ceremony."
Before his words fallen.
He already started eating again, speaking unclearly as he ate:
"Perfect in color and taste, rich but not greasy, countless times tastier than the delicacies I’ve had before. What even Immortal Gods in heaven eat must be like this."
Little Dragon Girl watched and listened beside him, unable to help feeling proud.
This was her husband’s cooking!
"Who made it?"
The old man asked.
Little Dragon Girl immediately replied:
"My husband did."
Her face alight with blush, she said proudly:
"Regardless of the dish, meat or vegetable, he’s excellent, making them irresistible. Since I started eating my husband’s cooking, I can’t stomach anyone else’s dishes."
Her testimonial prompted the old man’s heart to surge, and he couldn’t help but saying:
"Oh?! Even vegetable dishes are this good?!"
"Naturally."
Little Dragon Girl’s voice was as clear as a mountain spring flowing through dense forest, quite pleasing:
"This cannot be faked."
"Makes sense."
The old man’s eyes burned with anticipation, heart scorching, hoping:
"Young man, can you teach me..."
He was uncertain how to express it.
Ding Ling said, "Speak plainly."
Seeing Ding Ling’s forthrightness, the old man steeled himself and uttered: "Will you teach me your culinary supreme skills?"
"Sure."
"Really?!"
The old man initially couldn’t believe it, but after confirming multiple times, he was elated, laughing heartily toward the sky:
"Hahaha, this old beggar will have a feast for the rest of his days."
Ding Ling smiled.
After the three were full, they went hunting again.
Then Ding Ling began teaching the old man his supreme skill.
The old man had an extraordinary talent, learning quickly.
After just a short session.
He gained a basic understanding of grilling.
But still struggled with the essence.
Ding Ling’s Full Level Chef God skill captured the culinary essence of the real world, Three Kingdoms World, and The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World.
It could definitely be said.
His culinary skill was top-notch.
Guiding, teaching the old man was naturally nothing difficult.
But mastering it in short order was absolutely impossible.
The old man suddenly slapped his thigh, remembering an urgent matter and said:
"Oh no! I forgot the Five Uglies of Tibet!"
"What’s wrong?"
Ding Ling glanced sideways.
The old man had spent several hours with Ding Ling, perceiving Ding Ling’s generosity, goodness, and kindness, his recognition had risen to the highest level.
Not long ago.
Ding Ling heard a notification sound.
[Received E-level Achievement Medal: You have gained high recognition from Nine-fingered Divine Beggar Hong Qigong.]

[Note: Hong Qigong was extraordinarily chivalrous but exceedingly greedy. He tasted countless delicacies across Great River, the Jiangnan, and Tibetan Border. He tired of familiar foods and made unheard-of dishes himself.
His research, passion for cuisine is deep-rooted.
And you conquered him with your Full Level Chef God skill!
Your character, amiable attitude, also earned his preliminary recognition!
Little Dragon Girl’s innocence and kindness further convinced him of your goodness. Otherwise, how could you have such a virtuous, pure-hearted wife?
Little Dragon Girl’s disposition and character elevated his recognition of you further.
Your unselfish teaching of supreme skills moved him deeply! His commendation, admiration reached the utmost!]
Hearing this notification.
Ding Ling knew it was time.
Seeing Hong Qigong mention the Five Uglies of Tibet, Ding Ling seized the opportunity, saying:
"Sir, if you have urgent matters, you can leave at once. If destiny allows, I will surely pass onto you the supreme skill of crafting vegetarian dishes."
"This..."
Hong Qigong felt quite embarrassed, couldn’t resist asking:
"Young man, what reward do you want?"
"Reward?"
Ding Ling glanced at Little Dragon Girl.
Little Dragon Girl hesitated, then understood, immediately said:
"If sir has any supreme skill, could you teach it to my husband? He’s obsessed with Martial Dao, can learn anything quickly and with proficiency.
He is indeed a rare teacher. If sir could guide him a little, that would be excellent."
Little Dragon Girl truly offered a divine help again.
Ding Ling secretly praised Little Dragon Girl, thinking it was right to teach her these things over time. Now, they’re immediately useful.

chapters.title: Chapter 440: Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms at Full Level
paragraphs: "Oh?"
Hong Qigong looked sideways, seemingly a bit skeptical of Ding Ling’s martial arts talent:
"Do you really learn everything so quickly, and understand it immediately?"
"Absolutely!"
Ding Ling affirmed.
"Oh!"
Hong Qigong was moved. Having spent some time with Ding Ling, Hong Qigong knew that Ding Ling was not one to boast. He pondered for a while, pacing back and forth before saying:

"If you are indeed a prodigy, I would be happy to teach you martial arts. Here’s what we’ll do. I’ll teach you a palm technique first. If you can indeed master it just by watching once, I’ll teach you my most skilled techniques."
Having said this, Hong Qigong relaxed and stroked the short beard under his chin. Without another word, he began to demonstrate.
"Watch carefully."
He displayed a set of palm techniques with extreme fluidity, his movements shifting left and right like an immortal roaming the heavens and earth, exuding a sense of freedom, grandeur, and boldness.
As he demonstrated, he explained the key points.
After going through it once.
He looked at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling recalled it in his mind.
A moment later.
[Carefree Palm Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
This was a high-tier palm technique, quite exceptional.
But for the average person, it’s very difficult to master it to the level of instinctual mastery.
Ding Ling instantly reached full level, deeply understanding the ease of learning but difficulty of mastering this technique!
For a genius, entry is easy.
Even reaching great success is not hard.
But to reach instinctual mastery requires one or two years of hard work for most.
After Ding Ling learned it.
Seeing Little Dragon Girl and Hong Qigong both looking at him.
He didn’t hesitate.

He executed the palm technique, boom! The air was filled with countless palm shadows, his body moving like an immortal strolling, his palms sometimes striking the celestial palace, sometimes slapping the earth, striking left and right, causing the wind from his palms to surge, making the nearby thorns and flowers sway.
A moment later.
Ding Ling finished and stood.
Looking at Hong Qigong.
Hong Qigong was dumbfounded, unable to believe what he saw, thinking to himself:
"He learned and achieved great perfection in just one demonstration. This talent is many times greater than Guo Jing’s."
Compared to Guo Jing.
Ding Ling instantly became like the sun and moon in the sky!
Dazzling and conspicuous to the extreme!
Hong Qigong was amazed, glanced at Little Dragon Girl, and said:
"Little Dragon Girl, you truly didn’t lie. Your husband is indeed an unparalleled genius! With such a person, I can’t help but want to teach more techniques."
He remembered being tempted long ago by Huang Rong’s delicious food to teach Guo Jing his supreme skill.
And now, he succumbed to the same move again.
But compared to Huang Rong’s delicacies, Ding Ling’s were clearly superior, more unforgettable, and hard to erase from memory.
Eating Ding Ling’s food, and then eating Huang Rong’s, would surely feel like chewing wax.
No comparison.
Comparing Ding Ling’s talent with Guo Jing’s, there was a huge gap, like heaven and earth!
Moreover, Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl’s character and temperament had earned Hong Qigong’s high approval.
Thinking that he had already taught the supreme skill to Guo Jing, teaching it to a genius like Ding Ling, who was a good person, wasn’t an issue, he thought, and said:
"Very well! Then I’ll teach you my supreme skill."
He laid it all out honestly:
"To be honest, I am the Nine-Fingered Divine Beggar Hong Qigong. My supreme skills are the Dog Beating Stick Technique and the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms."
He looked at Little Dragon Girl and Ding Ling.

Seeing Little Dragon Girl looking quite puzzled, as if she hadn’t heard of his name, he couldn’t help but feel a bit shocked, wondering where these two emerged from to have never heard of the name Hong Qigong?!
Lately,
he rarely entered cities.
He had been chasing the Five Uglies of Tibet from the Tibetan border all the way to this ancient mountain path.
Traversing places sparsely populated, eating only wild game.
Despite the hardships, he found joy in it.
Only troubled by how fast the Five Uglies of Tibet ran, nearly losing their trail several times during the chase.
This time was no exception.
A few hours were missed due to indulging in cuisine, leaving him uncertain if he could still catch up to the Five Uglies, sighing inwardly, he said aloud:
"Ding Ling, you taught me culinary skills for several hours. I won’t be stingy either, and will teach you for some hours! If you can learn, that’s fine, if not, then perhaps it’s just our fate."
"Thank you, senior."
Ding Ling changed his address to ’senior’, and solemnly said:
"If I can’t learn your supreme skill within a few hours, it’s my own dullness, and I will not dare to ask you to waste more time, effort, and energy teaching me!"
Such confidence!
Hong Qigong was moved, and thinking about how quickly Ding Ling learned the Carefree Palm Technique, he couldn’t help but turn his head, considering:
"Ding Ling’s talent is the highest I’ve seen in my life! He might indeed learn quickly!
But the difficulty of the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms and the Dog Beating Stick Technique is several times, even ten times greater than the Carefree Palm Technique!
If he can learn quickly as well, then he would certainly be an unrivaled genius, a talent of historic proportions!"
With these thoughts in mind, he said:
"I will now teach you my supreme skill, the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms!"
After he finished,
he glanced at Little Dragon Girl.
Little Dragon Girl sensibly moved aside, not peeking.
Hong Qigong immediately began demonstrating moves and reciting the Heart Method Mantra for Ding Ling.
After only one demonstration.
Hong Qigong asked if he needed to demonstrate again.
Ding Ling shook his head.
Hong Qigong was flabbergasted, almost unable to believe Ding Ling.
He saw Ding Ling close his eyes slightly.
In an instant after.
Suddenly.
Boom!
He struck out a palm to one side, causing a booming sound to reverberate all around, it was a move called ’Shocking Hundred Li’ executed to masterly perfection by Ding Ling.
Then Ding Ling clapped both palms, faintly a dragon roar could be heard, boom! It was a move called ’Double Dragon Takes Water’ performed vividly!
Followed by Divine Dragon’s Tail Swing, Crossing the Great River, Dragon Battle in the Wilderness, Flying Dragon in the Sky...
All eighteen palms!
Mastered to instinctual level.
All were perfectly executed, impeccable!

Each move echoed with dragon roars throughout the universe, resonating far and wide, vaguely revealing a dragon-shaped void forming between Ding Ling’s palms! Dancing and roaring with Ding Ling’s movements!
Hong Qigong was astonished and deeply shaken.
When Ding Ling finished and stood watching him.
He was utterly shocked, feeling a lump in his throat, nearly suffocating himself.
For quite a while.
He took a deep breath, the way he looked at Ding Ling was entirely different.
As if he was looking at a demon god, a genius, a prodigy!
"You, you, you..."
Hong Qigong seemed to have something to say, but due to his intense shock, his tongue seemed tied, unable to form a complete sentence.
The Carefree Palm Technique is easy to learn but difficult to master.
Many geniuses learn it immediately with ease.
Ding Ling learned it immediately as well, and went further to perfect it, proving he’s an extraordinary genius.
But the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms.
It’s hard to learn and harder to master!
Even entry-level is difficult.
Achieving perfection is even more challenging!
And Ding Ling?
How long had he been learning it?!
His mastery of the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms seemed even more perfect and natural, more fluid and astonishing than Hong Qigong’s own display!
What an extraordinary and shocking achievement is this?!
"Unbelievable!"
"Inconceivable!"
"It’s like a tale from Arabian Nights!"
Hong Qigong used three phrases to express his inner shock, showing that his heart was surging with waves, hard to calm.
Little Dragon Girl turned around and glanced at Hong Qigong.
Hong Qigong smiled bitterly:
"Your husband is truly as you said. Little Dragon Girl, you really are an honest person. I should have believed you all along."

chapters.title: Chapter 441: Full Level Dog Beating Stick Technique
paragraphs: Little Dragon Girl is indeed very simple, kind, and sincere.
It can even be said.
Little Dragon Girl does not lie.
Hong Qigong has traveled far and wide, how extensive is his knowledge?

He long saw through Little Dragon Girl, so even though she initially said Ding Ling learned martial arts instantly and mastered them quickly, he only thought it was Little Dragon Girl infatuated with Ding Ling, seeing the most beautiful in him, and exaggerating.
But now upon reflection.
Little Dragon Girl was plainly speaking the truth.
Not a single word was exaggerated.
This truly is a good girl as innocent and genuine as herself!
As Hong Qigong thought this, his gaze at Ding Ling kept changing, unable to help but exclaim repeatedly:

"I remember back when I trained in Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms; the time spent was counted in years. Yet you mastered it instantly and reached Great Perfection. It makes me wonder, have you learned Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms before?"
Without waiting for Ding Ling to reply.
Hong Qigong continued on his own:
"But you and Little Dragon Girl have no reason to deceive this old man, so you are probably really encountering Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms for the first time.
First encounter, first learning, and reaching the perfect state instantly.
Such talent!"
Hong Qigong sighed, feeling waves of shock in his heart, difficult to calm for a long time:
"It’s too strong. Too astonishing. In front of you, I feel that all these years were lived in vain! I even feel like I’m nothing!"
To make one of the Five Extremes shocked to the point of declaring himself nothing.
One can imagine the shock in his heart must have been earth-shattering.
Ding Ling hurriedly said solemnly:
"Senior, your chivalry is widely known. You are a true hero. In terms of martial arts speed, I just happen to be a bit faster than you, that’s all. In other aspects, how can I compare to you?
There is no need for senior to undervalue yourself."
"You’re purely trying to comfort me."
Hong Qigong laughed:

"I know your goodwill. Rest assured, I’m old now, looking at everything openly; if I were young, I would compete with Wang Chongyang for the title of World’s Number One, never casually admitting inferiority.
Even with Old Poison Master in front, Eastern Evil in person, if Wang Chongyang were to revive, I wouldn’t say I’m inferior to them. But you?"
He shook his head:
"Your talent is truly beyond comprehension, extraordinary, I am not as good as you, and that’s a hard fact, impossible to deny. Ding Ling, can you promise me one thing?"
"Please say, senior."
"Well..."
Hong Qigong paced, stroked the short beard under his chin, glanced at Ding Ling, and then at Little Dragon Girl, pondering for a while before finally saying:
"You two, husband and wife, one pure-hearted, magnanimous; the other tolerant, with extraordinary talent, truly a perfect match. It reminds me of Guo Jing and Huang Rong in Xiangyang.
They have sacrificed too much to defend Xiangyang.
If possible.
Could you go to Xiangyang to help them?"
"Duty-bound!"
Ding Ling said solemnly.
He originally planned to go to Xiangyang this time, to see if he could obtain the Nine Yin Scripture and Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms from Guo Jing.
Now, if there is Hong Qigong’s recommendation letter.
It most likely will succeed.
Nine Yin Scripture paired with Nine Yang Divine Skill.
Ding Ling really wants to see what the effect will be.
Moreover.
He killed a corps of Kublai’s elite soldiers and also killed Kebineng, his prized general; even the numerous experts Kebineng gathered were smashed or defeated by him.
It can be said.
He and Kublai have already become mortal enemies!
From the time he killed Kebineng until now, many days have passed.
Ding Ling often travels with Little Dragon Girl in uninhabited regions or remote areas, only going to small towns for supplies, buying things and leaving without lingering.
Therefore, Ding Ling doesn’t know how the outside world is ’spreading’ about him.
But he can assume with his toes that various news must be flying everywhere, his ’infamy’ surely shaking one side!
Kublai might have already started planning to eliminate him!
Since they are mortal enemies.
Kublai wants to attack Xiangyang, and Ding Ling sides with Guo Jing against Kublai, naturally making perfect sense.
Yet.
Hong Qigong doesn’t know the reasoning, details within.
He doesn’t even know who Ding Ling or Little Dragon Girl is, only thinking of them as rising newcomers in Jianghu Martial Arts, sighing that Jianghu Martial Arts has successors.
At this moment, seeing Ding Ling instantly agree to his request, Hong Qigong was deeply moved, grabbing Ding Ling’s arm, repeatedly uttering three "good" words.
He then laughed and said:

"I, Hong Qigong, indeed did not misjudge people. Before I finished speaking, you agreed, truly a heart of chivalry and heroism, unrivaled. The Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms taught to you truly passed on to the right person."
He paused for a bit, then continued:
"I am certainly not intending to send you to die. I, the old beggar, can’t do such a thing, would eat poorly and sleep badly if I did.
Therefore, you need not worry about life or death; whenever sensing danger, calmly retreat, no need to fight too hard."
Ding Ling listened nearby, said nothing, only letting Hong Qigong explain in detail.,
"Dog Beating Stick Technique has always only been taught to Beggar Gang Leader, but I truly like, admire both of you as a couple."
Hong Qigong thought for a bit and then said:
"If you don’t mind, you might as well try to become the next Beggar Gang Leader. Even if you don’t, I have decided to break the rule and teach you the Dog Beating Stick Technique."
Hong Qigong acted naturally, free-spirited.
He once agreed to exchange his life’s supreme skills for delicious food.
Now meeting Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl, how they appear in every way more pleasing than Guo Jing and Huang Rong couple!
He truly admires them to the core.
Especially Ding Ling.
Previously never mentioning rewards, letting him taste delicious food first, selflessly teaching him Kitchen God’s supreme art!
Later, the martial arts learning ability further shocked him.
Such a heaven-defying talent!
Surely the future world belongs to him!
For Hong Qigong to contribute to this talent’s glorious future is worth a lifetime!
He determined, Ding Ling will certainly be renowned for ages, shaking the Martial Arts World!
Already extremely appreciating, acknowledging Ding Ling as a couple.
See again Ding Ling ’duty-bound’ willing to go to Xiangyang help Guo Jing couple, defend Xiangyang.
Hong Qigong liked even more, promptly and delightedly taught Ding Ling the Dog Beating Stick Technique.
Ding Ling also went through it once.
Instantly afterward.
[Dog Beating Stick Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.3]
[Constitution +0.2]
This is a supreme Stick Technique.
After mastering, there naturally is a vigorous qi moving through the limbs.
Ding Ling holding a stick, with a trace of vigorous qi from Nine Yang Divine Skill, started activating this Dog Beating Stick Technique; suddenly, stick shadows were everywhere in the sky,
The techniques of Stick Beating Double Dogs, Stick Beating Dog’s Head, Plundering Staff from Mastiff’s Mouth, Rebuking Dog to the Sky, Dogless Under-Heaven, etc., were all displayed.
As it escalated.
Stick shadows were everywhere, densely, like raindrops, lightning, ordinary people not wanting to approach, even looking would be intimidating, arousing respect.
After completing Dog Beating Stick Technique.
Ding Ling put away a wooden stick, looked at Hong Qigong, and cupped his hands:
"Senior."
"Incredible."
Hong Qigong speechlessly looked at the sky, stroked short beard, sighing:
"Seems I am truly old, facing you, I feel like I am as insignificant as gazing at stars and the sea!"

Such a heaven-defying talent!
Surely the future world belongs to him!
For Hong Qigong to contribute to this talent’s glorious future is worth a lifetime!
He determined, Ding Ling will certainly be renowned for ages, shaking the Martial Arts World!
Already extremely appreciating, acknowledging Ding Ling as a couple.
See again Ding Ling ’duty-bound’ willing to go to Xiangyang help Guo Jing couple, defend Xiangyang.
Hong Qigong liked even more, promptly and delightedly taught Ding Ling the Dog Beating Stick Technique.
Ding Ling also went through it once.
Instantly afterward.
[Dog Beating Stick Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.3]
[Constitution +0.2]
This is a supreme Stick Technique.
After mastering, there naturally is a vigorous qi moving through the limbs.
Ding Ling holding a stick, with a trace of vigorous qi from Nine Yang Divine Skill, started activating this Dog Beating Stick Technique; suddenly, stick shadows were everywhere in the sky,
The techniques of Stick Beating Double Dogs, Stick Beating Dog’s Head, Plundering Staff from Mastiff’s Mouth, Rebuking Dog to the Sky, Dogless Under-Heaven, etc., were all displayed.
As it escalated.
Stick shadows were everywhere, densely, like raindrops, lightning, ordinary people not wanting to approach, even looking would be intimidating, arousing respect.
After completing Dog Beating Stick Technique.
Ding Ling put away a wooden stick, looked at Hong Qigong, and cupped his hands:
"Senior."
"Incredible."
Hong Qigong speechlessly looked at the sky, stroked short beard, sighing:
"Seems I am truly old, facing you, I feel like I am as insignificant as gazing at stars and the sea!"

chapters.title: Chapter 442: Power Increase
paragraphs: This was absolutely unimaginable before.
But the more time Hong Qigong spent with Ding Ling,
the more severe the critical blows he suffered.
Especially after teaching Ding Ling martial arts.
He found that Ding Ling did not need him to explain the essence and esoteric truths of martial arts, he simply needed to perform the routine as it was written and recite the heart method mantra.
Ding Ling could instantly cultivate to the Great Perfection realm.
Such speed.
Is it certain that he’s human?!
Fortunately, the previous results from cultivating the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms had already greatly shocked him.
This time, with the Dog Beating Stick Technique cultivation.
Although it still brought him a huge sense of shock, he ultimately withstood the unparalleled impact, feeling a slight numbness in his body and cold sweat on his back.
In his words, he couldn’t help but sigh, expressing profound sentiment and an inevitable feeling of solitude and melancholy.
[Achievement Medal: You earned Hong Qigong’s profound admiration.]
[Note: Hong Qigong prides himself as an unparalleled genius, with rare comparison in mastering the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms and Dog Beating Stick Technique!
Yet you have successfully cultivated these two techniques he prides himself on in an instant!
This has rocked and overturned his worldview!
For the first time in his life, he had a strong sense of the Yangtze River waves pushing forward, with the old waves dying on the beach!]
Another achievement medal.
Counting the previous E-level.
Ding Ling has earned two achievement medals from Hong Qigong.
This incidentally proves that Hong Qigong is an innate level master.
Ding Ling glanced at other information on the character panel.
[Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms’ Dragon Subduing Heart Technique Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
[Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms’ External Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0.3]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.2]
This Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms is undeniably a superior martial arts of the same caliber as the Toad Skill, reaching the pinnacle in both inner power and external skill.
It is a rare technique where both internal and external skills can be cultivated simultaneously.
When reaching full level of the Dragon Subduing Heart Technique, the seventh drop of Nine Yang True Water in Ding Ling’s dantian split into another drop.
Up to now.
There are now eight drops of Nine Yang True Water in his dantian.
[True Power Value: 8 Points]
Such is the transformation of Ding Ling’s strength.
His four-dimensional attributes have greatly improved.
The true power value has also increased by one point.
An entire body of true qi, increasingly pure, mighty, and fierce!

The Dragon Subduing Heart Technique from the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms, absorbing the heaven and earth primordial qi, is exceptionally fierce. After being completely absorbed by the true qi of the Nine Yang Divine Skill, it leaves a strand of vigorous qi flowing within the limbs and bones.

But when Ding Ling activates the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms, it immediately flows out to cooperate with the Nine Yang Divine Skill, amplifying the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms, allowing it to unleash even stronger power.
"Now I’ve taught you my strongest supreme skill. There are still some miscellaneous martial arts, do you want to learn them?"
Hong Qigong asked.
"Learn!
Ding Ling promptly nodded.
There’s no reason to not learn.
This is a chance to enhance his foundation, improving the four-dimensional attribute points.
Right now.
Hong Qigong, without much hesitation, having already imparted the supreme skills of the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms and Dog Beating Stick Technique, had no reason to hold back on other techniques.
Lotus Palm, Copper Hammer Hand, Tiger Subduing Fist, Iron Broom Leg Technique...
A dozen martial arts.
There were second-class, third-class.
And first-class.
Ding Ling reached full level mastery instantly in all of them.
Seeing this, Hong Qigong was tongue-tied with admiration, stunning Ding Ling’s talent at the point of envy, marveling at his unmatched talent!
According to his words.
If there is a prodigy in the human world.
It must be Ding Ling!
And only Ding Ling!
For others, if we only discuss martial arts talent, they are like ants and moths compared to Ding Ling, completely incapable of resisting!
After learning these martial arts.
Ding Ling’s four-dimensional attributes increased to:
[Strength +0.5]
[Agility +0.5]
[Constitution +0.5]
Very balanced.
Because most of these techniques that can increase attributes are generally ordinary first-class martial arts.
They absolutely cannot match the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms and Dog Beating Stick Technique.
However, being able to gain these attribute point increases is certainly an unexpected gain.
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
The enhancement in foundation made it increasingly easy and natural for him to wield the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms and Dog Beating Stick Technique.
Before, there might have been some sluggish parts.
But after learning all of Hong Qigong’s supreme skills.
The execution of the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms and Dog Beating Stick Technique has become increasingly smooth and fluent.
Clearly.

These miscellaneous martial arts, seemingly unrelated to the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms and Dog Beating Stick Technique, do indeed play a supporting role. Learning them does have some amplification effect on the two supreme skills.
"Besides these martial arts, I’ve also learned the Nine Yin Scripture, although it’s incomplete. Do you want to learn it?"
After imparting all his martial arts to Ding Ling, Hong Qigong mentioned the Nine Yin Scripture on impulse.
"Of course."
"Then I’ll teach you."
Hong Qigong’s Nine Yin Scripture still offered some assistance to Ding Ling.
But because it’s incomplete.
It cannot satisfy Ding Ling’s idea of fully integrating Nine Yin and Nine Yang into Yin Yang Unity.
Ding Ling expressed his wish to see the complete Nine Yin Scripture.
And noted that he and Little Dragon Girl had previously learned a fragment of the Nine Yin Scripture.
Hong Qigong was surprised.
But seeing Little Dragon Girl indeed perform some techniques from the Nine Yin Scripture, he believed her.
At this, he stroked the short beard at his chin and said:
"The Nine Yin Scripture was once hailed as the world’s number one divine skill. Countless martial arts heroes lost their lives over it, with families destroyed."
He looked deeply at Ding Ling and said:

"Your martial arts talent is extraordinarily high, so you won’t have the problem of biting off more than you can chew. But I also hope you won’t indulge excessively in practicing various internal skills, to prevent causing chaos in true qi, damage to the dantian, and disordered meridians."
Ding Ling naturally expressed acceptance of the advice.
However, he has opened up.
For now, he doesn’t need to worry about these issues.
Unless encountering erratic martial arts like the Sunflower Manual.
But as his physical quality improves day by day, even if he learns the Sunflower Manual, it likely won’t force him to the point of needing self-castration.
The Nine Yin Scripture compared to the Sunflower Manual is presumably much gentler.
Ding Ling naturally wants to give it a try.
Especially since his dantian still holds innate true qi, a strand of vigorous qi from Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic, a strand of vigorous qi from Tai Chi Scripture...
These strands of vigorous qi can all play a subtle role in harmonization.
If he integrates these divine skills.
Perfect fusion of Nine Yin and Nine Yang.
It is envisioned that Ding Ling’s combat power will inevitably undergo a significant leap forward in growth!
Ding Ling is quite expecting.
This time, he clearly sensed that his foundation was as deep as a mountain, and even if attempted, it seemed harmless to himself.
Only because of this.
He dares to try.
Otherwise.
He definitely would not dare to attempt rashly.
"Since you have your reasons. Alright."
Hong Qigong said:
"I’ll write you a letter, you personally take it to Xiangyang to find Guo Jing, and have him teach you the full text of the Nine Yin Scripture."
"Thank you, senior!"
Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl together solemnly bowed in gratitude.
"Alright, alright."
Hong Qigong waved his hand:
"No need for these formalities with me. Do you have pen, ink, paper, and inkstone?"
Ding Ling’s storage pouch had them.
The first time Hong Qigong saw the storage pouch, he was also amazed, marveling repeatedly, his curiosity about Ding Ling’s background growing, and his appreciation for Ding Ling steadily increasing.
To possess such immortal treasure! Is there any need to question his future prospects?
The two stayed.
For another few hours.
Hong Qigong received the ’Kitchen God’s Secret Manual of Ultimate Art’ personally written by Ding Ling, and left with satisfaction.
He couldn’t learn the Kitchen God’s ultimate skill in a short time.
So Ding Ling simply wrote him a secret manual.

chapters.title: Chapter 443: Mission Progress! Heading South to the Destination
paragraphs: Latest release.
Hong Qigong felt immensely satisfied just looking at those characters.
More than once, he said if Ding Ling were to take the imperial examination, just based on these characters, he could indisputably bring back the title of Advanced Scholar!
Even without taking the exam, these characters are enough to make Ding Ling famous throughout the land and admired by future generations.
In his eyes.
Ding Ling is truly omnipotent now.
A Kitchen God level in cooking.
A Celestial God level in martial arts.
Even his calligraphy is at the Calligraphy Saint level.
Ask the world.
Where else can you find a second such prodigy?!
Too terrifying!!
After bidding farewell to Ding Ling, Hong Qigong, while riding a horse given by Ding Ling, couldn’t help but shake his head and sigh:
"It’s true that in this vast world, there are endless wonders. I never imagined that in my old age, I would encounter such a pair of divine lovers.
Encountered such an unbelievable, beyond rational standard prodigy!
Comparing him.
What are Wang Chongyang, Eastern Evil, West Poison—all of them are just nonsense!"
Speaking later.
Hong Qigong couldn’t help but utter a ’national curse.’
One can see the surging and agitated emotions within him.
The longer he spent with Ding Ling.
The more Hong Qigong could sense Ding Ling’s terrifying prowess.
He now dares to conclude.
Ding Ling’s abilities undoubtedly only display the tip of the iceberg; perhaps Ding Ling also possesses top-notch expertise in medicine, painting, and playing the zither?
"How old is he?!"
"Even if he started cultivating from the womb, he wouldn’t be this terrifying, right?"
But considering Ding Ling’s cultivation of Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms and Dog Beating Stick Technique, both mastered in an instant like instincts.
Hong Qigong was speechless, choked up, and sighed to the sky:
"He truly is a god! Who knows how far this guy Ding Ling can go, truly wishing to see him standing at the peak of the world, witnessing his most glorious moment during my lifetime."
Hong Qigong went on to pursue the Five Uglies of Tibet.
He was unaware of Ding Ling’s killing of Qiu Chuji and defeating the monks of Shaolin Temple.
If he knew.
Who knows if he would regard Ding Ling as an enemy?
Ding Ling initially did not think of this aspect.
It was only after interacting with Hong Qigong for a while that he learned what Hong Qigong had been up to during this time.
Thinking about Hong Qigong’s personality, naturally, he knew Hong Qigong surely was unaware of his deeds during this period.
Regarding this.
Ding Ling did not know what to say.
Feel grateful?
Sigh?
Be at ease? Relax?
It is hard to say.
But Ding Ling knew that he always acted with courage and determination, with no regrets!
He does not regret killing Qiu Chuji and defeating the monks of Shaolin Temple; even if time were to rewind and he had to do it again, he would still do it.
He generally doesn’t provoke others actively.
But if someone dares to provoke him, even with the intention to kill him, he won’t care who they are; if they’re going to kill him, how could he hold back?
Ding Ling has traversed multiple worlds, killing countless people; it’s not an exaggeration to call him the butcher of tens of thousands.
Does he shy away from killing?!
Ding Ling took a deep breath, looked at the letter in his hand, and thought:

"With Hong Qigong’s letter, learning the complete Nine Yin Scripture shouldn’t be difficult. My only worry now might be if the Guo Jing and Huang Rong couple harbor any resentment towards me after knowing what I’ve done, and won’t pass it on to me."
Ding Ling slightly furrowed his brow.
He can only choose to take it one step at a time.
If the Guo Jing couple really refuse.
Ding Ling wouldn’t force it.
He would choose to leave.
Go searching for other cultivation skills.
Ding Ling glanced at the character panel:
[Aptitude 3 (ordinary people at 1 point), Wisdom 4.2, Strength 50.8, Agility 51.4, Constitution 53.3, Defense 47.2, Charisma 11.7.]
Strength, Agility, Constitution all exceeded 50 points.
These three attributes have broken a layer of shackles.
Ding Ling can clearly perceive the surge in his power, speed, and all aspects.
If supported by the Fusion Qi of the Five Great Breathing Techniques and Nine Yang Divine Skill, Ding Ling’s strength would be immeasurable!
Absolutely not just five thousand jin, perhaps even tens of thousands of jin are possible.
How many jin exactly, Ding Ling does not know, as it’s hard to measure.
He can only activate the Fusion Qi, then utilize the strength inherent in his physical constitution, and when he unleashes a palm strike, he can effortlessly break a big tree, flatten the earth.
Every move, tens of thousands of jin strength, is definitely there!
"The natural physical strength alone reaches over five thousand pounds. With Fusion Qi to complement it, it’s truly invincible."
Ordinary people couldn’t even withstand tens of thousands of pounds.
Being able to withstand even a thousand pounds surpasses Third-class Generals.
It’s safe to say.
If Ding Ling takes action now, even if a group of Second-class and Third-class Generals line up, form an army, with a Drumming Golden Hammer in his hand, he could sweep them all aside on the spot!
[1: Defeat more than 20 plane world experts: 47/20.]
The experts he defeated include: Qiu Chuji, Hao Datong, Sunx Bu’er, Little Dragon Girl, Li Mochou, dozens of First-class or higher experts from Shaolin Temple...
[3: Your name must resonate as the world’s number one throughout the plane world. 13%/100%.]
This is the current situation of Ding Ling’s tasks.
Task 1 has been completed unknowingly.
Task 3 also jumped from 0% to 13%.
It shows that his ’notoriety’ must have resonated in one region, receiving recognition from many people, who believe he is the world’s number one.
This undoubtedly includes some of Kublai’s warriors.
After all, they once faced Ding Ling directly, causing the most tragic casualties.
"The names of Hai Dafu and Mu Renqing are not on the list for task 1. As expected, defeating them doesn’t count."
It’s quite clear.
Task 1 requires defeating the strengths of this plane world only.
Ding Ling pondered:
"There are quite a number of strong individuals on this plane. Perhaps this time there’s hope for more glory bonuses."
Naturally, Ding Ling wants to earn more Glory Medals.
It concerns not only his potential to ascend.
But also whether he can purchase more and better treasures.
"Let’s go then.
Ding Ling saw that the Little Dragon Girl had already tidied up the scattered equipment and said to her:
"We are going to Xiangyang."
"Where you go, I go."
The Little Dragon Girl immediately replied:
"We are a couple. There’s absolutely no reason to part ways."
Hearing her words.
Ding Ling thought of the Ascension, and wondered what choice the Little Dragon Girl would make at that time?
It seems he needs to prepare for it.
Ding Ling and the Little Dragon Girl mounted their horses and headed south to Xiangyang.
Along the way, Ding Ling continued to guide the Little Dragon Girl.
This time the Little Dragon Girl added the Dog Beating Stick Technique to her cultivation skills.
This Stick Technique is truly remarkable.
Once mastered, even a random piece of wood by the roadside can be turned into a ’Divine Weapon,’ so there’s no reason not to learn it.
Moreover.
Hong Qigong allowed the Little Dragon Girl to learn this cultivation skill and even compete for the Beggar Gang Leader position, so how could Ding Ling let her not learn it.
As for the Beggar Gang Leader position?
Ding Ling had no interest at all.
Being a Prince before.
How could he want to be a Beggar Gang Leader?
It truly doesn’t pique his interest.
Better to go with the flow.
On this day.
Ding Ling and the Little Dragon Girl couple arrived near Xiangyang.
While resting and drinking tea at a tea stall, they saw a group of people riding towards Xiangyang City.
On the road, many local people watched, but they were unmoved, as if they’ve seen it many times and have become accustomed and numb.
The Little Dragon Girl, although seeing such a scene for the first time, showed no interest and was focused entirely on Ding Ling, occasionally pouring tea for him.
Serving him meticulously.
Attracting the attention of many natives and players nearby, they couldn’t help but whisper:
"Ding Ling actually came to Xiangyang. Is he intending to join the Hero Assembly?"

"Hehe. Kublai’s general was killed, prompting early movements southward, aiming to besiege Xiangyang and break Xiangyang City. The Guo Jing couple had no choice but to assemble martial arts heroes to Xiangyang, seeking to defend Xiangyang together. But I think, this matter is precarious, with little reason for success. Now Ding Ling comes.
Tsk tsk, it instantly turns the scene into a puzzle, leaving the outcome unclear."
Players have mixed feelings towards Ding Ling, ranging from jealousy, envy, admiration, approval, awe, wishing for Ding Ling’s demise; all these emotions exist;
But without exception.
They all highly recognize Ding Ling’s unparalleled martial power.
They all feel that with Ding Ling’s presence in Xiangyang, his intervention might turn the tide for what seemed to be destined as a defeat for the martial arts heroes and Xiangyang’s side?
As for why they believe Xiangyang’s side is bound to lose?
It’s because Kublai’s side has recruited many experts from other worlds.
And Xiangyang’s side.
The court is inactive.

There’s no enthusiasm in recruiting these extraordinary talents, compared to the vastly open-minded, generous, grand and noble Kublai, clearly, the Great Song Court’s leader ’Emperor Lizong of Song, Zhao Yun’ lacks such character, not to mention his inability to discern talent, which leads to the Great Song Court being dominated by treacherous officials.
Up till now.
The Great Song has entered its final years, and unless there’s someone capable of turning the tide, able to suppress everything with unparalleled heroism, it inevitably faces extinction.
