"How old is he?!"
"Even if he started cultivating from the womb, he wouldn’t be this terrifying, right?"
But considering Ding Ling’s cultivation of Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms and Dog Beating Stick Technique, both mastered in an instant like instincts.
Hong Qigong was speechless, choked up, and sighed to the sky:
"He truly is a god!
Who knows how far this guy Ding Ling can go, truly wishing to see him standing at the peak of the world, witnessing his most glorious moment during my lifetime."
Hong Qigong went on to pursue the Five Uglies of Tibet.
He was unaware of Ding Ling’s killing of Qiu Chuji and defeating the monks of Shaolin Temple.
If he knew.
Who knows if he would regard Ding Ling as an enemy?
Ding Ling initially did not think of this aspect.
It was only after interacting with Hong Qigong for a while that he learned what Hong Qigong had been up to during this time.
Thinking about Hong Qigong’s personality, naturally, he knew Hong Qigong surely was unaware of his deeds during this period.
Regarding this.
Ding Ling did not know what to say.
Feel grateful?
Sigh?
Be at ease?
Relax?
It is hard to say.
But Ding Ling knew that he always acted with courage and determination, with no regrets!
He does not regret killing Qiu Chuji and defeating the monks of Shaolin Temple; even if time were to rewind and he had to do it again, he would still do it.
He generally doesn’t provoke others actively.
But if someone dares to provoke him, even with the intention to kill him, he won’t care who they are; if they’re going to kill him, how could he hold back?
Ding Ling has traversed multiple worlds, killing countless people; it’s not an exaggeration to call him the butcher of tens of thousands.
Does he shy away from killing?!
Ding Ling took a deep breath, looked at the letter in his hand, and thought:
"With Hong Qigong’s letter, learning the complete Nine Yin Scripture shouldn’t be difficult.
My only worry now might be if the Guo Jing and Huang Rong couple harbor any resentment towards me after knowing what I’ve done, and won’t pass it on to me."
Ding Ling slightly furrowed his brow.
He can only choose to take it one step at a time.
If the Guo Jing couple really refuse.
Ding Ling wouldn’t force it.
He would choose to leave.
Go searching for other cultivation skills.
Ding Ling glanced at the character panel:
[Aptitude 3 (ordinary people at 1 point), Wisdom 4.2, Strength 50.8, Agility 51.4, Constitution 53.3, Defense 47.2, Charisma 11.7.]
Strength, Agility, Constitution all exceeded 50 points.
These three attributes have broken a layer of shackles.
Ding Ling can clearly perceive the surge in his power, speed, and all aspects.
If supported by the Fusion Qi of the Five Great Breathing Techniques and Nine Yang Divine Skill, Ding Ling’s strength would be immeasurable!
Absolutely not just five thousand jin, perhaps even tens of thousands of jin are possible.
How many jin exactly, Ding Ling does not know, as it’s hard to measure.
He can only activate the Fusion Qi, then utilize the strength inherent in his physical constitution, and when he unleashes a palm strike, he can effortlessly break a big tree, flatten the earth.
Every move, tens of thousands of jin strength, is definitely there!
"The natural physical strength alone reaches over five thousand pounds.
With Fusion Qi to complement it, it’s truly invincible."
Ordinary people couldn’t even withstand tens of thousands of pounds.
Being able to withstand even a thousand pounds surpasses Third-class Generals.
It’s safe to say.
If Ding Ling takes action now, even if a group of Second-class and Third-class Generals line up, form an army, with a Drumming Golden Hammer in his hand, he could sweep them all aside on the spot!
[1: Defeat more than 20 plane world experts: 47/20.]
The experts he defeated include: Qiu Chuji, Hao Datong, Sunx Bu’er, Little Dragon Girl, Li Mochou, dozens of First-class or higher experts from Shaolin Temple...
[3: Your name must resonate as the world’s number one throughout the plane world.
This is the current situation of Ding Ling’s tasks.
Task 1 has been completed unknowingly.
Task 3 also jumped from 0% to 13%.
It shows that his ’notoriety’ must have resonated in one region, receiving recognition from many people, who believe he is the world’s number one.
This undoubtedly includes some of Kublai’s warriors.
After all, they once faced Ding Ling directly, causing the most tragic casualties.
"The names of Hai Dafu and Mu Renqing are not on the list for task 1.
As expected, defeating them doesn’t count."
It’s quite clear.
Task 1 requires defeating the strengths of this plane world only.
Ding Ling pondered:
"There are quite a number of strong individuals on this plane.
Perhaps this time there’s hope for more glory bonuses."
Naturally, Ding Ling wants to earn more Glory Medals.
It concerns not only his potential to ascend.
But also whether he can purchase more and better treasures.
"Let’s go then.
Ding Ling saw that the Little Dragon Girl had already tidied up the scattered equipment and said to her:
"We are going to Xiangyang."
"Where you go, I go."
The Little Dragon Girl immediately replied:
"We are a couple.
There’s absolutely no reason to part ways."
Hearing her words.
Ding Ling thought of the Ascension, and wondered what choice the Little Dragon Girl would make at that time?
It seems he needs to prepare for it.
Ding Ling and the Little Dragon Girl mounted their horses and headed south to Xiangyang.
Along the way, Ding Ling continued to guide the Little Dragon Girl.
This time the Little Dragon Girl added the Dog Beating Stick Technique to her cultivation skills.
This Stick Technique is truly remarkable.
Once mastered, even a random piece of wood by the roadside can be turned into a ’Divine Weapon,’ so there’s no reason not to learn it.
Moreover.
Hong Qigong allowed the Little Dragon Girl to learn this cultivation skill and even compete for the Beggar Gang Leader position, so how could Ding Ling let her not learn it.
As for the Beggar Gang Leader position?
Ding Ling had no interest at all.
Being a Prince before.
How could he want to be a Beggar Gang Leader?
It truly doesn’t pique his interest.
Better to go with the flow.
On this day.
Ding Ling and the Little Dragon Girl couple arrived near Xiangyang.
While resting and drinking tea at a tea stall, they saw a group of people riding towards Xiangyang City.
On the road, many local people watched, but they were unmoved, as if they’ve seen it many times and have become accustomed and numb.
The Little Dragon Girl, although seeing such a scene for the first time, showed no interest and was focused entirely on Ding Ling, occasionally pouring tea for him.
Serving him meticulously.
Attracting the attention of many natives and players nearby, they couldn’t help but whisper:
"Ding Ling actually came to Xiangyang.
Is he intending to join the Hero Assembly?"
"Hehe.
Kublai’s general was killed, prompting early movements southward, aiming to besiege Xiangyang and break Xiangyang City.
The Guo Jing couple had no choice but to assemble martial arts heroes to Xiangyang, seeking to defend Xiangyang together.
But I think, this matter is precarious, with little reason for success.
Now Ding Ling comes.
Tsk tsk, it instantly turns the scene into a puzzle, leaving the outcome unclear."
Players have mixed feelings towards Ding Ling, ranging from jealousy, envy, admiration, approval, awe, wishing for Ding Ling’s demise; all these emotions exist;
But without exception.
They all highly recognize Ding Ling’s unparalleled martial power.
They all feel that with Ding Ling’s presence in Xiangyang, his intervention might turn the tide for what seemed to be destined as a defeat for the martial arts heroes and Xiangyang’s side?
As for why they believe Xiangyang’s side is bound to lose?
It’s because Kublai’s side has recruited many experts from other worlds.
And Xiangyang’s side.
The court is inactive.

There’s no enthusiasm in recruiting these extraordinary talents, compared to the vastly open-minded, generous, grand and noble Kublai, clearly, the Great Song Court’s leader ’Emperor Lizong of Song, Zhao Yun’ lacks such character, not to mention his inability to discern talent, which leads to the Great Song Court being dominated by treacherous officials.
Up till now.
The Great Song has entered its final years, and unless there’s someone capable of turning the tide, able to suppress everything with unparalleled heroism, it inevitably faces extinction.

chapters.title: Chapter 444: Guo Mansion! The Wu Brothers
paragraphs: The Guo Jing and Huang Rong couple attempted to save this country on the brink of collapse with ’the strength of a single family,’ trying to pull up this ship on the verge of capsizing.
The likelihood is that they would be swept into the whirlpool with the capsizing ship! Perishing without a burial place!
And the truth was indeed so.
Ultimately, Guo Jing and Huang Rong met a tragic end.
In terms of morality, conduct, and chivalry.
Ding Ling greatly admired Guo Jing because he couldn’t achieve what Guo Jing did.
Sacrificing the small self to achieve the greater self.
Forgoing the small family to fulfill the greater family.
This selfless devotion and heroic spirit, Ding Ling could only express his respect and admiration.
He was incapable of reaching this level.
Players, apart from envying and being jealous of Ding Ling, also feared and recognized him... the myriad human emotions were all present.
The natives listened to the players’ conversations.
They seemed to recognize Ding Ling, causing them to turn their heads and change their expressions.
They previously paid attention to Ding Ling.
Just because by his side stood a girl of unmatched beauty, like an Immortal Fairy resembling Chang’e from the moon!
The presence of such a beautiful girl only drew admiration from many, frequently glancing at her.
But this beautiful girl looked at Ding Ling with tender affection, pouring tea and keeping busy for him.
This made many people feel jealous, envious, and even disgusted to the point of resentment.
In their eyes.
Such a pure, unearthly Fairy was being ’mistreated’ by Ding Ling, which was indeed infuriating, hateful, and lamentable!
Some couldn’t stand it, even thinking that when they have the chance, they’ll properly reprimand Ding Ling to vent the grievances of this Fairy-like girl.
But the players’ discourse and their deep-seated envy, jealousy, and hatred for Ding Ling made these natives suddenly realize and start whispering:
"Could this be the same Ding Ling who wiped out the Shaolin High Monks and crushed Kublai’s elite army of ten thousand with a hammer?!"

"If this is truly that controversial expert, we must be cautious and vigilant; it’s said this person, with a Drumming Golden Hammer, became unstoppable at his peak, and many heroes died under his hammer."
"But I don’t see him carrying a hammer right now. Is he really Ding Ling?!"

"These Aliens all say he’s Ding Ling, so it’s probably true. If he really is Ding Ling, we must avoid provoking him and not gaze recklessly at his female companion, lest we anger him and end up dead under his hammer. Wouldn’t that be pitiful and sad?!"

After Ding Ling achieved mastery in the Nine Yang Divine Skill, he cultivated the Dragon Subduing Heart Technique of the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms. The True Qi of his Nine Yang Divine Skill had already advanced to the realm of the eighth drop of True Water.
His senses and perception were almost instinctual.
Unless the distance was too far apart.
Conversations within a few dozen meters were clearly audible to him.
He heard clearly, further confirming his previous suspicions.
He couldn’t help but think to himself:

"It seems I’m not an irredeemable villain. In this region of the Great Song, some people certainly have a favorable opinion of me. After all, I did kill or injure tens of thousands of elite troops on Kublai’s side.
But listening to the tone of these people. It seems Kublai has already issued a death order against me. Haha."
Ding Ling chuckled coldly in his heart.
Is Kublai seeking death?
Daring to issue a death order against him?
With just himself and a hammer, he had already crushed Kebineng’s elite army of tens of thousands.
Would Kublai be so foolish and ignorant?!
Ding Ling pondered, there must be some trick, some elaborate setup awaiting him, which he was unaware of.
He preferred direct confrontation.
He didn’t like playing with schemes and plots.
Thus, unable to figure it out, he simply thought:
"No matter what Kublai wants to do, no matter what scheme he devises, since he dares to issue a death order against me, don’t blame me for not being polite to the Mongolian Army!"
He had already promised Hong Qigong to come to Xiangyang to assist Guo Jing.
Since Kublai issued a death order against him.
This was an opportunity to go with the flow.
Of course.
In addition to that.
It was also related to a mission.
"Mission 3 requires the title of the World’s Number One to resonate throughout All Under Heaven! This is the perfect opportunity to defend the city and further my reputation."
With this thought, Ding Ling, having a goal and a plan in mind, settled the bill and, accompanied by Little Dragon Girl, rode towards Xiangyang.
They weren’t far from Xiangyang City to begin with.
And they were riding Ferghana Horses.
In no time, they reached the city gate.
Looking around.
There were common folks lining up to enter the city.
The soldiers guarding the gate were inspecting the common folks.
Various martial arts heroes had come as invited, many holding hero invitations, and the soldiers didn’t conduct thorough inspections.
Or those who, at first glance, appeared to be martial arts heroes, the soldiers dared not obstruct them much, only conducting perfunctory checks, then allowing passage.
Seeing this.
Ding Ling realized why Kublai’s Golden Wheel Dharma King and others could openly appear at the Hero Assembly!
These soldiers were so negligent.
Who dared to stop the Golden Wheel Dharma King?
But Ding Ling also understood these soldiers.
Their martial strength was low, and most martial arts heroes had rough, wild temperaments. Once provoked, they could kill or injure without a second thought; it was no joke.
This world was not the historical one.
Martial arts experts were abundant, spread across the Ten Directions Realm.
These soldiers were evidently quite knowledgeable.
And Ding Ling, Little Dragon Girl, one exuding the demeanor of a Grandmaster, unshakable and majestic;
The other seemingly as beautiful as a Celestial Immortal, aloof and ethereal.
Both were equipped with Divine Swords.
At just a glance, the soldiers immediately made way.
Once inside Xiangyang City.
With a little inquiry, Ding Ling quickly knew Guo Jing’s location.
Following the map, he proceeded.
In no time.
He arrived at the Guo Mansion.
It was a mansion occupying quite a vast area.
Whether it was offered by Lü Wenhuan and his brother to please Guo Jing, or if some change had occurred recently and the Guo Jing couple unexpectedly acquired it?
What the truth was, Ding Ling did not know. He merely exchanged a glance with Little Dragon Girl before dismounting his horse and heading to knock on the door.
Knock, knock, knock!
With the sound of knocking at the door.
Not long after.
Accompanied by an impatient shout of ’Coming, coming’.
Crack!
The door opened, and a young man appeared at the entrance.

He had a distinguished appearance, handsome and appropriate, but at this moment his eyes were filled with irritation. He glanced at Ding Ling, his eyes shifted, and then fixed on Little Dragon Girl, with a look of admiration and awe flashing across his face and eyes.
Apparently, he was captivated and mesmerized by Little Dragon Girl’s beauty.
Little Dragon Girl frowned, slightly turned sideways, and stood behind Ding Ling, avoiding the young man’s gaze.

Seeing this, the young man’s face slightly heated up, he couldn’t help but cough dryly, looked at Ding Ling, sized him up and down twice, and realized Ding Ling was young yet dignified. He dared not underestimate him too much, and only said:
"I don’t know why you’re knocking on the Guo Mansion door? Do you even know the rules of the Guo Family?!"
"Oh?"
Ding Ling was puzzled:
"I have urgent matters with Hero Guo. But I don’t know what rules the Guo Family has?"
The young man seemed impatient, but thinking of Little Dragon Girl’s stunning beauty, his heart warmed, and he unwittingly spoke:
"Recently, the Hero Assembly has been holding. There are countless heroes and champions entering Xiangyang City. If everyone privately comes to knock on my master’s door...
How can my master get anything done?!
Can the Guo Family get a moment of peace?!"
The young man glanced at Ding Ling and snorted, saying:
"The rule is that no one should knock on the Guo Family’s door casually, nor secretly visit my master."
"Your master is Hero Guo?"
Ding Ling raised his brows:
"Are you Wu Dunru? Or Wu Xiwen?!"
"You actually know our Wu Brothers?!"
The young man grinned, seemingly quite proud:
"I didn’t expect our Wu Brothers to be so famous now."
He raised his brows and snorted:
"Then let me tell you, standing in front of you is the famous and world-renowned True Disciple of Hero Guo, Wu Xiwen!"
"Since you’re the Wu Brothers, then..."
Ding Ling clasped his fists in greeting and was about to say a few kind words but was rudely interrupted by Wu Xiwen:
"Who’s your brother? Don’t try to make connections with me here. Are you worthy?!"
He glanced at the figure behind Ding Ling:

"Hmph. If it wasn’t for the girl behind you, do you think I would waste this much time talking to you here? Look at how many elders and heroes have come to Xiangyang City, I haven’t entertained them. Who do you think you are?!"
Despite Ding Ling’s dignified demeanor.
But most martial artists are either heroic, imposing, or spirited.

Wu Xiwen is obviously insightful, seeing Ding Ling’s extraordinary appearance, although he didn’t underestimate him, but given he is Hero Guo Jing’s True Disciple, how could he care about ordinary martial heroes?
Seeing Ding Ling trying to bond like brothers, he immediately got angry:
"I’ve been clear enough with you, if you keep knocking, don’t blame me for being rude."
Ding Ling, helpless, thought no further, took out a letter from his pocket and handed it over:
"This is a letter specially written by Hong Qigong. I hope you can pass it to Hero Guo. Once he reads it, he’ll understand everything."
He spoke directly.
Wu Xiwen was startled, hurriedly received the letter, looked at it twice. The letter had no envelope, slightly unfolded, the content was visible.
Wu Xiwen took a glance, saw part of the content, couldn’t help but quickly skim it.

Saw it praised Ding Ling to the skies, saying he was the most talented, remarkable person old beggar had seen, that Central Divine Technique, Eastern Evil, and Western Poison were insignificant before Ding Ling, hoping Guo Jing could pass the entire Nine Yin Scripture to Ding Ling.
Seeing this.
Wu Xiwen was furious and shocked, just felt Ding Ling was too absurd, detestable, even the deception was crude.
"Do you even know who Central Divine Technique, Eastern Evil, and Western Poison are?!"
Wu Xiwen glared at Ding Ling.
"Of course, I know."
"If you know, you still dare to fake, create such a letter?!"
Wu Xiwen reached out wanting to tear the letter:
"Simply absurd, ridiculous. Too disgraceful, too hateful!"
Rip!
Wu Xiwen moved fast, he reached out and the letter was torn open.
Ding Ling was furious, turned his palm and struck at Wu Xiwen.
Slap!
Hit Wu Xiwen’s arm, causing him to cry out in pain, bones fracturing, both hands involuntarily released.
The letter fell.
Ding Ling reached out, grabbed it.
"You dare hit me?!"

Wu Xiwen, enraged, his arm powerless, his legs exerted Vigorous Qi, kicked at Ding Ling with all his might, seeing his gritted teeth, crazed anger, clearly unless Ding Ling was severely injured, he wouldn’t give up?
What kind of person is Ding Ling?
How could he tolerate it?
Immediately frowned, backhanded another palm strike!
Primordial Palm!
A powerful Qi shot out.
Slap!
Hit Wu Xiwen’s leg, made him scream again, Ding Ling took advantage, flipped his hand, slap!
A surge of palm power hit, directly knocked Wu Xiwen to the ground, rolled three zhang away, yet couldn’t get up for a while.
"Brother."
A more refined, composed young man seemed to hear the commotion, walked over from the side, seeing Wu Xiwen knocked down and wounded on the ground, screaming in pain.
Couldn’t help but be furious, without a word, gathered his Inner Power cultivation, rushed at Ding Ling like the wind.
Primordial Palm!
Ding Ling again casually swung a palm, slap!
Hit the young man’s face, knocked him flying one zhang away, heavily fell to the ground.
Poof!
He instantly spat out a thick mouthful of blood.
This blood seemed to contain a few teeth, quite obvious, Ding Ling’s slap caused him serious harm.
The young man realized he met a skillful adversary, couldn’t help but let out a long howl.
Boom!
A disheveled middle-aged man darted out sideways!
His hair was disheveled, face deeply wrinkled, seeing the Wu Brothers on the ground screaming, couldn’t help but rage, let out a roar.
Reached out his finger, pointed at Ding Ling in the air.
Swoosh!
A Vigorous Qi flew from his fingertip, like a thunderbolt, more like a ray, piercing through the void, seeming to penetrate everything.

Wu Xiwen is obviously insightful, seeing Ding Ling’s extraordinary appearance, although he didn’t underestimate him, but given he is Hero Guo Jing’s True Disciple, how could he care about ordinary martial heroes?
Seeing Ding Ling trying to bond like brothers, he immediately got angry:
"I’ve been clear enough with you, if you keep knocking, don’t blame me for being rude."
Ding Ling, helpless, thought no further, took out a letter from his pocket and handed it over:
"This is a letter specially written by Hong Qigong.
I hope you can pass it to Hero Guo.
Once he reads it, he’ll understand everything."
He spoke directly.
Wu Xiwen was startled, hurriedly received the letter, looked at it twice.
The letter had no envelope, slightly unfolded, the content was visible.
Wu Xiwen took a glance, saw part of the content, couldn’t help but quickly skim it.

Saw it praised Ding Ling to the skies, saying he was the most talented, remarkable person old beggar had seen, that Central Divine Technique, Eastern Evil, and Western Poison were insignificant before Ding Ling, hoping Guo Jing could pass the entire Nine Yin Scripture to Ding Ling.
Seeing this.
Wu Xiwen was furious and shocked, just felt Ding Ling was too absurd, detestable, even the deception was crude.
"Do you even know who Central Divine Technique, Eastern Evil, and Western Poison are?!"
Wu Xiwen glared at Ding Ling.
"Of course, I know."
"If you know, you still dare to fake, create such a letter?!"
Wu Xiwen reached out wanting to tear the letter:
"Simply absurd, ridiculous.
Too disgraceful, too hateful!"
Rip!
Wu Xiwen moved fast, he reached out and the letter was torn open.
Ding Ling was furious, turned his palm and struck at Wu Xiwen.
Slap!
Hit Wu Xiwen’s arm, causing him to cry out in pain, bones fracturing, both hands involuntarily released.
The letter fell.
Ding Ling reached out, grabbed it.
"You dare hit me?!"

Wu Xiwen, enraged, his arm powerless, his legs exerted Vigorous Qi, kicked at Ding Ling with all his might, seeing his gritted teeth, crazed anger, clearly unless Ding Ling was severely injured, he wouldn’t give up?
What kind of person is Ding Ling?
How could he tolerate it?
Immediately frowned, backhanded another palm strike!
Primordial Palm!
A powerful Qi shot out.
Slap!
Hit Wu Xiwen’s leg, made him scream again, Ding Ling took advantage, flipped his hand, slap!
A surge of palm power hit, directly knocked Wu Xiwen to the ground, rolled three zhang away, yet couldn’t get up for a while.
"Brother."
A more refined, composed young man seemed to hear the commotion, walked over from the side, seeing Wu Xiwen knocked down and wounded on the ground, screaming in pain.
Couldn’t help but be furious, without a word, gathered his Inner Power cultivation, rushed at Ding Ling like the wind.
Primordial Palm!
Ding Ling again casually swung a palm, slap!
Hit the young man’s face, knocked him flying one zhang away, heavily fell to the ground.
Poof!
He instantly spat out a thick mouthful of blood.
This blood seemed to contain a few teeth, quite obvious, Ding Ling’s slap caused him serious harm.
The young man realized he met a skillful adversary, couldn’t help but let out a long howl.
Boom!
A disheveled middle-aged man darted out sideways!
His hair was disheveled, face deeply wrinkled, seeing the Wu Brothers on the ground screaming, couldn’t help but rage, let out a roar.
Reached out his finger, pointed at Ding Ling in the air.
Swoosh!
A Vigorous Qi flew from his fingertip, like a thunderbolt, more like a ray, piercing through the void, seeming to penetrate everything.

chapters.title: Chapter 445: Guo Jing
paragraphs: ’One Yang Finger?!’

Ding Ling’s eyebrows twitched. He deployed the Bird-Catching Skill, moving like the wind, and lightly pulled Little Dragon Girl to the left to dodge slightly, then surged forward another yard, perfectly avoiding this finger strike. He then activated the Nine Yang Divine Skill and Breathing Technique, driving the Fusion Qi into motion! Boom!

The speed of the Bird-Catching Skill was so fast it was difficult for the naked eye to discern. In just a breath’s time, Ding Ling maneuvered to the side of the middle-aged man. His palm flipped slightly, and a move called Prideful Dragon’s Regret was unleashed!
Roar!

A faint dragon’s roar seemed audible, and a vague dragon shadow appeared to spiral forth from his palm, boom! It hit directly against another Finger Force that the middle-aged man had struck out like lightning!
Crackling!

The Palm Force and Finger Force clashed and confronted each other in the void for just a moment. The palm shadow, with the momentum of Mount Tai crushing an egg, crashed heavily onto the middle-aged man’s middle finger, forcibly breaking it!
The mighty Palm Power, akin to Mountain Shifting and Sea Overturning, continued to overwhelm him as if intending to crush him into meat paste!

Seeing that in just an instant, this Palm Power had already broken the middle-aged man’s arm and was about to kill him, another person suddenly dashed out from the side. Shouting loudly, ’Spare him under your palm,’ he struck a move of Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms towards Ding Ling, attempting to save one by distracting the other.
Seeing this, Ding Ling kicked out, sending the middle-aged man flying several yards away. He then turned, and with a reverse strike, unleashed a Dragon Battle in the Wilderness, boom!
His palm collided heavily with the newcomer’s, and for a moment, only fierce wind arose, and the sound of dragon roars resonated in all directions!
The newcomer groaned, flew back several yards, and looked at Ding Ling with doubt and uncertainty:
’Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms?! Who on earth are you?!’

Ding Ling saw that the newcomer had a firm appearance, bright eyes, stood tall and straight, and was quite impressive. Thinking about the move of Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms that had already reached Mastery, he guessed the newcomer’s identity and said:
’Are you Hero Guo, Guo Jing?’
’I am unworthy of being called Hero Guo. I am Guo Jing.’
Guo Jing clasped his hands in greeting, spoke neither humbly nor arrogantly:
’I don’t know how my two disciples offended you for you to treat them this way?’
’Master.’
The scholarly man next to Wu Xiwen must be Wu Dunru. He had been struck hard, blood frothed at his mouth, and he looked at Ding Ling with hatred:

’This man shows no mercy, he must be ruthless. We have no right to care how he came to Xiangyang City, but he dares to blatantly cause trouble in our Guo Family, and that is truly detestable, unforgivable.’
’Exactly, exactly.’
Wu Xiwen, his arms and legs broken, lay on the ground unable to get up, wailing. At this moment, he couldn’t hold back from speaking either:
’This man is too ruthless. He broke the arms and legs of your disciple. Master, you must avenge me!’
’Ah!’

Before Guo Jing could speak, the middle-aged man once again charged at Ding Ling like a mad tiger. His right hand was broken, but his left hand was still usable. He flew in and pointed at Ding Ling, launching another Finger Force.
Guo Jing was shocked and quickly said:
’Wu Santong, calm down!’
Humph!
Ding Ling, adept in his Lightweight Skill, snorted, pulled Little Dragon Girl into a casual spin, and dodged this One Yang Finger.
The middle-aged man was indeed Wu Santong, and Ding Ling became increasingly certain this was One Yang Finger.
It was indeed quite remarkable.
Very fast, the Finger Force could attack from a distance, not inferior to ancient versions of firearms.
But Wu Santong’s Kung Fu was not fully mastered, and in Ding Ling’s eyes, his One Yang Finger was full of flaws and could easily be countered.
’Ah!’
Wu Santong, seeing Ding Ling dodge his One Yang Finger again, grew even more enraged and maniacal, attempting another attack. Guo Jing had already leapt over, grabbing hold of Wu Santong:
’Wu Santong, stop!’
’This man injured my sons and broke my hand, how can I just let it go!’ Wu Santong glared at Ding Ling, full of hatred.
’Did you ever think that if he hadn’t held back, you might not even be alive?’ Guo Jing said loudly.
Clearly, these words were meant for Ding Ling.
It was evident that while Guo Jing was somewhat naive in his youth, years spent with Huang Rong had influenced him to become more mature and steady.
He understood the ways of dealing with people.
But such a significant event happening here.
It prompted quite a few people to gather from the surrounding yards.
There were men and women, young and old.
There were dozens of them.
Ding Ling stood still, hands behind his back, eyes deep, expression calm, without a trace of fear.
Little Dragon Girl stood prettily beside Ding Ling, her eyes only on him, indifferent to how many people appeared in Guo Mansion, not wishing to look at anyone else.
In her eyes, Ding Ling was the World’s Number One, invincible, unmatchable!
But if such a person did appear.
She would instantly charge out to fight them alongside Ding Ling.
’Father.’
A charming young girl, with skin like jade and eyes like paintings, emerged with a blind old man.
The girl called out to Guo Jing, glanced at the pitiful state of the Wu brothers, and blurted out at the sight of Ding Ling:’
’I think the Wu brothers are right. This person has treated them so badly. How can we let him go easily?’
Obviously.

The Wu brothers’ hysterical screams had reached her ears from a distance, and she ran over here to say this, without considering whether these words would anger Ding Ling. She opened her mouth and continued:

’There are so many of us, and Father, you are the renowned Hero Guo, with the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms that none can withstand. The opponent is only two people, and both young, how can they resist you, Father? You should not be soft-hearted and spare such evil people, otherwise, how should the Wu brothers cope...’
Before she could finish her sentence.
A middle-aged beautiful woman stepped out, pulled the charming young girl aside, and glared at her:
’Fu’Er! Shut your mouth!’
’Mother!’
The young girl was indignant, pouting, ’I wasn’t wrong.’
’I told you to shut up.’
Even though the beautiful woman was somewhat older, she remained exceedingly attractive.
At this moment, she glared at the girl, her charm and elegance could even surpass the peonies in full bloom in the courtyard.
’If you’re not told to speak, don’t speak!’
’Alright.’
The charming young girl, seeing the woman’s stern expression and harsh eyes, became a bit frightened and timidly replied, pulling the blind old man to the side.
The blind old man frowned as if he wanted to say something, but in the end, he only tugged the girl’s sleeve and spoke softly, ’Fu’Er, tell me about what happened on the scene, who the visitor is.’
’Alright, grandfather...’
The charming young girl recounted the scene with vivid words.
The beautiful woman, however, walked up to Guo Jing, persuaded Wu Santong, and then they both turned to look at Ding Ling.

chapters.title: Chapter 446: Huang Rong
paragraphs: "Who might you be?"

Guo Jing’s heart was truly puzzled, shocked to the extreme. Although his recent exchange with Ding Ling was brief, he had already sensed that Ding Ling’s remarkably grand and profound palm power was exactly the same as his own Dragon Subduing Palm Power!
Moreover, the opponent’s Dragon Subduing Palm Power was even more vigorous, tyrannical, and fierce than his own!
If not for his deep skill, the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms had already reached Great Perfection.
Just now, in the clash of palms, it was almost certain that his hand would have been crushed!
Thinking of this, Guo Jing’s heart shivered. He tightened his grip on Wu Santong, signaling him to remain calm, while his piercing gaze fixed unblinkingly on Ding Ling:

"You are so young, yet have mastered the essence of the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms! Your skill is so profound, I am indeed ashamed in comparison. I wonder which family’s disciple you are, and which master taught such a remarkable talent like you?!"
Guo Jing’s voice was loud and clear.
He made no effort to hide anything.
The people around could hear clearly.
Everyone’s expression changed in astonishment.
Some suspected that Guo Jing was merely being modest.
Others, who knew Guo Jing’s nature, realized he wouldn’t exaggerate, and thus grew even more cautious and scrutinizing of Ding Ling.

Those at a loss were the Wu Brothers, who were overturned on the ground. Hearing Guo Jing speak in such a way, it was clear he wasn’t planning to avenge them, causing them to look at each other in dismay, feeling somewhat despondent. At this moment, they felt as if they had fallen into an abyss, abandoned like discarded trash, their desolation and dismay extremely apparent.
The sprightly young girl was conversing with a blind old man, her eyes constantly scanning for signs. Seeing the Wu Brothers in such a state, she couldn’t help but feel compassion.

The Wu Brothers shared a deep bond with her. Seeing them beaten so badly, her own father not avenging them, but rather praising the enemy, anger welled up within her, and she couldn’t help but say furiously:
"Father has such profound skill, not even Grandfather dares to claim victory. This person looks so young; starting martial training from birth wouldn’t make him stronger than Father.
Why does Father have to destroy our own prestige to praise others?!
You must know they’ve seriously injured the Wu Brothers and their family! If we forgive this, I..."
"Fu’er."
The beautiful woman beside Guo Jing couldn’t help but scold her sternly:
"I told you to shut up, didn’t you hear?!"
The sprightly young girl was frightened, her face turning white, her pretty almond eyes brimming red with tears in an instant, feeling deeply wronged.
In all her years, it was the first time her mother had scolded her so harshly, especially under the watchful eyes of everyone, right under the enemy’s nose!
This was an unprecedented occurrence.
Her heart couldn’t help but ache, feeling sad. She stood to the side, feeling deeply wronged, yet unable to stop herself from sobbing.
It was clear the sprightly young girl felt humiliated and disgraced, ashamed and furious to death!

The blind old man, with acute hearing, clearly heard the commotion and felt great compassion for the sprightly young girl. Seeing her crying in grievance, he couldn’t contain his anger, forcefully tapping his cane on the ground, making loud thumping sounds:
"No matter who the newcomer is, no matter how profound their skill, harming members of the Guo Family is unforgivable! Jing’er..."
He looked in Guo Jing’s direction and shouted:
"You must not soften your stance."
"I understand, Master."
Guo Jing nodded reluctantly, giving the beautiful woman a glance.
The beautiful woman understood Guo Jing very well and approached the blind old man, whispering a few words near his ear. The blind old man’s heart jolted, quieting instantly.
No one knew what the beautiful woman said.
Only Ding Ling vaguely overheard snippets about Guo Jing not lying and the newcomer being a terrifyingly supreme master.
The blind old man, though unafraid of masters or death, realized that causing a disturbance affecting the Guo Jing couple was inappropriate, so he suppressed his displeasure, contemplating inwardly:
"When time permits, I, old blind man, must find this person and spar a bit!"
"My master is straightforward and blunt, yet harbors no malice."
Guo Jing proactively introduced his side, pointing at the beautiful woman:
"This is my wife, Huang Rong. She is also the current Beggar Gang Leader."
Pointing at the sprightly young girl:
"That is my daughter, Guo Fu."
Pointing at the blind old man:
"My master, Ke Zhen’e."
Pointing at the scholarly man holding a brush:
"The top calligrapher of the south, disciple of Master Yideng, Zhu Ziliu."
Pointing at a dark-skinned, raggedly clothed, kindly-looking man:
"Beggar Gang’s nine-bag Elder, Loyal and Righteous Luu Youjiao."
A number of people were introduced one by one by Guo Jing. Afterwards, he looked at Ding Ling and cupped his hands:
"I, Guo Jing, walk upright and sit with a clear conscience. Who are you, kind sir? Please clarify."
"I am Ding Ling."
Ding Ling replied with a calm expression.
Just a single sentence.
Yet it caused many to change their expression.
Although, most people still didn’t react.
Evidently, Ding Ling’s deeds weren’t widely known.
Even those who knew might not entirely believe, as it sounded quite absurd.

Moreover, a common name isn’t uncommon; Ding Ling being so young, accompanied by a cold and beautiful girl resembling the moon goddess Chang’e, naturally makes it normal not to associate him with the infamous "Ten Thousand Butcher" Ding Ling.
Only Huang Rong’s pretty face changed slightly, asking hesitantly:
"Are you the Hero Ding who crushed Kublai’s elite army? Ding Ling, the Hero Ding?"
This comment was somewhat insincere.
Or rather.
Craftily stated.
Without directly revealing Ding Ling’s feats of defeating Shaolin’s high monks, she mentioned Ding Ling’s admirable side.
She even respectfully referred to Ding Ling as Hero.
Which testifies to Huang Rong’s skillfulness.
Others hearing Huang Rong thus enlightened.
Those in the know gasped, faces changing, eyes filled with fear;
The unaware, seeing those informed become fearful of Ding Ling, couldn’t help but feel a chill and take two steps back, daring not to underestimate or antagonize Ding Ling, lest they invite calamity.
Clever individuals were indeed more prevalent.
Knowing Ding Ling’s prowess, who would dare provoke him?
Especially seeing Ding Ling calmly confirm himself as Ding Ling who crushed a vast army, causing a stir!
But they were, after all, martial arts figures, extraordinary ones. Guo Jing, more so a hero of the times, said without hesitation:
"Since it’s Hero Ding in person, may I ask what grudge exists between our families that prompted you to act so ruthlessly against the juniors?"
Ding Ling admitted his true identity.
Instantly upgrading from a young man to a ’senior.’
The Wu Brothers were instantly relegated from peers to juniors in the presence of Ding Ling.
Wu Xiwen and Wu Dunru, hearing this, felt tumultuous, waves crashing inside, struggling to remain calm.
Especially Wu Xiwen.
Recalling past insults, disdain, and contempt towards Ding Ling, his face flushed, ashamed unto death!
Ding Ling, this master, with such an identity, treated him courteously, addressing him as Brother Wu.
Yet he assumed Ding Ling was trying to ascend through him!
Such a formidable person.
Why bother claiming brotherhood with him?
Claiming brotherhood with him was considering him Wu Xiwen!
But how did he respond?! Realizing this, Wu Xiwen felt even the pain faded somewhat, deeper feelings of unease and apprehension troubled him.
Nonetheless, there was anger and hatred, albeit temporarily suppressed due to Ding Ling’s staggering identity shock.

Pointing at a dark-skinned, raggedly clothed, kindly-looking man:
"Beggar Gang’s nine-bag Elder, Loyal and Righteous Luu Youjiao."
A number of people were introduced one by one by Guo Jing.
Afterwards, he looked at Ding Ling and cupped his hands:
"I, Guo Jing, walk upright and sit with a clear conscience.
Who are you, kind sir?
Please clarify."
"I am Ding Ling."
Ding Ling replied with a calm expression.
Just a single sentence.
Yet it caused many to change their expression.
Although, most people still didn’t react.
Evidently, Ding Ling’s deeds weren’t widely known.
Even those who knew might not entirely believe, as it sounded quite absurd.

Moreover, a common name isn’t uncommon; Ding Ling being so young, accompanied by a cold and beautiful girl resembling the moon goddess Chang’e, naturally makes it normal not to associate him with the infamous "Ten Thousand Butcher" Ding Ling.
Only Huang Rong’s pretty face changed slightly, asking hesitantly:
"Are you the Hero Ding who crushed Kublai’s elite army?
Ding Ling, the Hero Ding?"
This comment was somewhat insincere.
Or rather.
Craftily stated.
Without directly revealing Ding Ling’s feats of defeating Shaolin’s high monks, she mentioned Ding Ling’s admirable side.
She even respectfully referred to Ding Ling as Hero.
Which testifies to Huang Rong’s skillfulness.
Others hearing Huang Rong thus enlightened.
Those in the know gasped, faces changing, eyes filled with fear;
The unaware, seeing those informed become fearful of Ding Ling, couldn’t help but feel a chill and take two steps back, daring not to underestimate or antagonize Ding Ling, lest they invite calamity.
Clever individuals were indeed more prevalent.
Knowing Ding Ling’s prowess, who would dare provoke him?
Especially seeing Ding Ling calmly confirm himself as Ding Ling who crushed a vast army, causing a stir!
But they were, after all, martial arts figures, extraordinary ones.
Guo Jing, more so a hero of the times, said without hesitation:
"Since it’s Hero Ding in person, may I ask what grudge exists between our families that prompted you to act so ruthlessly against the juniors?"
Ding Ling admitted his true identity.
Instantly upgrading from a young man to a ’senior.’
The Wu Brothers were instantly relegated from peers to juniors in the presence of Ding Ling.
Wu Xiwen and Wu Dunru, hearing this, felt tumultuous, waves crashing inside, struggling to remain calm.
Especially Wu Xiwen.
Recalling past insults, disdain, and contempt towards Ding Ling, his face flushed, ashamed unto death!
Ding Ling, this master, with such an identity, treated him courteously, addressing him as Brother Wu.
Yet he assumed Ding Ling was trying to ascend through him!
Such a formidable person.
Why bother claiming brotherhood with him?
Claiming brotherhood with him was considering him Wu Xiwen!
But how did he respond?!
Realizing this, Wu Xiwen felt even the pain faded somewhat, deeper feelings of unease and apprehension troubled him.
Nonetheless, there was anger and hatred, albeit temporarily suppressed due to Ding Ling’s staggering identity shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 447: Negotiated! Wu Santong
paragraphs: Ding Ling’s Observing People Skill, acting, psychology, and other skills were all Full Level, seen in his eyes.
He naturally knew what everyone was thinking.
Not saying he knew everything, but he could grasp most of it. Hearing Guo Jing’s words, he couldn’t help but take out a letter and said:
"I came with goodwill, but received the most rude treatment. Even the letter from Elder Hong Qigong was torn by your people.
I acted out of anger, but more so to protect the letter."
Guo Jing was moved:
"Is it really from Elder Gang Leader Hong?!"
"Take a look and you’ll know."
Ding Ling handed over the torn letter.
The letter was torn in two.
Because Ding Ling acted in time to rescue it, it wasn’t torn into pieces.

Wu Xiwen saw this, and his heart sank involuntarily. He had previously scorned and envied Ding Ling, thinking that although Ding Ling appeared talented, he was actually nothing but superficial. He suspected Ding Ling had deceived an innocent, exceptionally beautiful young girl and then came over to trick his master into teaching the Nine Yin Scripture, which is why he tore up the letter without hesitation.
Thinking of it now.
His actions were indeed very inappropriate.
Not only did he offend by reading someone’s letter, but after reading most of it, he even intended to destroy it, which was clearly a deliberate provocation!
"This..."
Guo Jing put the torn letter together, carefully comparing, observing, and examining it.
After reading.
He felt a surge of disbelief in his heart, astonished at how highly Hong Qigong praised Ding Ling!
Huang Rong also looked and was secretly amazed.
It was completely different from what she thought.
Hong Qigong emphasized Ding Ling’s talent, character, and Little Dragon Girl’s innocence and kindness in the letter.
He mentioned that he himself had taught the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms and Dog Beating Stick Technique to Ding Ling and his wife.
Seeing this.
Huang Rong couldn’t help but change color and became emotional, thinking to herself:
"The Dog Beating Stick Technique is a Supreme Skill that only the Beggar Gang Leaders have traditionally been able to learn. The Elder Gang Leader Hong actually let Ding Ling and his wife learn it.
This indicates a desire to pass on the Gang Leader position to them. It’s clear that this couple’s character must have received his elder’s high recognition."
Huang Rong read the letter several times, confirming a few things, and thought:

"Although Ding Ling is known as the Murderous Demon King, many people are extremely wary and disgusted with him, but it cannot be denied that as the story of him hammering to death Kublai’s Great Army spread. The public’s appraisal of him was unexpectedly good.
This might be related to Shaolin Temple monks’ usual inaction."
The monks rarely participated in events like the ’Hero Assembly.’

Acts of chivalry and righteousness were hardly heard. Naturally, the recognition from the Great Song’s people was not high, though the tale of Ding Ling killing monks spread as crazily as his tale of destroying Mongolia’s army.
Yet among civilians, the reviews were extremely good, while within the Martial Arts circle, opinions were divided, making it hard to say clearly whether Ding Ling was good or bad.
Especially now that Huang Rong knew Ding Ling might have wreaked havoc at the Quanzhen Sect, killing Qiu Chuji, her judgment inclined towards Ding Ling being an untrustworthy villain!
But Quanzhen Sect’s Sect Leader Ma Yu and others hadn’t spoken a single bad word about Ding Ling, nor had any rumors emerged, which secretly amazed Huang Rong.
Now seeing Hong Qigong’s letter, it stirred a storm in her heart, overturning some previous assumptions, she thought silently:

"I know Elder Hong Qigong’s character best, he is known for his fierce hatred of evil. Since he confirmed Ding Ling and his wife’s character, it shows that this couple’s moral character is indeed outstanding."

He glanced at Wu Xiwen, seeing his uneasy, anxious expression, and then looked at the torn letter, a thought turned in his mind, guessing that the cause of this matter must be his side’s poor reception!
Or perhaps the attitude was bad, indeed as Ding Ling said, they directly acted to tear up the letter. The conflict occurring was indeed only natural.

Thinking this way, although his view of Ding Ling improved slightly, he was not prepared to harp on this matter. After all, the Wu Brothers were his own people, Ding Ling an outsider, it wasn’t good to insult the Wu Brothers again for an outsider.
Moreover, the Wu Brothers were now severely injured, how could they bear further humiliation?
What would outsiders think of their couple?
Thoughtfully figuring it out, Huang Rong was about to speak.
But Guo Jing spoke first:

"Indeed, it’s the handwriting of the Elder Gang Leader, no mistake. Moreover, there’s a special stamp from the Elder Gang Leader at the end, which ordinary people couldn’t imitate, how could it be fake?"
Guo Jing’s eyes shone brightly as he looked at Ding Ling:

"Since it’s an instruction from the Elder Gang Leader, I naturally wouldn’t refuse. How about this, Hero Ding, if you and your wife don’t mind, have a meal here first, then we’ll discuss the Nine Yin Scripture."
"No need for the meal."
Ding Ling observed the crowd, most of whom harbored suspicion, hostility, and dislike towards him, and couldn’t help raising his eyebrows:
"Hero Guo, let’s settle this quickly. We can go aside to discuss the Nine Yin Scripture matters. Once you teach me this True Scripture, I will naturally fulfill my agreement with Elder Hong."
"Alright."
Guo Jing was very sincere. After confirming several times that the letter was accurate, he nodded and said, "I’ll teach you now."
Huang Rong watched from the side, feeling quite helpless, wanting to interrupt and say something to delay or stop this matter.
But for the moment, she couldn’t find an excuse.
Especially when she thought of Ding Ling’s terrifying martial power.
Previously, the Wu Brothers and Wu Santong survived, clearly because Ding Ling held back. If he had attacked with full force, how could these three still have their lives?
If someone were to try and stop him now, provoking Ding Ling even more, wouldn’t that be making things worse?
Thinking this way, Huang Rong found it inappropriate to say anything further.

Yet, she was genuinely puzzled; Ding Ling was already invincible with Divine Skill, learned the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms and Dog Beating Stick Technique, and yet he wanted to learn Nine Yin Scripture as well?!
Thinking it through like this.
But seeing Guo Jing actually taking Ding Ling to the inner courtyard to impart the Nine Yin Scripture, she sighed inwardly, realizing it would be even harder to stop now.
On the side, Guo Fu was quite displeased, pouting and humming occasionally.
The Wu Brothers didn’t say anything, only Wu Santong kept muttering about revenge.
Couldn’t defeat Ding Ling.
Wu Santong noticed that Little Dragon Girl didn’t follow Ding Ling into the inner courtyard, his eyes lit up, he laughed loudly and pointed towards Little Dragon Girl!
One Yang Finger!
Finger Force was fierce and sharp, shooting out like a bolt of lightning.
Little Dragon Girl’s heart and eyes were all focused on Ding Ling, simply staring at the direction of the inner courtyard.
And so she didn’t notice the Finger Force shooting towards her from the side.
Huang Rong saw it, couldn’t help but exclaim:
"Little Dragon Girl, watch out!"
Ding Ling had introduced Little Dragon Girl.
So naturally, Huang Rong knew Little Dragon Girl’s name.

And she also knew Little Dragon Girl must occupy an extremely important place in Ding Ling’s heart. From the way the couple were inseparable, sweetly affectionate like glue, one could discern at least a little.
If Little Dragon Girl were seriously injured here, Ding Ling might go berserk, the more she thought about it, the more Huang Rong feared, unable to resist glaring at Wu Santong.
Over there, Little Dragon Girl heard the sound and looked towards Huang Rong.

Upon looking, she saw the Finger Force shooting towards her position. Her pretty eyebrows knit slightly, Bird-Catching Skill activated, under the Fusion Qi of Breathing Technique and Inner Power, boom!
Speed exploded, like light and electricity, nimbly dodging the attack.
Poof!
The Finger Force hit the wall beside Little Dragon Girl, actually piercing the wall with a small hole two inches deep.
One can imagine.
If just now that finger had landed on Little Dragon Girl.
She wouldn’t die but would be severely injured.
Little Dragon Girl was serene by nature, didn’t react much to this, simply wondering ’why would this person attack me, I didn’t provoke him? Could it be because my husband fought him?’
Thinking this way, yet she had no intention of making a move.
Unless it involved Ding Ling’s life and safety, she was generally indifferent, appearing aloof and icy!
Huang Rong noticed, her heart settled, increasingly convinced by Elder Hong’s words.
Elder Hong said Little Dragon Girl was pure and kind, like a breeze and bright moon.

Huang Rong’s keen eyes were exceptional, a brief encounter with Little Dragon Girl made her realize she was indeed an innocent and lovely maiden, seeing Wu Santong still wanting to act, she couldn’t help but stop him, sternly saying:
"Do you realize the consequences of angering Ding Ling?!"
"He crippled and injured our father and sons, I cripple and injure his wife, this is fair, cause and effect. Don’t stop me. I must cripple her today!"
Wu Santong lately was somewhat irrational, maniacal, hard to restrain when his craze flared up.
Huang Rong had to give Zhu Ziliu a look, whereupon Zhu Ziliu swiftly struck, a hand chop knocking Wu Santong unconscious.
The Wu Brothers saw this and couldn’t help but shout.
Huang Rong coldly looked at them:
"I’ll settle with you later."
Having said that, she ordered Wu Brothers to be carried into the house to recuperate.
Just now Huang Rong had felt their bones.
Though fractured, if the bones were set timely, they could be saved.
Clearly.
Ding Ling indeed held back.
Reflecting on Wu Santong’s actions towards Little Dragon Girl just now, Huang Rong couldn’t help but feel uneasy, sighed, and approached Little Dragon Girl saying:
"Earlier, Wu Santong wanted to harm you, could you not mention it to your husband?"

chapters.title: Chapter 448: Guo Fu Fears Being Beaten to Death
paragraphs: "Why?"
Little Dragon Girl glanced sideways, puzzled, her pair of cold, clear eyes devoid of any impurity, making it obvious at first sight that she was an innocent and extremely pure young woman:
"Anything my husband wants to know, I will tell him. I feel there’s nothing I need to hide from him."
Huang Rong listened, moved, and couldn’t help but engage in a thoughtful conversation with her.
The more they talked,
the more Huang Rong was convinced of her earlier guess.
This Little Dragon Girl was indeed just as Hong Qigong had described.
Even more charming and innocent than Hong Qigong had said.
Huang Rong sighed in her heart, how could such a girl be a villain?
There must be some hidden truth about the incident at Shaolin Temple.
Thinking of this, she couldn’t resist asking.
Little Dragon Girl did not hide, she simply said:

"Those Shaolin High Monks accused my husband of stealing their True Scripture. But we had just arrived at the foot of Mount Songh, we never even ascended the mountain, how could we have stolen the True Scripture?
They didn’t believe it..."
Little Dragon Girl’s voice was as clear and cool as a mountain spring crossing a stream, exceptionally pleasant and melodious.
When she spoke, she did not exaggerate, one meant one, two meant two, straightforward and forthright, pure and unclouded.
Huang Rong, after listening to her, was momentarily dumbfounded, considering:

"If it’s truly as Little Dragon Girl says, then Ding Ling’s furious massacre can be understood. Alas. Initially thought Ding Ling was the Great Demon, but now it seems, Ding Ling isn’t one to make trouble for no reason or murder without cause.
He is actually a very principled and righteous person.
Such a person being appreciated by the old Gang Leader is quite logical. But is Little Dragon Girl seeing a Xi Shi through her lover’s eyes?"
Huang Rong tested again.
She was clever, quick-witted, and shrewd to the extreme.
How could this super recluse, super innocent Little Dragon Girl be her match?
In just a few exchanges, everything she had was laid bare, every word spoken clearly and completely.
Huang Rong got her answer and couldn’t help but sigh.
She thought to herself:

"From Little Dragon Girl’s words and expressions, one can tell she truly has deep affection for Ding Ling! Adoration to the extreme! And her interactions and encounters with Ding Ling were all shared openly.
It’s rather clear.
Ding Ling is frank and straightforward, decisive in action!
He lacked any baseness or vileness, and when Little Dragon Girl was severely injured, he didn’t take advantage to do anything sordid. It was even Little Dragon Girl who pursued him actively.
Obviously, Ding Ling is indeed not bad at all. It’s just that his inclination towards violence is a bit too pronounced."
And it is this decisiveness towards violence.
That made Huang Rong quite apprehensive and cautious.
In other aspects, Ding Ling is neither humble nor arrogant, courteous and proper, cheerful and magnanimous, straightforward as a winnowing fan, in no way inferior to a typical gentleman or overlord.
This deeply impressed Huang Rong.
However, this tendency toward violence, Huang Rong found hard to agree with.
Yet thinking of the current chaotic world, it indeed needs someone like Ding Ling, who is decisive in action, to restore order, so she sighed again, getting a bit lost in thought:
"Does the old Gang Leader see this as well, which is why he wants Ding Ling to assist us?
Thinking this,
she thought of the Wu Brothers, Wu Santong, Guo Fu, and others.
Unable to resist, she bade farewell to Little Dragon Girl, and went inside the courtyard to find Guo Fu, Ke Zhen’e, and others, specifically instructing them.
Guo Fu was extremely frustrated, having been publicly scolded by Huang Rong, and now being reprimanded privately, she couldn’t help but feel discontent, saying crisply:

"Mother, what is there to fear about Ding Ling? You are the Hero Guo revered across Jiuzhou, and one of the most famous Gang Leaders of the Beggar Gang. My grandfather is one of the Five Extremes in Martial Arts, Island Master of Peach Blossom Island.
In this world, who is there that we need to fear or be cautious of?! Ding Ling? He doesn’t deserve that!"
Ke Zhen’e said nothing nearby, only sighing somewhat gloomily. Obviously, not speaking out to rebuke or criticize Ding Ling was something exceedingly frustrating and unpleasant for him!
"What do you know?!"
Huang Rong glared, chastising:
"If I don’t stop you in time, offending Ding Ling, even ten lives wouldn’t be enough for him to spare."
"Would he dare kill me?!"
Guo Fu did not believe it:
"With my father and mother, and my grandfather around, would he dare to act?!"
"Don’t be skeptical."
Huang Rong shook her head, her expression complex as she said:
"Ding Ling is indeed one of the most rare strongmen in the world, let alone your father, mother, and grandfather. Even if more people came, they would likely be defeated by him."
"How could he be that strong?!"
Guo Fu’s face changed dramatically, unbelieving:
"Mother, it’s one thing for Father to say that, but why are you saying it too?! Is he really that scary?"
"He is extremely frightening!"
Huang Rong affirmed:

"Do you know how formidable Kublai’s subordinate Kebineng of Mongolia is? In just a few days, he accomplished great feats, winning several major victories! Yet such a character, leading over ten thousand elite troops and countless martial arts heroes,
was still killed by Ding Ling..."
Huang Rong meticulously recounted the process.
She had heard bits from the Little Dragon Girl and gathered more information from elsewhere.
Consolidating it all together.
’Processed’ ’turned into’ ’a work of art’!
At this moment, with her inflection and tone, it was like a storyteller narrating a tale.
Guo Fu and Ke Zhen’e listened in a daze.
The Wu Brothers, not far off, also listened clearly, and could not help but be so frightened they almost rolled onto the ground.
They truly hadn’t expected Ding Ling to be so fierce and terrifying!
Guo Fu, after listening, turned pale as paper, somewhat frightened, rather fearful, yet somewhat disbelieving:
"How could there be such a terrifying person in the world?"
"That’s just how it is."
Huang Rong sighed:
"If I hadn’t heard it with my own ears, I wouldn’t believe it either.
"Is that what the Little Dragon Girl said?"
Guo Fu pouted and said:
"She’s biased towards her own husband, so she purposefully exaggerates."
"Little Dragon Girl isn’t the kind of person you think she is."
Huang Rong said:
"Your mother can still tell who’s lying and who’s not. The Little Dragon Girl is very easy to get along with, an extremely pure and kind girl. You mustn’t bully her!"
"How would I dare?"
Guo Fu said, feeling wronged:
"You’ve painted Ding Ling as so terrifying. If I bullied his wife, wouldn’t he beat me to death?!"
"It’s good that you know!"
Huang Rong sighed:
"I’m also doing this for your sake. You’re young and inexperienced, spoiled by us since childhood! Reckless and rude! It’s fine if you offend some people, but is Ding Ling someone you can provoke?
I’m afraid that if you, without discretion, act like you usually do, oblivious to etiquette, and end up provoking Ding Ling, your father and I will find it very hard to cope."
"I got it."
Guo Fu, her fair face scrunched into a frown:
"I’ll definitely keep far away from Ding Ling and his wife, and if I see them, I’ll go around three feet away!"
Huang Rong, upon hearing this, initially wanted to say: ’You don’t need to go that far, just remember to be polite and cautious.’
But knowing Guo Fu’s disposition, she quickly quashed the thought, only considering:
"This is also fine; without interaction, it’s less likely for conflicts to arise. If not, this Fu’Er girl, usually coddled and unrestrained, cannot endure even the slightest grievance.
If pushed to the brink.
There’s no telling she might really do something irrational. Both sides keeping their distance might be the best."
Today, merely a few stern words to Guo Fu,
and she’s already moved to tears.
Huang Rong saw this, feeling both worried and vexed, also understanding that they have placed too much importance on Guo Fu, allowing her to develop bad habits.
This temperament is usually just fine.
But if she falls into Ding Ling’s hands, a good outcome is hard to imagine. Ding Ling is certainly not one to show mercy.
From the way he killed Li Mochou.
To his straightforward behavior with the Little Dragon Girl.
You can see bits of it.

Though this person has delicate aspects, and treats the Little Dragon Girl very well, if there is no emotional connection with him, or without his approval, no matter how beautiful you are, he will still hit or kill without hesitation.
Thinking this far.
Huang Rong couldn’t help but remind Guo Fu again.
Guo Fu, being reprimanded, became irritated and felt wronged.
Huang Rong didn’t care, only growing stricter.
Ke Zhen’e, unable to bear it, tried to mediate.
Huang Rong couldn’t help but say a few words to Ke Zhen’e as well.
Ke Zhen’e, unable to save face, snorted in anger and pounded the ground with his cane as he stomped off!

sentences.text: "Why?"
Little Dragon Girl glanced sideways, puzzled, her pair of cold, clear eyes devoid of any impurity, making it obvious at first sight that she was an innocent and extremely pure young woman:
"Anything my husband wants to know, I will tell him.
I feel there’s nothing I need to hide from him."
Huang Rong listened, moved, and couldn’t help but engage in a thoughtful conversation with her.
The more they talked,
the more Huang Rong was convinced of her earlier guess.
This Little Dragon Girl was indeed just as Hong Qigong had described.
Even more charming and innocent than Hong Qigong had said.
Huang Rong sighed in her heart, how could such a girl be a villain?
There must be some hidden truth about the incident at Shaolin Temple.
Thinking of this, she couldn’t resist asking.
Little Dragon Girl did not hide, she simply said:
"Those Shaolin High Monks accused my husband of stealing their True Scripture.
But we had just arrived at the foot of Mount Songh, we never even ascended the mountain, how could we have stolen the True Scripture?
They didn’t believe it..."
Little Dragon Girl’s voice was as clear and cool as a mountain spring crossing a stream, exceptionally pleasant and melodious.
When she spoke, she did not exaggerate, one meant one, two meant two, straightforward and forthright, pure and unclouded.
Huang Rong, after listening to her, was momentarily dumbfounded, considering:
"If it’s truly as Little Dragon Girl says, then Ding Ling’s furious massacre can be understood.
Alas.
Initially thought Ding Ling was the Great Demon, but now it seems, Ding Ling isn’t one to make trouble for no reason or murder without cause.
He is actually a very principled and righteous person.
Such a person being appreciated by the old Gang Leader is quite logical.
But is Little Dragon Girl seeing a Xi Shi through her lover’s eyes?"
Huang Rong tested again.
She was clever, quick-witted, and shrewd to the extreme.
How could this super recluse, super innocent Little Dragon Girl be her match?
In just a few exchanges, everything she had was laid bare, every word spoken clearly and completely.
Huang Rong got her answer and couldn’t help but sigh.
She thought to herself:
"From Little Dragon Girl’s words and expressions, one can tell she truly has deep affection for Ding Ling!
Adoration to the extreme!
And her interactions and encounters with Ding Ling were all shared openly.
It’s rather clear.
Ding Ling is frank and straightforward, decisive in action!
He lacked any baseness or vileness, and when Little Dragon Girl was severely injured, he didn’t take advantage to do anything sordid.
It was even Little Dragon Girl who pursued him actively.
Obviously, Ding Ling is indeed not bad at all.
It’s just that his inclination towards violence is a bit too pronounced."
And it is this decisiveness towards violence.
That made Huang Rong quite apprehensive and cautious.
In other aspects, Ding Ling is neither humble nor arrogant, courteous and proper, cheerful and magnanimous, straightforward as a winnowing fan, in no way inferior to a typical gentleman or overlord.
This deeply impressed Huang Rong.
However, this tendency toward violence, Huang Rong found hard to agree with.
Yet thinking of the current chaotic world, it indeed needs someone like Ding Ling, who is decisive in action, to restore order, so she sighed again, getting a bit lost in thought:
"Does the old Gang Leader see this as well, which is why he wants Ding Ling to assist us?
Thinking this,
she thought of the Wu Brothers, Wu Santong, Guo Fu, and others.
Unable to resist, she bade farewell to Little Dragon Girl, and went inside the courtyard to find Guo Fu, Ke Zhen’e, and others, specifically instructing them.
Guo Fu was extremely frustrated, having been publicly scolded by Huang Rong, and now being reprimanded privately, she couldn’t help but feel discontent, saying crisply:
"Mother, what is there to fear about Ding Ling?
You are the Hero Guo revered across Jiuzhou, and one of the most famous Gang Leaders of the Beggar Gang.
My grandfather is one of the Five Extremes in Martial Arts, Island Master of Peach Blossom Island.
In this world, who is there that we need to fear or be cautious of?!
Ding Ling?
He doesn’t deserve that!"
Ke Zhen’e said nothing nearby, only sighing somewhat gloomily.
Obviously, not speaking out to rebuke or criticize Ding Ling was something exceedingly frustrating and unpleasant for him!
"What do you know?!"
Huang Rong glared, chastising:
"If I don’t stop you in time, offending Ding Ling, even ten lives wouldn’t be enough for him to spare."
"Would he dare kill me?!"
Guo Fu did not believe it:
"With my father and mother, and my grandfather around, would he dare to act?!"
"Don’t be skeptical."
Huang Rong shook her head, her expression complex as she said:
"Ding Ling is indeed one of the most rare strongmen in the world, let alone your father, mother, and grandfather.
Even if more people came, they would likely be defeated by him."
"How could he be that strong?!"
Guo Fu’s face changed dramatically, unbelieving:
"Mother, it’s one thing for Father to say that, but why are you saying it too?!
Is he really that scary?"
"He is extremely frightening!"
Huang Rong affirmed:
"Do you know how formidable Kublai’s subordinate Kebineng of Mongolia is?
In just a few days, he accomplished great feats, winning several major victories!
Yet such a character, leading over ten thousand elite troops and countless martial arts heroes,
was still killed by Ding Ling..."
Huang Rong meticulously recounted the process.
She had heard bits from the Little Dragon Girl and gathered more information from elsewhere.
Consolidating it all together.
’Processed’ ’turned into’ ’a work of art’!
At this moment, with her inflection and tone, it was like a storyteller narrating a tale.
Guo Fu and Ke Zhen’e listened in a daze.
The Wu Brothers, not far off, also listened clearly, and could not help but be so frightened they almost rolled onto the ground.
They truly hadn’t expected Ding Ling to be so fierce and terrifying!
Guo Fu, after listening, turned pale as paper, somewhat frightened, rather fearful, yet somewhat disbelieving:
"How could there be such a terrifying person in the world?"
"That’s just how it is."
Huang Rong sighed:
"If I hadn’t heard it with my own ears, I wouldn’t believe it either.
"Is that what the Little Dragon Girl said?"
Guo Fu pouted and said:
"She’s biased towards her own husband, so she purposefully exaggerates."
"Little Dragon Girl isn’t the kind of person you think she is."
Huang Rong said:
"Your mother can still tell who’s lying and who’s not.
The Little Dragon Girl is very easy to get along with, an extremely pure and kind girl.
You mustn’t bully her!"
"How would I dare?"
Guo Fu said, feeling wronged:
"You’ve painted Ding Ling as so terrifying.
If I bullied his wife, wouldn’t he beat me to death?!"
"It’s good that you know!"
Huang Rong sighed:
"I’m also doing this for your sake.
You’re young and inexperienced, spoiled by us since childhood!
Reckless and rude!
It’s fine if you offend some people, but is Ding Ling someone you can provoke?
I’m afraid that if you, without discretion, act like you usually do, oblivious to etiquette, and end up provoking Ding Ling, your father and I will find it very hard to cope."
"I got it."
Guo Fu, her fair face scrunched into a frown:
"I’ll definitely keep far away from Ding Ling and his wife, and if I see them, I’ll go around three feet away!"
Huang Rong, upon hearing this, initially wanted to say: ’You don’t need to go that far, just remember to be polite and cautious.’

There’s no telling she might really do something irrational.

and she’s already moved to tears.

chapters.title: Chapter 449: Spiral Nine Shadows Full Level! Nine Yin Scripture Full Level
paragraphs: The matters on Huang Rong’s side.
Ding Ling was unaware of.
He was learning the Nine Yin Scripture from Guo Jing.
The entire Nine Yin Scripture is extremely complex and formidable.
Ding Ling first learned the martial arts recorded in the Nine Yin Scripture.
Guo Jing first demonstrated and practiced the advanced lightweight skill ’Spiral Nine Shadows’ to Ding Ling.
This technique combines body technique, stepping technique, and gang qi into one!
If mastered, one could rise several meters off the ground, and fly dozens of miles as if it were ordinary.
Not only that.
After mastering it, once the lightweight skill technique is activated, a layer of natural gang qi forms around the body to attack external enemies.
Upon reaching the perfect realm, nine shadows could be conjured!
Extremely extraordinary!
Guo Jing only practiced it once.
Ding Ling briefly recalled.
A book condensed in the library.
[Spiral Nine Shadows Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.4]
[Constitution +0.2]
From the attribute points increase in the four-dimensional attributes, it was clear.
This technique indeed surpassed all the previous lightweight body techniques Ding Ling had learned.
Though Snake Slither and Fox Flip were extraordinary, they couldn’t compare to this Spiral Nine Shadows.
Whirling!
After Ding Ling reached full level, he moved within the room, stirring up gusts and waves as he instantly conjured nine shadows.
Each shadow looked as real as it could be, and for a moment, it was hard for anyone to distinguish the real from the fake!
Guo Jing was shocked, wide-eyed, and incredulous.
When Ding Ling landed and the nine shadows reconverged into one, he finally gasped, saying very shockedly,
"I originally didn’t quite believe what Elder Gang Leader Hong said in the letter. After all, how could there possibly be a divine being in this world who learns instantly and refines it in no time.
Now it seems, I really was a frog in a well, not knowing that the world could have someone as incredibly gifted as you, Ding Ling."
Upon finishing his words.
He felt deeply ashamed,
"Comparing myself to you, my aptitude is hopelessly inadequate."
He didn’t seem to want to dwell on the subject too much further, but after witnessing Ding Ling’s martial talent, he placed more trust in the letter’s contents.
He didn’t first pass down to Ding Ling the Overview of the Nine Yin Scripture and other crucial Chapters, but instead used other martial arts to test whether the contents of the letter were true.
Now it seems, it wasn’t false at all!

The corners of his eyes twitched twice, his expression somewhat unnatural, just like a poor student facing a super scholar; the kind of overwhelming, oppressive sense from such an unearthly learning speed indeed made Guo Jing, despite being upright, mature, and steady, unable to stay calm before someone like Ding Ling.
"Next, I’ll pass on to you Ghost Realm’s Howling Wind. This is a sound wave skill. It harms with sound, traps souls with sound, and can deploy gang qi with sound, with boundless power..."
Guo Jing began to explain the technique.
Before long, he finished speaking.
Ding Ling closed his eyes.
A book condensed in the library again.
[Ghost Realm’s Howling Wind Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.2]
This is a sound wave martial art quite similar to Lion’s Roar.
What sets it apart from Lion’s Roar is.
This martial art, when roared, sounds like the howling of hellish ghosts, bringing gusts of cold wind, making one feel as if covered by frost, shivering involuntarily.
After Ding Ling reached full level, he slightly roared towards Guo Jing.
Guo Jing couldn’t withstand it, waving his hands constantly, saying,
"Alright, alright. Hero Ding, please stop, please stop! Let’s continue to the next one!"
He said with some difficulty.
Being roared at by Ding Ling made him a bit dizzy.
Of course, he knew that Ding Ling didn’t use his full strength, perhaps not even a tenth of his power, yet this little power could still daze him, how formidable is that?!

Guo Jing thought that despite his endless struggle with the cultivation of Ghost Realm’s Howling Wind, unable to reach perfection, Ding Ling reached great perfection in an instant, giving him an immense sense of disparity!
In the past, no matter who he compared himself to.
Even if he was initially behind, he would often catch up later.
As for Ding Ling?
How many years less has he been cultivating?
In an instant, directly reached great perfection!
Not giving Guo Jing any chance or space to catch up!
How could this not fill Guo Jing’s heart with a huge sense of frustration and disparity?!
The gap has reached such a point that it’s unspeakable.
Next.
Guo Jing subsequently taught Ding Ling the Hand Waving Five Strings, Golden Bell Shield, and other martial arts.
Without exception, Ding Ling mastered them in no time.
The four-dimensional attributes improved to:
[Strength +0.7]
[Agility +0.7]
[Constitution +0.8]
Some skills were truly remarkable, with attribute point increases over 0.2.
Guo Jing grew numb watching this, looking at Ding Ling as though looking at a monster.
Especially after teaching him the Nine Yin Scripture Overview, Inner Power Skill, etc.
Seeing Ding Ling also achieving great success instantly.
Whirling!
Surging primordial qi flooded in from all directions, engulfing Ding Ling!
Seeing this scene.
Guo Jing’s body stiffened, his scalp tingled, his back broke out in a cold sweat; indeed, he was terrified to the extreme!
"Now I somewhat understand why Elder Gang Leader Hong’s letter was so earnest, so ’exaggerated,’ so assertive and powerful!"
"It turns out, it was entirely not exaggeration, but the most honest truth!"
Guo Jing’s heart surged with waves, unable to calm.

"Ding Ling, this young man, with such transcendental cultivation at a young age, is indeed an unparalleled genius. Central Divine Technique, Eastern Evil, and Western Poison are far inferior to him; this fact is truly undeniable.
Even I, Guo Jing, am absolutely far inferior to Ding Ling, not on the same level, with no comparison whatsoever."
Guo Jing understood this well.
Ding Ling’s talents are admirable, and his future achievements would be astonishingly explosive, far beyond what his current perspective could imagine.
"In that case, I have even more reason to make friends with him and guide him onto the right path."
Guo Jing couldn’t imagine how terrifying it would be if someone like Ding Ling turned to evil.
Could anyone in the world keep Ding Ling in check?
At that time, perhaps the common people would face a great calamity!

"No wonder Elder Gang Leader Hong wanted him to help guard Xiangyang, recognizing Ding Ling’s world-defying potential, hoping he would stand with the people, stand with the Great Song, rather than aiding the wicked?"
Guo Jing pondered.
Thinking of the recent difficulties in warfare.
The Great Song struggling.
He couldn’t help but feel heavy-hearted, anxious!
Yet Ding Ling’s arrival made him see a glimmer of hope!
Glimpsed a ray of victory!
"Can one person’s strength really save Xiangyang?"
Guo Jing was somewhat doubtful.
But thinking of Ding Ling’s achievements.
Looking again at Ding Ling’s terrifying progress in martial arts cultivation, his heart once again birthed a fervent light!
Ding Ling, naturally unaware of what Guo Jing was thinking at the moment.
After listening to the overview and inner power Chapters of the Nine Yin Scripture.
[Nine Yin Scripture Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
After the surging primordial qi engulfed him.
Ding Ling rapidly ran true power to absorb this qi.

However, as he suspected, this qi was not refined by the Nine Yang Divine Skill but naturally gathered into a true qi, roaming through his limbs and bones, finally pooling in the Dantian, coexisting with the Nine Yang True Water.
"Just like this... no reaction?"
Ding Ling was stunned.
In the Dantian.
The innate true qi formed into a cluster.
The Nine Yang Divine Skill gathered into eight drops of true water.
Now the Nine Yin Scripture also formed into a cluster.
"This isn’t right..."
Ding Ling sensed again.
He discovered that the three kinds of true qi were slowly approaching, yet did not interfere or fuse, appearing quite harmonious for the moment.
Upon detailed observation.
It was found that a thread of vigorous qi from the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic and Tai Chi Scripture was roaming in the Dantian, maintaining this delicate balance.
